The fee structure is like an open donation system, you can select from category 1 to 5 for every course. So students pay different fees for the same courses. Internships are difficult to get as there are soo many students in one batch.

Name: Dharansh Neema
review:
Annual fest name: Riviera,  This fest is so awesome, generally very talented high-profile celebrities come to perform. This fest is for 4 days you can search on YouTube for more info.

For a given semester 3 exams got conducted namely (CAT-1, CAT-2, and FAT), FAT is the final assessment test while CATs are to secure internal marks.
To pass a particular subject you need at least 40/100 in FAT and 50/100 in internals.

Name: Harsh Kumar
review:
I choose Computer engineering because I was quite interested in coding and tech-like things.
there are around 64 phd scholars and around 30 faculty members including assistant professors and professors in the computer engineering department, while there are around 400 students in the computer department.
professors are highly educated, some of them are from top IITs and some of them have done their education in foreign top universities and they are also good in practical knowledge as they publish research papers also.
there are two types of exams mid-term and end-term. subjects with labs are having mid-term of 20 marks and others with 25 marks and end term of labs are 40 marks and others are 50 marks. there is almost 2 months gap between the mid-term and the end-term. if anybody wants to pass he needs to attend classes and study to be eligible for tests because 75 % attendance is mandatory.There are many fests and the annual fest is Engifest which is organised in February month every year. there are so many fests like yuvaan, tech fest, innova, sports fest etc. there is almost every book related to the course in the library and books also related to UPSC are also available.
classes are fully air-conditioned and there is wifi and projector available in every class.
almost every sports pitch/ground is available like cricket, football, badminton, table tennis, basketball, lawn tennis,  volleyball, running track and chess etc. there is a website for students for exam preparation that is www.fresources.tech

review:
I've been personally interested in Computer Science for quite some time now, started my coding journey back in 11th grade at school.
The course curriculum is the usual, fairly decent amount of optional tracks offered as well.
Most of the faculty members are quite supportive. The one thing that stood out for me was the mindset of the faculty, they're not inclined towards conventional opinions, instead, they encourage you to think out of the box and go beyond books & theory to expand your knowledge & skillset. They're quite supportive whenever guidance is required and guide you through various co-curricular events like Hackathons & such. In terms of qualification, all of them are highly qualified and pretty knowledgeable.
Exams are held almost every month, with mid-semester exams and end-semester exams along with vivas and practical exams. They're fairly challenging but not absurdly difficult.Life at the campus is good. Variety of student clubs to choose from in addition to the plethora of events that take place throughout the year. The annual cultural fest Junoon is held at a great scale with an overflowing crowd. Tech fests and other technical events such as hackathons are also conducted and/or supported.
The infrastructure is great. Libraries, well-equipped labs with great connectivity, and also, a special Apple lab for students interested in the tech giant. Also a supercomputer, Param Shavak has been granted to the university by the Government of Gujarat.
The classrooms are spacious and well-lit. Sports & extracurricular activities are conducted around the clock.
The official website and portals are all developed by the students so that's quite promising and nice to have.

The students become eligible for campus placements from the 5-6th semester onwards, starting from the internships to the placements in the 7-8th semester.
The highest package offered this year was 62 lakhs per annum with an average of 8.5 lakhs per annum.
The percentage of students getting placed was around 90-95.
My plan after getting a degree is to acquire a job with a minimum pay of 15-20 lakhs per annum.
After having a few years of experience in the field, I may prepare for MBA.Life at the campus is amazing. The university recently conduct its carnival on its 25th anniversary and it was a blast.
There are many societies and the interaction is also great. You'll get to learn a lot from these societies.
There is a central library building in the University and also, and each branch has its libraries, many of the hostels also have a reading room.
Sports and extra curricular activities are also highly supported. A student will get a lot of opportunities to show their skills.

college: Asia Pacific Institute of Information Technology - [APIIT]

Name: Mohit Rawat
review:
Fees structure for my course is simple.
Every semester the fees are around 85000 for boys and around 75000 for girls (including scholarships).
There are a lot of scholarships such as:
On the basis of 12th marks,
If you are from Uttarakhand then you get a 25% scholarship,
If your father is in the army or an ex-serviceman then you get a 5 Percent scholarship,
If your sibling is also in the university then you get a sibling discount. Etc.
This college is known for its placement.
The highest package is 84.88 LPA.
And the record says 100% placement.About the course curriculum: the course curriculum is just like in every other college.
In first year they teach every subject including physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, electrical, electronic, etc.
And then after first year, you are only taught the subject which are included in your branch (for me it is computer science).
Some faculties are really great while some are not so great.
And the faculty: student ratio is really okayish.
There are a lot of students while a lot fewer faculties.

Name: Chanchal sharma
college: Madhav Institute of Technology and Science - [MITS]

Affiliation of college keeps changing with RTU and BTU. When I got admission in the college, the college was affiliated to BTU. There is no proper timing of exams in BTU. College has three different libraries, two for reading and one is an issue library.

Name: Rhik Rabha
review:

The college conducts mid-term and end-term examinations in a semester. Also, quizzes and lab assignments are also conducted. We have midterms after two and a half months after the start of the semester and end terms after the same amount of time.
Passing exams is easy if you just study occasionally even before the exams, you can pass.PECFEST(cultural) is conducted at the end of the year and PECFEST(technical) is conducted at around mid-year. Both are great and basically the same for someone who wants to enjoy. 
There are many books available in the library and you can even ask for them if a book is not there. 
Classrooms have projectors, ACs (not all), and normal chalk/whiteboards.
There are plenty of extra-curricular activities like cricket, football, basketball, tennis, Dramatics(dance+acting), singing, bhangra, editorial boards, and societies for each branch-specific thing. 
Most of the clubs are run by students only and they provide good opportunities for someone to grow in that field.

The annual fest is called Engifest, which is one of the best in the country. It is held in February or March every year. Other than these, there are many fests that happen like the E-summit, Homecoming etc. so the campus is always upto something. 
Books are always available in the library and one can issue them for the semester free of cost.
The classroom has all the basic amenities though water can be a problem, and water coolers are placed at a distance.
Sports and other activities are very good, there is an annual sports fest in which colleges from all over India participate.
There is a club for everything, Panache for fashion, Sahitya for debating, Kalakriti for art, Vibe, and Nrityangna for dance, and many more.I chose IT because it had a very great placement record with average packages upwards of 15 lacs per annum, plus it was what I was getting as per my rank.
The student-faculty ratio is good enough, teachers can develop one on one connections with students.
The faculty is highly qualified but their teaching methods can be a hit or miss. Some teachers are very good but many are not. Some teachers can be a pain to work with.
Term exams were moderate in difficulty, passing is easy but scoring well is difficult. Though it doesn't matter as the grading is relative at the end.

Name: Om Mishra
review:
A Technical and Cultural fest is organized in the institute every year - CORONA and MILANGE at around December. An annual fest, ECCENTRICA is also organized every year around October. Apart from these, many other festivals are enjoyed by students which are organized by different clubs.
The library includes all the books necessary during the course for every year, every branch. Journals and newpapers are also available in the latest editions.
Most of the classrooms are smart classes with projectors, screens, and microphones. All the classes have Air Conditioning and good ventilation.
Cricket, Football, Badminton, and other games are played on campus and students participate in different games in Inter-NIT sports meet. There is also a gym, music room, badminton court, and cafeteria to enjoy and chill.
NSS has a branch in NIT Patna that is run by the students themselves. There are many clubs robotics, coding, entrepreneurship etc.Mechanical engineering opens a gate for a number of opportunities that include GATE, PSUs, Indian Engineering Services, and many other government services. Students can also go for private companies.
The faculty-student ratio in NIT Patna is around 1:20. There are adequate faculty members in the college.
All of the professors and assistant professors have done Ph.D. from prestigious institutes around the world. Most of the faculty members have good teaching skills, but some of them are still preferring the years-old method of memorization which sometimes feels quite boring.
Exams are held two times in a semester, Mid-sem and End-sem. Class tests are also taken occasionally. Passing the semester exams are very easy, But maintaing a good CGPA is not so easy.

Annual Cultural Fest 'Rhythm' is conducted and various other cultural fest are organized. However, due to Covid, the annual cultural fest has not been organized in the recent past but it will be organized in the year 2023. Annual Technical Fest Technova was organized in 2022. 
Saraswati Library provides all the required books that one may need during their course journey. There are various other novels, research papers, magazines, and newspapers available in the library.
The classrooms have all the basic facilities, including air conditioners. There are smart classrooms as well.
There are great sports facilities at the University. There is the University Team for every sport and there are fields for all the sports.
There are many cultural and technical societies, for instance, the Musical Society ' Goonj', the dramatics society ' Jzaa' and 'Skaa', Entrepreneurship Cell, the Robotics society 'Thinkbots', and Western and Traditional Folk Dance Groups.The fess is quite low, thus it is economical and feasible for a middle-class student to pursue higher education in the institute without much problem, Yeah there are several scholarships as well, various category scholarships as well 10 % topper scholarship in which the 10% topper of each semester are given scholarships.

Name: Shubhi Verma
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review:
I took this course as the placement was very nice in this college and being a girls-only college it provides a very safe space for girls to grow. also, they introduced ece ai as a new branch and since it has a lot of future scopes I took this course. also ece ai is allowed to sit in tech placements.
faculty to student ratio is well maintained you will surely face no problem.
most of the faculties are phds some are research interns and all of them are well qualified in there fields.
in our college exams take place only twice. one time in mid-semester for 30 marks and then at the end an end semester exam takes place of 60 marks which is very easy to qualify for.our annual fest is taraangna and the tech fest is named innerve .both occur in February or march. they are said to be one of the best north India fests with stars like javed ali,darshan raval, and many standup comedians and singers.
the library is not very big but yes it has all the books required for academic help.
half of the classrooms have ac in them. the infrastructure is not that great though.
we have a single ground that is shared by another college named Ambedkar university. the ground is not very big so our sports fest synergy takes place in jln ground in Delhi.
there is a club for literally everything but only half of them are active.

Name: Bansikumar hirenbhai ujeniya
review: I like coding and building apps. so, I select the computer branch. this branch gives knowledge of hardware and software to computer engineering students. faculties are good. simple teaching methods and all the facilities have a master's degree in his/her subjects. mid sem. and end-sem exams are taken by colleges and universities in a whole semester.Fest and all are not permanent for every year. we got a big library over the college campus. all knowledgeable, history and your branch's subjects books are also available in this library. sports week and other curricular activities are conducted every year. we have college id on every social media platform.

Name: Shubham Kumar Mahato
review:
The campus is awesome in the campus as multiple big events take place every year, normal events take place every month and small events are on almost all alternative days.
Dhoom is the annual fest in the university that takes place from the end of Feb to the start of April every year and Projection is the tech fest that takes place in the middle of Feb month every year.
Limited books in the library, Also the library is only open during college hours.
Classrooms are average from the inside, but outside class, everything is too good and well maintained
No indoor sports complex, Sports grounds , equipment are available almost everything, but as here 10K+ students reside inside hostels, comparing to that, sports grounds & facilities are very less
GDSC PU is a club for all, and very fewer student clubs are there, many cells are there.I had taken computer science engineering, as in Parul University most placements are in cse only and also I am a tech guy from childhood.
here, lots of faculty are there, but students are here in huge no. so, 1 teacher is assigned for each batch(approx 60students)
most of the faculty here have done masters & less are Ph.D. holders, the Teaching method is average, not much interaction & practical explanation, however, some good teachers are also there.
3 exams are there each semester. 1st is weekly exam, 2nd is mid-sem exam & 3rd is end-sem exam. exam passing difficulty is too easy, most questions come from previous papers & assignments.

Name: Khushi Chauhan
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review:
I chose ECE as it's a technical branch and most of the companies visiting campus allow it. The basic aim of getting into this college is to get placement which is its best part. 
The faculties are not very good and you have to do things on your own. Exams are easy, anyone who studies a week before the exam can easily pass them.The campus is very small, and Life is not very good but yeah the cultural fest Tauranga is the best part of igdtuw. many celebs like javed ali, darshan raval have come here. The classrooms are not very good, they don't have AC. labs are also not very equipped. There are many clubs and societies which are active.

Name: Manikandan
review: On our campus we have so many technical and non-technical clubhouses which come under the name of SANGAMAM & IGNITRON and students can enhance their skills through them. These clubhouses are completely handled by the students of kpriet and also have Instagram accounts for it (ignitron_kpriet, sangamam_kpriet). There are various events being organized by our students in the name of FIESTAA and hostel day, annual day will be celebrated yearly. There are more numbers of journals and books available in our library and library management will offer us to buy books every year. Our institution supports sports strongly because our principal mam is also one of the most eminent people in sports and also our students went to various colleges and won many prizes and you can refer to that on the official website of the institution.First of all, I did choose the chemical engineering course as my domain. By some analysis, I did choose it and also this course has so many opportunities abroad and we will have fewer competitors. The bond between faculties and students is nice and we will have a mentor for each and they will take care till college ends. The ratio of faculty and students is equal that is we will work with them on their projects and so on. Mostly, the college recruits the faculties who completed their studies in IIT and experienced ones. So the teaching method is nice. The management will give us the schedule of the respective semester before it is started. The questions will be asked in exams that are taken in class only. so it will be easy to pass the examinations.

Name: Rahul Agrahari
college: Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology - [GCET]
review:
I have chosen this course because my percentile is not that enough that I could get a computer science branch so I have opted for this in this college, but this stream also gives good placement from this college.
Faculties are enough in college. The faculties are good and helpful. They are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Their teaching method is also good. Term exams are like one time in one and a half months and it is easy to pass if you have attended the college throughout the semester.Unifest is the annual fest of our college. It is organized in the month of April and a departmental fest is also organized by every department. The library facility is quite good. Books related to the course are available for students. Classrooms are like our schools. They should be more based on projectors. Cricket Grounds and basketball courts are available in the college. The student council is the main club of our college.

Name: faisal
college: Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology - [RKGIT]
review: I choose the post because in recent years B. Tech computer science demand was going very faster in the faculty ratio is one ratio 20 of the faculty holders are post-graduation and for some of the faculty or PC Ph.D. holders, the sessional exams are four times in one semester.The fee hike of the policy is not the 4 years means remains the same the years is a scholarship available of the UP Government Samaj Kalyan Vibhag but in only it and the EC branch because these branches are NBA accurate yes job opportunities are also available in the campus.

Name: Abhiram K
review:
The students are eligible from the 6th semester for the placement. Companies like Cred, TCS, NTT Data, Accenture, Capgemini, tech Mahindra, and Mercedes Benz visited our college. 
The highest package is 15 LPA,
The lowest package is 2 LPA,
The average package is 4lpa,
The percentage of students getting placement is 90.
My plan is to do a master's after completing the degree.The annual fest did here in the month of June. Ananya is the event name. There is a very vast library with a number of collections in that and very useful it has a reading room where we can complete our assignments and other things. There is little scope for sports. Less equipment and small ground. Our college has an IEEE club, an NSS club, and many more.

Name: Mohit
college: Faculty of Engineering & Technology College, Agra College
review: I want To take Computer Science From 12th I love to do Coding so I take the computer science branch. There is a 120-student class. There are some good teachers in the college. Exams happen 2 times a year and it is difficult to pass them.there are 55000 Fees per year and there is a high cost to study. you can get the benefit of a scholarship but I can't receive any benefit of a scholarship. There is no job support from the college on campus you have to apply off campus.

Name: Anupriya Singh
college: Parul Institute of Engineering and Technology - [PIET]
review: The campus is really amazing and far better than other colleges. Every month they are organising fests like Projections, Dhoom, New year Party, Halloween Party, Fresher's party, EDM nights, etc. We have big libraries and reading rooms with all the facilities. We have cricket ground , Badminton court , volleyball ground, basket ground , football ground etc. They organize extra curricular activities like dance, singing, speeches, drawing, painting, art, etc. They have there youtube channel and Instagram profile too.There are a lot of scopes in the CSE and IT sector so I preferred this course. Our faculties were also engineers and some of them are Masters in CSE and IT sectors. Every week we are having weekly exams and assignments. Practical exams were hard to clarify. Final exams were also not so easy to get passed. Per semester we were having one mid sem exam and one final exam.

Name: Devansh madne
review: After the fourth and sixth semesters onwards you can get placement offers and internship offers from various companies like Goldmann sach, google, Wipro, etc with many high and low packages. You can go off-campus for placements.Abhivyakti, kshitiz, and tech fest (TF) are conducted in this college every month. Institute offers state of art facilities to its students, including well-equipped ground and sports facilities for extracurricular activities.

Name: ABHISHEK
college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review: I have an interest in computer science and its industry .. I can relate myself with coding and developing stuff so I choose this course in miet ..there is 1 mentor of the 30 students who they did PhD in their subjects and there is assistant prof. Who also doing PhD in teaching ..if you ask about academics are enough good to deliver you what they have .. there are two times in a whole sem which is known as sessional and then one put which is done before the semester's main exam and then, at last, we have to give the university semester exam to clear the semester.There are many fests held on campus. Some of them are kolhahal, rangotsav, dandiya night, robot fest, tech fest and many more small and big fests... And there are e-library and one central library and every block has its own library too and no need to pay for the book. Just needed is ur library card to take any book . And the college provides good sports facilities too like basketball, volleyball, football, kho kho, billiards, poll, etc there are many social groups there in colleges like a dance community, a painting community, its community and many more ...

Name: Madhav Agarwal
college: Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology - [RKGIT]
review:
life on campus is very good and secure. our campus is securely protected 24*7 by guards and CCTV cameras.
there is a dedicated library of books and journals which is available for students at every time.
The college also offers many other sports facilities for the students, so that they can play in their spare time.College fees-
for 1st year is-132000/-
for 2nd year onwards-111500/-
Hostel fees-
for double seater-82000/-
There are many scholarships provided by colleges and the government also(referred by the college).college is also very helpful for getting scholarships to all students.

Name: Moin Mairaj
review:
The fee structure is based on family income.
The fee is to be submitted on semester bases.
Students with income above 8 lakhs have a semester fee of Rs 73,000 and those with lower than 1 lakh have a fee of Rs 10,000
College does provide financial assistance to deserving candidates.
Stipend does exist for many courses like MTech or PhD but not for BTech.I choose this course because I wanted to be a software developer.
The faculty at NIT Srinagar is good all are well-educated and very professional.
The student ratio is a typical engineering class ratio of almost 8 boys: 1 girl.
Exams are conducted twice in a semester which is mid-term and end-term examinations.
It requires effort to pass exams.

Name: Mohammed Amaan Abdul Rashid Mistry
college: Shah and Anchor Kutchhi Engineering College - [SAKEC]
review: I chose this course because I am interested in electronics things much and also in computer science so this course makes a combination of both my interests. Like in electronics, there is a signal processing thing which I personally believe is much better, and some knowledge of computer science links with electronics core subjects. The faculty-student ratio is 1:70 faculty are very friendly they help us before every semester exam whenever we want to learn at the last moment. Qualification of the faculty almost every teacher had done their Masters in their respective teaching subject and the remaining are qualified with B.E degree but their teaching method is very good they teach with practicals exam and not just theory part which helps students thinks more innovative. Terms exams are not that difficult but we need to give 2 internal exams before every semester which helps make us prepare for the semester exam without any difficulties. These engineering exams are too interesting to pass.The annual fest name is PRATISHTA and it is conducted every year in the month of February-March while conducting this all the activities of colleges are suspended except the Mumbai University examination. Tech fest is also being conducted named Aura in this fest students to use their logical and Innovative minds to present something new to the audience. Almost every subject's books are available in the college for reference purposes and their sources are 100% genuine. Amenities are enough for the students in college which attract students to class. sports like cricket badminton chess carrom are conducted in the college and prizes are given to the winners which is a different part of the fun for students. social group also run by the students is ECELL-SAKEC this is run by students and every event in the college is organized by this group.

Name: Rajni
college: World College of Technology and Management - [WCTM]
review: I wish to be a web developer, here at APPLE iOS excellence center, Panasonic center for automation, and i7 systems, and learning so many software are skilling me to get good packages in my dream company. teaching methods are very excellent, faculties provide notes on every topic and the digital library helps to get more information on curriculum topics and sub-topics. discussion on previous years' papers built confidence in a student to be presentative in the examinations. It makes it easy to get excellent marks. students can issue books from the library.APPLE iOS center, Panasonic center for automation. TCS Learning Center, skill academy, Bajaj, American Express,Jaro education, flipkart, Amazon offer Rs20000-40000/- (per month)stipend. students work on projects based on society benefits, and for this, they visit many industries Amul, Amar Ujala, NTPC, Panasonic, Incubation center at IIT  which provides opportunities to learn real techniques followed by companies.

Name: Rajmani Gautam
college: Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology & Management - [RKGITM]
review: The course curriculum was very easy the faculty ratio of students is one ratio to the qualification of the faculty most of the faculty are Ph.D. hotel holders the exam was taken four times in a semester S1 S2. The Faculty has been really helpful in the exam and also the checking is really strict.The campus life was decent. The annual fest was tatva. Sports facilities are also decent. the classroom was also decent. There are so many social group clubs were many technical clubs. The library was also good providing many books.

Name: Md Ibrahim
review: In Nit Srinagar fees didn't hike yet. If I will about scholarships, if you belong to SC/ST category then your tuition fee which is 125000/year will be exempt and you have to the registration fee, hostel fee and mess fee which is around 80000/year ( including all). if you belong to OBC/General and your income less than one lac your course fee will be equal to SC/ST categories students as I said earlier. OBC/General student's income is between 1 to 5 lac they have to pay 1.25 lac per year ( including all). OBC/General student's income greater than 5 lac have to course fees of around 2 lac per year ( including all)I chose the ECE branch in Nit Srinagar because I want to go into tech companies. Faculty most of the are good to remember it's a government college that's why you will not get good marks if you didn't give accurate answers in exams. All faculties are PhD holders. The semester happened in four months and semester exams happened timely and if you study properly you will not face any issues with exam time

Name: Utpal Kumar Kashyap
review:
The placement at my university is good.
From the 7th or after the 6th semester you will eligible for placement.
A company like HCL, JIO, BEBO TECHNOLOGY, COLLABERA ETC are visiting our campus.
This year 20 to 30 students get more than two or three offers. 
The highest package of this year is 8.5 lac now and the average is 4.5 lac.
Till now almost 90 percent of students of in my course is get placed. 
My plan after getting is not decided yet.Dharohar is the annual fest of my university.
It is organized in the month of April.
Srijan is the tech fest of the university which comes under the annual fest Dharohar you can say it is part of Dharohar.
Books and journals are available in the library or you can also access e-books.
Basic facilities are available.
Sports and extra circulars are conducted from time to time.
Pahal ek nanha kadam is social club.

Name: Manoj
review: Mechanical engineering is an industrial subject and a very interesting course. The qualifications of faculty are PhDs and Mtech and they are very good at teaching and have good knowledge about the courses. The exams are based on textbook and application questionsThe fees are normal and the cost of the study is based on courses and the number of students in the courses. The Epass scholarships are offered for qualified students and backward castes students. The jobs and internships are available for students

Name: Sneham Thakur
review:
There is an IP's biggest annual fest "Anugoon" which is held around February and March.
And small fest like cultural and tech fests are held every 3-4 months 
There is a big sports complex for badminton in our college 
There are several clubs like the science club, dancing club, adakari club, dramatics club, etcThe fees for the total course (4 years) are 493000.
The government provide a scholarship program such as the EWS scholarship and scholarship for academic excellence are provided here.
Tho there are no on-campus jobs but college provides internships for 4-6 weeks after 3rd year.

Name: Mani chourasiya
college: Prestige Institute of Engineering Management and Research - [PIEMR]
review: I want to up to date myself from the current technology and the need of the market and cooperate world that's why i choose this course the ratio of the students is 60:40,faculty is Highly qualified in their particular field some appear masters and some appear doctorate in their field,the exams are conducted as 3 mid-semester test and once University semester exam.The fees structure of the course are as follows for computer science and electronics and communication fees are 72k the post metric scholarship is provided by state government according to category and a scholarship name CHHAVI JAIN SCHOLARSHIP is provided by college based on percentile

Name: Shashank kumar srivastava
review:
I chose the branch of Computer Science And Engineering with the specification in Data Science.
the Faculty of the college is very good their behaviour is good and found very supportive, always be there to help you.
the qualifications of faculties are good to teach you enough to understand some faculties are qualified from IITs and some also have teaching experience in abroad colleges and universities.
examinations were held timely, and there are 2 sessionals 1 pre-university and a final University Paper held in 1 semester.The cost for study at my college is not much, the cost per year is approx 110000. if you got any benefits from special reservations you will get the course free of cost you don't have to pay any academic fees for all four years.
scholarships are also given by the University and Govt. also.
jobs and internship opportunities are also good. more than 90% of students are got placed in campus recruitment.

Name: TARUN S
review: I have a wonderful life at agni college of technology. the placement in agni college of technology is very good for students who are studying here coz there will get confirmed placement in their core for a decent package. the placement cell is working hard to make the students placed in companies.There are more than 100 companies that are welcoming to take the students for the best packages and the internship is too good in this college. the students should get an internship on their own through many platforms and the staff will help students with their internship.

Name: Mahima Sree
review: From 2nd year we have training programs like programming languages, aptitude, etc. And from 3 rd year, we have placement training, students will be placed from 3 rd year. Students will attend drive form 6th sem. Many companies provide job opportunities and internships to our students.Many top companies like Tcs, hcl, Infosys, etc provide paid internships and job opportunities for students. Students are placed with high salary packs. Teachers will guide students in their projects and all other activities this will help students get placed without any difficulties.

Name: Tejas Patil
college: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering & Technology - [ADCET]
review:
It is very costly and not worth the fees Because of the teaching. But the facilities are great. They give uniforms, a bag, and study materials for the stationary fees.
By applying for a scholarship you can pay 75000 of 120000 by EBC and for the caste, it's lower.Campus Life is good in this college but it requires extra fees for the sports clubs and to enjoy the sports campus facilities. The events held in this college are good if not great. There are various clubs run by students that you can enjoy by applying.

Name: AAYUSH THAKKAR
college: Charotar University of Science and Technology - [CHARUSAT]
review: You get eligible for placements after they come into the 7th sem. Companies like TCS, MEDITAB, E-INFOCHIPS, CREST, WIPRO etc are the major recruiters. More than 100 companies visit the campus every year. Last academic year highest package was 18LPA and the average package was 5LPA. Above 90% of the students applying for placements get a good placement from the campus.The infrastructure is fantastic the whole campus is around 140 acres with various amenities, sports grounds, and indoor sports. Every class has projectors, ACs, and well-lighted classrooms. And libraries are like an ocean of books you can get books related to every field in the library.

Name: Raju Kumar Thakur
review:
You can assume that every course fees are same
Of Rs 2.20 lakh for the first year.
Yes, University provides scholarships for students who had a family income less than from benchmark mark of the rupee just they have to show valid documents that show their eligibility to grant scholarships.
On campus, you could have lots of opportunities to grab internships and also gets a chance to work with startupsYes, you will experience a very good life on the campus as talking about social life you will interact with International students and also the student from the master's background and from the design background there are lots of students to talk to elaborate your skills. 
 one of the most famous  annual fests is engifest and recently we had a literature and film fest we called it YUVAAN23

Name: Mohnish Dutt
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Fees per semester are nearly 1.2 lakhs for the general category whose family income is more than 5 lakhs. And for general category students with a family income between 1 to 5 lakhs and all OBC students get a remission of 2/3 of tuition fees which are 1 lakh per semester. And whose family income is less than 1 lakh will get full remission of tuition fees and a 100 per cent tuition fee waiver for sc /st / pwd students. 
And there are lots of scholarship here for students.Life on campus is fun but academics here at IITK are more difficult than at other IITs. Fests time is too much enjoyable there is a total of 3 fests but something keeps going on campus for a year. Lecture Hall has AC and a lot of places on campus to study. Sports and other facilities are great and there are too many clubs, societies, and teams run by the student body to discover and live their passion.

Name: Kumar Gunjan
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Annual fest - Antaragni in October, Tech fest - techkriti in March. 
Almost all curriculum books are available in the library.
All classrooms have AC and projectors
One of the best sports infrastructures in our college. Almost all sports are played

Student Gymkhana website of iitk and all other club websitesThere is an organisation called the student's placement office - which manages all placements and internships given to students. Amazon, Mahindra, Microsoft and many more companies recruit for internships
I haven't sit for an internship or placement yet so can't say much about it

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Playground is quite small so there's not enough area for you to choose where to sit.
Since I have came into this college, there's only one fest happened & other was the dandiya night.
Club members will help you in every way if you really want to know & learn. They will teach you in the field you want to go.They will provide you many internship opportunities but you need to be skillful to attempt and get into them. Your basic knowledge will take you to reach higher goals. Many companies approach them, but since I'm in 2nd year i haven't got the chance to meet and greet the companies.

Name: Divyanshu Singh
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Placement season comes every year likely for last year's students. The company from various fields including cooperate and research-based companies are present. 
The average package is like 10 to 15 lakhs CTC and the highest fits cores.
Almost everybody gets placed though depending on the skill of the person also.Companies come to grant internship opportunities after every summer break.
Moreover, information about internships is also circulated via mail between semesters. 
Companies for both research and industrial sectors grant internship opportunities.

Name: Junaid Ahamd Teli
review:
Students here at the National Institute of Technology Srinagar start getting placed right from the 6th semester. The main recruiting 
 companies include wirpo, Tesla, Maruti, Hyundai, Tata, etc. Also, some government jobs offer by PSU companies. Our institution recorded a sky-high percentage of placements last year which was about 85% overall with students getting at an average of 15-20 LPA and the highest of 45 LPA.The fee structure here at the National Institute Of Technology Srinagar varies over ranges.
Suppose if your family income is less than 1LPA, you'll get a 100% fee concession. However if your family income is between 1-5LPA, you need to pay 1/3 of the tuition fee and if it's above 5LPA, you need to pay the full tuition fee which is about 75k per semester.

Name: Kamlesh Patel
review:
You are in dtu, so your campus life will be excellent.
Cultural Council and LFC are the main cultural councils of dtu. And a lot of tech society's like IEEE, siam, Innova, e-cell etc present in college. 
Engifest, yuvaan, homecoming, aarambh, pehli mulakaat are some cultural fest of dtu. 
Invictus is the annual tech fest of dtu. 
Aahavan is the annual sports feat. 
So you can imagine your college life is going to be awesome.Yes, companies come to dtu for internships. 
But very less no. Of students get internship opportunities at the campus. If you are a tech student and you have mentioned well cgpa then you can get an internship at the campus. 
Sprinkler gives max 2,00,000 stipend for an internship. And the average stipend was approximately 55,000.

Name: Sai teja
review:
Computer science has scope nowadays so I chose this course and also I have some interests in coding. The faculty-student ratio is good and faculty is available in cabins the whole day. Faculty is having good knowledge of their subjects. Exams are conducted every 30 to 40 days and are easy to moderate levelIiit Nagpur has high costs/fees for study.
 But you can avail of scholarships also on the basis of category or state level and national level scholarships are also available. You can get good jobs with your coding skills with a stipend of approximately 60k to 1lakh.

Name: Aryan
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review: I chose this course because of my rank. The ratio here is around 300-400 students for first-year students but after that, it reduces to around 50-100 students depending on the department they are enrolled in here. The faculty are highly qualified and great at teaching. But exams are tough here so you need to study regularly.The fee is around 1.3 lac per semester which is similar to other IITs as well. Being a general category student I don't get to avail any of the scholarships or financial aid provided but still, loans are available if students find it difficult to pay.

Name: Deham Rajvanshi
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
IIT Kanpur is a big campus with an area of over 1000 acres. The library is old and has lakhs of books. Udghosh is the annual Sports fest of IIT Kanpur.
Techkriti is the annual technical fest. Antaragni is the annual Cultural Fest. Students from all parts of the country participate in all the festsThis was the best option for me according to my rank. IIT Kanpur is considered one of the best colleges for electrical engineering. The lab facilities at IIT Kanpur are great. The most important reason for choosing IIT Kanpur for me was the culture and the facilities provided here.

Name: Tabish shabir
review:
Our college has around 20+ clubs. We celebrate holidays like religious festivals, Freshers, farewell, Teachers' day, women's day, etc.
All types of books available in the library related to our courses and GK and also journals.
Classrooms are maintained well. 
Enter-campus tournaments are conducted, and students are trained for public speaking.
We have TEDX, Semicolon, and Zerod4y, like clubs.After the end of the 6th semester, students apply for placement and till the 8th semester, the maximum number of students get placed.
Companies like IBM, NTPC Limited, Indian Oil Corporation, Brillio, HCL technologies, Microsoft, Bharat petroleum, Wipro, Lowe's,  Tally solutions, etc
65% of students are getting placed on average.
I will go for placement after getting my degree.

Name: Kumar sambhav
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review: Antragni  udgosh techkriti are the cultural and tech fedt of college. It is Asia's famous fest. the classroom has full facilities like a projector, speaker, and big screen. in IIT there are classrooms with 600 student capacity.Job opportunity is good. The average package is 17 lakh. IIT Kanpur gives scholarships to needy ones. So one can easily go for that course. Fees are approx 1 lakh but one with an income lower than 1 lakh needs no tuition fees

Name: Lakshita
review:

I appeared for the EBC scheme of Maharashtra where I get scholarships of Rs 1000.& to pay half the fees for college. After completion of 3 years, the university provides an internship of 4 months where students get to experience and a stipend.

Name: VIBHANSHU SHRIVASTAVA
review:
moonstone is the name of the fest, and one of the best fest u will in our city now talking about different fests they all are done by the club members we have different clubs.

1:20,
they are well qualified and good as well.
it was easy and most of the lectures are about 1hr - 2hr long.
and to talk about the curriculum was well prepared as well as well developed.

Name: hariom rathore

although students can apply for the scholarship which is provided by the government.I chose this course because it's very demanding nowadays and I am interested in this course from school time.
faculty is well experienced and their way of teaching is good, above average.
exams are conducted every month in the form of internal tests.

Name: Rehan
review: The hike policy and the cost of the study are too costly for the students.  On our campus there are two types of scholarships first is a national scholarship and the second is a government scholarship. The job we get from the university is professor teacher and assistant and many more with good stipend.From the 7th semester, students become eligible for campus placement there are many companies that visited our campus and many offers are made the highest package is 21 lakh per annum and the average package is 6 lakh per annum 80 cents of students get placement after I get the degree I go for a job.

Name: Pranav
review:
Life at campus is not much exciting we are always short on attendance to have a social life, clubs are average and infrastructure is not up to the mark.
There are many books in Library but there is shortage of important books.
Sports is dead in our college there is no focus on sports section.
Till now there is no special extra curricular activities in the campus.
Photography club, cultural club etcDuring counseling session a faculty from institute guided me for course registration.
1:20
Teachers do teach in class seriously with 100% efforts.
Teaching methods are vintage can be improved.
Qualification of teachers are unknown.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Course Curriculum was totally updated which helps the students to get industry ready by the end of the B.E Programme. Each and Every Faculties in our college is Mtech and PhD Holder and Few have completed their Mtech Degree from IITs and NITs. The teachers are so friendly and they have good teaching skills. Always help the students. From the academic year 2021, UGC has been granted Autonomous Status to the Sahyadri. Sem Exams will be conducted every 4 months from the day of the beginning of Sem. The difficulty level of Exams was Moderate.The Fee Structure depends on what Quota you were getting into a college. Through KCET it's around 85k/yr and through Comed-k it will be 300000/yr through the Management the fee will be 350000 to 400000 per year for CSE/IS and its allied courses. Many Premiere Companies like Google, MS, Wipro, SAP, etc. visit the college every year to recruit students. And almost 90% of them are placed on Campus this year.

Name: Sarvesh  Biwalkar
college: Smt Kashibai Navale College of Engineering - [SKNCOE] Vadgaon
review:
The faculties available here are well educated mostly ME or PhD holders from renowned institutions and colleges. Bonding between faculties and students is good so students get their help of them at any time during college hours. As the college is affiliated to sppu(Pune university) exams are conducted by them.Colleges provide internships also but the percentage of internships is less. For internships, various companies visit here like jio, TCS, Accenture, etc. 
But we get internships from our campus also this year one girl from TE is having paid internship of nearly 1lakh per month.

Name: Abhishek verma
college: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology - [SVNIT]
review: College life is awesome. The annual cultural and technical fests are Sparsh and mind bend and after that celeb, the night is also there. The library is actually very good all the books are there and the e-library is also available. the department buildings are newly made that's why it is very good. In svnit we have a big ground where we have two basketball courts, two volleyball courts, two lawn tennis, two badminton court, and a big ground for cricket, football, and other games. It also has a gym and table tennis. Svnit has many clubs such as Raag for music, Akriti for arts, dancing club, economical club, and many more.Fees are a little bit high if you do not get any scholarship or fee remission it will charge around 1.5 lakhs per annum but if your family income is between 1 to 5 lakhs per annum you receive 2/3rd fee remission in tuition fees which are 62500 and if it is below 1lakh per annum then your full tuition fees will waive. If you have SC/ST or PWD benefits then also your full fees were waived.

Name: Aman Bhardwaj
review: According to the university curriculum, teachers complete the syllabus timely and also take the unit test when it is scheduled. The syllabus is not very difficult and it can be easily completed with very less effort before exams if you are regularly in classes.College fees are highly expensive in comparison with other government colleges and fees increase by 10 percent after each consecutive year. But financial assistance is provided by University on basis of total family income up to 100 percent tuition fees waiver.

Name: Aditya
review:
Life on the campus is excellent. The campus is covered by trees and nature. 
There are two major fests of the college that occur every year, those are Hill'ffair( the annual cultural fest) and Nimbus( the annual technical fest).
There are various clubs in the college which students can join according to their interests.My branch is electrical engineering here. As known by all, being the toughest of all branches here also its is the toughest branch. Subjects are interesting but difficult. The faculty is experienced and a bit strict too. There are mid sems and end sems every semester.

Name: Saakshi Gupta
review: The infrastructure of the college is the best thing all over. It is quite spread over and it is overall nicely maintained. The infrastructure of the hostels is average but overall manageable. There are many blocks where different course classes are held. There are 2 libraries. Very lively indeed, the college has a good strength of students. There are various clubs as well and extracurricular activities happen once in a while. Also, many hackathons and events are held quite often.The course curriculum focuses on web development first then full stack. The faculty is qualified and very helpful. As per the student ratio though, one faculty is not enough. Would like the class to be divided into groups of students further. The faculty teaches all theory during class hours and during lab hours they focus on practicals more. Exams are held every month as per the course curriculum and duration, they are quite hard but can be managed to pass.

Name: Shiridi reddy
college: Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences - [ANITS]
review: If study well you get a good job and placement in a good company like TCS or amazon. very helpful Jagan anna vidya devena is one of the scholarships provided by the government for some reservation students and they are very helpfulTech fest is very high level and the cultural activities are very good some of the teachers behave like lkg staff they treat like student lkg students some of them are good and nice manner and many are also a little bit good

Name: Papan kumar biswas
review: The fees of any stream is a different but the minimum fee for every stream is 400000 in my stream csbs( computer science and business systems) fees are 500000. All scholarships ar provide in our college like svmcm, sitaram Jindal, and many more.In this college when you passed the 4th semester then you are eligible to apply for internship and placement. Many students get internships in their dream companies like TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, Amazon, swiggy, and many more.

Name: Md Shazeed
college: Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology & Management - [ADGITM]
review: There is a good placement I heard that out of 100 students 80 student are placed which is good I think and highest package is around 45 lakh and the average package is 5 lakh which is a little bit low it is good if it goes above 10lakh after 3th-year student are eligible for placement and student require above 8.5 cgpa to get an interview of all the companies and big companies come there like wipro, TCS, Accenture etcI am an Artificial intelligence and data science btech student and this course fee is 118000 now this fee is increased by 20000 which is 138000. Name: Aditi jain
review: For every year one internship is compulsory that can be done outside also or under the guidance of the teachers within the department can be done and proper evaluation is done so that students take it seriously. There is no restriction for the subject of interest.For 2020 the fees were 2 lac per year but for 2021 it git increased to 2 lac 20 k per year. However several scholarship schemes like nsp and ssp are valid here also through kcet exam the fees are near to 50k per year but it is only for residents of Karnataka.

Name: Jayveersinh Jadeja
college: L.J. Institute of Engineering and Technology - [LJIET]
review:
Nowadays there is a full demand for IT engineers in IT departments. So there is no regret in choosing a degree in IT engineering. Also, there are lots of professional faculties in our institute as it is a private Institute. Faculties use teaching hours very effectively.
Every 2-3 weeks there is a term test and the level of toughness is average.As of now, LJ college is deemed it uses its own fee structure of 73000 per year. Students have to pay fees every semester. Most students are eligible for MYSY scholarships and colleges also provide scholarships other than MYSY for those who are not eligible i.e. additional scholarships.

Name: Abhinay Bajpai
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review:
I chose this course because it has also Artificial intelligence and machine learning which will be taught in 6th semester to us, unlike traditional CSE branches.
In first year of btech faculty is very good and supportive, they are very strict also.They teach you everything and give notes also at the end moment but also make you submit assignments on time .
Student to faculty ratio is satisfactory with different facilities for labs and classrooms for even the same subject.
Faculty in the first year are qualified and teach you everything A to Z, however, in the third semester you will see that faculty are not teaching properly and little less qualified than first-year one but in the third year your faculties will again be good, and qualified and even less strict.
Exams are held timely with two sessional and one pre-University test.
Even if you fail in any sessional you have to give retest until you pass.
Those who fail are even required to attend extra classes of one hour with respective faculty.Placement of students is good or satisfactory we can say at GL Bajaj( in comparison to other AKTU colleges).
You are given separate technical training classes from the second year however real preparation starts from the third year and only then do students become able to be eligible for placement and internship offers.
Companies that visit are TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, and sometimes Adobe. A large no of small to medium companies also visit but they hire less no of students also.
This year Palo Alto networks visited the campus and made an offer of the highest 58 lakhs. One student got placed and it was on on-campus placement.
The average package is around 6-8 lakhs with the median being 10 ( what I have seen from my seniors)
The college tries that almost 95% of students should get placed and almost 90% of students get placed.
I am also planning to get a placement after my degree.

Name: Harsh Jain
review: From 6th semester onwards students become eligible for placement and in last year 6 months internship is compulsory. Highest package offered this year is 44 lpa by amazon given to 3 students. Average package of CSE is 7 lpa. About 80 percent students are placed here. After getting degree I would prefer to work for 2-3 years in a company and then to create a business on own.I want to be a software development engineer so I decided to choose this course. Faculty: Student ratio is 1:60 in theory classes and 1:30 in practical classes. Teachers are well qualified and some are PhD also. Teaching methods are old and boring though. In a semester 2 exams are conducted, one mid-term, 1 end term and practical exams are also conducted once.

Name: Aryan Pal
review: The fee's structure seems to be a little expensive as expected from a  government funded college. And the graduale hike in the fees of the college is also a downside, though availing for education loan is really easy and scholarship are also available for certain categories.The course curriculum is really strict and totally based on the fact that you have to get maximum output from it. The faculty members are very punctual and strict though sometimes the 75% attendance criteria can be a pain for us.

Name: Harsh Dwivedi
review:
The name of the annual fest is encore it is our cultural and technical fest celebrated in such a way as students get a chance to show their skills up to marks.
Almost all types of books and journals you will get in the library and the condition of the library is also very good, it is our resting place also.
The condition of the classrooms is not up to mark as it is made of late 90's style.
Every month some sort of sports are conducted and branch-wise fests are also conducted like ANKURAN by ece branch.students., TANTRANSH by cse students.
PARMARTH is a social club run by students of our college to teach underprivileged students from nearby slum areas.I had chosen this course because this college ranks first among all other uptu colleges and the fees are also very nominal compared to all other engineering colleges. The faculty and student ratio is very hot mark.
Faculties are very highly reputed teachers with good qualifications and degrees but they don't want to spend their energy on teaching us as happens almost everywhere.
In one semester there are two midterms and one end-semester exam which you could easily clear.

Name: Vivek
review:
The annual fest is called Swaranjali. In swaranjali various activities are played such as sports, music, dance, comedy, and any other skills you have. Here different teams are created in different departments such as civil, cse, mechanical, etc. 
They compete with each other and the winners got trophies and prizes. 
Many tech fests such as ips hackathons, ips google developer teams, etc. happen in the middle of the semester. 
All the books required for studying semester subjects are available in the library. Every student can issue 3 books on his/her id. 
Classrooms have blackboards and also smart boards for better teaching. Classrooms are well maintained. 
The college has many sports facilities such as cricket, football, basketball court, badminton court, swimming pool, skating rink, and volleyball court. 
In extracurricular activities, the college has many dances, singing fests, anchoring fests, painting, etc. 
Many social are created such as rural outreach, studying poor children, etc.I choose this course because in the field of computer and IT sector, many jobs are available and i also have some sort of interest in web designing. 
Here, faculty-student ratio is 1:70.
Most faculty are post-graduated, some are graduated and a few are also PhDs. Teaching methods are mostly traditional board methods. Some teachers may use smart boards to teach some complex topics. 
In a semester there are two mid-semester of 20 marks each. Then a semester of 70 marks is there. Exams are easy to pass as college is autonomous, so they decide their paper patterns and papers.

Name: Gurkirat Singh
review: The course curriculum is up to point and faculty members (though not experienced) are good enough for understanding. I chose this course because I have a lot of interest in computer-related technologies and wanted to do something in it. Here for 80 students, there is 1 faculty for every subject. Teacher qualification is mostly up to bachelor's or Ph.D Exams are conducted every month and we used to study for a week to be passed.Campus life is fair. Fest months are March, August, and November. The library is good enough for serious ones. Books can also be issued for 1 month from the library. The classrooms are spacious and clean. Almost every sport is present and nothing about no extracurricular activities. There is an app UHostel that is ruined by a student for gate passes.

Name: Hyman Reddy kotla
review:
Campus life is very decent and pleasant.
They conduct 2 fests in a year one is ortus which is a very event and another one is freshers both events have a traditional day.
The library is very big and we can get all types of books including every coding language book to.
Class rooms digital and also have boards.
Various social groups are conducted in the incubation centers in the college.I choose this course because I have an interest in machine learning and the teaching faculty at Vardhan college of engineering is quite good at teaching these courses.
The student-teacher ratio is 20:1 for every 20 students there Will be a teacher.
Maximum Ph.D. done lectures are teaching.
To pass an examination is quite easy.

Name: Dadhaniya Ayush
college: L.J. Institute of Engineering and Technology - [LJIET]
review: The college gives us the opportunity of an internship in internship first you have to complete 100-200 hours of course about Html Css and javascript after completing the course the college finds a company for usAmazon Microsoft has announced that it will launch its own version for Windows by the students of upcoming big universities like us so we are very happy because of this I will recommend this college very highly

Name: Umang Verma
review: Students from almost every state are present. There's a friendly atmosphere in college. The library accounts for almost all subject-related books and nothing more. There are smart classrooms, e classrooms etc present. There is a volleyball and football ground along with badminton courts. Student-run clubs include GDSC, GFG, Equilibrio and Udaan Magazine.The fees are decent enough. Semester fees are almost 15000 inr and plus accommodations. It's a good enough amount for students from average households. Scholarship opportunities are present and informed about. Jobs on campus are close to none but student groups are sufficient enough to provide internship opportunities.

Name: Satya jitanshu Jena
review: During college, internships in your field of study are essential to successful outcomes after graduation. Many MNCs companies come to this institution. The highest package is 12LPA average is 3-4 LPA. From the 5th sem, a student become eligible for campus placements.

Name: Shubhangi Tiwari
college: Babu Banarasi Das Institute of Technology & Management - [BBDITM]
review: After 6 semester the students become eligible for the the placement activities there are so many companies who offers good packages and the highest package that is provided to us 32 lakh . And the other companies also provide good packages Fee structure is ok but little expensive as we are 5 siblings and only father working so it is little difficult for us sometimes there are scholarship opportunities for the ews and they also provide the oncampus placement for students

Name: Soumya r naik
college: Alva's Institute of Engineering and Technology
review:
Every year in AIET, they conduct many activities. They have many clubs like Rostrum, Srishti and many branch activities. A well-equipped multi-cuisine food court is on the campus.
The quality of the faculties is also awesome.
Around 10:100 is the ratio of faculties.

Name: Mrutyunjay mandal

There is 90%campus placement WarrantyThe annual festival is done in April every year it is conducted in the library there all kinds of engineering books are available for students. The classroom is most should be good as compared to other engineering colleges

Name: Devam Patel
college: SAL Institute of Technology and Engineering Research - [SITER]
review:
CE is a very good course which help me in future for a job that's why I choose this course.
Faculty are also good 
The faculty-student ratio is the same
The teaching method is superb
Exam conducted at regular interval
The final exam of each sem is conducted by GTU which is difficult if you can't study regularlyFees are very low compared to other private colleges
28000 per sem and 56000 per year 
Opportunity for the scholarship is very much for those who get problems with fee

Many companies are visiting campus regularly

Name: Harshith
review: As I said before everything depends on us. many companies reach out to the college but our talent depends. not only in our college max college faculty will focus on the semester syllabus ( theory part ) all the practical knowledge should be gained by usThe fee structure changes year after year. I guess 5000 is incremented every year and while coming to the scholarship every year Vardhaman conducts a scholarship examination named vst Vardhaman scholarship test in which 4 students can avail some money

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
The techno-cultural fest "enugma' happen in the first or 2nd week of November. last year we really enjoyed this fest and keenly waiting for the next year to celebrate with you guys. About the library- there is a library in our college where various types of books are kept .library is having a large collection of books. There are clubs for everything in our college. either sports-related or any technology-related work.
you can visit enyugma site of our college which is made by the student body itself.So I am coming to the main point for which you are reading this.
It's placement, isn't it?
the main goal for most of us is to get a good package and I can say with a hundred per cent surety that this college is fulfilling the dream of students of getting a good package.
for broad details you can visit the tnp site of iiit Bhagalpur .then you will get the more clear image

Name: Yashav
review:
Life in NiT Hamirpur is way too good. Greenery all around. 
NiT Hamirpur's annual college fest Hillfair is organised in the month of November and December every year.
And technical fest Nimbus one of the greatest technical fests of North India is organised In hereby NIT Hamirpur in the month of March and April.
College classrooms are maintained and have LCD projectors  Air conditioners etc. The college has well-equipped labs with well-maintained instruments. 
The college has well maintained Library all books of the courses are available there which can be issued by students.
In Nit hamirpur sports activities are always at their peak. Here are every sports intercollege competitions are held. 
To keep college life enjoyable and fun there are different clubs and societies run by Students in college. Pravah is dramatic club of nit hamirpur 
Fashp fashion club, Rythmeze is a dance  club 
And many more clubs are here.So I chose the electrical branch because I had an interest in electrical parts and moreover you get the wide scope in government job as well.
Faculty: student ratio is 30:70.although the faculty of the rest of the branches is quite lenient and good. Give marks and don't do hard checking.
But the electrical branch in Nit hamirpur is considered one of the toughest branches.
Because the faculty is so strict here.
Faculty is highly qualified professors are qualified from IITs NITs are PHD holders.
But their teaching method is not so good it's like 6/10
Term exams are conducted twice in a semester mid semester and end-semester.
Mid-semester exams were easy to pass but end-semester exams were way too hard. Especially in the electrical department.

Name: Ayush Behal
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review:
I choose this course because I am deeply interested in forming designs and someday, I want to establish my own brand 
the faculty is interactive but strict and they don't accept any excuse at the student's end to maintain a good reputation and maintain the 75% attendance.
the professors are fairly qualified and have very interesting teaching methods but they require some contribution at the student's end
the examination marks distribution criteria are fairly simple. Firstly you have 2 minors (each of 20 marks)(happens every 40 days or so), then you have an end sem (50 marks) and the rest 10 marks are in the hands of the professor tutoring the course.life at the campus is pretty lively and very happening, there are lesser restrictions as you progress into next semester 
the infrastructure of the campus is above average but the classrooms and study rooms are well furnished and have an all-around nice vibe.
there are a variety of sports and clubs but the infrastructure for open sports is poor.

Name: Yash Vardhan
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: Students here also get the benefits of excellent internship opportunities both paid and unpaid or research interns both in Indian and foreign colleges. Min. stipend for paid internships is 30k per month which goes to a maximum of about 17 lakhs offered by Optiver for the year 2023. Although the CGPA required for such highly paying internships is quite high (Obviously).Rendezvous is an annual cultural fest and Tryst is an annual tech fest that occurs at the start of the year. Variety of books and journals available at 24*7 open library. Fully air-conditioned classes. Sports facilities are also good as compared to other colleges. A lot of clubs are run by student bodies such as Music clubs, sports clubs, dance clubs, etc.

Name: Saurav singh
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review:
I first got admission to the textile technology branch but as I wanted to experience electrical branches I applied for branch change after the completion of the first year, where I got promoted to the ICE branch. 
The faculty-to-student ratio is about 1:20 at NIT Jalandhar though faculty is unable to pay attention to every student but they entertain their every doubt. 
Every faculty is highly qualified to educate students as they are PhDs. 
Every semester we attempt 2 minors and 1 major exam, at intervals of a month to precious.Mains on major cultural fest "Utkansh" And one major technical fest "technity" Is celebrated on large scale. 
Classrooms are newly built with high-tech facilities and even security measures are taken into consideration during building them. 
Annual sports day of 2 days is celebrated every year and many sports like running, long jump, etc. are performed. 
The Institute has many clubs like TCA for cultural events, TTA for technical events, criminals and dance club, spice club for students of ICE, various sports clubs, etc..

Name: Lokesh Ranjan
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review: The annual fest that is held is Utkansh while the tech fest held is techniti .various institutes of the countries take part in both of the events. There are multiple clubs in the institute where extracurricular activities and sports are being conducted. One of the clubs I found interesting is prayas run by students of our institute which teaches underprivileged kids. Glad to inform you that one of my batchmates was a prayas student so contributing to bringing a change. Classrooms are very good with centralized cooling and cushion chairs. There are smart boards and projectors which can be used as per need.Students are eligible for placement starting from the 7th semester although some are offered earlier based on their internship approval and the work they are pre-placed. There are plenty of companies more than 200 visiting the institute like Amazon, and Paytm. The highest package offered in the previous year was 1.23 cr and was offered by Microsoft. Every year around 90 percent of students interested in placements are placed in top companies like Amazon Microsoft and google.

Name: Managobinda Malik
review: Since my childhood, I want to be an electrical engineer so I choose this course. the faculty members are so friendly to students and always help students in their studies. All faculty members do p.hd in their own course. the teaching methods of faculties are so simple and understandable to students. there are 2 surprises, 2 quiz tests and 2 internal exams held in a semester. there are some difficulties faced by students because the exam session is straight. There is no way to cheat in exams.Every year college makes a musical night every Saturday night. Also, annual sports are held in our college. Thursday of every week 2 hours of hobby club will be arranged for students Hobby. our college has a central library in which every essential study material is available. everyday newspaper is also available in our library. our classroom is big as normal. it contains A/C and projector system also. In our college, all sports are available.

Name: Roshan Kumar
review: Moksha in the month of march and resonanz in October, the university is quite liberal about the fest they give appropriate time and money, and guidance for the fest. Classrooms are ultra-modern in 1st year but sarkari from 2nd year, Societies are in great number. You can easily pursue your hobby.I chose for placement. There were 1 faculty for 70 students from 2nd year however in 1st year we got to sit in the APJ complex where our strength was 200-215. All the faculties were Ph.D. holders and exams were timely and moderate. If you study you pass with good marks.

Name: Chirag
review: The internship scene isn't that good I should say as most companies come for women candidates only. However, opportunities are also given to other candidates but few grab this opportunity. Also, it is one of the oldest branches in NSUT

Name: Munishwar Bondugula
review: Life on our campus will be very nice every year our college will conduct a fest named kitsozon and cse fest will be conducted in mid jan there are so many books in our library and our college have a digital library where we can find lakhs of books and sports is main in our college we have basketball court indoor badminton court cricket ground and indoor games like table tennis and carroms for CSE we have club names kits cyber Association (KCA) in this club there will be technical events.I have chosen computer Science because CSE is problem-solving an essential skill for life students studying the design, development, and analysis of software and hardware used to solve problems in a variety of business, scientific, and social contexts. our faculty was very good and they teach us very nicely most of our faculty are Ph.D. holders and some faculty members pursuing their Ph.D. Exams will be conducted in timely their is no difficulty to pass the exam.

Name: Pranathi Chowdary
review: Life at the campus is good, the annual fest they conducted as annual day which is on March 19th on the occasion of actor  Mohan Babu sir's birthday. Tech fest will be twice a month we are involved in this fest and gets knowledge and experience. The key role in this college is the Library, there are a lot of books to study and learn. The faculty teaches through PowerPoint presentations in a good classroom. NCC and NSS are extra activities that are done in college, The CETA is a club that is run by students.I chose Computer science and Engineering, cause there is a large growth in this field, and we will get more packages with quality of work. The faculty and student ratio is 1:60. The faculty is quite good. The qualification of faculty might be an associate professor. The faculty should communicate more with students. Term exams are twice in a semester with one and half month difference and this is quite easy to pass these exams.

Name: Rakesh   bandaru
review:
There will be every technical and nontechnical fest will be going on with lots of joy and happiness.
The library is huge here and has lots of books

Name: Varun Mahesh Kupte

Name: Ajay akarapu

Name: Yash Agarwal
review:
HBTU has a thriving student life, with a variety of social, cultural, and sporting events taking place throughout the year. Some of the major annual fests and tech fests hosted by the university include "Adhyaay" (cultural fest), "Aagaz" (sports fest), and "Technika" (technical fest). These events provide students with the opportunity to showcase their talents, network with peers, and have fun.

The university has a well-equipped library that provides students with access to a wide range of books, journals, and other resources. The library also has modern facilities, including internet access and study spaces, to support students in their academic pursuits.

HBTU provides students with a wide range of sports and extra-curricular activities. The university also has several student-run clubs and organizations, such as the debating club, music club, and robotics club, that provide students with the opportunity to pursue their interests and develop new skills.The placement prospects for graduates of Harcourt Butler Technical University (HBTU), Kanpur are generally good, with many students securing employment in leading companies across various industries.
Students become eligible for campus placements from the 7th semester of their program. Over the years, HBTU has welcomed several leading companies from various sectors, including IT, Manufacturing, Consulting, FMCG, and others. Some of the top companies that have visited the campus for recruitment include Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Samsung R&D, and many more.

The highest package offered to students at HBTU is INR 60 lakhs per annum, while the average package is around INR 10-12 lakhs per annum, depending on the profile offered. 
Typically, a significant percentage of students get placed through campus recruitment, with the exact percentage varying each year. However, on average, more than 90% of students can secure employment through campus placements.
