Name: DEVANSH SINGH
review: Teachers are all exceptionally qualified and willing to entertain ideas and doubts. We have the option to provide anonymous feedback. Faculty members do their best to accommodate our suggestions. Even in the online mode, we have regular lectures with teaching quality at par with the offline mode. The course curriculum is very flexible. In the first two years, we finish all the basics of computer science, and the next two years can be devoted to research or to pursuing minors in other branches like economics, Biology, etc. Our college has provided a lot of options for electives in the last two years, and CSE students are eligible to choose any subject. Most of the mandatory courses are extremely relevant and essential, and some courses might not be industry-specific. IIITD has a strict plagiarism policy. Our college offers relaxation during tough times like the pandemic. Assignments and exams are on the tougher side, but the teaching is on the same level, so it is nothing one cannot handle.Wi-Fi facility is available with excellent speed throughout campus. It has five floors fully air-conditioned library 24x7. All the classrooms are air-conditioned. Faculty members are provided with a mic, screen, and every piece of equipment to conduct classes smoothly in auditoriums or smaller classrooms as per need. It has multiple designs, electronics, and computer labs, with most of them being open 24x7 and providing free access to resources like 3-D printers and laser cutters. The hostels are new and in excellent condition. The hostels are also air-conditioned after 8 pm. Common rooms are spacious and provided with sofas, television with Netflix subscription, football, etc. The canteen is open 24x7 with a wide array of options. It also has a café and a Bikaner stall. The mess provides decent food at a reasonable fee. All sports facilities and equipment, i.e., football, basketball, pool, football, table tennis, carrom, and gym are available 24x7 throughout the night.

review:
The campus life at Delhi Technological University (DTU) is a mix of academic rigor and extracurricular activities. 
- Social Life: DTU has a vibrant social life with a diverse student population from all over India. The university has a number of student-run clubs and organizations that offer opportunities for students to socialize and get involved in various activities. There are also several events and festivals(ENGIFEST, YUVAAN, etc) that are organized throughout the year, providing students with the opportunity to have fun and make new friends.
- Clubs: DTU has a variety of clubs, including technical clubs, cultural clubs, and sports clubs. These clubs provide students with the opportunity to pursue their interests and develop new skills. Some of the popular clubs at DTU include the Robotics Club, Music Club(Madhurima)a , Dramatics Club(Pratibimb), Dance club (VIBE and Nrityangana), and Sports Club. There are Tech and Business oriented clubs at DTU with huge number of accomplishments.The placements at Delhi Technological University (DTU) are quite good. DTU has a dedicated placement cell that works closely with companies to provide students with opportunities for internships and full-time employment. The placement percentage at DTU is consistently high, with a large number of students securing job offers from leading companies each year. In recent years, the placement percentage has been over 85% for most programs. DTU has a strong industry network and attracts a large number of recruiters from reputed companies across a variety of sectors, including IT, finance, consulting, and manufacturing. Some of the top recruiters include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Flipkart, and McKinsey. In the 2022 session, 795 offers were made with packages between INR 10 LPA and INR 20 LPA. Highest package INR 1.2 Cr p.a.

Name: Shalom Samuel
review:
The social life at NSUT is restricted because of the not-too-celebrated attendance rule.
But still, if you can manage your time like a pro you'll not get bored by the monotonous classes.
There are two cultural fests that happen at NSUT, one is in Feb-March, the all-so-famous Moksha, and the other one is an intra-college fest conducted in October called Resonance. The tech fest (innovision) is usually conducted along with either one of them.
Talking about the societies, there are ~40 societies as of now at NSUT and if you feel like it you can create your own too!
There is a decent-sized library at the campus where you can find everything that you'll ever need for your course.
There is also a sports complex consisting of a football field, cricket field, volleyball course, tennis court, and basketball court.
There also are facilities available for billiards, Table Tennis, badminton and other sports.If asked about the course curriculum. For the first few semesters, the courses taught are standard across engineering. After that, some branch-related courses are added to the curriculum. 
One thing that should be mentioned is the difficulty of the curriculum that is it is on the tougher side and sometimes it gets hard for the students to manage their studies with other ventures.
Talking about the faculty, most of the teachers are well-equipped for their assigned jobs barring some exceptions which are I guess always present.
One thing I would point out is the exams model is not too appreciated by the students. As there are exams held in terms of so many forms (especially class tests) which results in students giving exams every 3 to 4 weeks sometimes even less which doesn't help.

review:

Many sports events are held in college like kabbadi, basketball, football, cricket, etc.

Name: Palak Saxena
review:
Apaji Mela is conducted every year with great enthusiasm on our college campus. Talking about the availability of books, there are many departmental libraries present on our campus. There are various social clubs and societies for students to take part in actively and socially.I always wanted to pursue a career in technology. That's why I have chosen Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering from Banasthali Vidyapeeth. The faculty of engineering in our college is quite good, experienced and really helpful. Also, it's not a very difficult part to pass in mid-semesters and even end semesters. You can easily study one day before periodical exams to get passing marks but should start preparing at least 10 days before the end-semester exams.

Name: Akshay Ganesh
college: Thakur College of Engineering and Technology - [TCET]
review:
• Excellent Infrastructure with clean, abundant, and quality classrooms, toilets, canteen, campus, library, reading rooms, seminar halls/auditoriums, labs, computers, sports ground, indoor sports equipment, and other technical pieces of equipment.
• A big and excellent library (and e-library) with a lot of technical books (of local + foreign authors), journals, magazines, research papers, etc. in almost every field of engineering.

• There are multiple (local and national) clubs and communities in the college hosting a ton of exciting tech fests and events every year.• The course curriculum and the course structure for the computer engineering course are pretty good.
• The faculty: student ratio is approximately 1:7
• All the faculties are qualified (They have a bachelor's degree and teaching experience. Many of them even have a Master's and a Ph.D. degree as well) and use innovative teaching methods for better understanding and content retention.
• The term exams (for the entire semester) take place at the end of the semester (~5 months) and they are easy to pass if studied well enough.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: IIT Delhi attracts the attention of the best recruiter in town! You'll get enough opportunities to get into any field you like it may or may not be the field your major is in. college: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology  - [MANIT]
review: IN today's scenario, DATA SCIENCE is considered the most paying job which a large number of vacancies I always had an interest in technology that's why I opt this course. In our year there are approx 1250 students out of which approx 250 are girls. In my branch, we have 29 students including 7 girls. Teachers are cooperative. We have two semesters in a year in which we have mini-tests, one mid-term exam, and end-term exams in both semesters. If you attend each class then with some revision you can easily pass the exam. But to score well, you need to self-study daily.A techfest TECHNO is conducted every year in September. Many societies also conduct their events across the year. A society "TOORYANAAD" conducts a huge Cultural fest of three days in September which is quite famous in college. Our library has two floors and most of the books, as well as recent news items, are available there. In the classroom, we have a projector, benches, fan, tube light. Almost all sports are available here in SPORTS COMPLEX and every year INTER NIT tournaments are also conducted. We have a programming club "ZENITH" and an NGO "AAROHA" which is totally run by students.

Name: Jashan

review:

CAT(continuous assessment test) for 50 marks and FAT(final assessment test) for 60 marks. These are descriptive examinations and each question carries 8-12 marks. Subjects may be open or closed-book exams.

Our college has 100+ active clubs and a total of 600+ clubs & chapters. We have technical, non-technical, cultural, and different clubs. 
The library is fully air-conditioned with a capacity of 300+ students. We can find more books related to the subject then journals. 
Every classroom has a whiteboard and projector. You cannot find blackboard and chalk anywhere. 
Labs have 32GB RAM-supported desktops. 
The college focuses less on sports than academics. 
Clubs are generally organised by students. Some of them are CSI, ACM, Rotract club, Machine Learning Club, and Data Analytics Club.

Name: Sheik Abdulla

Name: Kaushal Kumbhani

Name: Vishal chandrawansi

Name: Sunny
review: There is no fee hike after joining in the college. All you have to do is to pay some extra amount for exam fees and NBA accreditation fees. There is no scholarship facility currently offered by college but the government of state is offering full fees reimbursementFaculty student ratio is 1:60.Here the faculty is experienced phd holders who will help us understand the concepts easily. They teach in smart classrooms and sometimes on the board. Exams are conducted in the middle of the semester and also in the end.

Name: Hemant Bhaskar Kamat
review: The fee structure is moderate as I am from management quota compared to other colleges this college has a moderate fee. There are many scholarship opportunities we get through the college I have got a state scholarship(SSP) which was suggested by the college.I chose this course because the course has high scope for the future. The faculty who are present to teach this course is very good they teach us all the preparations and they are highly skilled. They try to connect with students as friends.

Name: Deepjyoti Dutta
college: Girijananda Chowdhury Institute of Management & Technology - [GIMT]
review:
The annual fest is Euphisim which is celebrated after a gap of 1 year in the month of February.
The tech fest is Techmilap which is a 3day technical fest which is celebrated every year on the month of May.
Various books and journals are available in the college library. One can issue the books for a period of 14 days.
All the basic necessities are available in the classroom which also includes smart boards , projection screens, etc.
Sports week is celebrated every year on the months of months of December.
There are various social groups available at Instagram run by the students.I took this course because I wanted to learn more about fieldwork and also about the construction of various civil engineering projects.
1:3 is the faculty: student ratio.
The faculty is good concerning all the fields of work they do. Their teaching is much improved and also their teaching method is quite good.
Every semester 2 midterms are held and at the end of the semester, and end-semester exam is conducted. It is much more difficult to pass the exams cause 30% of the passing marks to come from the KPI.

Name: Lipika Arya
review:
The campus life in this college is very happening. 
There are various societies such as- 
PRAKRITI- the environmental and humanitarian society. It is the most active society on campus. It also hosts the annual cultural fest of MSIT i.e ENVA. 
 IEEE- IEEE mist is the student chapter of IEEE. It is also a very active society in the Delhi region of IEEE. It has various affinity groups such as IEEE WIE (women in engineering), IEEE RAS (robotics and automation society), and IEEE CS (computer science). I am a part of the hardware team under the PROJECT committee of the IEEE 
 TARK- it is the debating, writing, and poetic society.
 CEREBRATE- a debating society, is very active and participates in various intercollege events. 
 ASTITVA and UNITY STREETS- these are the dance societies. 
Aarambh and SIFAR- the dramatics society.
E-cell- the entrepreneurship society, has also been very active throughout the years and holds various pitching events in collaboration with HULT PRIZE MSIT.I have a keen interest in information and computer science-related branches so I chose the IT branch at Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology(MSIT). The college is AICTE-approved and NBA-accredited. Currently, I am in 2nd year of college. The faculty is well qualified and the teaching methods are also good. The course curriculum is also well constructed keeping in mind the course objectives.
The student-to-faculty ratio in my branch is nearly 8:1. 
There is one mid-semester exam and an end-term examination. The mid-semester can be passed on basis of class notes while the end-semester can be passed with the help of guides such as AAKASH, which contains all the previous year's papers of IPU. So, it's not that tough to pass depending on how much attention one pays in class and the attendance criteria too which from this year is 75% mandatory.

Name: Ashish Kishu
review: The campus life is very good. Although the senior-junior interaction is a bit harsh. Friendly ragging is there but not that much. The campus is 40 + acres. It has a Library that is the second largest library after IIT KGP.  Many sports activity also occurs frequently on campus. There are social and technical clubs as well.The faculties are average, but the facilities are very good. The student ratio is 5:1 as a boy is to a girl. The faculties are well qualified ..almost all of them are Ph.D. holders. Every month exams are conducted which are known as CTs and after 3 CT's end of semester exams take place.

Name: Harshit Prajapati
review:
Total amount of fee is around 10-11 lacs for the whole engineering course of the 4rth year, but if you are a student with a ration card then you'll get 100% tuition fee assistance which would be 130000 approx, also there are various meritorious scholarships and scholarships for students who need financial assistance that you can check on NSP and edistrict portal respectively.Placements are really good, almost all of the students who sit in the placement get placed.
For tech branches like CS/IT, the avg package that you get is around 20-30lpa and a max of 1-2 crores. 
And in lower non-tech branches, the avg package is 7-8 LPA.
Core placements like in civil, and mechanical are dead nowadays so there's not much scope in it.

Name: Sumit
review: The campus placements of college are good. In college, various companies visited. Foremostly all of the IT companies visit college for placements. For core branches, there are few companies.  Core branch students try to be placed in IT companies and the college provides support to them. For the 7th semester, students are eligible for campus placements. Every year TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini, Mahindra, KPIT, D- Mart, and many more companies visited a college campus. Every year 500 + offers are offered by MNCs. The highest package offered was about 18 LPA and the average package was about 5.5 LPA. Almost everyone is able to get placements. About 90%+ students get placed every year. My plan is to get a good placement after my degree.College life is actually best in RIT. There are 50 + clubs in college so you can improve your skills. Some are technical and some are technical.  There are 3 Motorsport clubs also on a college campus. College does not support these clubs in making their Motorsport vehicle. The college infrastructure is good. The college has one of the best libraries. Virangula is an annual cultural event of RIT. There are lots of books available in the library. The college provides sports facility also. The college has various grounds like cricket, football, basketball, etc.

Name: Akshat Kareer
review: Societies often conduct their big events. You can get books from the book bank. There is also a library where you can go anytime and issue books as well. The classrooms are spacious. No air conditioning though. There is a big ground and 2 badminton courts. Societies for coding, environment, speaking, etc. are there.I have an interest in electrical and electronics engineering. There are two mentors for 60 students in the class. Many teachers are P.hD. They have good qualifications. Term exams were online for me. Midterms have been offline.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Campus Life in this university is excellent, the infrastructure is the best part of it, and students from different countries feel vibrant here. "DHOOM" is the annual festival in college, there are different days that are celebrated during this whole event. There are many technical fests that are conducted every month. The libraries here are in very good condition all the books related to the course can be found in the library. The labs are almost in good condition. Every type of sport is being played in the university, there are a variety of grounds for a variety of sports. There are different clubs that are run by the students which help in organizing extracurricular activities.My reason for choosing this course is because I was very furious and passionate about learning the different processes and researching to make a variety of products make life easier and helpful to others. Talking about the faculties are very helpful and friendly in nature and they have many years of teaching experience, many faculties are from renowned institutes such as IITs, and NITs. Now talking about exams, there are weekly exams every week of the semester, midsem after 2-3 months of the semester, and endsems at the end of the semester, you can easily qualify for the exams if you are prepared well.

Name: Amit
college: J.C. Bose University Of Science And Technology, YMCA
review:
Life on campus is nice. This college has a lot of clubs. And these clubs are basically run by senior students.

sessional exams are not strictly checked. but final exams are checked strictly.

Name: Divyansh Pathak
review: I chose this course because I had a keen interest in electronics and also I got it in earlier rounds so I opt for it. And the faculty is quite decent, as we know in all colleges there are some good teachers and some are not that good, so yeah similarly all the teachers are well qualified and the teaching method is really good, but some teachers are qualified but don't teach that well, but yeah maximum teachers are hardworking and pretty decent. And here at MSIT, there are 2-semester exams each semester, the MiD sem and END Sem and MID SEM quite easy it's easy to score in this and not that difficult, but the end sem is quite challenging because the paper comes from the university and gets checked there only. Name: SATYAM KUMAR
college: Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology - [SLIET]
review:

Many companies are visited for recruitment like TCS, WIPRO, CAPGEMINI,L&T, RALSTON INDIA LIMITED, TORRENT GAS LTD, HONDA, AMAZON, JINDAL STEEL, PEPSICO, ETC for more details regarding placements please visit the website www.sliet.ac.in

My plan is to study further for a higher degree.

Name: Suyash Baranwal
review:
It basically depends upon which branch you pick. Students in 1 St year have the same subject. faculty: student ratio is 1:50.
The faculty is ok but some are great. Some faculty is Ph.D. holders and some are M.tech degrees. In one semester, there is 1 term exam and 2 mid-term exams. The difficulty of exams is less and any one can score good marks with less hard work. The previous year's question is very important. The fee hike is approx 5-10 % per year and it is constant for 4 years.
One has to live in a hostel or as a day scholar.

Name: Ganesh Singh Parmar
college: College of Technology and Engineering, Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture and Technology - [CTAE]

review:

Name: Dhairy
college: Lakshmi Narain College of Technology & Science - [LNCTS]
review: The infrastructure is good. The college has communities like the google developer student club to organize several events and coding competitions. Awareness is the key here, the information about competitions is not circulated properly among the faculty or students. So it's better to have connections with many students from different buildings to be updated with info on these. The other thing is the classroom doesn't have a dustbin (con). The college does organize sports events and selection.Some faculty is extremely good and some feel like not qualified to teach. College seems to be lacking faculty in new rgpv introduced courses like Aiml,Cyber security, etc.  As for the syllabus, they try complete it as much as possible, in some subjects it gets completed on time while in others it's not. Students are provided with a manual consisting of past yeat mid sem and sem papers, it surely helps a lot. Though I feel college is lacking in providing actual skills to the student.

Name: Kushagra
review:
HBTU provides one of the best college life to its students. With college being present in the centre of Kanpur City...all hangout places are very close to the college with excellent transport facilities.
Annual fest and tech fest are being organized regularly by various communities and clubs. Sports and Extra curricular activities are also supported in the college.
Insta handle of the biggest club/community in HBTU -
https://www.instagram.com/hbtialumni/Facilities are good here in campus. Many of them are even holding a PhD degree in there subjects. Infrastructure are average. Library are quite good with peace in there.
Medical facilities here are quite good with 24/ 7 medical facility sitting in college .
There are two midsems that occur every semester with an additional end sem at the end of semester.

Name: G KRISHNA VINEETH
college: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education
review:
IBM collaborated with the college for providing advanced training to computer science students.
Strength is increasing as compared to previous years. In 2020, Around 1800, in 2021 around 2500 - 3000, and this year (2022) around 4500 students.

Most of the faculty are completed their post-graduation in their respective fields, many got their PhDs. some faculty are doing state & central government-funded projects, and some of them are research-oriented too.
There will be 3 exams: two sessional examinations (mid-exams) and the end semester. Around 85 working days for each semester, there will be around one and half month gap between each sessional examination and less than a month gap between the second sessional and end semester examination. The difficulty is easy & moderate and one can pass with sufficient effort.Cultural fests occur once a year or occasionally, but tech fests are conducted often. Food feasts are conducted almost every month.
Almost all the required books & journals are available at the central library.
Amenities in classrooms include Air conditioners, and projectors, but very poor network strength.

Sports and extra circular activities like NCC, Yoga, swimming, camps, many others and will occur very effectively. Intra & Inter level competitions also happen every semester.

There are nearly 10 clubs: 1)Red cross, 2)Innovation and startup cell, 3)Fine arts club, 4)Green army, 5)Photography club, 6)Nature club, 7)Music club, 8)Technical clubs, 9)IKSC (By IUCEE), 10)Aquatics club. etc.

Name: Sameer Kumar
review: Campus life is extremely pleasant and outstanding. Many fests are organized throughout the year by various departments and various clubs. Events like Dance, drama, and singing are organized in all fests. Tech fests are also organized so that students get the opportunity to learn more about Technology and get to study exciting things outside of the syllabus. All types of books and journals are made available in the library for readers. All amenities such as AC, wifi, fan, and lights have been provided in all classrooms. Sports and extracurricular activities are also organized annually for students from all years.From semester 7 we become eligible for campus placements. Companies like TCS, Deloitte, Amazon, Accenture, and Wipro have visited and plenty of offers have been made. The highest package obtained so far is 20LPA and the average package is 5LPA. The roles offered are Software development engineer, DevOps engineer, Cloud computing analyst, Full Stack developer, etc. 100% of the students get placed every year. I plan to pursue my dream job in an MNC as a software development engineer.

Name: RAGHAVENDRA PRATAP SINGH
review: Chitkara conducts a lot of fests, from SneakerFest to Concerts to Treasure Hunts etc. Its filled with events. Chitkara has many libraries but the biggest one is near the Turing Block and it has almost all the books you could ever need for Computer Science, as well as literature too. Classrooms are kept clean and tidy for the students and the faculty and are cleaned regularly after class hours everyday. There is a proper lost and found system as well. As mentioned above Chitkara holds various events, which are not limited just to enjoyment, but also sports. Chitkara has various sports groups as well as proper sports equipment and the required infrastructure. Many of the sports teams go for competitions in other colleges as well. Chitkara has many clubs, not just sports but also clubs like NoComply which is focused on Skating or DebSoc for parliamentary debates, these are run by students.After semester 6, students become eligible for campus placements. There are various companies that visit the campus and make numerous offers. For example, companies like - Apple, ARM, Nvidia, Google, Infosys, VMware, Wipro etc. The highest package went up to, 35 Lakh and the average package is around, 8 Lakh. There are 500+ recruiters therefore the percentage of students getting offers and placed is 98% in 2019 and in 2021 it was 85%. My plan after getting my degree is to pursue higher education abroad.

Name: Shriyog Jambekar
college: Pillai College of Engineering - [PCE] Navi Mumbai
review: the annual fest Alegria is awesome you will find a lot of attractive things in this fest it is one of the best fests in the MMR region and the top fest in the Navi Mumbai region. the library has a lot of books and it is available till 6 pm with a time limit of 15 days. the lifts are not that good the infrastructure is average. sports and extra curricular activities are a good.My admission fees have not changed yet. Name: Swapnil Deshmukh
review:

There are various clubs and societies like the Literary Club, Music Club, Dance Club, Photography Club, etc. which organize various events and activities throughout the year. There are also regular fests and events like Freshers' Day, Annual Day, and Sports Day. The college also has a very active student council which organizes various events and activities.

Name: vishal poddar
review:
Almost all the engineering courses at Jadavpur university have the same fee except IT ( information technology) because it is not yet government-sponsored, for the first year and second year you have to pay 5500 rupees, which includes everything like lab fee, library fee, tuition fee etc,  then in 3rd year, you have to pay approx 2500  and in 4th year also approx 2500, so total four year cost is approx 11k. Name: Subhadip De
review:
There are broadly two important fests namely Srijan (annual tech fest) and Sanskriti (annual cultural fest) which are generally conducted in April and May respectively. There is also the fresher's event which consists of a series of games and cultural events.
The library of Jadavpur university on both campuses is filled with adequate resources both offline and online. Departmental books, research articles, topic wise books not related to the curriculum but academic. Also a wide variety of storybooks and magazines. JU has its own magazine (Indie publishing). 
Classrooms don't have AC but fans are present, and there are basic benches for students to sit and attend classes with projectors. 
There are numerous social groups made and run by students ranging from science to sports to literature and films. Chess, debate, dance, music, science, anime, fashion, cricket, football, coding, entrepreneurial, drama, literature, film, photography, Motosport and many more clubs. All of them are highly active.Over 95% of students get placed in my department of Instrumentation and electronics engineering (IEE). From starting of 4th year, students can seat for interviews and grab placements in top firms. All companies visit here with offers like Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Adobe, ZS associates, DE Shaw, IDFC first bank, wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Texas instruments, micron, Samsung, tata, PWC, airtel, reliance, ONGC, Gail, bpcl, hpcl, Nvidia, Intel and many more. Opportunities are endless. The average package is 15lpa and the highest is 42lpa. 95% of students got placed in IEE. 
After getting the degree, I will continue with the placement that I will get(hopefully a tech company) and after a few years of the experience I want to do MBA and hope for a promotion.

Name: Om Mittal
review:
Srijan is the tech fest of Jadavpur University, where we have various competitions ranging from coding to mystery.
Sanskriti is the annual fest of our college, and we have a very elaborate itinerary, though, without any very big names, the fun is unparalleled.
Classrooms are very spacious, and as per current developments, all classrooms in the BCSE department are going to get air conditioners. 
There is hardly any sport you can't play here in Jadavpur, from football grounds to cricket pitches, you have it all. 
We also have a mountaineering club, a photography club, a coding club, music and dance clubs, and a lot more.Students are usually allowed to sit for placements from the beginning of the 7th semester. 
Students from CSE bag placements at almost all of the FAANG companies, while some even get placed in very high-paying startups. International offers, too, are very common.
The highest packages, when converted into Indian currency and the PPP not accounted for, are usually in the range of 1 to 1.25crs per annum. The average placement is around 20 to 25 LPA.
Everyone who decides to sit for placements gets placed here in JU BCSE, though a sizeable number decide to opt for higher studies and/or research.

College library & online resources are always available for you. Most of your needs will be fulfilled by the library. Labs are also well equipped, but classes can be modified a bit. College is just silent in the case of sports. Most of them and other all extracurricular activities are performed by the Rotaract club of MCKVIE. Rotaract Club, startup club, coders club, and Tech events like Kodikas, Pulse.exe etc are organised by college students. At the last, you have to find your joy outside the college. The difficulty level is moderate in most subjects that can be passed with decent grades from class notes and one good reference book.The fee structure is different for people in different income slabs. People with having family annual income of more than 5Lacs have to pay a tuition fee and hostel rent of about 77,000 INR along with mess bills of around 35,000INR. All the teachers are minimum qualified in master's in engineering and most of all are in Ph.D. in their field.
The teaching method is quite impressive as they teach with the help of ppt and study material.
There is a sessional exam in one and a half months and there is no difficulty to pass them if you are well prepared.There is an 88900 fee per year for the second year for engineering students along with a 6500-uniform fee.
And you will get a scholarship almost 100% if you apply for up government.
There is an education loan available for those students who are not in a position to afford this fee which you can pay later month by month.
Currently, I'm in my third year and I didn't get any job right now.

Name: Adiya
review:
The Avishkar is a national-level event organized by students. There is a central library in the college which is funded by the world bank. Classrooms must be maintained properly. There are zonal events in the college. There are several clubs in the college like the Dias club, Defence club, house of arts, SAE club, etc.I choose this field because having a lot of opportunities in the future. The faculty for academics is not sufficient for some departments.
The teaching method is offline and has practical sessions. the exams are conducted very strictly, and it is moderately easy to pass over them.

Name: Abhigyan Shandilya
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review:
Students become placement eligible according to their course like B.Tech students become eligible in their 4th year and MCA students in their 2nd year. 
Plethora of companies have visited such as virtusa, tcs, cognizant, Capgemini, prolifics, IBM, Microsoft, neebal tech, Knoldus etc, the list goes on. 
Highest package is 44 LPA and average package is around 5-6 LPA. 
Lot of student are already placed. Like in 180 students in MCA, 60% are placed.There are a lot of festivals and event organized here. Life on campus is phenomenal, I'm really enjoying it. 
We have a three floor library so we have a ton of books, both curriculum and extra curriculum. 
If you're interested in any field such as cultural activities or sports, you have a lot of opportunity here.

Name: Neha Sapre
college: Hon Shri Babanrao Pachpute Vichardhara Trust's Faculty of Engineering - [HSBPVTFE]
review: I have an interest in computers so I choose computer engineering. Today there are a lot of jobs available for computers. There are 5-6 faculty members available and 78 students are in the class. All teachers are B. E computer. They teach in very simple methods.The total fee for a student is 38000 and mahadbt scholarships are offered for students. There are no campus offers for the student. There are no job offers for the student. no extra activities are taken for the placement side.   Only focus on the study

Name: Isha Pandey
review: Overall college is beautiful and huge in the area, but because of that, the main buildings of this college are pretty far, so it takes a bit of time to go from one place to another. For example, my hostel is about 800 meters far from the college. And since we entered college during the covid period, we didn't have much experience with club activities.I will say that college fees were a bit too high for me because I didn't give the entrance exam, but if you apply for the exam and get a scholarship, then it might be reasonable for you. For the last few years, due to corona crisis, the placement has been quite bad in this college.

Name: AYUSH PATIL
review: college life at IIIT nagpur is quite good . many events  conducted  every  year .Sports facilities are also there like badminton ,cricket ,volleyball,chess etc .classrooms are well maintained with projector techniques .Many companies like  google, microsoft give internships to  students .Different projects like web and android development,graphic  design  and game development with 100000 stipend per month to some students .

Name: Amit Choudhary
review:
Placement  of this college is outstanding and the up to 200 plus companies visit in college campus the minimum  package is 3 lakh per annum 
The maximum package is 28 lakh per annum 
And the average package is 6 lakh per annumThey also provide internship opportunities for online and offline platforms in many multinationals  companies Microsoft, salesforce,  cisco, and many more after the internship they also  provide a certificate that helps in jobs

Name: Bharghav
college: Malla Reddy Institute of Engineering and Technology- [MRIET]
review: There was a fest conducted only once in 6 months and the college beside our have fest up to 3 times but it has only one in the semester and the all books are available in the library only and classroom have neat and clean and sports and curriculum activities were very well and the social group has in our college run by senior in our collegeThe students are eligible for the placements from the 7th semester of the campus and the companies that visited the are Google, Amazon, tech Mahindra, cognizant and so many highest package is 12 lakhs per annum and the average package is 6lakhs 90 percent of students are placed in college placement and I plan to study MTech

Name: Tapan dhakad
review:
I have an interest in this course and I wanna do the reputed job all faculty members are familiar with and fully supported they are all highly educated (Ph.D.) 
And have more than 15 years of experience hods of all departments and are focused on student performance and attendance they conduct the weekly test and two MSDs between the semesterThe fees of this college are affordable and they are not strict about the fee Fee structure of the college is designed per semester wise We have to pay the remaining fee after the scholarship if your financial condition is not good you get extra time to pay the fee via an application

Name: Arjun Kadam
college: Hon Shri Babanrao Pachpute Vichardhara Trust's Faculty of Engineering - [HSBPVTFE]
review: There are many events in my college like the tech fest, the Avishkar event for pharmacy students, and the PARAS event for IoT subjects. Our school invited Gopal Jee India's Youngest Scientist. Our college arranges sports events and other activities.My college fee structure is very easy and affordable for every type if student. Total fees are 80K for Open category students. Fees are different for different cast students. The Maharashtra government provide scholarship for every student.

Name: Deepak singh
review: The fees of this college are a little bit high, especially the hostel fees. Academic fees are 225000 per year for the 2021 batch and slightly a little bit increased for the 2022 batch and hostel fees are 111000. No scholarship is provided by the college but you can get various state scholarship programs. Campus placements are also good and increasing year by year but recently most of the good placements are off campus.I opt CSE branch in this college because there will be a great scope and feature in this field. The faculty of this college is corporate and supported. For each subject at least 2 to 3 faculty is available. Most of the faculty are phd passed out and some of them are doing phd and there would be 3 exams in a semester sessional 1, sessional 2 and the end semester.

Name: Suyash Mahajan
review: The total fees for the college including the hostel will be around 13-14 lakh and the Maharashtra OBC student can avail scholarship of about Rs.1,80,000 and other caste students can avail of their scholarships respectively. Even a few states provide scholarships for their SC/ST students, do check that as well. Also, you can apply for an education loan, they have SBI loan assistance in college and you can apply in some other banks too.There are individual year groups like IIITN_2021 on social media for students of the same batch and there are clubs like Orator for public speaking, Crescendo Music club, dance club, drama club, innovative cell, E cell, blender designing and a lot more.

Name: Anshul Parmar
college: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology  - [MANIT]
review: As this is an institute of national importance there are two major fests one is tecnoserch which is central India's largest technical fest. Another is maffic. There is a huge library that contains lakhs of books by different writers in the central library of MANIT. there are many clubs and societies which conduct events on regular basis.In the last year of graduation, students are allowed for placements. There are more than 150 companies visited every year and most of the students are placed. More than 85% of students got placed from campus placement or pre-placement offers.

Name: Utkarsh Yadav
review:
There is only one annual fest. 
In the library, you will get all the types of books which you required as per your course.
The classroom is quite well you will get comfortable chairs and you will not find any difficulties.
There are not as many sports facilities as on other campuses.
You will get many clubs geeks for geek, google cloud-sourced, bitbybit, etc.Scholarships are based on marks in entrance if you are from a lower economical background.
If you are investing in the study you will get in the form of campus placement but you have to work hard. 
You will difficulty get a campus job if you do work hard and full filling the criteria of college as well as company criteria you will get placement.

Name: Shubham VATS
review: The college has good placement in 2021 and 2022. the college was started in the year 2017. the first batch was passes out iin 2021 and 100% student got placed form all branches. Many students got internships in iit guwahati also as it is the mentor institute of iiitbhagalpur. The average placement of the 2018-2022 batch is 12.5 LPA. also 7 students 0f the 2019-2023 batch placed in amazon with 45LPA.The annual fest will be conducted in December every year. The college has various types of clubs and it conducts many events and fest related to them. The sports facility in our college is not good. The College library has many books.

Name: Gargi
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: The fee structure is different for different categories. If you belong to an unreserved category and your family income is greater than 6 lakhs you will be charged a total tuition fee that is 110000. But if you belong to the ews or OBC category and your family is between 100000 and 500000 then you will have a waiver of two-thirds of your tuition fees. For students with a family income of less than 100000, the tuition fee is fully waived.From 6th semester, students become eligible for campus placements. Several companies visit the college every year. The highest package for my branch went as high as 1crore while the average package is 33 lakhs. Almost 95% of students get placed. I plan to work in an MNC after the placements.

Name: Kesav
review: I Love to choose the course I had choose. 1:13 faculty and student ratio and many of us have to clarify our doubts. Each faculty should complete PhD. and they should be in a good position. 4 SEM for each year in our college.The fest for the whole year and 4 fests per sem will be conducted in our college and they informed us to join as much as possible as they informed us earlier in their info paper. we need to submit our Original files to them.

Name: Rishivasan
review:
As per the office placement report 2022, more than 1,545 students in the final year of their Engineering program were selected for placements. The highest package offered during Saveetha Engineering College placements in 2022 was recorded at INR 11
LPA, whereas the average package was recorded to be something about INR 4.3 LPA.It's a great college. The management is very strict, I like that. It inculcates discipline into the students. The faculty are amazing as far as I've seen in the college. So only I like the college there are many club activities are held.

Name: vishwajeet sanjay koshti
review: PCCoE is well known for its discipline and strict academics. As our college is autonomous so the curriculum is well-updated as per industrial requirements. The faculty is very experienced and they won't disappoint you. Faculty to student ratio is almost 1:50 most of the faculty members are Ph.D. holders and the most important is that sessional exams are taken very seriously and you have to struggle a little to pass.The College campus is not that big but the productivity of the college is the main aim also many modern facilities are provided like a digital library. There is a grand annual fest in Swartarang also many fests are organized by respective students association they are quite interesting. We also had a know japan event, exploring Japanese culture.

Name: Barath kumar
review: once a year there will be a college fest and for each month there will be a tech fest. all books are available in our college and we can use them to use the books. There is a lack of sports events. We have certain clubs in our college.Nearly 4,00,000 per annum for us to study. Get an idea of the information regarding final placements. There will be a mentor for every 13 students and they send the details about the fee structure and also the financial records.

Name: Satveer
review: the fee s around 2lakh per year. the students can apply for different state and central scholarship schemes like the national scholarship portal or many other state-specific schemes. but any extra scholarship is not provided by the college.all teachers are very good and very helpful at any time and all are well-known and Ph.D. holders. the course curriculum is relevant and easy to study and understand concepts accordingly, its based on the requirement of the industry

Name: Sushant Kumar
review:
In starting, you will obviously have great fun, joining the atmosphere of the college. But after when you will go through your academics, you will be hectic.
Annual Fest Name: Enyugma 
Enyugma is conducted in the month of November or December for 3 days. It is Techno-Cultural Fest.
There is also a library where you will find your all course books. You can issue it at any time from the college.
Classrooms are fully equipped with the required things.
In college, there are many clubs including sports, cultural and technical clubs.According to National Importance Institute, this Institute has a high fee structure but you should have to look that this Institute is PPP, which means Public Private Partnership and this is the reason why the fee structure looks high.

Now talking about the scholarship, colleges offer many scholarships according to their state of living. One of the Scholarship Name is: NSP

Name: Vishal Singh
review: Campus life is good here especially the weather of this location good also seniors are so helpful. For books, there is a big central library. Also, there are projectors in every class in the lecture hall. There is one student activity center where we can play many sports like basketball, table tennis, badminton, etc. Also, there are many clubs that are run by students for students which will enhance your overall personality.I chose this because of the good placements. The faculty: student ratio is 1/5. All teachers are Ph.D. holders and their teaching method is good. There are two main exams every semester, one mid-semester and one end semester. The difficulty level is average you can pass the exams by studying two to three days before the exams.

Name: Rohit Jain
review: I was interested in computers and software since my childhood and I wanted to be a software engineer. The faculty-student ratio is proper here but faculty changes every two months which creates a difference between the teaching methods of two different teachers. All the faculties are doctorates. The teaching method is very practical. There are some class tests, some practicals, assignments, and semester exams. There are 8 semesters. The exams are not much difficult if you will attend the classes you will get passed easily.First, if you are a first-year student you will get a fresher party. There is an annual fest organized every year in May. Some festivals are also celebrated here but mainly Jainism or Jain festivals are organized here. There is one library that provides all the books and study material related to your course. There is one sports meet organized every year. There is no club I have listened to or seen which is run by any student.

Name: Ritik Shriwastava
review:
I chose this course because it is a circirutary branch and has a good possible opening in its sector as well as PSU.

2 main professors, 4 assistant professors, and some Ph.D. scholars in every department, the subject are taken by the respective department, and students per class are around 100 for each batch except civil which has 180.

Every faculty is highly qualified and many have ongoing research as NIT is a government college, teaching methods of many are excellent but some are a little bookish and hard to understand.

One mid-semester exam (30% weightage) and one end-semester (60% weightage) along with internal assessment (10% weightage) is the standard pattern, exam standard entirely depends on the teacher but the thumb of rule is that at least two subjects are going to be either tricky or very difficult (generally math).No annual fest, fests are mostly not conducted and events are generally just done by sitting in classrooms, tech-fest is done similarly by club semicolon.

The library has all course-related books and a few additional ones related to competitive exams like gates and periodicals.

Classrooms have elevated seats, smart boards, air conditioning, and proper lighting system.

Sports and extracurricular activities are at a bare minimum but will change after the completion of the construction of multiple basketball, tennis, cricket grounds.

Groups can't be formed without faculty approval but are still run by students, some groups include, the sargam club (music), semicolon (coding), rhetoric club (debate), etc.

Name: VIVEK RAJ
review: I have had a great interst in computers since my childhood so I opt for this course. The faculties here are well qualified and they are selected by the vacancies released by the collleges and interview processes are conducted to choose themIndian Institute of Information Technology Bhagalpur is a new college but still, it's placement is increasing exponentially and it's performing very well being a new college, the highest package for this session is 47 lpa .

Name: Harman Singh
review: For Most of the activities, clubs and societies are present on campus some of them are CSEC, bhangra club, English club, robotics society, etc. The annual fest is Hill-fair and the tech fest is Nimbus. In campus central library is present from there you can avail books for free. Student Activity Center is there where you can play badminton, table tennis, and basketball. And the proper ground is present for outdoor games.Till now in November 40% of  ECE students are already placed. Placement going well this year. Students got placed in companies like amazon, cred, etc. There are also some new branches introduced last year for which placement stats are still awaited. The highest Package is 54 lakh by cred and the average package is around 14 lakh for CSE and 6-7 lakh overall. I plan to take a placement before my degree is over.

Name: Keshav Bansal
college: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology - [DCRUST]
review: Students can be eligible to sit in the campus placement after the 7th semester. companies visits are TCS, fidelity, Samsung, etc . highest package offered on campus is 10  LPA, and off campus 65 LPA. I am planning to start a business after my degree.The fees for the BTech degree are quite affordable. the fees are only 45 thousand per year student has to pay 35 k for the even semester and 10 k for the odd semester. students get scholarships on the basis of the categories like sc st quota.

Name: Vipul Kumar
review:
From 3rd year u are eligible for campus placement our placement statistics are osm almost every student will get placement for the 2017-21 batch age packages 8.5lpa.
For 2018-2022 average is 12lpa  LPA highest is 30 LPA.
For the 2019-23 batch average package 20 LPA heights 45lpa and seven students placed in Amazon recently.Clubs are very active if u are interested you will get Manu opportunities in our college we have a techno-cultural fest called enyugma and it is a very big fest in this fest many students came from different colleges and take part and it is three days fest including star night and all.

Name: Samar
review:
It is one of the most placement promising courses in this college, and that's why I opted for it. Also, the faculty of IT is most supportive in college in all aspects.
Each class comprises about 60 students which is just enough for one teacher in the classroom and a pretty common teacher-to-student ratio per classroom.
Faculty is well educated but they lack in the skill of teaching. Sometimes they don't get what the student is trying to imply.
There are 3 sessional tests throughout a semester, which is pretty easy to pass, then comes a pre-university test just before the final sem exams, which, if have studied well, are a piece of cake.In the library, only educational, coursebooks are available. You can't read anything if it's not in your syllabus.
Classrooms are equipped with smart boards. I think they should be air-conditioned as well, given their enormous fee structure.
You can't play sports there if classes are going on in the meantime. You will have to wait till 4 pm.
Colleges have many cultural societies and many tech societies. Only tech societies are beneficial.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: The total cost for 1-year of the study is around 2.7 lakhs. State scholarships are available. The NSP is also available. Vidya Laxmi Scheme is available for loans. As college is continuously giving very good placement, you can say it's worth paying more than 2 lakhs every year.All faculty members are really good and helpful. They are well-knowledgeable and most of them are from IITs and Ph.D. holders. The course curriculum is also good but it requires some improvement (The course curriculum is the same as the IIT Guwahati course curriculum).

Name: Abhishek Anand
review: Celegance is our annual fest that is organized every single year by our college. You can also enjoy festival fest on campus. Talking about the library you will get a sufficient amount of books and notes. You can participate in a sports event. There are several groups like GDSC.From the third year onwards you are eligible to seat for the placement offers on campus. Several companies have shown interest in our college students like Capgemini, cognizant. The highest package on campus is 18 lakh given by CISCO. Four students have been selected.

Name: Tushar digarse
review: Students become eligible for placement in the 6th semester itself. TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, and Tech Mahindra are some of the major recruiting companies of the college which visit the college every year. About more than 200 companies visit the college every year and 1000+ offers are made during the last year. The average package of the students is 6LPA which the highest being 48LPA. About 80% of students were placed last year. After completing my degree I would work in corporates and after a few years of experience, I would continue my higher education for better career development.The fee structure is provided at the time of admission. Exam fees and other misc. the fee could be as high as 3000 per year and other than a day scholars have to pay just the tuition fee. Bus facilities are provided by the Institute itself for free. MP Post matric Scholarship, Bihar Post Matric Scholarship, etc. are some of the Scholarships being availed by the students in the college. The college doesn't provide any campus jobs for the students thus they have to manage part-time jobs on their own.

Name: Yash Kumar
review: Total fees to complete Btech from this institute costs around 1100000 including hostel and mess. Fees are taken per semester, the institute provides no scholarships of its own, and students can take national or state government scholarships or any other scholarships. 2017-21 batch has 100 % placement with an average of 10 lpa and 2018-22 have 100% placement with an average of 14.5 lpa. Top companies which visits regularly are Amazon, Media.Net, Nykaa, MAQ Software, and many more.Campus life is great, you have gym, various outdoor sports courts and ground like cricket, badminton, basketball, volleyball etc. This college have all types of Clubs related to technical and cultural. Its annual fest is called "Enyugma" which happens around Oct-Nov eery year. Laboratories and classroom are air-conditioned.

Name: Rohit Kumar
review: The annual fest is a great experience for the students and teachers here. They all celebrate together and are conducted once every year. The library is favorable for students if they want to study. A good peaceful library with tons of books to choose from. Sports is often received good environment here to sharpen your skills here. Anubhuti dramatics club is the drama club run by the students here.The course curriculum is quite good. I chose this course because of the growth of the IT sector in the coming years and the present time. The relatability also matters as I wanted to go into the technology field and make a career out of it. Exams are held timely and accordingly to the schedule. If you study well enough passing won't be an issue for you.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: The fee structure is affordable and budget-friendly compared to other colleges with the same facilities. A few percent hikes in fees are observed every year. Scholarships are provided every year to deserving students on a merit basis. There are government scholarships,Sports fest and tech fest are organized twice a year. Course-related books are available in large numbers in the library. Sports & extracurricular activities on campus are conducted on regular basis. The infrastructure is satisfactory.

Name: Priyanshu  sahu
review:
A number of the fest are very very less. For day scholars and once a year you will meet the annual fest that is Elegance.
 The library has enough materials to full fill your educational needs.
 You can play here basketball, volleyball, Badminton, Cricket, Football, and Inter college competition are available. Social groups like Dexters for Dance and Anubhuti for Drama are there. And chess club, Google club, etc. club are there.CSE (AI & ML) in this current scenario is one of the top degrees and AI is now growing in every field.
 Student and teacher ratio in offline classes is 90:1 and in online classes 180:1.
The teachers are very excellent and well-qualified. 
 The semester is of 2 to 4 months and the Semester exam questions are difficult to pass.

Name: Patamsetti Sandeep
review: Life at the campus is very good and all the facilities were provided and the coordination is very good between Faculty and students which helps in all the courses and there is a separate block for the Library and the classrooms are very good and the sports and club activities were accurately participated by all the students and club carnival will be conducted well.The course curriculum is very good and I choose this course of Ece because it is very good for the opportunities in placements and Faculty teaching also very good and Teaching method also good and all the Faculty Qualifications are M.Tech and ph.D and the exams are conducted weekly.

Name: ABHISHEK SINGH
review:
I am in CSE DEPARTMENT and I chose this course because of my interest in Computer fundamentals and programming and placement offers are not to be forgotten. Here Faculty to student ratio is quite less that means our college needs some more faculties but this is adjustable as of now as our college came up with new branches in previous years and even it increased seat intake and college emphasis on hiring the best suitable professor for which they take extensive interviews of faculties and that is a time-consuming process. Faculties are well qualified and most of them have done a doctorate and even post-doctorate.ENYUGMA is the most awaited techno-cultural fest that is conducted every December.
There are ample books available in the library, you should have the enthusiasm to study and you are all set to read those.
You will be provided AC in selected classrooms.
There is a sports fest as such and as of now we have limited space so we can only play cricket, football, and volleyball.
A lot of extracurricular events get organized like singing and dancing. Those who have skills can participate or else do enjoy those dance shows.
There are ample clubs approx. 15 clubs in our college, you will get enough chances.

Name: Abhishek Verma
review:
The fest's Name is ENYUGMA which includes both Cultural and Technical activities. Fest is generally held in October or December.
The library is available and contains approx. 3000 books. Sports like Volleyball, Cricket, and chess are played under the Sports club.
All club websites are run by students. There are many clubs i.e. coding club, robotics club, electronics club, web development club, and sports club, etc. These clubs help the students to improve their knowledge as well as their self-development.The placement is very good and approximately 100% of students got placed in famous companies (amazon, media.net, TCS, cognizant, Wipro, etc.)
The highest package of the college offered by amazon is 45 Lakh. And the average package of the college is around 14 lakh.
The companies also offered an internship at the best package.

Name: Hari Raja Prabhu P
review: Yearly 1 fest will be celebrated and in 3 months once tech fest will be celebrated. In Library, all the books we need for our studies are available. All classrooms are fully furnished with Ac, so it is very comfortable to sit in the classrooms. Sports are quite small in our college. Nearly 20+ clubs are available in our college.For those who got above 80% in their 12th, There is a scholarship in our college. Nearly 2 lakhs will be reduced for each person who got 80% above in their 12th Class. For financial assistance for all students,13 members are there, there will be a mentor not only for financial but also for studies.

Name: Shivam Srivastava
review: The placements of our college are getting better every year. Last year the average placement was around 13 LPA and this year since the placements are going on, the statistics would be available after a few months. This year the stats would be better as few of our seniors have cracked 44 LPA from Amazon. The placement percentage is more than 98%.The fee is around 2+ lacs for academics and since the hostels are under construction, day scholar is allowed. The hostels we are living in now are charging 14.5k and around the same for the mess. There are scholarships available from your state so you may opt for that. There is a national scholarship too based on merit.

Name: Abhishek Kumar
review: I chose IT as you all know everyone wants to take only CSE. I didn't get cse so IT became my branch. most of the faculties are either Ph.D. holders or Ph.D. pursuing in the university itself. the faculties are not so renowned or not so bad. There is always an exam scenario here every month. because there are two CTs (CT-1 & CT-2 each of 15 marks on the name of internal assessment) and an End semester exam of 70 marks. Here there are no marks for the assignment. you have to study to pass the course.Equilibrio is techfest.There is no AC but only a fan in the classroom. Nexus is a club for alumni interaction run by students. Campus life is okay. You will not get the vibe of an engineering college here also because This is a central university and engineering is just a small part of this so you will find students from pharmacy, law, general BSc, etc in your college canteen.

Name: Yash
college: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology University - [JIIT]
review:
Yaa Fest also is the main thing in college life. So every year Fest is organized About Library. It is very huge and mostly all types of books are present. No Such sports are there in this college basically this is a study college.  All the extracurricular activities are available in the college with the best infrastructure in the college.Yes In placement, students can sit in placement for 6 semesters.
So I cannot explain the name of the companies because there are too many companies coming every year. mostly around 400 tech company visits And the percentage of placement is very high 99%. Mostly all the students are placed in good companies.

Name: Ambika Mishra
college: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology - [MMMUT]
review:
Life on campus is good and there are different types of clubs that always hold social activities and coding competitions which can help us to improve our skills.
Sports clubs, dance clubs, CodeChef chapters, robotics clubs, NSS, finance clubs, etc are such types of clubs.
There is a central library where you can sit and learn in peace, there is no disturbance and all types and course books are available in the library. An e-library where you can use PCs also.After completing 3rd year when we moved to the final year, we are eligible for campus placement and many companies are coming.
The average placement of mmmut is 8lpa and the maximum for last year was 45 LPA.
So it's good to get placed from MMMUT. From computer science and information technology 100% students get placed and also from other branches students get placed more than 60%.

Name: Ayush kumar sharma
college: Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology - [IERT]
review:
The course curriculum is very hectic as we have all six days of classes in a week. Every other college only runs for 5 days a week but here we have 6 college days with around 8 classes every day from 9 AM to 5 PM.
Faculty members take regular classes and we have to maintain a minimum of 75 percent attendance,
To sit in the sessional and semester exams it is mandatory of having 75 percent attendance.Campus life is not as good as you see in other top government colleges. The campus is small and all buildings are old. Boys to girls ratio are very low and you will have to hustle every day to maintain your social life. There is no club in the college. The studies are really good in the college.

Name: Lalit mohan singh
review: The syllabus and the course curriculum are very much relevant to each other and thus make students industry ready. Faculty in this college are highly knowledgeable and extremely experienced which enables them to deliver good teaching and also helps students to understand all concepts. Most of the faculty members are graduates of IITs and NITs.
