But student also gets benefits from college and from other scholarship also those boys who are sc, and stand BPL gets a scholarship from the JEE portal. And college also provides a TFWS seat tuition fee warier scheme.

Name: Karthik
review: There so many social groups will be there. So many WhatsApp groups. And instagram groups are there. Every month there will be a fest in our college. One library is there. Every Wednesday we will go to the library. So many games will be conducted on the campusThere will be eight semesters for this course. College timings start 9:30 am in the morning there were 2 classes morning then break is there for lunch. After 1 pm the class will start and end at 4 pm. Per year there will be 2 semesters.

Name: Yashashvi Sharma
review: The university conducts two fests every year. Along with that we also have a grand freshers' party and several other cultural events. Sports facilities are quite good at Chandigarh university. They also have a sports complex for students interested in sports.Fees for CSE core are 90000 per semester and 105000 for CSE specialization. But you can easily get scholarships by giving the cucet exam and to maintain the scholarship you have to maintain a cgpa above 7.5 and avoid getting backlogs in any subject.

Name: Abhiram
review: The course curriculum is vast and quite challenging which makes it better as the crop of students and competitiveness is also high. The course of CSE is on par with some of the top institutions in the country and the faculty is highly established and provides high research output which provides students an opportunity to expand and aim beyond their prescribed course.The campus is still undergoing a lot of construction but the lifestyle is really good and there are a lot of clubs that provide the students an opportunity to learn through experiences that help them better themselves and push through the normally prescribed books. There are a lot of sports competitions held on campus which is a plus.

Name: Shashank Dewangan
review:
Life at the campus is vibrant. The campus is filled with plenty of facilities for recreational activities. Students are also provided with washing rooms and libraries in their hostels. The classrooms are spacious and can hold a student strength of 80 at a time. Classrooms are all fitted with smart educational appliances and free wifi is also available (300+mbps).
The KIIT deemed to be a university is known for its encouraging nature to push students to participate in extra-curricular activities with many renowned national athletes hailing from the institution such as Dyuti Chand.The course curriculum in KIIT deemed to be university is up to date with coding implementation in labs.
1:80 is the faculty-to-student ratio.
Most of the faculties have done their post graduations and graduations from prestigious universities like IITs, NITs, etc
There are two exams in a semester. The exam difficulty is moderate.

Name: Yasharth Gupta
college: Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology - [IERT]
review:
Our annual fest is Udbhav and tech fest is technovation which is conducted in the month of October and June respectively.
Almost all type of book is available in the library and you can issue it with your Library card.
Wooden table chair, fan, perfect lighting and Wi-Fi is available in the classroom.
Annually zonal are conducted and you would participate if you want.
Our top club is gdsc.I choose this branch because I wanted to be employed as a government employee and this branch will provide me with great opportunities.
1:8 ratio faculty to student ratio.
The faculties qualifications are Ph.D. with a few of them MTech from top colleges in India.
The teaching method is old style.
Exams are taken semester wise and they can be cleared by a one-night study before exams.

Name: ashish singh
review:
Our college organized annual fests named Anakhroons in June at Newton Mela ground. At this fest, famous singers are invited such as Milind Gaba.
We have a very beautiful library almost 10000 books are there.
Our college organized different sports such as Kabaddi, Football, Cricket, and Tug of War on Independence Day.
There are very social groups in our college. For cultural Ankaran, social activities Samaritans, and so on.From the 6th semester, students became eligible for campus placements.
Amazon, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, PWC, etc. tech companies visited our campus every year.
In 2018-22 the highest package is 36lpa which is offered by Amazon and the average package is 5 lakhs.
Almost 80-90% got placed from cse and it departments and 60-70% from the core department.

Name: Jivan Gajanan Dongare
review:
In this college great independent library. Available the not but must books are available for students. Also, there are good books for those students who are preparing for the gate exam.
College's annual festival is there in this college.  And there are all department festivals.  This festival there must include Bollywood day, fashion day and sports day. For all departments. 
Sports the greatest sports event of the college is coeta cup. Is in this College.

For the actors and singers and dancers, the music club is there and independent room for this activity provide by the college 

And in extracurricular activities in this College arrange some of them are NSS camp, blood donation and tree plantation.I choose the course BE in computer science and engineering because I have an interest in coding and computer basics knowledge as well as programming languages.
The course duration is 4 years along with other courses or what says the branches are Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering and Mechanical Engineering these courses are also in this College. With a duration of 4 years respectively.
The faculty members are very nice and friendly and there's teaching is awesome.
Term exams are arranged in 5 months period and unit tests arrange after every 2 months.
If students are hardworking and smart work person for you passing the exam is not difficult for students

Name: Kshitij Singh
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review:
there is an annual fest called Bharat dhwani celebrated in October. and also there is a technical fest called Ukash. there are also some big and small events. there is a decent library in nit Jalandhar you can find many books related to your course and there are also many journals and novels in the library. all the class is a centralized air conditioning system, and there are also one projector and one smart board in every lecture hall. there are many sports clubs like athletics, football, volleyball, etc they also organize inter-branch, inter-hostel tournaments. NCC, NSO, AND NSS are also the main clubs there.
there is a debate club where you can enhance your communication skills. there is also a Prayaas society where students volunteer and teach the local kids. zeal society is also one of the famous societies.I got this course due to my rank in jee mains exam. and specifically choose this branch because it is a circuital branch and also there is programming culture involved in the curriculum like c language, dsa, etc.
in the main subject we got 2 teachers, one is the main teacher who takes classes and the other takes the tutorial sessions for doubt solving.
in lab classes, we get again 2 teachers. all the faculty is Ph.D. qualified and also involved in many types of research.
there are 3 exams in a semester 2 minors and one end sem there is almost 1.5 months gap in each exam.

Name: AKCHAT JAIN
review:
For 6 semesters on average students are eligible for placement but if you had some soft skills you are eligible before. Several companies came for placement the main ones are Infosys, infotech., Wipro, TCS, etc 
It should be above 7.5 cgpa to be eligible for placement. To get a master's degree from the same collegeThere is an Instagram page. The name of the page is wit_offical. The website of the college is with Solapur.
There is stroke which is a sports event in which all types of indoor and outdoor games are played by students even if a student loses he also grand a reward for his skills and achievements.

Name: Arslan
review:
There are many clubs such as chess, dance, art, cricket, basketball, volleyball,etc. The college never pays attention to football even when there are many good players who are willing to form a football club and go for tournament, they don't even provide a good ground to play football, this is a issue I faced myself. The meal provided by the college mess is just bad, even the plates they serve are covered in oil because its not washed properly.

One good thing is that the college has one of the best cricket ground and really well maintained.I chose Computer Science Engineering with a specialization in IoT and Cyber Security. However, you can also opt for other specializations such as Data Science, Artificial intelligence, Machine Learning, etc. The core branch is also available.
Faculty is pretty good and decent. Every single student has a mentor whose job is to help the student if any problem arises.

Name: MUDA SAI VENKATA RAMANA
review: For placements on campus, the student will pursue zero backlogs in all semesters, Placement offers will be enlarged by seeing their past performance like internships, clubs and hackathons that will help their resume.Many applications and software development companies are gathered in Placements to offer the job to the students internship that are useful for a better experience in some fields to pursue a permanent job in life

Name: Abhishek Wankhade
review: The curriculum of VIT is new and good compared to University Curriculum. There are 2 modules each year. The faculty of VIT is also good and experienced. When I am in 1st year two term exams were conducted Midesem and Endsem. But in 2nd year only Endsem is going to be conducted. Each subject has CVV, Course Project, GD, Assignments, Written Examination, and Lab examination.The placement of VIT is good. The number of companies visited per year is increasing year by year. Also, Packages are increasing per year. In Computer Engineering Department near about 98 percentage students were placed in the year 2021. Information about placement is also given on the college website.

Name: Arjun Sharma
review:
Campus life is up to the mark. you will always feel positive due to a green environment.
There are different clubs. u can join According to your choice. the college infrastructure is average if you look at other comedk colleges. but at the same time, the campus area is very big if you compare it with other comedk colleges.Internships are average here .about half of the students who applied got internships. if you are in the top 10 of your batch then for sure you will get an internship with a good amount paid.
 You can also get an internship in the big tech company.

Name: Shiva katiyar
college: Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology - [GCET]
review:
Teachers are well qualified and experienced enough to teach and guide in every kind of activity whether it is academics or projects. 
The semester exams conducted in our college are average and the students are able to score well if they study hard and are dedicated for a short period of time.A lot of fests are also organized by our college so that students can enjoy their campus life and explore it as well. 
I chose my course because I was willing to study MCA at a good college and GCET has a good rank in UP private colleges.

Name: Garvit Patel
review: Life on the campus is pretty good. There are in total 22 councils run by fellow students and seniors of the college. Various events are held by these councils on a regular basis.  Each council has its unique characteristics and students are selected for the respective councils through interviews and submission of their CVs. Cultural fests and events are also organized by the councils. An annual function called "ANUBHUTI" is organized every year where many events are organized and students have tons of fun and leisure. Various sports councils are available ranging from carrom to cricket everything.The curriculum is well-planned and structured though some classes are skipped and canceled. The faculty members are extremely charming and helpful. They teach very well if students pay full attention and stay alert. Sessional are taken inn2 terms CT1 and CT2. After 2 sessionals, the main exam is conducted. The exam level is moderate according to the AKTU curriculum. Faculty members are highly qualified personnel with much experience in their respective fields.

Name: Rohan
review: Scholarships are also provided for the sc and st cast students. Also, there is a scholarship for girls that is a Pragati scholarship. Companies like Reliance, and Flipkart come there for better convenience. Almost 70 percent of students are placed in every batch.Students from the 5th semester can become eligible for their campus placement.  The companies visited are reliance, Flipkart, and Amazon.  The highest package in my college is 11 lakhs and the average package is 4 to 5 lakh.

Name: Mayank
review:
There is some sort of exam every week after the first two weeks of the semester. Sometimes it's hectic but it is somewhat necessary. 
In sem end, there is a sufficient gap between exams, but labs ext. The teaching here is really nice and the teachers are well qualified and helpful.I am a student I didn't get any scholarship, no financial assistance whatsoever.
The fee hike is not there yet in my college. 
So I don't know what to say. 
There are a lot of other expenses that they don't include such as examination fees which are 1500.

Name: Abhishek paridwal
college: Arya College of Engineering & Research Centre - [ACERC]
review: Campus Life is cheerful. The annual fest is l party and every holy festival is conducted on campus. Many technology hackathons are held in college. All books and journals are available in the college library. All facilities are available in the classroom. All sports facilities were available in the college.The placement of the college is average. From the 7th semester, students are eligible for campus placement. Adobe AWS Infosys byjus Accenture etc. Companies visit colleges. Many offers make companies. The package is according to students' knowledge and profile. Some companies fixed criteria for placement.

Name: Amit Raj
review:
From the 5th and 6th semesters, students become eligible for campus placements.
Many companies visited our college such as American Express, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Geminis solution, etc.
The highest package offered in the year 2021 from information technology is approx 23 lacs. And the lowest package was approx. 2.2lacs.
Almost 80-90 percent of students get placed Every year.
Perhaps if I am going to talk about my plans then I just want to say my dream goal is UPSC. So I prefer completing my graduation from government college so that my graduation fees are sorted.The fee structure in this college is very affordable compared to rival institutions, and the cost to study is one of the best considering the designation it carries, however, the infrastructure provided is below standard and in line with other government institutions. The opportunity for scholarships, financial help, and campus jobs has definitely improved in recent years as confirmed by our respective seniors, as of now, these things are average, though far better than other lower-tier colleges.

Name: Manish Kumar Singh
review:
They take 4 quizzes along with assignments and 2 internals for a single semester. The total credits for the first year are 20 in each semester. One can also drop the course if he/she faces any difficulties for the same. The teachers here are extremely qualified.Looking for a better placement and all.
One should get the placement of the desired choice.
The process goes through all the placement exams and interview processes.                             
The degree is provided with all 4 years of education.

Name: NARENDRA KUMAR JHA
review:
College provides a lot of internship opportunities which you can grab easily by developing some good skills and almost everyone who has a skill gets an internship easily. so in terms of internships, I would like to give 10 stars to this college.Life on campus is quite awesome and always makes you feel relaxed due to the green and positive campus. you will get a lot of exposure here.
 The campus is large enough about 65 acres which is quite good if we compare it with comedk colleges.

Name: Arpit Pandey
review: Faculty students ratio in this college is good enough to maintain discipline. all the teachers are highly qualified most of them are passed out from IITs. Almost all teachers gave teaching experience of more than 15 years. All the teachers are so supportive.  The exam paper here is set by this University only so it is not that difficult to clear semester exams but still at the end of 4th ear 75% of strength will leave due to tough checking. If you get back in any subject you will get only one chance to clear the back if you are not able to do that you have to stay home for one year till the next batch will come.No annual fest is conducted here only one tech fest was conducted in my one-year experience which is Hackathon. We have a departmental library here open from 10 am to 5 pm and that is a nice library. There are no sports done here although we have grounds and courts for everything only acquired by the B.PEd department but if you want to play you can come and play in the morning and evening with your own equipment. There are a lot of different activities. all the scenarios are so supportive and helpful. There is also no ragging culture here.

Name: Prajwal Patil
review: We have tantrafiesta as techfest and abhivyakti as a cultural fest. The technical fest is done in offline mode in October month In this year the arrange in offline very few colleges outside college participate in it. Management of the college is not actively participating in the fest in form of providing funds. We don't have a sports ground. Now the college just flats the ground for a sports facility. We only have a badminton court single in the hostel block and a very small basketball court not in a proper way. There are only studies not any activities like Navratri or any other festival celebration. We only do the Ganesh festival until now. Abhivyakti has not been done in offline mode until now in a new campus online we have had a good response from other colleges. We have many coding clubs, music clubs, and orator clubs. Orator club is most active in college. Others are only for just names. There are no proper clubs for refreshments. College only has competitive programming coding culture not other fields like data science and web development.I want to pursue computer science and it is good for it. The student-faculty ratio is not good. Talking about the qualification of faculties we have only two-three faculties who have done their Ph.D. from IITs. Most of the Other teachers are not qualified from central Colleges like IIT, NIT, and IIIT. Up to the third semester, we don't have properly qualified faculties. Some of them are learned from local colleges of Maharashtra. As the college is in Nagpur we have more than expected Marathi teachers. There are 2 sessional exams and one end-sem exam in the semester. The papers are at a moderate to hard level. By learning teacher notes we can easily pass.

Name: Inzamam ali
review: The faculties were more than average and quite supportive. All the faculties were highly qualified and polite. The student ratio was 60:40 percent, male and female. Exams were at perfect timings giving students a proper timetable for students to prepare for it.The annual fest of our college is halcyon which is held at an inter-college level many games food stalls, theatre works, etc are done including mobile gaming. Many teams from different colleges participate actively and give their best.

Name: Ashutosh
review:
HALCYON is the annual fest in our college it's a 2 to a 3-day huge event and other small events are going on the whole year. There are many clubs and social groups you can join by showing your skills and after being a part of you can organize events, and participate in other college events. CORSIT is one of the best technical clubs it's the only robotics club in the college. You can search about it on insta YouTube and many other clubs are there in most fields.Placement is very good and students get placed in 3rd year and get a good package placement is going on the whole year good companies come the whole year.
The highest package offered in years 22-23 is 46lpa and the lowest is 3lpa average package of CSE and ECE is 6lpa for ISE is 7 LPA and lower branches also have good placement opportunities more than 5 is average for other circuit branches.
mechanical highest package is 8lpa.

Name: Niyazur Rahman
review:
The course curriculum is good and the best of many of the colleges in west Bengal. I choose B.Tech in computer science because of my passion for coding and placement scenarios. Before taking admission I am also curious about how the faculty is but the best part is we have the very best faculties who are like friends they supported you in every way possible. Most of the teachers are MTech graduates from Tier 1 colleges. There are 2 midterm exams every semester and 1 main semester exam. If you study well you can pass easily.We have many fest but our main fest is in month of February named Ecstasia . This is the biggest festival or fest our college. Library is full of books any type of book you want there is including law, journalism, etc.
Classroom is equipped with projector , computers, etc. Labs are best . Many sports activities are in college such as cricket, football, etc.

Name: Hritik
review:
The fees of the college are a little bit high which is too much for army wards the annual fee of the college is 2lakh 98 thousand including the hostel and mess and for day scholars it is 2 lakh 13 thousand.
But giving this much cost is worth it because the campus placement is just awesome in the computer and IT branch the placement is very good.
Scholarships are provided to needy ones Like PMSS, ESSA, also the top 3 students of each class are provided with scholarship money
The internship opportunities are also there many students got places in Microsoft as a mentee in 2nd year with a stipend of 1lakh 25 thousand per month and many in Deutsche bank with a stipend of 75 thousand about 50 percent of students get an internship second and third year.Especially for the Computer and IT branch, the placement is very good the highest placement in 2021 was 1 crore 16 lakh (international placement Amazon Dublin) and the domestic package was 60 lakh in uber, also the average placement for the computer Engineering branch was 18 lakh and the average for the college was 13 lakh.
Many top MNCs visits to college like Google Microsoft Amazon etc approx of 113 companies visited our college
The highest package this year is 52 lakh in cred.
The placement is 99 percent for computer Engineering,98 for Information Technology 93 for Electronic and telecommunications, and 88 percent for mechanical engineering.
I also want to get a good placement at a top MNC.

Name: Nafees Siddiqui
review:
Campus life is quite good. it is about 65 acres which quite enough if you look at Comedk colleges.
The library is open from early morning till late at night. lots of books are available .you get lots of exposure. there are many different clubs, based on your interest you can joinEach semester has 2 internals and 4 quizzes and at last sem exam. one sem is about 4-5 months and according to difficulty level it is very easy to pass the exam even if you study a day before the exam or at last night before an exam

Name: NASIR HUSSAIN
review:
The annual fest at the national level is Anubhuti, and due to covid it wasn't conducted in previous years but now it will be conducted in upcoming months for sure. The availability of books & journals is very good. Research papers, etc can easily be found in the library and the environment is friendly too. All the basic amenities are there in classrooms along with smart-tech gadgets. 
When it comes to Sports and extracurricular activities, this institute is one of the best, as it has almost every sport you can imagine of.
There are many social groups, clubs, forums, etc run by students and monitored by faculty as well. To be precise there are 22 clubs in KNIT.I wanted to choose a core branch in engineering and being from Uttar Pradesh, KNIT has one of the best Electrical Engineering Department. 
The faculty is quite well qualified and PhD holders from IITs (Dr KS Verma sir, Dr SM Tripathi sir, Dr Deependra sir, etc ). Their teaching method is quite good too. The new innovative methods and interactive sessions really help us all. Semester exams were at the exact time and it was like if you have studied well, you can pass the exams easily.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Tulsiramji GaikwadPatil College of Engineering and Technology - [TGPCET]
review: Our college has a good record of placement. Last year, about 1 lakh went to the minimum and the maximum was 4.5 lakhs and about 40 to 50 per cent of the students get placements comfortably. Many companies come to us for placements such as Bajaj, Tata Motors, Wipro, Infosys, HCL, and Tech Mahindra. Talking about eligibility, you are eligible for placement in the fourth year and you can start preparing for the campus placement.The teaching faculty inside the college is very good and they teach very well, they will have experience of about 5 years and they have done a PhD. The exam is conducted 4 times in a whole year. In which twice is a class test and twice is a semester exam. Exams are easy if you study notes provided by the faculty.

Name: Chauhan Pushparajsin
review: Internships and industry projects Offered in the final year only, Students can work with faculty on research projects. The job opportunities are predicted to meet the ambition of supreme students. The placement cell offers appropriate training and career guidance for the students. The placement cell frequently conducts seminars, guest lectures, and other career-oriented activities to offer industry exposure to the students.For the first year the fee is Rs.65,000 then 2nd and 3rd years Rs.65,000. Total is almost 2 lakhs. So many scholarships are available. Loans depend on the financial condition of the students. It varies in students. If needed they will get it from the bank. And I don't think these loans can be got easily.

Name: Gitesh Patil
college: Institute of Engineering and Technology, Devi Ahilya University - [IET -DAVV]
review: I choose Civil Engineering because Civil Engineering has more job opportunity in the government sector and vacancy for a civil engineer is increasing in government departments the Faculty of my college was well educated and trained all Civil senior faculty had doctorate degree and they explained to us all the concepts efficiently and we can learn and understand that very easily. The Midterm exam was timely conducted by the exam department and to pass the exam with good marks is very easy only you have to attend the classes regularly and revise the topic daily so you can score good marks in the term exam.the College campus has Greenery entire campus there are various tech clubs and cultural club and financial club on our campus which is run by the students the College also conducted many fests on campus the main and annual fest was the largest fest in central India called aakshank it is conducted in last of February or March. the students enjoy it very much in the event, and very famous celebrity comes to the event. the most active club in our college was cell it is the main club of ietdavv and win many awards at different levels.

Name: Chaitanya Singh Rathore
college: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Faculty of Engineering & Technology
review: Campus Life is very good there are good scenarios in university. there are many clubs available in universities like GDSC GFG and many more. you can get good infrastructure and a systemic view of the campus. All the necessary facilities like Wi-fi, Labs, Classroom and a library are available here. The infrastructures here are quite well maintained. There is a central library for all the departments. There are 4 hostels 2 for girls and 2 for boys. The food quality of the mess and canteen is good. There is also sports& GYM facility available.The fee structure for these universities is very less and affordable as compared to other universities. so you can get your target and desired dreams for an affordable fee. it is very good and value for money. All type of scholarship is available in the university and is given at State, national, Central, or university levels if you are eligible for a scholarship then definitely you will get and use the benefits.

Name: Varun Kumar Singh
college: Oriental Institute of Science and Technology - [OIST]
review:
There are two techfest conducted in a year.
 One is techacme, in the month of November and the other is techfest in the month of May.
A variety of study material books is available in the library.
Our college is also active in sports. If you have talent, then surely college will help you to lift up your skills and help you to gain more and more opportunities.
There are also many social groups run by students i.e. cultural, technical, etc.In one semester, there are two mid-semester conducted. The first midsemester will have one half of the course and the second mid-semester will have another half of the course. The mid-semester is easy to score.
The main semester exam papers are set by RGPV University. The college makes their students well prepared before they appear for exams. You can easily score 7.5 cgpa if you study according to the faculty.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
There is our tech fest named 'EQUILIBRIO' which is conducted in March. 
There is a central Library in which all types of books are available and there is also a department library for B.Tech students. Sports tournaments of sports like cricket, football, basketball, volley ball, badminton, kabaddi, etc. are conducted on campus. And many curricular activities are also conducted such as Dancing, drawing, singing, poster making, etc. There are many clubs in the college such as GFG, GDSE, etc. which are run by students.I choose this course because I was interested in the technical field and especially in computer technologies. 
The student and teacher both are very cooperative and the ratio is 1:2.
The qualification of a professor is a Ph.D. and an assistant professor is under a Ph.D. The teaching experience of all the teachers is very good. Their method of teaching is also very good. Timely exams are a little tough but if you study constantly then no issue for you.

Name: KISLAY SINGH RAJPUT
review:
Campus life is very good. There are a lot of fests namely Celegance, Roshni nights, Tech Fest, etc.
A lot of books are available in the library either you can borrow them for one week or one semester.
There are a lot of trees which make the campus pleasant and calm you will enjoy it a lot.

Social groups are NCC, NSS, and GDSC.From the 7th semester, students became eligible for placements.
Cisco, Amazon, Wipro, Infosys, and cognizant come for placements.

More than 95% of students get placed every year.

Name: Ankush
college: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology - [MMMUT]
review: I choose computer science and engineering because I have an interest in coding and technology is increasing day by day. Faculty are studied from IITs and teaching method is very good. The average package is 7 LPA which is increasing every year. About 70 percent of students are placed.

Name: Lalit seervi
college: Jodhpur Institute of Engineering and Technology - [JIET]
review:
The annual fest is held in December in which many types of games and technical activities were held. 
Yes, there is a library for the availability of all types of books. 
The sports facility in this college is very good, there is a ground for all games and available all the sports equipment.
There are 8 types of groups in this college such as robotics, auto cad, etc.I choose this course because I think that the future of this student is bright. 
There are 200+ faculty members and 2500+ students. 
All the faculty members experience 9 to 12 years of teaching. 
In 6 months of the semester, there are 3exam held 2mid terms and 1 end term. 
It is not easy to pass the exams you need to study at least 2weeks before the exams.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Students are eligible from 3rd year for placements. Companies visited are Zynga. Code k technology Pvt. limited, etc. The highest package is 36lpa and the average is 12lpa. 80 percent for IT CSE  and 60 percent for other core branches. My plans after my degree are to for higher studies.Yearly academic fees are 29500 Rs, hostel fees are 12000, and mess fees are 3360 per month. The scholarship is provided for ST and SC students and nsp is also available. University also has a training and placement cell which helped many students with their placements.

Name: Indresh Chauhan
college: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology - [MMMUT]
review:
Civil engineering is the oldest and best branch of our college, faculties are the best.
They also provide knowledge with practicals of each subject. Some faculties have experience for a long time. Student & teacher ratio is good, they are always available if you have doubts or for help with any project.
Some professors are alumni of IITs some are also from foreign universities with the best practical and theoretical knowledge.
There are 2 semesters each year and there are two minor exams & one major exam in a semester and a practice for each subject, surprise tests are also conducted timely and some other tests are also taken by the professor as per the length of the syllabus.Our college organises an annual fest every year named ABHYUDAY.
There are many different societies and clubs in our college like All India civil engineering association, Ecell, cultural synod and many others.
In extracurricular activities, our college organises a sports competition every year named AAYAS.

Name: Lokesh Kakkar
review:

The faculty: student ratio is decent, where a class consists of 70-120 students. That, I believe, is almost perfect for a teacher to look into each individual student and account for what can be better for all of them.

Recent years have seen an enormous growth in the placements of the institute, where the average package was 15.6LPA for CSE department, and 12.9 LPA for ECE department, accounting for a total average of 14.9 LPA placement.

Also, almost all the sports are available here and our college's Cricket and Volleyball teams recently won the inter college tournaments too. Hence you can enjoy every sport here.

Name: Harshit Goyal
college: Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre
review: The AI culture can be seen everywhere in today's era. All IT sector companies required AI engineers. There were many future scopes in AI. In college, there was a good ratio between faculty and students. For 60 students one particular subject teacher was available. The faculty members are good communication skills and are highly educated. Their learning method was also good. There were 2 midterms in a semester. The level of the exam is the question paper of RTU. To pass the exam 70% marks are mandatory.Renaissance is the annual event of our college. This is a 3 days event. There were technical, cultural events were takes place. DJ night and music night are also there. Renaissance is the most popular event in Rajasthan among all colleges. Books are easily available in the library. There were many social activities and social groups like SOCH, SUHASINI, AASHAYEIN, COUNCIL, etc.

Name: Amit
review: I choose the B.Tech course because I want to become a software developer. Every faculty members are support the students and helps them in their studies. In my class, there are 53 students including lateral students, and all over campus there in s 1000+ students. Every teacher and faculty member are well educated. The exam process is semester-wise and the exam is not so difficult. Every student who studied he will pass definitely.Colleges organized farewells for passed students but during Covid, there is no ceremony for 2years. But it organized motivational seminars and webinars every month. There is 1000+book are available in the library. Every class has 5-6fans and proper lighting in the classroom. Every year campus organized sports festivals and science festivals also. There is no group on the college campus and a ragging-free campus.

Name: Pawan Rai
review:
I choose this course because I want be a software engineer.
It provides better faculties for the students and have a good ratio of faculties.
All the faculties which are provided have done their master degrees.
There are two sessionols and Pre University test has been taken by the institute it is not very difficult but through this exams we are be ready for our semester exams.
The college always celebrate annual fest and also held the tech fest.
In classrooms the college provides projector classes and also provides AC facility.
It also held so many sports programs and also send their students for the competition with another colleges.
And there are also a social account on instagram which are run by the students.

Name: Amrit Raj
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: The annual cultural fest in my college is KASHIYATRA. while the annual technical fest is TECHNEX. Kashiyatra is held usually in January while technex is held in February. The library has many books and journals, one can easily find books of any genre in the library. Some classrooms are AC equipped while some are not. The bigger classroom has speakers. But talking about classrooms the amenities provided are rudimentary. We have the facility of playing almost every sport we can think of. We have got a newly constructed student activity center for all the indoor games and the gym. There are many clubs in the college, and I am active in the biz, scs, and sochem.Students studying in the 8th or last semester are eligible to sit for the placements if they don't have any backlogs. Around 200 companies last time to the campus to recruit students. They offered jobs to around 800 or more undergraduate students. The highest international package is 2 cr while the highest domestic package is around 1 cr for the sde profile. The average package is around 18 LPA. Most students are easily placed in those who sit for the placements. I will work as a data scientist after my graduation.

Name: Parth
review: The fees are a fairly good prices, one can definitely earn back their investments in little more than 3-4 years. I am talking about all the streams. If someone is coming to college by the management quota they might have a hard time getting a return on investment, the donation is really high if they go in at the last moment, I am sure it's the same everywhere. There are so many opportunities in placements, the students are well prepared for their jobs as they provide compulsory internships, so by the end of last year, everyone is well prepared. Job placements are really good, more than 5 students got the packages of 20L last year 1 got 30L as well, although it's tough for the mechanical course, the placement in mechanical is kinda poor sure is more than enough for those who get it, The placements in others streams are amazing, especially computer science its 100% placement. I personally am happy because there is a possibility for mech students to get placed in Germany France or japan.There is Sargam fest which is an annual fest, NHCE is well known for Sargam fest, which is conducted in Nov. There are tons of activities you can do during fests. Almost all the books are available in the library, u might need to do a hustle for borrowing the book sometimes otherwise they are mostly available in the library. The classrooms are good all the facilities are available including the smart boards, there are sufficient benches for students and they are fairly comfortable. There are way too many extracurricular activities, there are plenty of options for a student, the clubs are very good and are unique in their own ways, all the clubs are friendly and there are so many constant activities going on the campus. All the information is also available on the website of NHCE college. Overall the infrastructure and the social life are absolutely insane, I personally like it a lot since the college is friendly. The canteen food is fairly good there are 3 canteens in college.

Name: Mayank Tripathi
review: The fee structure is similar to that of NITs or IITs and every year there is an increase of 10% in tuition fees there is financial assistance also to students from economically weaker sections there are two categories one below five lakhs and other below 1 lakh.The course curriculum is as per the industry requirements and you get all faculties from IITs and renowned institutes of India across all courses which you will do in your degree. The term exams are made by the faculty only.

Name: Saumyajeet Behuria
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: There is a library with all books available. There are a lot of clubs like Business club, E-cell, Photography club, Astronomy club, Chess Club, SCS, etc. There are various websites for departments like udyam, and Cops. Social life is good at IIT BHU like other IITs.Fees are 2.16 lac for people above 5 lakh income and from general and obc categories for SC/ST fee is 16k per year fee waivers are available for income between 5 to 1 lakh, 66% waiver and for income less than 1 lakh 100 % tuition fee waiver.

Name: Ekansh Srivastava
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
The faculty is nice on the campus they work hard with the students. I choose CSE because I knew since high school I wanted to do this and my college also helped me with this there are different facilities for every subject and there are 60 students in one class so 60:1, the. Exams are also friendly it's not too hard. And there are highly qualified teachers7 semesters our placements begin in our college. It's the right time for the placement.
The companies visited are a lot of 700+ 
Many many students get a chance to bag big placements the highest package is 50lack + which is a dream placement for anyone and the average is 5+ 80 percent of students get placed

Name: SHIVAMSINGH
review:
Life at the campus is not easy when we were in 1 st year it feels like jail because whenever we have to go out for anything we got a pass signed by the warden and the warden signed the pass when he talks to our parents/guardian so this was so much hectic. 
There is a central library which is very good. 
The annual fest conducted by the college is ANUGOONJ  in this fest other colleges also 
And tech fest is held in Feb Or march which is  TECHNO MAX in which the person coming 1st, 2nd, and 3rd will be awarded a cash prize of 51000, and 31000,11000.
There are four to five which are active not quite active excpt SOCIAL group it always entains news thing in club
And when it comes to sports we have cricket team recently winning the university cup in UTU tournament and football, basketball, volleyball, kabadi kho kho etc are playedI choose ece because I have an interest in iot and electronic devices. 
And talking about faculty in 1 st year experience was good because we knew there so we were taken care and now in the 2nd year also but for *CSE.
Students, there are not good teachers so they are facing issues regarding classes but our classes are going smoothly and the ratio of students for every class is not more than sixty students.

Name: Gopal Krishna Yadav
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: students become eligible after the 7th sem for placements and the 4th sem for internships a lot of big Tech companies like Google, Graviton, Microsoft, Adobe etc come to our college for recruitment and also hire for international offers.There are a lot of clubs which you could explore like E-cell, Business Club, COPS, Cycling Club, Astronomy Club etc you can join whichever interests you and enjoy your campus life. Classrooms don't have ACs that's a Big Con over here.

Name: Payal kumari
college: Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology - [RKGIT]
review: I want to become a software engineer that's why I have chosen this course. There are sufficient and well-trained faculty in this college. All of them are Doctorate. They all have their youtube channel as well. There are 3 internal exams that will be taken in the college. 2 of them are 40% syllabus and another is 100 % syllabus.College is conducting the fest named TATVA. It is generally conducted in the month of September. There is also one digital library in the college. There is a separate ground for each outdoor game like football, volleyball etc. There are various societies based on culture and skills as well.

Name: Paramjeet Rathod
review: The campus is Good means very good the environment the infrastructure there is really well. all sports activities are available there some cultural programs also happened in the college named "RAAZMATAZ" library is too vast all books are available their classrooms are also goodMGM'S JAWAHARLAL NEHRU ENGINEERING COLLEGE AURANGABAD fees are like 1,50,000 per year they don't provide any scholarships as the university is DEEMED. The fees are not affordable for everyone but in some case they give you some concession in fees.

Name: Prasad
review:
When it comes to fest I will rate it 10 out of 10 
Because excellent surroundings and fests are conducted by the college.
The biggest fest at our college is SARGAM which might be conducted in September or October
Library's excellent infrastructure and books will be around 15K 
We have various clubs in our college and the classroom are excellent infrastructure and neatnessI had chosen electronics and communication engineering because the main reason I was very interested in physics-based courses and the second reason is nowadays the job offers that come for electronics and communication engineers are from IT and also from hardware companies so there will be the choice for us to go for both IT professionals and also job-based on core

Name: Hari
review: Sargam is conducted every year in November and another fest named Sargam was conducted earlier this year in June. Tech fests and events are conducted from time to time by the clubs in the college which are organized by students. Plenty of books and study materials are available in the library of college and they can be borrowed to be taken home too. Most of the books suggested by the faculty are available in the library. There are good amenities in the classroom. There is a projector fixed to the ceiling and there is a speaker so that explanatory videos and pictures can be shown for better understanding. There are plenty of sports and extracurricular activities conducted regularly. Every month there are at least 3 to 4 sports events and club events from which students can participate and earn certificates. One of the most prominent clubs is the media club and art club which make the posters, artwork, and all design-related things for the events conducted in college.I chose Mechanical Engineering to pursue my interest in getting a job in the automotive field once I graduate. The faculty is very good and are readily available to help students. Almost all the faculties have good qualifications and have a wide knowledge of their respective subject. The final exams of the 2nd semester were difficult and very hectic because the semester was completed within just three months and the practical exams were right before the theory exams and thus gave us very little to no time to revise the portions of the 2nd semester. This combined with the change in the pattern of the papers made it slightly difficult to expect what type of questions would be asked in the exam.

Name: Harsh
review: I have a good interest in electronics so I chose this course and it has higher chances to get a student placed in good comapanies. faculty members are friendly but all you have to do on your own. most of the faculties are Ph.D. and exams are conducted every semester.cost to study is not much if you have an income certificate of less than 5 lac income. You get 2/3 of the fee remission. Many scholarships are also there you get emails whenever a new scholarship comes. One of the scholarships known to me is from the state govt.

Name: Satyansh Singh
review: The course curriculum is good but I think they should change the syllabus as per the trend. In the first year of BTech, we all study the fundamentals of BTech as they teach all subjects i.e physics, chemistry, mathematics, mechanicals, mechanic, graphics, etc. the teachers have been really helpful in making us study.The fee structure given in the brochure for BTech is 125000/-. In terms of a scholarship students who achieved 80+ in 12th they will get 25%, for 85+ they will get 50%, and for 90+ students will get a 100% scholarship in tuition fee which is 110000 for BTech.

Name: Swastick Kumar Dey
review: The placement statistics are increasing year by year in this college. Like other colleges, the placement starts at the end of 6 semesters. Almost all students get offers. Like other private colleges, students also get offers from mass recruiters like Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, etc but students also get offers from Cisco, Amazon, and Adobe every year. This year the highest package is 45lpa offered by Amazon.The campus life is above average. All the facilities are available. It got its Library building where you can get any kind of Book. The annual fest and tech fest are also conducted on the premises. It has many clubs for leisure activities. It conducts many events in almost all festivals. So everyone enjoys the campus.

Name: Harshvardhan Parmar
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: So we have here 10 technical club which deals in every current technical field and 10 cultural club which take care of every aspect of cultural side. They work very efficiently. Plus we have tech board and sport boards which provides World class facilities in the same . Classes are fully central air conditioned with projectors and sound system.Fees of IITs are same everywhere and is decided by central government considering inflation and World class facilities they provide here so it's not a issue besides financial assistance of every kind in form of scholarship of various ministries and institute scholarship for top performers are available here.

Name: Amit Gupta
review:
Btech is a trending course with job opportunities at this time skyrocketing. 
This was my motivation to choose this course but if anyone's dream is to become a software engineer or is interested in ai ml or other stuff this is the course for them. A class of 60 students is taken with one teacher taking the class. 
But there are extra faculty for labs and in case some teacher is absent or left the college immediately. 
So approx ratio would be 1:50
The teachers are qualified and their teaching reviews are quite good they make students learn the course teachers don't encourage students to do extracurricular activities. Basically, in class, there is a school-type surrounding. But outside you can decide what u have to do. 
Exams are easy a student can easily pass the exam with one-day prior study to the exam. 
Quantum book all college students may hear of it is enough for passing and topping in class.The annual fee for BTech students is 134000.
The college provides a hostel with an extra cost of 94000.
There is no such thing as a scholarship for students who have taken direct admission. 
And students who have taken admitted through the entrance exam can avail of the benefit of the scholarship. 
I do not fully know about financial assistance but to my knowledge, they have not provided it till now to my batch. 
There is no such thing as a campus job one has to find online work for extra money. 
There are many websites on which student like us can earn money.

Name: Namandeep Singh
review: The fee structure is almost similar to all other IIITs, since being run both by the government and privately. Although, state scholarships are available in mass for each category of students. It is confirmed that each of the students who study at IIIT Bhopal will get a job with min. salary of 16 LPA till the end of the final year.The campus life is good. We are the ones who are trying to conduct our very first fest. Tech fests are usually online conducted by clubs. Classrooms are not so big but can be managed. Sports are okayish. We need permission for any of the sports to play from MANIT.

Name: ASHLESHA GAUTAM
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: I chose this course as it provides us with so many opportunities. Faculty depends on the department as I am from computer science and technology. Here, faculty members are very helpful and polite. Some faculty members are alumni of this college. Teaching method varies from teacher to teacher, some teach from the slides, and some on the board as well as from slides. There will be mid-semester and end-semester exams in one semester. The teacher's notes are sufficient to pass the exams.Kolkata's largest tech fest- Instruo is organized by this college annually in November. Clubs are very active and they also help to build confidence in oneself. Ramanujan Central Library of this college is one of the top libraries in Kolkata. Sports facilities are there. College ranked 7 in the Sparda event which was organized by the IIT bhu.

Name: s chetan
college: Vallurupalli Nageswara Rao Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [VNR VJIET]
review:
The annual fest in our college is known as scintillahunz it is the biggest college fest in hyd and every college waits for this fest which usually happens in the month of June to July and there are technical and club fests which are happened often.
The books and journals in the library are abundant u will get a library card and using that card u can grab any 2 books for a particular time period.
Sports and extra curricular activities are great on campus and our college takes part in every competition which will happen.I could not name all the companies which have offered internships with stipends because I could not remember them.
there are two types of projects they have offered first is a minor project and the second one is a major project minor project is the project which we do and the major project is the project in which we go to the site and do it.

Name: Nitish Kumar
review:
My course Name is computer science and engineering (Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning). At present and in the future there is a very good scope for AI &ML.
The professors are very good they are very supportive and helpful, Highly qualified (Ph.D.).
The examination process is very good generally questions are coming from Notes which are discussed in the classroom.The fee structure is average. Financially they will help you if exactly you need. Campus placement is very good. you can take an education loan with the help of your State Government. For example, if you are from Bihar you can take an education loan from State Government (Bihar student credit card).

Name: Monika Saraswat
review: Because it helps us to aware of the new era of technology and I'm also quite fascinated with this. The ratio is about 1:70 . Teachers are qualified but sometimes it is quite miserable when the teacher wants to deliver something but it is not so happening. Term exams happen in nearly a 1.5 -2 month period .. their level is moderate.There is no such internship done by me as I am a second-year student still in 3 Rd sem. But according to our seniors, there are very less internship opportunities for the students on campus but off campus, there is a lot. If you're applying to an internship then there must be a project regarding ml, web, app, and all.

Name: Kuldeep
review: The fee for BTech specialization is 740000 and the BTech core fee is 660000. The scholarship is available on the percentage of your 12 for 1 first year at the time of admission and to maintain that scholarship for next year you have to maintain your 8 cgpa .I choose my course because there is a good scope of job in it. There are lots of faculty and there us about 3000 students in the overall university. All faculty is Ph.D. qualified and some of them are fresher. Exams are taken after one month on time.

Name: garvit kirodiwal
college: Modern Institute of Technology and Research Centre -[MITRC]
review:
from the 7th semester students are eligible for placement and, TCS , Wipro, lenskart, are the companies that visited the college for placements highest package is 12 lakh and the least package is 3 lakh given by companies there is a max. 75? of students getting placement I plan to achieve the best in my field,I choose this course because of the job opportunities after the course.
3:1
most of the professors are Ph.D. and well qualified in teaching and make effort to teach students.
Exam timings are very poor and students know about the exams one day before the exam.

Name: Alish Shrestha
review: The fee is around 3-5 lakhs per year including the hostel and mesh fee. The overall cost is average compared to other universities of the same rank and same status. Some people also get scholarships if they are eligible for them.Life on campus is very wonderful and fun. There are lots of gardens to walk in when felt bored. Also, there are fountains. The swimming pool is also present. Some events occur rarely which are also conducted by students.

Name: Mudit Sharma
review:
The course curriculum is good and most of the faculty members are good.
The faculty-student ratio is good.
Facility members are appropriately qualified and few of them are highly qualified.
Exams happen for a shorter period than in other universities or colleges.....the exams are not that difficult to score if you have studied well.The fees hike around 2-4 thousand yearly.
There are many scholarship opportunities based on your 12th percentage, residence, etc.
I am a sophomore so I have not been placed yet or done internships provide by the college but I have heard from my seniors that it is quite good and most of it depends upon your ability.

Name: Tushar Latiyan
college: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University - [AKTU]
review: Every year an annual fest KOLAAHAL is organized by the College in November month. Other fests are also organized like dandiya night, shankhnaad, Akshaya Jyoti etc. Books in the library are easily available with the help of a library card. Sports facilities are available in college but not at a good level. There are 4 to 5 committees in college for cultural and social works.Placement at the meet is quite good than any other college in Meerut. Students become eligible for campus placements from the 7th semester. Renowned companies like Wipro, TCS, Deloitte, amazon, etc. visit the colleges to hire students. Above 90% of students from cse branch are hired. The highest package of last year is 43 lakh and avg package of cse is 4.5 lakh.

Name: Vaibhav Sharma
review:
I chose this course as I have a passion for computer science. GLA is adding faculty from time to time to comply with the student ratio which is increasing per year. Faculty is well qualified to give you knowledge about his/her subject in depth. The teaching method is OK.
There are 2 exams per semester, Midterm and End term. In the midterm, you hear around 30-50% of the syllabus and in the End term, you get the next 50% including the previous one (however the percentage of midterm topics is less as compared to end-term topics).We have fests organized by clubs and festive fests in corresponding months.
Maximum books are available in Library, they have an online system to search for available books.
You will have AC classrooms and halls with good lighting.
There are many sports activities organized by the sports club of gla.
Many clubs are run by students, E-cell, Abacus, Gla Voice, Nature Club, etc.

Name: Harsh
review: You are free from the start of college to do an internship in any firm. Companies that visit the campus offer around 18 lacs as the highest package and the average placement offered here is 800000. My plan after getting my degree is to do a job. Students here prefer studying abroad rather than getting placed.The annual fees for the course are 176000 rupees. You can get various scholarships like financial aid which is provided by the university and also scholarships like MYSY and other government scholarships. You can work in the university like being a teaching assistant and this way you get stabilized income.

Name: Aryan Dahiya
review:
Life at the campus is very good you get a lot of exposure, and interaction with a variety of people.
Many fests are conducted but there are not at all that good but it's fine.
The library is also good. The classrooms are fine.
Sports and extracurricular activities are also there.The placement is good for BTech cs students they can easily get a package of 6-8 lakh which is also the average package. If you put a little more effort you can easily get 10+ LPA. Companies visiting the campus are well known like Microsoft, Amazon, and tech Mahindra.

Name: VARSHITHA R
review:
Fresher's day is celebrated in our college. All government functions are celebrated.
Course-related subjects related are available at the library. it will be given showing a library card.
The classroom was well structured.
Extracurricular activities are provided this year for 1st-year students' internships.
Science club was created it will help us to know technical facts.In 2021 scheme it is a new scheme NEP. 
The fee for 1st year is 34810. All category students.
And I got a scholarship from SSP which will provide 18260 and I get one more scholarship Mukyamantri Raita Vidyanidhi 11000. It will be helpful.
And the Sem exam applies fees of 1300.

Name: Abhinav Gupta
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review:
Campus life is far better than private colleges in India as there are no PDA charges. 
There are many 2 important fests on our campus. The technical fest is INSTRUO and the annual fest is REBECA.
There is also a library that holds over 100000 journals and books and is one of the oldest in India.
The classroom is quite good and there are fans for 1st-year students. But don't worry you will get AC from the Second year if you don't belong to the civil or mechanical branch.
There are 2 grounds Oval and the Lords. One is football and the other is cricket ground.
There are many clubs and one may join accordingly to their interests. There is an EDC club that is run by students and funded by the institute.The course curriculum is similar to that of other NITs and nothing much difference. The faculty members are highly knowledgeable and approachable. They clear your doubts from time to time.
I chose civil engineering because I wanted to serve my nation in its building and infrastructure.
There is a good amount of faculty: student ratio. Some professors are old and hence they still have old-school style methods of teaching but new teachers and professors make teaching interactive by introducing smart boards and learning with AI.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: The cost to study is quite good if you are in a category (st, sc). But if you are not then might feel it to be quite expensive. Job offers are good in my department as it is a very good department for IT jobs. Students also get government scholarships.I choose computer science and technology because I just love to spend time with electronic equipment. Many faculties are very friendly and very supportive.  Exams come twice in one semester one in the mid-semester and the other at the end semester.

Name: Muskan Gupta
review: The campus is impressive and attractive. Some proctors are always there to feel safe. There are libraries in each block where you can have max to max for every book. There are hundreds of clubs that conduct multiple events with the collaboration of other colleges like IIT NITs.I think some fewer people get placed off campus. The placement criteria of my college are nearly 75 to 85 percent. I wish to get the on-campus placement and then off off-campus one. There are many great companies like Amazon, and Google that comes to the campus for placement.

Name: Ayush Jain
review:
Being a technology geek, I am very interested in knowing the emerging latest technology, that's why I opted for this course.
In this course, each semester consists of 5 subjects and 3 practical lab subjects. All the faculties are well qualified and Ph.D. holders have immense knowledge about the subject. The teaching method is more schools, however, the practical labs are an addon to the subject giving practical knowledge of the subject. Each semester consists of 3 tier system of examination mini-test, mid and end-sem.There are many fests held throughout the year like dance fest, music fest, sports fest, coding fest, etc. The annual fest Aarambh is held in February and the sports fest sporlumina is held in December. The college is accessible to the multi-floor library of MANIT having books of all types. There are many clubs in college, some of them are Codame- coding club, Antrigini- cultural club, GDSC- Google development student club, GUC - Linux user club, E-cell, etc.

Name: Tanmay Sharma
review:
I choose B.Tech (CSE) because I had a slight interest in programming languages and computers. And I can say without any risk that this course is at the top in terms of no. of students pursuing it. GLA University gives quite good placements in CS brach compared to other private colleges in UP or nearby states. There are more than 12000 students in the university and more than 2000 faculty. So roughly the ratio of faculty students is 1:6. Almost every teacher is helpful and literally has good knowledge and you'll find a few outstanding faculty but sometimes if a teacher is not delivering their knowledge well and if you complain about that teacher, they will listen to you. 
In a year you have to give exams 4 times in a gap of around 1.5-2 months. If you studied well and attend classes properly you can easily score good marks but if you are the one who studies the night before the exam then it won't be easy for you to pass the exam.There are a lot of fests conducted by different types of clubs. E-cell club organizes tech fests like inviting some intellectuals and they conversate with students. Cultural fests like DJ night and dandiya night happen. The library has a lot of books you can get any book you want. And I should mention GLA's library is something to talk about. Every sport is available and sports tournaments are conducted annually. Clubs are run by students and mentored by one particular faculty.

Name: Charan sai
college: Malla Reddy Institute of Engineering and Technology- [MRIET]
review: In our college there is only a freshers' party and they will conduct only one fest in six months and it is very and books and journals in the library and it has pass separate for the library and have extra sports and games on the campus and has also in social group and clubs and runs by the student.I chose this course because of my eamcet rank and getting a seat only in this course and thas why I take this faculty was good was a ratio of 20:50 and the faculty was very qualified and very nice to teach but very strict in the exams and it was very easy paper for easy.

Name: Atharv
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: Students sit for placements after the seventh semester. top companies like DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, Google, Microsoft, and amazon visit the campus. The highest international package was 2 crore last year and avg package of college was 25 lakh per annum. Nearly 90 percent of students of college get placed.Life at the campus is great. there are various clubs here according to your interests. Alcheringa is the biggest fest of the college as well as one of the biggest fest in northeast India. All classes are equipped with projectors. Clubs for sports, music, coding, etc are all run by student bodies.

Name: Nitika
review: Life on campus is good. There is a three-day annual fest called dharohar in our college also two-day fest called abhivyakti and kavyanjali in our college and many technical seminars and hackathons in our college. There are about 4000 books and journals in our library. There are many sports in our college like cricket basketball volleyball and many more. There are many clubs in our collegeThe fee Structure of 115000 but there is some scholarship for Uttrakhand students and also for the students who got good marks in 12th jee mains and entrance exam q-care. You have to pay the fees semester-wise in our college and also the sem fee is also be submitted in two instalments. And about job stipends, some students get jobs with stipends not many students

Name: Deepak
review: Placement is most important for students.  many social groups and clubs are run by students you can find out some of them on Instagram like ECA, dance club, music club, etc.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
No fest is conducted in this college just small cultural programmes were conducted once in a year in auditorium hall or in ground.
Yes since it is a university so it has one college library and one central university library so books are easily available to students but there are not many copies of one book so students have to follow - the " first go first take " rule in the library during exam times.

Name: Yamini Rathore
review:

Name: jivesh kumar
college: Punjab Engineering College University of Technology - [PEC]
review:
Campus life at PEC is very good. Social life is great as people here are quite open and broad-minded, and seniors are also quite involved and helpful. There are more than 20 active clubs and cells run by the students. The infrastructure at PEC is nicely built and well maintained, high-quality labs are available and also a very good library is there.
Annual fest and tech fest - PEC FEST conducted in the month of November.
In the Library, most of the books and journals required are easily available, and more than 1.5 lakhs volumes are available. Although Library is small compared to that of an IIT.
Classrooms are of sufficient size and have a capacity of 120 to 140 students. Classroom equipped with smart boards and a projector. Wi-Fi connectivity in every classroom is available and is also equipped with air conditioners.
Most of the sports are available here and extracurricular activities such as summits, surveys, and street play are held here. Every club or social group here is run by the students.The course curriculum is nicely designed and well structured to keenly implement the outcomes of courses. Faculty members are highly educated and well-trained and are also quite involved in research with students.
I chose this particular course as I had a good interest in mechanical engineering and also the college was able to provide ample opportunities in this particular field. College is able to bring good companies for placements.
Faculty to student ratio is 1:20 (counting only full-time faculty) excluding part-time faculty.
Every faculty is required to have a PhD MTech BTech in the specified courses. Additionally for Professor 10 years of experience and 6 research papers published are a must, for an associate professor 8 years of experience and 6 research papers are a must,  for an Assistant Professor these are not required. The teaching methodology is completely dependent on the professor.
Exams are held as per the Academic calendar and no delay occurs.

Name: Aditya Sharma
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: In SRM the campus environment is very good. All the students are very helpful. Seniors always help juniors and the campus is completely ragging-free. Name: Piyush patel
college: Dwarkadas J Sanghvi College of Engineering - [DJSCE]
review: I didn't opt for any scholarships because there was no clear communication from the government about the Gujarati minority being eligible for the scholarship and hence no financial assistance and internship I got on my campus. Name: Rohit Tiwari
review: The reason I chose this B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering is due to my liking for it and the various opportunities in the newly mechatronics field. Since admission was a bit late thus exams were delayed too but they managed to get the track session.In my college there is a training and placement cell that is very active regarding the placement opportunities  . In the past year, we had a placement opportunity in BYJU and other well known companies such as Hindalco and Ultratech cement.  The highest package offered was 12 LPA in BYJU and the average is usually between 6-7 LPA.

Name: Gaurish siwan
review: DTU is known for its amazing campus life and fests. Dtu has about a 170 acres campus area, consisting of A library, two auditoriums an OAT, A huge sports complex, and many other things. Social life in this college is really good, seniors interact a lot with the freshers and also guide them in their career paths. Clubs and societies are very active here and take auditions or interviews every year to take in interested candidates. The best thing that happens in DTU is THE ENGIFEST and which occurs around April or May. It's the largest cultural fest in Northern India. Many celebrities come to perform on our campus, and the cultural clubs also play their role in making this event a huge success. In the end, I would like to say that, if you're looking for a great campus life along with a good placement, you should opt for DTU.I chose this course because at my rank this was the best possible option. Also, DTU ( formerly known as DCE) is an esteemed institution with good faculties and other facilities. The teaching faculties are quite experienced here, for example, you might have heard of Professor Dr. HC Taneja. He's the HOD of the mathematics dept. at DTU. We only get a month to prepare for our end-term examination after giving our midterm exams, and the syllabus is also completed by the teachers. But studying efficiently and solving past year papers, helps a ton and one can get good marks in the exams.
