My plan after the degree is to peruse a master's in my field.

Name: Ranna mn
review:
In this college, you don't need to worry about placement and internship.
This college provides internships in the college only. There is a ship in a college which is having all facilities like the original ship. In that only internship, practice is done.Life at the campus is good and very exciting. There is a big library with total air conditioning. It has a variety of new books and a huge collection of books related to the course. there are many sports events and other functions.

Name: Yash Thakur
review:
College campus is best from other college. Fest is in September month specialy for the freshers student. 
You can easily get your books from the library no need to buy the books. There are jounarals if you fill good to study you can take it by registering in computer but you should have id card for that. 
Classroom are good with good design, AC, and comfortable banch . 
Sports tournament are conducted every months in which you can play criket, football, volleyball, basketball, kabadi etc. 
There are insta account of jb knowledge park which are run by studentI have great interest in computers and animation, so i opted this course by which I can do what I like in future.
faculty are supportive not everytime but in maximum time they will help you. Teacher's are very good they just mind their own business and very supportive u can message them any time and they will help you. 
There are 120 student in B. Tech(C.S.E) this time and 900+ student in BCA and 700+ student in BBA. 
There are 2 semester in a year. And every semester have 2 term exam. Term exam are easy to pass but semester exams are hard to pass.

Name: Ashish
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
There are two big fest i SRM one is Milan which is conducted by DSA( directorate of student affairs) and another one is aaruush maindays ( aaruush). One another directorate conducting an event name an alumni reunion is conducted by DAA ( directorate of alumni affairs). Books are there in library you can borrow for 15 Days after 15 days you can renew the book. 
Sports and other events are conducted from time to time.
DAA,DSA, aaruush,srmkzilla ,cell ... There are 40+ student working organization in SRM.7th semester onwards students are giving the interviews. This year 100+ companies visited SRM. And a total of 2000+ students got placed. This data is for cse students.
You also got some pre-placement in the internship period. 100 percent of students are placed on campus there is a process for placement.

Name: Rakesh
review:
in month near 4 or 5 tech ciub are conduted and ever year ferval party and student stalls also.
in sse and sec have one library that  name was SAIL it was so cinematic and foregin look. i hope  every one most like that library in whole campus 
each class have 30 members benches and dicussion table's 
the have sports have throe ball ,circket ,foot ball ,volly ball,baskey ball, and other ATHLETICS also there
Faculty are highly qualified . in curriculum they provide GATE syllabus and there sem exam conduct gate exam also.
ever 30 students have one professior
ever faculty completed (Mtech and other PG)
in this campus have 70% internal and 30% external (lab and theory)

Name: Anant Kumar Sharma
review: As placement is considered it has the best placement rate in central India and the average rate of placement is 6 lacs per annum, from the very 3 year or 5semester companies start coming to our college. Our college has signed MoU with very different companies these companies hire students at a very high rate and high packages almost every student got placed.  I have to focus on MNC companies that visit our college.The campus is too big to enjoy college life, 4 to 5 months ago there was a fest for freshers, and the Indian star are invited like aasta gill performed the stage show and there are many more fests held in our college. All types of sports are conducted on campus and all college site is divided into many groups and clubs hence many students participate in extracurricular activities.

Name: Abhishek JAISWAL
review: I have chosen this course because it contains lots of free time. I wanted the free time for exploring new things and exploring my passion. The student ratio is very bad in civil in my class there were only 2 girls in 78 boys. The faculties are highly qualified but the teaching method is traditional. I think the term exams are more frequent and it is easy to pass, It can be passed by some small past study and overnight study before the paper.In DTU there are many fests going on across the whole year, among them manifest is the biggest cultural fest. Almost all international writer's books are present in the DTU library. DTU has a fully AC three-floor library. Classrooms are fully AC equipped and have large sitting areas. The campus is having a large playing area with all indoor and outdoor games DTU also has many societies that regularly organize different programs on campus.

Name: Priyanshu Kumar Singh
college: MIT Art, Design and Technology University - [MITADT]
review:
The campus life is the campus is best in the whole state. There are regular events and celebrations conducted. 
Persona fest is the point of attention which is held in February for all the cultural fest. 
Sports are a lot good in the college you can play any sport from cricket to swimming and there are regular sports events like Intercollegiate, WPU summit, and Vishwanathan sports meet which are held from October to January in Quick Succession. 

There are also selections for All India university teams. 

There are different clubs run by students like gods, aces, and CodeChef. All of them are national-level clubs.Computer science and engineering is the best course taught in college. 
The faculties are qualified enough. Sometimes they suck as they have to rush the syllabus but they provide online sessions also for doubt clearance. Examinations are divided into four parts per semester. There are 2 unit tests of 20 marks and 1 unit test MCQ type and then the end sem examination. 
You just have to study, not that hard, you can score good marks easily.

Name: Atique Hussain
college: Dr. D. Y. Patil School of Engineering and Technology - [DYPSOET]
review:
The fee structure is the same for every branch.
It's around 1.17 lakhs per year. 
Talking about the scholarships the open category got not have any scholarships from the Maharashtra government. But other categories can apply for a scholarship from MahaDBT and get scholarships up to 50% or even more.This is the best part of this college which attracts the students.
Apart from being small in size, the college provides phenomenal placements. The highest placement was 43lpa.
There is a very good chunk of companies visiting the college.
The TPO office is one of the best and helps a lot.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Institute of Infrastructure Technology Research and Management - [IITRAM]
review: Placements are not satisfactory. You cannot expect a 3-3.5LPA package after spending 9-10 lakhs for this degree. It will take 3 years to get your money back only which you have invested in pursuing this degree. The placement percentage is also very low(got to know this while discussing with seniors). There is no single data available on its website regarding package and placement percentage.The fee of this college is very high as compared to the rest of govt. colleges/GFTIs. Its fee is approx 2.25 lakhs/year(for candidates admitted through JoSAA/CSAB) and 1.5lakhs/yr (for candidates admitted thru ACPC counseling/GUJCET exam). Scholarships are only available for ACPC students (ACPC is the counseling of Gujarat state).

Name: Antala jenish sanjivkumar
college: L.J. Institute of Engineering and Technology - [LJIET]
review: i choose CE because it is in prime mode. also faculty in this college is veryvery hepling and always ready to sopve any doubts of students. i can rate 4.5/5 to faculties.Here exams are taken in 4 phase no mid sems or final university exam only 4 exmas per 3 week and every one is final exam of 25 marks so, total out of 100 placed in your original marksheet. and exams difficulty levels are according to the course not so easy.there are soo many clubs in the college in the university that run by students. clubs includes photography, Sports, Coding skills, Content writing, music, E-sports, many more etc. you csn get connect with any you want there is not any restrictions for any other field students

Name: Shubham Khonde
review:
I choose this course because I have some knowledge about this field and a also done my diploma in this field, therefore, I choose this course.
The student's ratio is I think 50:50 male: female,
Some teachers are well qualified and some are on a contract base. 
Exams are conducted on a timely basis and exams are easy to pass if you study well.There is a very decent infrastructure or campus,
But their fest and monthly event are the best. 
Books and journals availability in college is also very descent it's not more and less it is at medium.
If you are sports addicted person then go for this college because this is a government college that organized a well amount of sports events.

Name: SAHIL SAGAR
review: Campus Life is excellent at NIT KURUKSHETRA. Clubs and cultural societies help students to explore. Clubs help students to improve their skills. The dance crew and Bhangra crew are awesome. There are a robotics club, music and dramatics club, HLAD, and ELAD society which are amazing. And Automatic vehicle club. It is best, they develop FW vehicles and participate in races.The placement is quite good here. Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Adobe, and many more companies hire students from NIT KURUKSHETRA. The best placement is for the IT branch followed by CSE. A total of 7 courses is offered here. In EE almost 70 to 80 percent of students got places this year. The average package is also satisfactory.

Name: Ankit Raj
review:
The Bachelor of Technology in Computer science is trending and has a good future in computer science. There is an approx. 1:50 teacher: student ratio in our college. Many of the faculties have doctorate degrees (Ph.D.), many of them have master's degrees in their field many many of them are experts in their particular field. 
Term exam will be held after 2 months of sem starting and after 2 months of mid sem, there is an end sem held in our college.There is a two-day annual fest called Kavyanjali and Abhivyakti and also a three-day fest called Dharohar in which many fests will be held like technical fest game fest and many more. Classrooms are good podiums fans tables chairs and much space to seat approx. 70 students easily in one classroom. There is good scope in sports and extracurricular activities on campus.

Name: Shivansh Pathak
college: The LNM Institute of Information Technology - [LNMIIT]
review:
A well-maintained library is constructed, where all types of books are available for reading as well as issuing. 
Lecture halls are big enough to accommodate 200 students at once, there are 10-12 as such. Seminars and sessions are held there as we lack an auditorium.
There are decent sports facilities, one SAC includes 3 badminton courts, one squash room, and one dance room. Then the outside area has a volleyball court, lawn tennis court, basketball court, football ground, and a cricket ground.
Campus life on normal days is not so good, we have a canteen area where one general Store, one stationary, one salon, one snacks corner, one ice cream corner, one laundry shop, and 2 restaurants are there. 
There are many clubs and societies one can be a part of and develop its personality. We have 3 fests cultural/technical/sports namely, Vivacity/Plinth/Desportivos.Companies visit the college for an internship, take coding round, and interviews. During the recession period as well companies are visiting for internships, it's a big thing in itself, and in coming years these stats will go up. Students apply for campus internships as well in summer break after the 2nd and 3rd semesters.
Some companies provide internships and then recruitment in 4th year, for that we have the 8th semester also known as SLI (semester-long Internship).

Name: Nikhil Sharma
review:
I chose this course because I have an interest in a technical field - coding I started computer coding and learning from 8th standard, I used to make webpages using HTML and CSS, and also money is another important reason.
As I can say in my college, Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology I am in the IT branch so, it has 4 technical branches - CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, and morning and evening shifts in IT,CSE. CSE and IT are divided into 3 groups CSE-1,2,3 and IT-1,2,3. Speaking of faculty in my It branch we have around 10 faculty members. So the total faculty: student ratio is approximately 9:1.
 I mean some out of many I can say aren't that qualified but most of our teachers and professors are highly qualified as they came from many prestigious universities like DU, NSUT, etc. In the case of their teaching method, they are teachers so can't differ but I can some teachers are bad while most teach well.
 Term exams were about 1.5 months apart from the start of sem, it was not that difficult.MSIT Raunak Fest 2022, happened recently and the dress code for the event was ethnic clothes( Indian traditional clothes ) celebrated in October from 10 am to 4 pm.
Books are easily available in the library and can be assured on a semester basis from the Book bank. 
 Talking of amenities in classrooms most of the classrooms have wooden tables with blackboards, projectors are generally cleaned and have ventilation, and full lighting. Some of the fans don't even work but they get repaired as per the student's request.
Most of the classes don't have Air conditioners
There are sports and extracurricular activities on campus.
I don't know about clubs but there are many societies (Prakriti, IEEE, DSC) and social groups on WhatsApp for development competitive and many things.

Name: Latha Devi
college: University College of Engineering, Anna University - [UCEA]
review:
I wish to work in the IT field. So, I choose this course. In my college, the faculties are very friendly they help us a lot through subjects, they also help us financially (fees). Anna university is never tough. But sometimes they ask one subject too tough. To get a good score semester exam you can start study before one month before the final exam.Here, my first-semester fee is 17810/- and after that till eight sem 9000/- per semester. 
Scholarship 3500-5500/- depends on the individual. So many scholarships are there, and students have to search for them and apply. 
My senior got placed in TCS. We can apply for job interviews during 3rd sem. Here, seniors are so friendly.

Name: INDRANI GHOSH
review: I choose my course because it can give me chances in both governments as well as private sector jobs. The faculty members are good enough to teach us. They provide us with notes, study materials, online study materials, videos, etc. for our understanding. The faculty and students ratio is 40:1. More than 75% of teachers are doctorate. Exams process is very good.Students reading in the 6th semester can seat for placement. Many big boss g companies come in our college such as Wipro, techno, etc. More than 70% of students get placement. In my opinion, I want to give the gate competitive exam to continue my studies.

Name: KUNAPALLI SYAM SUNDAR
college: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education
review: I choose my course, with more benefits, the faculty was good in our college, the Qualification faculty above Ph.D., MTech, and good stuff faculty, easy to pass the examination, and we can study for 1 week before exams. There is a semester-wise examination.The fee Structure is based on the course department, mostly CSE will be high, the scholarship on 12th and emacet and JEE Mains, job placements going well every year, and college is good for placements and study purposes.

Name: Borse Kunal Prashant
review: The fees are 65000rs in this college. the fees are paid in form of instalments. there are 2 instalment is available in this college. The scholarship is different types for depends on the student category. the college is financially strong and it always helps students to do new projects.The college is the best and they give the opportunity and placement, that's why I chose this college. the teaching faculty is also good. All the teachers are educated in PhD. the term exam is conducted as per time in this college is very difficult to pass in exams.

Name: CHHOTU GUPTA
review: The fee structure is semester wise each semester fee is 72500 and some conditions are applied when your family income is below 1lacs then you got 100% tuition fee remission and also those students who have a family income between 1lacs to 5lacs then got 66% fee remission on tution fee and tution fee is 62500 and scholarship is NSP and e-Kalyan and FFE and college provide also many more scholarshipWe choose here civil engineering b.tech course because my JEE MAIN rank was not so good or according to my rank, I got Civil branch. The faculties of civil engineering are so good and In this college, our branch is one of the best branch faculties.

Name: Suresh Meena
college: IIT Roorkee - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITR]
review: The annual fest name is THOMPSON, which is conducted in the month of October. Every book is available in the central library. Sports and other extracurricular activities are conducted from time to time. The best part of the fest is DJ nightMainly this depends on your computer skills like ( coding, and editing ). And the companies are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Hcl etc and some others are start-ups companies. After interns, you may get a job as well after good references.

Name: Aryan Verma
review:
The annual fest of the college is known as moonstone and it is organised in the month of November every year.
Books are easily available in the library and you can issue one book for 2 weeks.
Proper benches and tables are available in classes for students also smart class is there as well as fans and lights are present in classes.
There are no sports activities happening in the college.
There are different clubs present in the college which are a cultural club, socio-eco club, physics club and many other clubs also thereI chose the IT branch at MEDICAPS UNIVERSITY, INDORE because nowadays there is a good scope in the IT sector.
In a 1 hour lecture: 1 faculty per 60 students.
Faculties are normally assistant professors who are either pursuing M.Tech or P.HD.
But the teaching method is very good. Teaching is either done on a smartboard through a projector or through Blackboard.
The Semester exams were always on time as per the Academic Calendar of the University.
Exams were easy to pass.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Malhar is tech festival going to conduct in November.
Then there is fest named as anugoong in main University in February in which every affiliated colleges student are allowed.

There is book bank for every semester. So no need to buy books for academic.

There are cultural society for poetry dramatics dance photography. There is also a huge ground for volleyball, basketball and football.
Then there is a common room for boys where there is table tennis and carrom and is fully air conditioned. Student can go there for rest and spend there free time.Because in future everything will be going to depend on semiconductor industry that's why i chosed electronics as my subject.

Girl : boy is approx 1:3

Most of the faculty are phd and good in there subjects and some faculty is still doing there phd.

After the two - three week of commencement of semester there is mid term examination and in 5th month there is practical and external end sem examination.

Name: Kunal Singh Rajpurohit
review: Some of the new faculty (mostly phd students) are not very good, but all other professors are excellent in there respective field and are very intelligent , well qualified, very helpful and also support students in research field. We have regular classes, premium quality labs ensure amazing educational experience. The course curriculum is relevent and useful.There are two fest one is Engineer's ,a technical fest and incident a cultural fest ,which is one of the largest fest in south india . Libary is very good, excellent infrastructure. There are many special clubs.

Name: Ganesh janrao
review: The course curriculum is totally based on project-centric learning. The faculty is so good and experienced. most of the faculty members are Ph.D. qualified. the exam is not much difficult you easily clear all subjects with very good pointers. For the exam, there are 20 marks for the written paper 20 marks for the presentation, 20 marks for the group discussion, 20 marks for the mid-semester exam, 10 marks for the course project, and 10 marks for the lab. for the presentation and group discussion there is mid semester review also.Fees structure: for open cast the fee is 183000, for OBC is 106000, and for NT cast is 278300. The opportunity for the scholarship is so vast. There are some private as well as government scholarships are also there. In college, there is a separate department for scholarships and there is one branch scholarship secretary for helping students.

Name: Shibam
review: I chose this course because govt opportunities are high as well as private. Our faculty members are too friendly, give advice about carrier and inspire us, all the teachers are Ph.D. holders, the best teachers, and administrative activities are also quite impressive.Campus placement are average, if you study well u can get good company, so many companies visited in our college, placement persentage u can say around 84 percent , this companies offer good package and very good opportunities ahead.

Name: Samyamoy Bhattacharya
review:
The fee structure of the college is affordable as in 2022 the cost of the annual fees of the courses increased a little bit but still it is affordable to pay the fees.
I got a scholarship from Swami Vivekananda Merit Cum Means Scholarship which is a government scholarship scheme. The college also provides a scholarship scheme for students who are financially weak and want to study for the courses by providing a scholarship test and on merit, he/she will get the scholarshipFrom the 4th semester, the students become eligible for campus placement.
The companies that visited the college campus for placement are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant, Chegg India, IBM, etc.
The highest package is 16LPA and the average package offered is 5 LPA as per company and profile offered.
Around 80 percent of the student get placed at campus drive.
I plan to get a handly package job after the completion of my course.

Name: Pranjali Chavan
review:
The internship is compulsory in the fourth semester i.e. second year. Also, there is a chance for an internship in the last semester I.e eight for 6 months. Students with really good potential get good internships. Also, there is an important project named a capstone project in the last semester of the third year and the first semester of the fourth year.The placement of the college is decent. Almost every year the placement of soft branches is near to 100 %.
Also, there is a hike in the placement of hard-branch students.
The highest package for the year 2021-22 was 15 lakh grabbed by 4 students.
Also, many students opt for higher studies some choose the track of entrepreneurship.

Name: Sourin Ghanty
review:
I chose Computer Science Engineering because of my interest in coding and as per the current scenario, it is very high demanding in terms of job opportunities.
The faculties are very good and helpful. There is a total of 8 permanent faculties in the Computer Science department.
As this college is Government aided maximum faculties are M.Tech qualified and few of them have also done Ph.D.
There are a total of 4 internal exams of various forms in each semester and the semester exam pattern is a little bit tough.The campus is big and awesome.
Annual and Tech fest happens every year.
Annual sports(Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Badminton) happen every year.
The college has a big library and huge grounds and has many clubs and social groups.
Besides academics, students can enjoy a good social life.

Name: Mohit Kumar
review: The course curriculum was good and most of the faculty members are young and helpful. The ratio of faculty to students is about  1: 20. Faculty members are well educated but have not had too much experience in how to train students according to the current situation. But they are enthusiastic to help students to grab the highest placement.Campus life is good. Aaghaaz is the fresher party and CU fest is one of the best in the university. Libraries are good and almost every book your need. 24×7 Library under construction. Great opportunity for those who are good at sports. There are many social groups, clubs like sports, and many more.

Name: Bhanu Prakash
review: From the third semester onwards students are eligible for taking on-campus placements. Many MNCs will visit colleges like Amazon, Wipro, Infosys, TCS, CTC, etc. Recently virtuasa took 146 students to work for their college. The highest package till today is 29LPA and the average is 4.4LPA.Out of 1500,1420 got placements.I went to college through counseling which was conducted by the ap government. Now I am getting full fee reimbursement from the ap government. As  I am pursuing BTech now. I didn't get any job till up to date. But I am sure I will get a job on this campus.

Name: Saurabh Kumar Verma
college: Galgotias College of Engineering and Technology - [GCET]
review:
There are two types of clubs one is the Rotaract club which includes all students.
Other are departmental clubs Such for the civil department is the aces club, I am the treasure of the aces club.
We held monthly events and an annual fest named sanrachana.
All the books required for the syllabus are available in the library 
The classroom is in the worst condition.
Benches are broken, and fans do not work properly. 
Sports and extracurricular activities are organized by only clubs.
Aces club for the civil department and Rotaract club for the whole collegeFrom 6th semester students  became eligible for campus placement 
Only computer science  companies came into college  other branch students either  sit in those companies or take off-campus placement 
Companies  like TCS, and INFOSYS visit the college 
The average package is 4 lakh and the highest package  is around 20 lakh
Approximately  30 % of students get placed.
I plan to prepare for government services  or start a private  company of contractors

Name: Aditya Singh
review: For the first semester, the tuition fee was 79000 which includes your uniform fees, ID Card fees, etc. And then in the second semester, the tuition fee was 65000 and from 3rd sem onwards it was 56500. The hostel and mess fee depends ok which hostel you are staying in. Financial Assistance like Tuition Fee Waivers, Scholarships are also provided.The college faculties are well qualified and will also help you. This college follows the curriculum of MAKAUT since the college is affiliated with it. The curriculum can make a student job ready if he/she does extra skills (like a new programming language, soft skills, etc.) at home without taking dependent on college.

Name: Akash tiwari
college: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology - [GJUS&T]
review:
Campus life is too good and everyone should get a lot of chances for enjoyment.
There are many events organized by different activities cell and they help to develop yourself.
Like there is an Entrepreneurship club, Coding club, SSB club, and many more.
Along with all that, there is a good library which is special in itself and contains much readable stuff.I got admission to the IT branch and which comes under the department of CSE and the semester papers will be conducted by the CSE branch. Faculty are neither good nor bad as it's the story of every engineering college.
Everyone needs to appear for two minor papers and one major paper in one semester and Qs are not that much tough.

Name: Deepak yadav
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review:
I choose this college because placement is best in this college in Greater Noida.
Faculty members of this college are supportive and helping nature.
Faculty members are well qualified with master's degrees and Ph.D. degrees.
They completed the syllabus timely before the exam.The fee structure of this college in greater Noida is high but you can apply for a scholarship from Uttar Pradesh which is provided by the up government.
You can also take a student loan for admission.
Job opportunity in this college is very good.

Name: Abhishek kumar
review:
Annual fest uddan and tech fest Vigyan used to happen in our college in November and December every year.
Iiitkota is sharing its campus with MNIT Jaipur the infrastructures available are well enough and regularly maintained. 
The library has plenty of journals magazines story comics practicals and course books available.
Our college has about 12 clubs covering fitness journalism,  cinematics, photography,  dance, arts, acting, coding, cyber security,  competitive programming, and robotics.I received a scholarship of an amount equal to the institute fee under the scholarship scheme TOP CLASS EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIP for SC students through the NSP portal. College kept us updated regarding all the schemes timely.
PPO and internship opportunities from games craft, adobe, google, and Jio used to happen during 3rd year of college, and placement of students about 94% happen about every year.

Name: Nikhil Kumar
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:
I chose this course because I am interested in mechanicals.
There are few courses in which more than one branch studies so more number of students otherwise 70-80 students per faculty.
Faculties are well qualified done masters from foreign universities. Some faculties use slides others use chalk and board. 
There are minors(mid-sem) and majors(end-sem).  Other than that there are quizzes ~4 per semester per course.Life in this campus is very amazing, Cultural fest Rendezvous in April, and Tech fest TRYST in January.
There are approximately 2 lakhs of books and plenty of space to study in the library.
There are lots of cultural and technical clubs like AXLR8R, EDC, and DEVCLUB.

Name: Shibraj Dev
review:
This is a central university and the opportunity for internship placement is soo high. There are so many scholarships available for students from college and the government. And fee structure is average which you can check on the college's official website.The faculties are so good in my department. 
My department is civil engineering and I choose this because I want to join PSU which I can't do from tech branches. There is no gap between the exams. And papers are so hard. The faculties are excellent.

Name: Vivek bharti
review:
When I was choosing my college I was thinking to get admission to a good college because I want to different people and best explore college. By the way, my branch is civil in NIT KURUKSHETRA I choose this because I was passionate about the structure and I want to explore new things in this field. As u heard this is not all about professors this is all about your disciple when you entered college you are fully dependent on yourself and from my experience, this is true whether you are in NIT or IIT. About faculty, faculty is awesome and cool but exceptions are always there so some are rude and strict. There are two or more faculty to a particular subject and I think the faculty ratio is good or enough for the student. The faculties have done there P.hd in their subject with foreign universities and have great knowledge but these professors are not the same as school teachers so don't judge. About examinations, there are TWO MID-SEM exams for every semester. And a final exam after every semester. The exam is moderate.College is not all about study and placement. College life should be awesome and clubs and societies make this life more awesome. In nit Kurukshetra, CONFLUENCE is the largest fest in North India and this fest continues for 3 to 4 days in the month of October or November. In this fest different college takes part in different activities in college. Prizes and money are distributed to the winners I also won but I didn't get money. For the tech fest that is TECHSPRADA is held after CONFLUENCE. About the library, there are a lot of books in the library for different courses. Good availability of books and a seating plan. In our classroom, there is AC and also almost all equipment in practical classes. There is also a CNNCS lab for using computers is also fully furnished. Let's go ahead about sports, there are different types of sports played in college like basketball, handball, badminton, etc. They're a big sports complex.
About clubs like photolog, 
Awahaan and societies like infra, technote.

Name: Soumya Das
review: Campus placements are held after the course. Many service-based tech companies visit our campus like TCS, CTS, Wipro, Infosys, etc. Last year Amazon visited too but selected only 4 students. So most placements are held in service-based companies. In our CSE stream, there are 94% of placements till now.Not so many fests are held throughout the year. Almost every book in the curriculum syllabus is available in Library. The classrooms are clean and well-equipped. Sports competition is held once a year. There are no social groups and not so many extracurricular activities are held.

Name: Pennada Sri Phani Rathnam
college: Aditya College Of Engineering and Technology - [ACET]
review:
I have chosen this course because I am much interested in learning to code and putting it into practice and getting placed in a high-paying job.
the faculty members are good at explaining concepts and are more friendly with us for every 10 members of students there are proctors to look after every student to motivate them in achieving their goals.
all the faculty members have completed their PhDs and their way of approaching and teaching is good.
term exams were conducted in certain periods of time with sufficient time for students to study and it is somewhat difficult to pass the exam.the fees for campus recruitment training and soft skills are paid up to 10,000 rs and bus fees etc is paid overall it takes 50 to 60 thousand rupees for completion of 1 yr of the course.
jagan vidhya deevena by govt is received which is helping for the parents to pay the fee.

Name: Utkarsha
review:
The course I choose was civil because of the availability of government jobs moreover, the course is interesting.
The faculty-student ratio I'm not sure but the teachers are good there.
All the faculty are either appointed by bpsc or the guest faculty are not qualified.
For exams, we have semester,mid-semester, and practicals.
The semester takes place every 6 months.Gyaniki is the name of the tech fest but due to corona, it didn't happen for two years.
Ut usually takes place in May or June.
The library is good and course books are available.
Not any extra books are available.
Sports are not up to the mark as a ground for sports is not good.
We have different clubs like club news, chapter one, cultural club, etc.

Name: Deepak Bhati
review: The yearly fee the college is affordable for middle-class families. If someone is not able to afford it, then there are many scholarships given by the Government of the state to their respective students of the state, so that their studies can go smoothly.Since the scope of Artificial Intelligence in nearer future is high, so I opted for this Branch. Teachers are highly qualified and they do their best in clarifying the doubts of students. Teachers are very polite to students in clarifying doubts.

Name: SANJAN KUMAR
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: first of all, every department gets placement. most of the students get a place in 8 semesters but some of them get PPO during internships. Microsoft, Google, Wipro, TCS, etc. Microsoft gives the highest package and mass recruitment give the normal package. from my dep. 100 percentplacement.There are three fests which are the most important in our college. I am giving the name of the three fests. name of the intro, Rebecca, music event. our college has a central library with thousands of books available. name of the library is Ramanujan.

Name: Vivek Kumar
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review: CSE is the most famous course of B.Tech as of now. Its scope is wide. That's why I choose this course. Faculty to students ratio is 1:60 approx. Teachers are selected by the AKTU board, so they are well-qualified. Semester exams are held every 6 months and they are moderately hard.Culture fests are generally organized by students. Colleges generally organize fest regarding internship and placement. Classrooms have a projector and some have smart boards. Sports are played. Books from different departments are present in the library.

Name: Vishal Bindal
review: We have 2 cultural fests named utkarsh and confluence which is the main fest of our college held every year and we have 1 technical fest also named tech spardha. we have a central library with more than 50k hard copies of books with well equipped air-conditioned reading room. All the lecture halls and classrooms are well-air-conditioned. College is also active in various sports activities like we have teams for every sport here nit kkr has many awards in the field of sports won in the past years, we have a gym with well-equiped air conditioners in the sports complex, and at Last we have many cultural as well tech clubs run by students itself with the support from the college.My branch is information technology here I choose this branch because of my interest the course curriculum of both cs and it here are the same and well defined but it's not updated according to the very latest trends in the market still, it's good in comparison to other colleges faculties here are very helpful and supportive and my branch has 1:4 girls to boys ratio most of the faculties are Ph.D. holders with MTech as minimum qualification we have 2 mid sem exams in a semester with end sem examinations at the end.

Name: Rahul Sehgal
review:
The cultural fest is Confluence which is one of the biggest cultural fests in North India. Recently it was conducted in October.
Tech Fest is Techspardha. Recently it was conducted in April.
There are so many books in the library and you can issue them for a certain period. There is a book bank also on campus by which you can issue books for the semester-long.
Sports facilities are Badminton courts, Tennis courts, cricket pitches, hockey grounds, volleyball courts, basketball courts, kabaddi grounds, a stadium and sports complex, etc.
There are many cultural and technical clubs and societies that exist in NIT Kurukshetra run by students.
Confluence Website: confluencenitkkr.com.
Techspardha Website: techspardha.live.From the 7th semester, the students become eligible for campus placements.
There are many recruiters including Microsoft, Amazon, DE Shaw, and Google recruits through campus placements and the number of offers made was 626.
The highest package offered was 44 LPA by Microsoft and the average package in IT was 16.74 LPA. The major recruiting profile was for SDE roles.
The total percentage of students who got placed was nearly 90% (all branches included).
I plan to get campus placement in the SDE role.

Name: Gorantla Madhuri
college: Samskruti College of Engineering and Technology -[SCET]
review:
As I wanted to become a software engineer so I took this computer science which supports my aims very possible ways 
The faculty was very friendly towards the students for every subject we have at least 2 to 3 faculty members for clearing our doubts.
All the faculty members are highly qualified and experienced as they opt for a degree in their subject-based field they will conduct digital classes and teach classes based on chapters.
For each term exam, we have at least 5 months of time and the paper was given from JNTUH which is very difficult to pass.We have an every year annual fest which was conducted at the end of the year with that we also have a natural fest every 3 months and festival celebrations.
We have all kinds of books related to our curriculum in the Library which we can take at any time with permission.
We have fully spacious classrooms digital classrooms and labs according to our daily activities.
Every week we have min 2 hrs for sports.
We have officially Instagram page for students where all types of talents are encouraged @samskruthi_got_talent.

Name: Shaurya Jain
college: Hindustan College of Science and Technology - [HCST]
review:
There are ample opportunities for a job after completing the course.
The college provides scholarships on a merit basis.
You can apply for scholarships other than the college offer.
If you have any specific condition regarding the finance than you can contact the management.The students become eligible for placements in the seventh semester.
The highest package is 25 LPA and the average package is 5 LPA.
Around 80 percent of students get placed every year.
some of the companies that visited the college are Tech Mahindra, Wipro, and TCS.

Name: Rahul kumar
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: Internship opportunities are provided. every department has the opportunity for an internship. Students from cs and IT branches got internships at Microsoft, google, and amazon. we get to learn different things from internships and get more and more experience.The campus life is very good. There are many clubs and various societies in my college. Students can easily find their niche and their interest and can follow their hobbies and got their dream. the library facilities are also good.

Name: Roshan Mahankuda
review:
As my background was in electronics so I wanted to pursue next only.
Faculty is more helpful because you need to be ready for acquiring knowledge from them.
The student ratio is 40:30, male: female.
The exam will be very easy you just have to learn what they taught you.The fees structure is 134000
For me, it gets reduced to 127000.
The college will guide you for the ebc scholarship in which you will get a 50% tuition fee refund.
College placement is quite good but if you want a job you have to be capable of it

Name: Krishna
college: Bhivarabai Sawant Institute of Technolgy and Research - [BSITOR] Wagholi
review: The course fee is 93000 per year But if you are from OBC or EWS category you get scholarships from the government that is you have to pay only  50% of tuition fees. You can also opt for the Punjabrao Deshmukh hostel allowance where you get 30000 rupees for the hostel yearly as a scholarship if you fulfill eligibility. For other categories like SC, ST, and NT you have to only pay the development fee no tuition fees are charged for these candidates.Computer Engineering is one of the best fields to be in Engineering. For the First Year, all branches have the same subjects. After that, your subjects are branch specific. Nearly all teaching faculties are experienced and experts in their subject, also they are helping in doubt solving. They also motivate us and help us to find out opportunities.  Term exams are based on the SPPU schedule as the college is affiliated with SPPU.

Name: Aryan Tare
review: Fees for 4 years are 22 lakhs and opportunities for placement are very high they provide us with a job if we have good marks and behavior, and campus jobs also provide, and the cost of tuition charges is 45000 Per semester. Students can get government scholarships.Life is campus is very good, we have lots of sports here, and students are divided into four groups: master, Cassim, morarjee, and mudaliar, to increase the hype in the sport whoever won their team celebrates, There is a library on the campus with all the books.

Name: Devashish Gupta
college: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology - [IIEST] Shibpur
review: Campus placements are very good here,  Many students go for Higher study opportunities here. The average package here is around 8.5k and almost  70% are placed. CS and IT has the best placements here with around 90 - 94% of students placed.Internship opportunities are provided. Every department has the opportunity for an internship. Students from CS and IT branches got internships in Microsoft and amazon like companies. We get to learn different things from the internship

Name: Sushant Dhone
college: Prof Ram Meghe College of Engineering and Management - [PRMCEAM]
review:
From the 6th semester, companies start visiting the campus for recruitment.
Many mass recruitment companies like TCS, INFOSYS, and WIPRO visit the college every year.
Sometimes product-based companies also visit like HP.
The highest placement offered is 10 LPA, & average placement is from 3-5 lakhs.
Almost all eligible students get placed in the companies, and the training & placement committee of the college is also very supportive.Many cultural events are conducted throughout the year.
The library of the college is really good and provides all types of books for reading.
The classrooms are well equipped.
Various sports activities are also arranged every month.
Many clubs are run by senior students for students.

Name: Soumyadip Roy
review:
The campus life is awesome. Also, we have had several fests based on several occasions. We have inter-house competitions over everything where cadets showcase their talent through this. The benefit of the Library are here, a large collection of books is stored in different sections so that you don't have a problem finding any books.
The classroom decorum is good, having different facilities like OHP, and Projector.I choose this course because I want to become a marine engineer and a Chief Engineer. Each year consists of 6 divisions and each division has 35 average students. The teachers and the faculties are well-qualified and their teaching style is very good. Also, we are having OHP, Projector. The time is less for completion but the level of the term exam is decent.

Name: Rachit
college: University Institute of Engineering and Technology -[UIET]
review:
Campus life is pretty cool. The North campus infrastructure is good compared to the south campus. Panjab University has a library which is known as AC Joshi Library and all the departments have their own library also.
Talking about classrooms, some classrooms have AC (Block 1) while others haven't.  Projectors are available in almost every class.
Uiet has an annual fest Goonj as I have heard and a fest called legacy is also organized this year it was a very good fest and everyone enjoyed it.
As uiet is in Chandigarh so social life is excellent,  no hostel timings so you can easily night out and too many clubs are there in chandigarh so don't worry , life is chill.Placements of Cse and It are very good and many excellent companies offer excellent packages to students. Compaines like Amazon, American Express, optimum, and many startups also offer in uiet. Students become eligible for placement in the 7th sem. The highest package last time was 44 LPA which was off-campus I think and the on-campus highest is 34 by amazon. Around 90% of cse and its students get placed in decent companies so if you are from it or cse you don't have to worry.

Name: Shantanu Kholkute
college: Suryodaya College of Engineering and Technology - [SCET]
review: I chose Computer Engineering because of its high demand and good career opportunities. The faculty is ok but someone faculty members don't behave well with students some teachers are really good but some of them treat students in a bad way. All The HOD of the departments are highly qualified with Ph.D. degrees and the teachers are also well qualified some of the teachers are very helpful. The teaching method is ok. Practical exams and unit tests are taken per semester before final exams and papers are medium-level difficult. It's easy to pass on the paper.The total fees of college are nearly 80k but if you scored well in MHTCET and get admission to the college then by applying for EBC concession your fees will become half and fees are classified on the basis of a category but if you have done provisional admission then you will have to pay less if you got the college in Cap round. The cost of studying in this college is comparatively very low. The college provides free courses to final-year students who are good at studying and attendance also. Placements are not that good in this college.

Name: Sachin Kumar Singh
college: Accurate Institute of Management and Technology - [AIMT]
review:
Placements at our college are average. There are so many companies that came and offer jobs to the students who qualified in their tests. Some of the companies are Chetu, Wipro, Accenture, Idm, and others.
The highest package of our college is 12 lakh the previous year.
 Previous year about 100% of students got placed in different companies. For this big success, our college also celebrate and gave a party for all the students of the college. When I complete my degree from Accurate I will try for an campus drive and I know I will get a job.I choose BTech cse because I have a great want of computer knowledge to bring a change in our society. Expertise in computing helps you even if your primary career choice is something else. 
All faculty in our college are well qualified. They have done their masters and have also done Ph.D. Examinations are always on time. Questions paper level were hard but our teachers taught us in a very good manner so for us the examination is fun.

Name: Sarthak Takekar
review:
Placement in Tolani is 100% both for Marine Engineering and nautical science.
Diploma guys are already placed they want to take placement from the company and take admission in Tolani.
Companies start visiting in the second year and second semester and start picking cadets.Some companies have policy of doing internship in PVD. PVD is dummy ship in campus itself.
If not placed till 4th year we have to do internship by our own in Tolani.
Company such as NYK, MARSEK TANKERS, SHEVRON, BSM, Pacific Ocean, chellaram, Tk tanker and many more.

Name: Bhargav
review:
The faculties who teach us have very nice behavior and are very explanatory. 
They behave friendly with us.
I choose this course because I want to do a master's in the environmental field and do research. 
There was one mid semester exam and one university exam in the semester.There were many clubs and social groups active in our college LD College of Engineering. 
The huge library is available with all particular department's books. 
LDCE conducts many tech fests.
This year 2022 college conducted the Lakshya Tech fest.

Name: Vinod Sharma
college: BS Anangpuria Institute of Technology and Management
review:
No annual fest was conducted in our college. Tech fest was likely to be conducted in August month.
Books and journals of every field and every genre were available every time in the library. 
Our classroom was well furnished with leather chairs and full AC with good lighting. Overall amenities in the classrooms were good. 
Regular sports events were conducted at the college level. 
There are no social groups and clubs were exist in our college.I choose this course because I have been very fond of technology since 9th grade. 
I think the ratio of teachers over 30 students is like 2-3. 
Every faculty member of our college is well-qualified and has a minimum PG Degree. The method of teaching was good but not as good as to be. 
Our department conducts sessionals every month and it's easy to pass.

Name: Ankit Raj
review:
Dharohar of three days fest, and Kavyanjali and Abhivyakti literature fest of 2 days on our campus.
There are also many technical fests in our college during Dharohar.
There are more than 5000 books in our college lib but our library requires more books.
The classrooms are Good. There is a good ratio of tables and chairs in our college. There are 60 student-capacity classrooms.
There is a basic scope of sports and extracurricular activities on our campus.
There are many clubs for technical clubs like Codex, a Social club that collaborated with the UK govt named Pahal- Ek nanha Kadam, and many more.The fee structure of our college is normal only 1.15 lakh/yr and also we pay our fee in installments there are no limitations. There are three options for scholarships in this college.
First according to the class 12th mark sheet.
Second according to to jee mains.
Third according to the Q-care entrance exam organized by University.
And we get a 100% scholarship on academics for one sem if we have a good score in the above three.
There is a normal opportunity in an on-campus job.

Name: chirag jain
review: Choosing the computer science because the cse course is demand and need in future must. The facultys are very friendly type an solving us doubts weekly ina brief context. The qualification of faculty are dr, graduated with a 1 st tier college s the  exams are taken monthly basisThe college doesn't provide any type of internship we have to do internship us only with the help of YouTube, google etc. But the university provide the chance of project s this is the best option provided by the university

Name: Afraj Khan
review:
I choose this course because according to my rank in jee mains this is the best I am getting and also because NIT Raipur is a reputed and also a good college among all engineering colleges. All the faculty members are good and also very cooperative. Almost all faculty members are Ph.D. degree holders having a good experience.
The faculty: student ratio is also good as good amounts of teachers are present. There is a three-term exam which occurs at a gap of almost 1 month. The exams are moderate but viva-voice is difficult enough to check the ability of students.There are a lot of clubs and communities at NIT Raipur. There are a lot of fest and curricular activities going on the whole year on campus. There is a  saurya club which organizes many events related to different games .there is a literate club which is for literature-related curricular .there are clubs like abhinaya, ragga, and nitryam which are related to drama, singing, and dancing. The NIT Raipur has one of the biggest libraries among all Nits, which has the availability of a lot of books and journals.

Name: Aditya mishra
review:
I am interested in the CSE branch so I choose here as per my rank this was the best college that I found. In our batch, there are 350 students and around there are 35 faculty members so around 1 faculty per 10 students. Most of the faculty have done PhD from IITs or NITs. In my college there are three exams are held per semester i.e. mid-semester, end-semester exams and quizzes.
You can pass them if you start your study 10 to 15 days before the examination.The campus is around 25 acres. There are various small events happening every month but the most exciting event is ADVITA. there are lots of clubs and societies like photo geeks, cult society, Vedanta Samiti etc. In the library, u will find a good number of books and a study room/reading room.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Paradigm is an annual fest that is conducted every year. There are departmental libraries and a central library has mostly all books. Books are issued free for home up to 15 days period after 15 days there is a fine and but anyone can reissue the books for free again 15 days period. The classroom's condition is fair. Sports and extracurriculars are not good here not too many extracurricular activities are held. But different sports ground is available like badminton, football, basketball, etc. There are many clubs is run by students like Techno Tuner and ignite club etc.I had choose this course because I have an interest in computer science. The faculty of the CSE department is average not too good. Faculty: student ratio is 1:19. Qualification of faculty is mostly B.Tech and MTech and some faculty are Ph.D. qualified. The teaching method is good, teachers provide notes and solve doubts in every lecture. There are 2 Sessional exams held within a semester and the level of the exam is easy to moderate. And end semester exam is held at the end of the semester and the level of the exam is moderate. Exams are easy to pass.

Name: Akarsh
review: Life on the campus is amazing because of the good hostel and mess facilities. The annual fest of Visvesvaraya National institute of technology is one of the biggest fests in central India and the name of the fest is AAROHI. It usually takes place in November. Library facilities is also good in VNIT but it can be more spacious as during exam time it always gets full. Although books and journals are available in good amounts. The classroom complexes are pretty as it is having good benches smart boards, normal boards and ac, and fan facilities. Sports facilities are also available to each and everyone interested as there are a football ground, cricket ground, lawn tennis ground, and an indoor sports complex for badminton, table tennis, chess, and other sports. Chess club, prayaas club, dramatics club, mag club, etc clubs are present.I choose the course Electrical and Electronics Engineering because of my interest and because of my rank also. The placement scenario for branches like Computer science engineering, electronics engineering, and electrical and electronics engineering are pretty good compared to other core branches in Visvesvaraya National institute of technology. Faculty to student ratio is very good in VNIT as it is around 1:30 . All the professors are highly qualified and knowledgeable and their teaching method is also great. We have to appear for 2 sessional exams of 15 marks each and then 1 end semester exam of 60 marks and the remaining 10 marks are internal markings based on attendance, quiz, viva, or maybe on teachers' mood. The passing percentage is good as 80+% clear their exam without taking any re-exam.

Name: Krishna Gupta
review:
An annual function named pragyan is conducted by the college every year which is 3 days long during this you will enjoy a lot.
The library facility is also provided by the college but you have to wait 30-40 minutes to issue a book, because of rude library employees.Here the placement of CS and IT students is average.
But for civil mechanical and other branches the placement is very less.
Companies came into the college and select a few students.
Wipro Infosys Bajaj etc companies visited the college.

Name: Nikhil kumar rajput
review: There is no hike to minimum hike in fees within a year which is approx. 1-2k in a year which is in fees for the next batch. There are different scholarship programs for different criteria such as military, girl, single child, etc.yes, the placement is very good at my university. 85 percent of the students have been placed every year in good companies with good packages. The highest package was 5 lakh per annum. The placement cell is very good.

Name: Ayush chechani
college: The LNM Institute of Information Technology - [LNMIIT]
review: The campus area is small but includes everything that is needed. One bad thing is that hostel time is 10:45 pm and you cannot roam on campus after that. There is the cultural fest Vivacity, sports fest Deportivos and science fest Plinth that occur annually. Fests are held between the months of December to February. Many books are present in the library, containing all course-related books and many novels and literature. Classrooms are well structured with proper lighting, a big blackboard, a projector and proper ventilation and ducts. The sports part of college is also good with courts for basketball, table tennis, volleyball, badminton, and cricket ground and tt table and coordinators for each sport. Clubs are there for almost all extracurricular activities such as dancing, singing, acting, nukkad, robotics, astronomy, etc.As this college comes under private colleges, fees here are too high compared to other colleges. Fees per semester can be divided into 165000 tuition fees and 50000 mess, electricity and hostel charges. Fees hike is 10% of tuition every year. Scholarships include merit-based that is based on jee advanced rank and jee mains score. Further, if your parent's income is less than 500000 and you score good marks in a particular subject, you can become a teaching assistant in that subject in college. College also helps you with internships.

Name: Abhishek Kumar Prasad
review: The course is quite decent and good. I chose the Undergraduate degree of B.Tech in the Civil Engineering Department as it was my dream to study at this Institute since I was in school. All the faculties are well educated and qualified to the best of their knowledge and the teaching is average. It depends on the student how well he interacts with the teachers and grasps knowledge.Life on campus depends from student to student. The campus is very beautiful including lakes, roads covered with trees, ponds etc. The sunsets here are so beautiful and aesthetic. There are many clubs including literature, poetry, music, dance, spiritual, trading, machine learning, coding, GDSC and many more.

Name: Jayesh G Paighan
college: Mauli Group of Institution's College of Engineering and Technology
review:
in Mauli college state level ignite fest is conducted every year 
life at the campus is good 
the very big library is present on the college campus so you don't have a need to purchase books 
there is huge ground on the college premises 
there is a cricket pitch and volleyball court for sportsfirst-year college fees are 48586 rs and in the second year the fees are 46586 rs if you are from obc category 
fees for the open category is 75586 rs 
overall fees are average as compared to other colleges, yes this college is affordable

Name: Prakhar Chaturvedi
college: Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology - [IERT]
review:
Students after the 5th semester are eligible for placement but only a selected number of companies visit our college and INFOSYS, TCS, WIPRO, and CHETU are our frequently visited companies. And an average of 3.5-4 LPA is offered to students. Recently a student got a 24 LPA job from on-campus placement but opted for a 1.5 cr package which he was getting off campus in Germany. Also a senior from ME got to intern at MITACS. The reason behind the Low average package is that 90% of students opt to go for higher studies and they quit placements. 
If you search our college ranked at the top for getting admissions in MTech In iits, every year around 7-8 students get into the top 100 AIR. In 2022 our top scorer got AIR 4. 
I am also interested in qualifying gate exam and getting a master's degree.I think our tech fest which is technovation was held in June the previous year and it was a very good experience to be part of it. Our annual fest is UDBHAV which is going to be held in October and it will be my first time experiencing it. 
We can issue books according to our interest from the Central Library and can sit and use the office library till the college is open, around 5 PM. 
The classroom is well-equipped with lights, fans, chairs, and tables, a whiteboard. 
Every year zonals are our annual sports event in which we play with different colleges, and also represented ourselves on the state level, it is a two-day event. 
There are clubs like IERT DSC which have many chapters and students actively participate in them.

Name: Niraj Thombre
review: Campus Life is very enjoyable. You will never regret coming to this college. The environment is very good here. There are many clubs you can join. There are many activities to take part in that. There are different functions also conducted every year.The faculty members are very good. They are well educated and know everything about the course. They are always ready to help cadets in any situation. The term exam is held after 5 months it is not that hard if you study regularly.

Name: Rithvik
college: Vallurupalli Nageswara Rao Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [VNR VJIET]
review:
There is a scholarship provided by the government if we come through the TS eamcet. the scholarship is different for different castes. Sc and ST got full-fee scholarships and obc get a 30 thousand scholarship.
The fee is around 1.3 and lacs.The faculty here are good. they have good subject knowledge and they are well qualified. the teaching methods are good compared to the other colleges in this city. the exams are not that easy but it is not difficult to pass.

Name: Yuvraj Kanathe
college: Oriental Institute of Science and Technology - [OIST]
review: The college fee is 96000 and talks about the scholarship, it is available according to the categories obc  27k and st sc  55k to 60k. This makes it easy for the students to pay the fees, And the college also gets campus placement which is 4lack to 7 lakhHere sir madam teaches well, learns good skills and the relation of faculty-student is also very good. And the technique of their reading is very different, it is understood by the students very quickly. Which makes it enough to pass the exam

Name: Om Asati
college: Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing - [IIITDM]
review:
There is a decent placement of college. On an average 14.5 lakh per annum of whole college .
For placement we are eligible in 7th semester.
College gives opportunity to sit in Amazon samsung paytm many more 
Here highest pakage of 46lpa and lowest package 5lpa and average package is 14.5 lpa
Percentage of student getting placement is about 90%There were lot of internship provide by the institute and also we can get from ourself.
Lot of company like Amazon also give intership for 3rd and 4th year student. Most of the company take student for core like it , electronics, mechanical.
We have to make a good projects for getting the intern .

Name: Vineet Soni
college: Jaypee University of Engineering and Technology - [JUET]
review: For, I chose this course because of my interest in computer science and the upcoming tech opportunity. Talking about the faculty, being in college, you totally depend on yourself for study purposes. Except for a few teachers, all the faculty members are on average level. Also, the student-faculty ratio is quite low because you see the same teacher for two semesters in the CSE branch. For other branches, the ratio is very different, as there are very less students in other branches. All the faculty members are enough qualified for teaching at a university. Most of them have completed their Ph.D. The most interesting thing is about term exams, there are 3 tests- T1 for 15 marks, T2 for 25 marks, and T3 for 35 marks. Scoring in tests is quite easy if you had paid enough attention in classes.College have a good number of events every year including a 3-days event "Dequinox". Campus crowd has been greatly affected after they started to have direct admission. Campus infrastructure is very lush green, you will find plenty of greenery in college. But worst thing is outside surroundings of the college. No metro city nearby, and the nearest village to the college is 3 km away. On weekends there are no places for an outing just you can go to the nearest city (30 km) to have food.

Name: Mohith
college: Samskruti College of Engineering and Technology -[SCET]

Name: Samar SIngh Sisodia

Name: RAHUL KARMAKAR

Our team worked on industrial Arduino during our 1st year

Name: ALLI VAMSHI NANDHU

In that fee, the government pay 35000 in the name of a scholarship for every year. The fee is the same for all the courses. The name of the scholarship is ts-epass and we have internships too.

Name: SYED AUSAF EJAZ
review: The fee structure is according to the categories in category 1 the fee is 2 lakhs per annum in category 2 the fee is 3 lakhs per annum in a nutshell the fees are proportional to the category. Name: Arun choudhary
college: Mangalmay Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review: On our college campus, the placement program is organized in a very good manner the college provided equal opportunities to all the students to get placed in multinational companies at the average package of our college is around 10 lakhs and the highest package is dependent upon the caliber of students.In the BTech program, the exam procedure was a duration of around six months or a semester based and there is no need for extra hard work but give attention when professors are discussing lectures and do daily basis revision and the very thing will be fine.

Name: Zeel
college: Silver Oak College of Engineering and Technology - [SOCET]
review: There are lots of annual and tech fests in college in a year recently there is a program on how Alexa works and the programming behind that. In library, you can find all writer's best books for your course and other books like journal you can get in the library.The fees of a year are 78000 so for 1 sem it's 39000 now in 4 years of that course the fee is a total of 312000 it's very affordable fees as compared to other colleges and mysy scholarship you can avail or I got an internship as a web developer.

Name: Jaspreet Singh
review:
The course is good. The curriculum is the same for the 1st two semesters for all branches. From the 2nd year onwards it includes the main subjects in accordance with the branch you have opted for. All the faculties include professors assisted by Ph.D. Student. Some faculties are exceptionally good rest are decent.Life at the campus is very chill. Attendance in lectures is lenient. All the newly constructed classrooms are air-conditioned. 
There is an indoor stadium for badminton, table tennis, and snooker. Cultural fests and events are held many times every year.

Name: Jatin
review: The fees are increasing every year by 5-10% and the current cost to study in this course is 9.5 lakhs the scholarship is provided to economically weak students by taking their interview along with their familyEngifest is the annual fest of DTU which occurs during February every year and many tech fests are conducted every month the sports facilities are excellent here there are many clubs run by students of dtu

Name: Devansh Tanwar
college: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science- [SGSITS]
review:
The course I have chosen is because of my passion for formula cars. I have joined a college club for formula students also. Faculties just teach you but in case of doubt solving they are very busy that they don't give you time. As all facilities are highly graduate done their Ph.D. from reputed government colleges but their way of teaching is not as I wanted. The student ratio here is very good whereas the gender ratio is quite good this time in mechanical. The papers were very tough and the checking done by them hardly pass any student. In 5 months endsems are conducted but in every 2 months, a mid-sem test is conducted ( 2 mindsets are conducted in each sem).The fee structure of the government college is very low but talking about the scholarship the limit for my and obc scholarship was very low 6 lac and 3 lac respectively as may have a percentage barrier also. But in our college for poor students, there are approx 10-20 scholarship schemes. loans are also given by the college.
On campus, many companies come like Microsoft, Amazon, Asian paints, etc, and mass recruiters like Deloitte, TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. For core branches, mechanical Asian paints, Yamaha, Suzuki, Honda, etc many companies come with decent packages. Avg package this year for mechanical was 5 lac and the highest was 9 lac.

Name: Rishabh soni
college: Charotar University of Science and Technology - [CHARUSAT]
review: I chose Computer Science and Engineering because it grabs lots of placements nowadays There are 4 faculties in a class of 70 so student to faculty ratio is awesome. The Qualification of the faculty is nice they are highly educated but they should change their teaching method from ppt so we can get detailed knowledge . Our exams are divided into 3 parts there are 2 internal and 1 external in one semester and they are quite easy to pass.My fees are 98000 per year they are pretty high but our college does provide high-tech labs AC and infrastructural facilities so they are worth it. The scholarship is all abt government which is MYSY also our college gives scholarships to the top 3 ranked students in the CSE program and the scholarship is up to 50% fees which are 49000.

Name: JAY SHARMA
college: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science- [SGSITS]
review: Infrastructure: Facilities are very good. We have a library which consists of all the books related to studies. Labs are a bit smaller, but they are enough to handle the crowd. Wi-Fi is provided, but it has a limit of 100 MB. Classrooms are well-ventilated and equipped with modern facilities. The quality of the food is not that good. In the dining hall, you can pay for the quality food, but in the mess, it is of below-average quality. Medical facilities are available. Our college also focuses on sports very much, and we have one of the best sports clubs in Madhya Pradesh.Placements: Almost 60% of the students got placed in our course. The maximum salary package offered is 44 LPA, the minimum salary package offered is 3 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 10 LPA. TCS and Wipro are the most recruiting companies. Almost 40% of the students got an internship from the IT department. The top roles offered to the students are software engineer, web developer, android, and IOS developer.

Name: Tanmay Thakre
college: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science- [SGSITS]
review:
from the 6th semester, students become eligible for campus placements some companies like Microsoft and Amazon offer recruitment to the student's average package is around 40 lakh per annum around 60% of students get placements my plan is to prepare for government jobs after getting the degree.I chose is the course for placement purposes.

Name: Nikhil

The percentage of students getting placed in this college is merely 90 percentage

Name: K DHEERAJ
college: Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education

The timetable is provided at the beginning itself. The difficulty level of exams is medium.

Name: TRILOCHAN PATRA
review: The course curriculum was really fantastic it was followed as per the instructions given by the government. I personally choose this course because I was interested in studying computer languages and even though it has the potential to fulfil the human requirements and In the IT sector there is a lot of scope for the job. More than  300 Faculty members are there for the students in each section there are only 50 to 60 students there show the students can easily understand what was teaching also after the classes faculty members are available there in their cabins till 6 pm to 7 pm you can go and ask your doubts they are also there for your help   In each semester there are 2 cycle test and 1-semester exam is there which you can easily pass if you studied and you have to more focus on your core subjects like c, c++, Java etc.Life on campus is really beautiful experience because there are many programs going on on campus like there are a lot of opportunities for those who have skills and also in sports and the students can also go swimming and gyming etc . About the social group which are active those are NSS ncc etc which are doing a great job for the people.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: G H Patel College of Engineering & Technology - [GCET]
review: The gcet is the best college for the extra curriculum activities they had fest named as an image which is the best month for students and otherwise, there are many other clubs like rotary and TEDx, etc and sports competitions are also held at a very big level. There is a library building where there is very good space to at least accommodate 100 students at a time and there are no extra charges for the library.The chemical was the best course and was the most in-demand as of now and the faculty are the best of this college the laboratory of college are the best most of the faculty have been completed there masters and the hod of the chemical field has passed out from IIT Kharagpur there were mainly mid sem exams which were not that tough if you just attend all lecture they are easy to cop up.

Name: Kartik Soni
college: Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre
review:
As I wanted to explore IT companies and wanna be good at coding so I opt for this course.

Name: Shreya Mahajan

Name: Omkar Gaikwad
review: The students of the Artificial Intelligence and Data Science course will have more opportunities as compared to other courses. You just named the club and Vishwakarma Institute of Technology College have the club. There is a library in the college and there are lots of books available.

Name: Vedant Desai
review: Meraki is the biggest festival in April-may. Many books are available especially study books are all available in the library. The schedule is strict 2 exams in a semester. Mid Semester and end semester generally mid is of 50 mark and end is 100.

Name: Sahana
college: Dayananda Sagar Academy of Technology and Management - [DSATM]
review:
I got 20k in kcet... I think for 20k in general. This is the best college I got...

Name: Makarand dinesh Jadhav
review:

The general category student can apply for Economic backward class (EBC) scholarship, it is only for students who score good marks in MHT-CET.The internship is compulsory for 4th-year students. Students from 3rd year can apply for placements. The major companies visiting for recruitment are amazon, Wipro, and Microsof . The highest package is 52 lakhs and it is offered by  Microsoft.

Name: KESAV T S
review: There is a large library with a huge collection of books. Events, sports day, annual day, and other fests happen during the even semester. The classroom is sufficient to occupy around 60 students. There are more than 30 clubs that run in our college.I was interested in technical field and so I had intended to choose the course .The one of the best college in Coimbatore. This the reason to choose the college. We have three internal in each semester. The faculties are jovial and friendly.

Name: Hitesh
college: IIT Roorkee - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITR]
review:
Placements here are also very good, one should maintain a decent CGPA to grab every possible opportunity here.
