Very green and open campus, with excellent sports facilities, Grounds are facilitated with floodlights, so you can play the night matches too. Also, IITR has an Olympic size swimming pool. 
Almost all the sports facilities are available here.

Name: Jeshta
review: If you are here you will be experiencing at least one of the fests every year. The fests here are super crazy. fun-filled and feels like a break from monotonous college hours! 8th mile is one of the biggest fests, E summit was the most recent fest where we had famous speakers sharing their ideas and thoughts on various topics. It was overall a magical experience. If you name a skill you want to develop there is a club you'll get. Clubs are numerous with legit auditions to get into. Footprints(dance club), ALAAP(music club), DEBSOC(debating club) to name a few.Scholarships are provided to students coming from economically weaker sections. It is a great initiative taken by the college. There are also various Scholarship portals online where you can apply and avail! Fees through KCET are manageable with lower Fees for those coming from the economically weaker background while Fees for COMEDK are the same for all and a tat bit high however there are educational loans that one can avail of at low-interest rates which I'd suggest considering if you've got a seat here because it's worth it.

Name: Ankit Babu
college: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science- [SGSITS]
review: Teacher teaches us is knowledgeable and even hod teaches us ee network and all teachers are good and the course is also good and we study with great enthusiasm semester exams level is good some students have difficulty in some subject so they fail but overall at least 90-95 percentage students pass in semester examinationFee year wise is 100000 for study means tuition fee and other means hostel and mess fee is 70000 around in a year means approx 700000for 4 years but in MMVY scholarship we have received tuition fee so all expense is around 300000 more and also placements did from this collage

Name: Guddu Kumar sah
review: Annual fest and tech fest are not conducted by the department all the fests are organized by students. Books and journals are available in the library. Amenities in the classroom like fan AC. Sports and extracurricular activities on the campus are conducted by campus. No social group is run by students.5-semester students are eligible for placement. There are many companies visited in this college like Infosys tech Mahindra FedEx and others. The highest package is 42 lacs and the average package is 4lacs. 70% of students are placed. I want to get a job after my degree.

Name: Aniket Singh
review: I didn't choose this course I got it by chance, not a choice, I wanted to be in aerospace engineering but my rank didn't allow it. The faculty-student ratio is 1:60. All the faculties are highly qualified with many years of experience. Teaching methods are above the average and the college takes feedback every semester from the students. We have CIE(Continuous internal evaluation)every month of 50 marks, which are three in number of which the best of the 2 are taken for adding in the finals. Exams level is not that much easy and we have certain other things to be completed which carry credits like EL (Experiential learning) of every subject which carry 40 marks.The first-year fee is 2.5 lakhs after that I think it will come down to 2kakhs since I am in the first year only so I don't have confirmation about it. The cost to study is high for outside Karnataka students but it is not so for locals. I didn't get any scholarships because I am not from a government school. Placements are really good in our college but I don't have that much idea because I am in the 1st year only.

Name: Priya
review: An internship is the phase of time for students when they are trained for the skill they are good at and it gives them a chance to apply their knowledge practically in industries. AICTE has also made 3 internship compulsory for engineering students. AICTE Makes 6 Months Internship Compulsory for Engineering Students.Infrastructures and a dedicated team provide excellent educational facilities that serve the areas and domains that have. Life at the campus is good. Social life, different clubs and infrastructure are good. There are many annual fests going on throughout the year

Name: Sai charan
college: Dhanekula Institute of Engineering and Technology - [DIET]
review: They conduct a fest every 3 or 6 months which will boost students' energy. The classrooms maintained are average but they are good. The college got a very big playground. Many many clubs also their and student chapters called themThey are many companies that offered internships to help students to get work experience in the college itself. Amazon brought very good internships and some of them are paid ones. The college provides good internships.

Name: Mihira
review: Supposedly the best placements in Karnataka after IIIT and NITK, but looking at the placements, they seem like peanuts, taking a job after B.E for chemical engineering at least is an absolute waste since the average package is 7-8 lakh p.a and the highest is 14-16 lakh p.a. Percentage for chem is less since most students do Masters or M.Tech after Chemical engineering. But yes it's the best u can get in Karnataka. The companies that come are actually good. The number too.The term exams are known as SEE or semester-end exams, the papers were fairly moderate but electrical was insanely hard for all students combined. The semester was rushed to the next level to finish portions without giving gaps between internals because of covid, they finished the semester in 3 months.

Name: Sanjay D Kulal
review: This curriculum is good and the faculty members are also very good and supportive. They help a lot with different things. The faculty is also well qualified and their teaching method is also very good. Very good.Fees are very affordable for students who have taken admission from the state entrance exam. The hostel facility is also good. The living expense is a little bit high as the college is situated in Bangalore City.

Name: Harshil Bansal
review:
This is my favorite part: The Campus Life!
It is the best. I mean you will be on the main campus of GGSIPU. You will get to enjoy the main fest ANUGOONJ.
Apart from it Techfest, ethnic day, sports day, and other events are conducted.
The library of the university is just amazing. Filled with so many books on various subjects and various authors. The library is well air-conditioned. The sitting capacity of the library is quite decent as well.
The classrooms of the IT department are pretty decent. The only red flag is- no A/C.However, it didn't bother me much as most of the time we were in labs which are again air-conditioned.
The sports facility of the college is amazing. Football ground, volleyball court, basketball court, swimming pool, indoor badminton court, and whatnot.
The college has a large number of clubs and societies like ACM, GDSC, IEEE, dance, music and singing, photography, fine arts, chess club, etc.I chose this course as it covered all the subjects and various aspects of engineering which I am fond of. Being a computer lover this branch was the best pick.
Generally, the student to faculty ratio is somewhat around 6:1 which is quite decent. Moreover teachers and friendly and ready to resolve your doubts.
All of the faculty members are highly qualified with high certifications in their respective domains. Almost all the teachers have educational qualifications of Ph.D. The teaching method varies depending on the teacher. From the old school board marker method to using PPTs, videos, graphics, etc.
B.Tech is 4 years. Every year consists of 2 semesters and in each semester 2 official exams(MidTerm and EndTerm) are conducted.
These exams are not difficult to crack but at the same time not easy enough to pass without studying.

Name: Sameer
review:
RV college has an annual fest named 8th Mile. And there will be some technical fest happening in college over the months(not that much fest here).
RVCE has one of the best library facilities one can have u will find most of u r course-related books in the library. RVCE has a good environment for sports. sports teams have won many awards as I am not into sports I can say u can check all the achievements on the official website of RVCE.
There are so many clubs in RVCE you will find a club for almost everything there is a coding club there is NSS, NCC,Oshawa racing club there are many u can check on the official website.I choose this in RV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING because it has very good placements and the faculty for ISE is very good. coming to faculty: the student ratio is 1:30. Most of the professors u get here are Ph.D. holders and others are MTech holders. for our batch, we have 3 CIE(continuous internal evaluation) out of which 2 best internals are considered for the finalization and u will have your sem-end exams passing the exams in RV COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING is not that difficult u can study for a week and still manage to pass the exams (if you have the skills of writing the exam).

Name: Akansha Tanu
review: 8th Mile is one of the biggest fests in Southern India organized by our college having a lot of celebrities in attendance. It is organised probably in the month of September. E Summit is another fest here at RVCE its magnitude is not as large when compared to 8th Mile but still, it's a sight to watch and be a part of, Aman Dhattarwal and Raj Shamani were a few celebs this time at the e-summit We have a good library which opens from 9 AM to 9 PM. The library holds a vast collection of books related to different subjects and also many other reading materials for research purposes too. There is a Digital library as well and the library has good seating for the students to sit and study. We have a gym, playground, badminton court, and table tennis court. Also, our college organizes many sports tournaments and many other competitions. There are different clubs like ROTARACT, ALAAP, CARV, and many more which hold events from time to time keeping the atmosphere of the college lively.I am a student in the Electronics and Communication Branch. I personally chose this branch as it gives me an opportunity to explore both the IT and the Core sectors. The teacher-to-student ratio is also quite good with each teacher taking up about 3-4 classes across many semesters. The faculty here at RVCE is highly educated with an in-depth understanding of the subject they specialize in, the curriculum followed by the college ensures that the students learn the concepts not only through books but also by gaining some hands-on experience through innovative projects and labs. 3 internals are conducted out of which 2 are mandatory while 3rd one is an improvement test which one can take to improve their scores. The best 2 out of these 3 are considered for evaluation. Labs are also held that carry marks.

Name: YUVRAJ
review: The fee is a little high for admission through comedk. For management quota, it is very high. The cost of studying here if you just count the fees will be around 10lac.but if you count personal expenses and all, it'll be somewhere around 15 lacs. There are government scholarships provided.Fest occurs every month. The tech clubs of the college are really good. Classrooms are of good Enough size for 60 students. Lots of sports-related activities occur every month. A no. Of clubs are there in college from rotaract to ashwa.

Name: Manan Goyal
college: IIT Roorkee - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITR]
review: You have to pay fees for every semester; for one semester, fees are around 130000. In the college, there is a scholarship for those students whose parent's income is less than 5lakhs for sc/st/PWD, three is no tuition fees, and for those students whose parent's income is less than 1lakhs, there are no tuition fees, and whose parents' income is less than 5lakhs they have to pay 1/3rd of tuition fees.Our annual fest is Thomas, and this is conducted in October. In college, there is a Central library whose Name is Mahatma Gandhi central library almost every branch books are available, all sports facilities are available there are many clubs in the college, for example, UBA, NSS, NCC, CIVIL CONCLAVE, ROBOCORN, PAG, etc.

Name: Harshit Agarwal
review: students become eligible of appearing for placements after the end of the third year which is the 6th semester numerous companies visit the college campus for placement among the top including Qualcomm, Atlassian, Samsung, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Walmart, etc. Overall companies visited the campus and made more than 1400 offers. Some use animations, some use real-life examples. We have 3 internals almost every month and later 1 external exam. If you are giving your best and concentrating in class then it will be very easy to pass exams.

Name: Sathya
review: I chose the course because I wanted to work in the pharmaceutical, industry, and cosmetic industries. It is a very vast course and you can work in any industry after studying chemical engineering. RVCE is one of the top colleges in the country as well.It is a very chill college, it is not as strict as we find on social media. There are many clubs such as coding clubs, agriculture clubs, car racing clubs, astronomy clubs and space research clubs. There are projectors in classrooms.

Name: Aryan Jain
review: I have an interest in the chemical field, and that's the only reason I chose this course. The faculty-to-student ratio is decent for our course. Some of the teachers are good and some are okayish. Exams in RVCE are not very difficult to pass. If you pay attention in class, it's very easy.The placement in RVCE is really good. Like for circuital branches, the average placement is around 12lpa+. CSE and ISE have around 18lpa+. Almost everyone gets placed in college. I've different plans after getting my degree. Either I'll go for a master's or MBA.

Name: Buvan KC
review: We have wonderful fests at RVCE. All of them have a very high budget and are usually very successful. There are loads of clubs as well, both technical and nontechnical clubs. There is a club for everyone and I highly recommend everyone to join a club. The campus is very big (Approx-52 Acres) one of the biggest in Bangalore. The Metro station is attached right next to the college.The fee is based on how you obtain admission to the college. If you are obtaining admission through KCET your fee irrespective of the course is 1L/year. If you obtain admission through COMEDK your fee irrespective of the course is 2.25L/ year. Name: romharsh sheth
review: Our annual fest is 8th mile which is biggest in banglore and our Library is pretty big and very quite ,the classroom has projectors and board ,extra curricular activities not so much but not very less either and many many different clubsWe have three class internals out of which 2 are compulsory and the internals are every month and in between we have our presentations,it's not very difficult to pass and it's not very hard to score very good in first year

Name: Aman Rohilla
review:
Engifest is the best fest of DTU. It is the biggest fest in Delhi after the IIT DELHI fest.

Name: Luv Sharma

Name: Ankit

Name: Manini Vidyarthi
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: I chose BE in Computer Engineering at Thapar University because I always saw myself as a software engineer and have worked on some projects while was in school, the faculties are helpful and for every lecturer 35 students are there. Name: KIshan Kumar
review:

Name: Student (Anonymous)

Name: saubhagya gupta
review: The course curriculum is quite hectic and I don't enjoy the classes that much. I like to have fun in college rather than attending classes. Social life is very nice because it's Bangalore(The pub capital of India)

Name: Mahesh
review:
There are so many fests like branch fests every year and college fests for every three years.

In our classes, we have both a board and a projector and our classroom size is big.
GEC members.

Name: Abhishek
review:
Life at the campus is awesome as we have a private beach so if you feel bored you can go to the beach with your friends and spend time there.

Name: Vivek Kaloori
review: The faculty is a bit lineant and friendly(depends onn the faculty that you get). And the professors are highly qualified with atleast 10 to 25 years of experience. The student ratio in the college is almost equal. If you want to go abroad for higher studies the college also helps you with it as it has connects with many famous universities around the world.

Name: Shashank Singh
review:

Name: MOHAMMED RAYAN KHAN

Name: Vipul Kumar Baitha
review: They are not conducting an annual fest and tech fest sometimes students are conducting all the fest.  All the books and journals are available in the Central Library. Name: Shahil Mullick
college: St. Thomas College of Engineering and Technology - [STCET]
review: Usually, no fests are organised but online webinars and workshops happen from time to time. A variety of books are available in the library. The average package is 4lpa and the highest is 10lpa. 60% throughout is required to sit for campus exams or else opt for off-campus drives.

Name: SUBIR KUMAR
review: Every year annual fest is conducted by the college in September month.Such as Engineer's Day and many more.Liberary contain all types of book which are necessary for a students.Classes are good there is many smart classes through which students get digital knowledge.Every year inter branch tournament is conducted by the sports committee.A program in run by the students called UMEED.IN which students teach the poor children free of cost.In my openion the faculty of REC SONBHADRA is very good.All the faculty are from IITs and NITs.They all are very supportive in nature .They work on the students for their better carrier.In one semester 2 class test and 1 semester exam are conducted.Class test is taken by the subject teacher while semester is conducted by the AKTU.

Name: shivam sharma

review: Course is well designed and it meets all the industry  requirements .Faculties are highly qualified and are helpful in every manner.Almost all faculties have done their masters from IIT's and NIT's.Exam(College exam) level is moderate and u can easily qualify when if u study one night before????.Internship opportunities are also good in the college.Companies that have offered internships are Amazon TCS and many more.They get internships around 10000 to 12000 per month.Many students also develop their projects like they make various kind of bots etc

Name: Tanmay
review:

Name: Shruti Sharma
college: Institute of Engineering and Technology, Devi Ahilya University - [IET -DAVV]
review:

Name: YASH TRIPATHI

 Nearly 40 to 60 percentage  Students are placed every year in different companies.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
The fee structure of the college is provided on the college website and it remains the same for the years.
1st year Fees=2,33,700+18000(Hostel)+monthly mess charge.
2nd year Fees=2,38,300+22000(Hostel)+mess
3rd year Fees=2,50,400+22000(Hostel)+mess
4th year Fees=2,73,100+26000(Hostel)+mess.

Name: Sanjaykanth

Name: Saksham Sengar
review:

Name: Yash Gaur

Name: Aditya Prakash Rai

Name: NIGAR PARVEEN
review:

Name: Sahil botre
review:

Name: Nishant Kumar Behera
review:
Life at the campus is just awesome. The greeneries and clean surroundings throughout the campus make the environment of campus to another level.

During the placement drive of the college companies from TCS, WIPRO, ACCENTURE, SIEMENS, COGNIZANT, DR. Reddy's, SCALER, BOSCH, DELOITTE, NALCO, and INFOSYS come for campus hiring offering an average package of 4.5 LPA to 17.39 LPA.
This year through on-campus placement 4students got the highest placement package from CISCO SYSTEMS of 17.39lpa.
Almost 95% of students from different branches got placed through a placement drive as almost all the companies allow all branch's students to sit for campus selection.

Name: Keshav Singla
college: Punjab Engineering College University of Technology - [PEC]
review:

The Library is not big but almost every book on our syllabus is available in the library. apart from the syllabus, there are many books that can help personality development.
The Classrooms are big as compared to the number of students. But there is no air conditioning in the classes 
 The college organises various sports events in which anyone can participate and win. There are many games which can be played in the college, they got a football ground, basketball ground, Badminton Ground, every type of indoor game is available in the college like chess table tennis carrom board.
There are many Societies in the college but the ADGITM Codechef chapter is the most working societyI always dreamed to be an Engineer from a good College and grab a good Placements.
The Faculty to Student ratio is pretty much fine, as there are 10-12 teachers for every subject each year, and we can ask our doubts to any one of them.
The Teachers of the College are well Qualified in their field and the way their teaching is very good. Teachers are very helpful, qualified and knowledgeable, and also support all types of think that students needed in their studies.
The exams are timely held in the college, Notices for the exam are given a month ago and the datesheet of the exam is given 2 weeks prior. The exams are not very tough one could pass the exams by practising the previous year's question papers

Name: Kirtan khunt
college: SAL Institute of Technology and Engineering Research - [SITER]
review: We got 2 libraries all over the college campus and In there you got almost all of your needed books. Half-yearly university arranges or organize very nice sports for a week and that is awesome for us. Also, they organize sports activities for that type of student.I choose this particular course because my interest is also in software development which is the reason for choosing this course. The faculty is well knowledgeable in their own subjects and daily updates of that subject related. Also, they are well qualified.

Name: Abhinav
review:
Campus life is amazing if we remove infrastructure from it. Apart from that everything will be likable. You may get disappointed by the infrastructure because there is no gym and no SAC. Vacant spaces are abundant. Playgrounds are available, main building, new academic building, hostels, medical dispensary, TSG, VSG, badminton court, volleyball court, hockey ground, all other things are there.
Many clubs are there in every field, coding, sports, culture like Rooh, BTBS, etc. Social, Technical.The fee structure for the 1st sem is 116000 and next sem onwards it is 105000. There are several scholarships having criteria income margins, under 2lakhs or 3lakhs such as state Cummins, FFE, and Vidyasaarthi.
Fee remission is also given to the students by college having income less than 5 lakh.
Below 1 lakh full tuition fees remission
Below 5lakhs and above 1 lakh 2/3rd tuition fees remission

Name: Aditya  Singh
review:
Life on Parul campus is quite good though as you won't feel boring here it's more like a family here and campus is quite big though to roam around for walking there are lots of programs and festivals been conducted in our university at every time basis and many actors and politicians do have visited our university once ..talking about the availability of the books there are 2 big libraries in our university which are having every book around a student need though for their needs.
There are many types of sports activities conducted  by the university such as cricket,football, and badminton tournament and many though 
 There is an official page of the Parul university club run by the students of Parul universityFess hike is quite basic compared to other universities around Parul university because it changes mainly depending upon your comfort of type of hostel you are choosing to stay or the department in which you are studying mainly it's being affordable for a middle-class family and university also provides you the opportunity of a scholarship to students who are having good grades and percentage in their board exams  and while taking  admission  in the university and taking about financials assistance they mainly provide fees deduction for the students who are scholars  and at last but not the least talking about the job they provide you the best vinous jobs and 100% job opportunities

Name: Harsh Goladara
review: Fees of Nirma university are usually on the higher side. In B.tech general fees are around 200000. It is expensive but you will get its value by getting a good placement and good faculty. You will get a Mysy scholarship for a Gujrat board student.In this course, you get every important subject of computer science. All faculty are interactive and responsive and all faculty members are highly qualified and with PhD. Term exams take after every six months and are very easy to pass the exam.

Name: Ayush Jadvani
college: Silver Oak College of Engineering and Technology - [SOCET]
review: Generally, students apply for internships after the 5 semesters. Various opportunities by the college for internship in different departments for various roles are provided. One of the students got the internship opportunity in INFOCHIPS for six months and later also got POP(pre-placement offer) in the same.From the fifth semester, we got placement from different types of companies like IBM, TATA, ADANI, INFOSYS, Indian defence cyber team, Government forensic, etc. The highest package given by Microsoft was 78 LPA. The ratio of students getting placement is 70 per cent.

Name: Jizmil
review:
I wanted to become an aerospace engineer so I choose mechanical engineering.
The number of students from the class of the year 2021-25 is 22 which is very less Even though there is a total seat of 120 for mechanical engineering.
There are so many teachers for mechanical engineering.
Exams were a little toughThe fee for my course is 35000 rs per year + an additional 6000 for tuition fee and special fee.
Namely 3 scholarships are there.
Egrantz for students also for hostelers .
A scholarship for women.
MOMO scholarship for minority students.

Name: Bhawna
review: E-magazines and newsletters are hosted on the college website from time to time, further, the campus is so huge which includes a badminton court, and a basketball court. further various sporting events are organized from time to time by the college including inter-college badminton championships. various freshers' parties named carbuncle and fests are organized by the college wherein they call Punjabi singers recently they called parmish Verma 'the Punjabi singer '. overall it's an amazing experience in this college.The fees are high in comparison with other colleges, this is the only thing where the college is lagging behind the other college still college is giving quality education, and also with that amount of fees they are actually offering the quality further their campus placement is amazing, they proved in 2021 where they called best companies in their campus drives. which ultimately helped the students to build their careers.

Name: gunja
college: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology - [DCRUST]
review: I chose computer science as I want to get placed on google. and also I was curious about tech from the beginning which is from my childhood days. there are in total 60 students in a class. Since DCRUST is a university campus. there are teachers with good academics and years of experience in teaching. They can easily understand where the student is lagging in their studies and they give them a deep inside knowledge so that all doubts will get cleared and the student will ace in exams and real life as well.The fees are low among other colleges as this college is getting funding from the Haryana government. further, the DCRUST is famous for its placement drives. once you get into this college it's approximately 80-85% confirmed that you'll get a job either in BIG 4s, KPOs, or BPOs. overall job placement opportunity is great on this campus. Also, fascinating internships are there which offer you a good stipend in your student life ranging from 10k-25k based upon capability.

Name: param
review: The reason behind choosing Geeta engineering college is because of its reputation and further because it is located in my locality, also one of my friends is in the 7th semester in the ECE stream and recently got placed in Crompton. further, the faculties are amazing they will treat you like their family members and will teach you with their whole hearts and help you to deal with real-life practical problems. there are in total 8 semesters making it a total of 4 years and further, there is also a quarterly test scheme which is conducted after every 3 months to check the performance of students.Fees are less in comparison with other colleges further they offer scholarships to lower background family students who are not able to pay fees for college so to keep their dream alive they offer scholarships. further job placements are also good, it has been seen that they start calling new companies in addition to the existing in-campus placements drives. the only thing that I feel needs to be improved is that they should start calling good corporate companies which offer good packages to students.

Name: Kunal
college: B. M. Institute of Engineering and Technology - [BMIET]
review: I chose this course because I have always wanted to be an engineer as my brother is also an engineer and currently working for Google cloud. the faculty is quite experienced and few teachers are from even IITs and NITs and they actually know how students can get the knowledge about the subject they actually use practically life examples and try to prove their sayings. in total, we are 55 students in the class. there are in total 8 semesters comprising of 5-6 subjects in each semester. further, there are sessionals organised on regular basis after every 3 months so that students can evaluate themselves.the fees hike policy is not so good as they increase fees on any ground which is actually not good for a student who is from the middle class and lower middle class. thus I want this thing to be improved and further, the job assistance is quite impressive. in the 7th semester, there will be a placement drive where you can get hired if you suit the job requirements and your capabilities. there are various companies that join in campus placement drives including Wipro, Accenture, HCL, Genpact and various other kpos and Bpos.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: KLS Gogte Institute of Technology - [KLS GIT]
review: There was a wonderful fest conducted last month One22 in our college. The college library is very big and is open 24*7 for all the students there are lots of books available for study we can even carry them home. Classrooms are very good with smart boards. Sports are conducted offend. There are many social groups and clubs run by students like Rotract, CSS, astronomy club etc.From the 6th semester, students are eligible for campus placements. many companies visited this year like Mercedes Benz, Infosys, Falabella, TCS, Samsung etc. almost 100% of computer science got placed this year. The Highest package this year was 23.5 lakhs by Samsung and the average packages are around 5-6 lakhs.

Name: Jahnavi Valmiki
college: Sri Krishnadevaraya University College of Engineering and Technology - [SKUCET]
review: As it is a government University the fee at the University is minimum when compared to the other engineering colleges. The hostel fee is also minimum and it is not fixed it be changed from term to term and there will be scholarship opportunities too. If you're a candidate who got qualified and got a seat in the University you don't need to pay the fee with your money you will get the scholarship money from the government itself if you're eligible for themThe campus life is totally good and it is a ragging-free campus there are very strict rules passed by the college principal and the University vice chancellor there will be serious action can be taken if any of such actions will happen in the University. It's a joyful green campus and there will be clubs for making the annual fests and there is an individual library for every college as well as the central University Library.

Name: Ishrat Ali
review: From my child hood I want be an engineer and that what I followed but after coming into this field I came to know so much things I started loving coding and web development and all. Faculty of the University is not that good .they are not that qualified and knowledge inspite of having helping nature and mentoring quality.The fee for the CSE student is 180000 for that you need to give the scholarship exam and you can decrease your fees. According to the marks, you will get a scholarship which will only be continued every semester if you score 75% percent every semester.

Name: Shubham Kumar
review:
This college conducts a number of events on a regular basis. The events and fest which they conduct are AAKRITI, SOLUTION, and every club like debate drama and quiz, e-cell, nature, sports, competitive programming and technical clubs etc conduct their own events regularly for the students.

There is a big Library and reading room with AC which remains open on SUnday also so that students can fully utilize the resources.
Sports facilities are excellent  with 2 basketball, volleyball and indoor badminton courts. There is a huge football grounds and cricket ground which are maintained regularly by the institute.Army institute of technology Pune is known for its excellent placements. For the year 2021-22 the percentage of students placed was 98.4% with the highest placement of112 lac and an average was 16.43 lac in computer engineering which is really awesome.
Top recruiting companies visiting are Amazon, Microsoft, Accolite, Avalara, Condensation, Cohesity, Paytm, etc offering a good placement.

Name: Rohith
college: St Ann's College of Engineering and Technology - [SACET]
review: The campus is full of students it's beautiful and recently we celebrate the ECE Department fest. We enjoyed ourselves a lot and on sports day my college conducts sports in our college so many colleges are joined in games prizes also distributed we don't have any social group.I Love the ECE Branch because it's go to both the software and hardware side. And my faculty sirs are teaching well and well. Mid-exams are conducted strictly and I got good marks. Mid exams marks 15. and internal exams also conduct labs also.

Name: ASIF ZAKARIA
review:
Our university has too much fewer fees. I pay 2450 for a year and also get back those rupees after filling University scholarship form. Without it, I also get svmcm scholarship where I get 60k rupees. I think if anyone can't afford these college then he will not afford any other college fees.From the 2nd year, u can get a chance to do an internship but in the middle of the 4th year company came and placement starts.
Here big companies like Amazon, Google, apple, Microsoft, the, etc company come.
This year's highest package was 2.13cpa from the CSE branch.

Name: Aayush Singh
college: CGC College of Engineering - [CGC COE] Landran
review: There are many clubs. Social life is very cool. On campus, there is an antique Chowk. It's always gove push to extracurricular activities. Lots of Fest held. Inter hostel competition is also held. There are also some websites of assignments which is run by our seniors.Placements are very good. The average package is 7 lac. 800+ companies visit our campus every year. Around 8500+ students get placement offer every year. Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Flipkart, Cisco, by just etc visits our campus.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: If you are from Rajkot then you have to pay only college fees. AND IF YOU are outside of Rajkot then you have to pay living costs also. A new opening just started this year for students. To apply you have to check the website regularly. Fees for the first year are 4200 and 1200 fees after the first year. You have to pay 50 rupees extra for a one-time meal. There are many scholarships available for students. Likes MYSY AND FFE.I choose this college because I'm from the Lower middle class that's why I have financial problems in my family. I heard about Gec Rajkot which is the best engineering college in Gujarat that's why I took admitted to this college. here all the teachers are well qualified and have good teaching methods. here term exam happens in mid after every 3 months. It's easy to clear the exam if you prepare well

Name: Ayush pandey
review:
As we know there are many courses available here in our college , GNIOT college. 
I choose CSE (IOT) as my course because I have an interest in wireless technologies.
Each class contain maximum 60 students.
And faculty is quite good.
The teachers and professors are good and they help students.There is no proper placement cell, and the companies visiting the college are not good. The average salary package offered is 4.5 LPA. If students want good salary packages, then they have to apply off-campus. Some top companies visit our college for placements too.

Name: Jayesh Chaudhari
review:
More than infrastructure two significant things we need to consider are branches and placements of college. Because in long term that's what you're gonna get out with. the fee structures are quite moderate but if you got yourself into a good institute then it's worth it.
There are many opportunities nowadays for engineering students from the 2nd year only So can get yourself into a scholarship and then go for RnD and foreign studies or can opt an for internship and get a full-time industry job after college. But more importantly, colleges are to explore more things, technologies, and innovative things so you can also go for Startups as there are many opportunities at graduation.Over 200+ companies visit colleges under 150 NIRF rankings so average placement is no big deal for average Students. and for those who wish to get higher packages, you got to stand out of crowd and walk ahead of them to have handsome packages. From 3rd yr of B tech, you can opt for placements and internships majorly. Although you can go for off-campus placements or further studies also according to your convenience and choices. And to make the best out of a degree try for startups as there are very constructive surroundings while completing college.

Name: Anish Baghel
review:
There are different fests organized in different months like summer fest in June July gra fest one of the name fest organized during Sep oct winter fest in dec and competition and quizzes are too organized in different months. 
The college consists of 3 huge libraries consisting of all useful books regarding the course, in addition, it consists novels and other books
Amenities in the classroom is a good furnished cushioned seat with proper rooms and projectors and well-built labs to do study
Sports college consist of basketball ground football ground volleyball cricket table tennis chess pool table every game has it a suitable place to play and so the competition is organized. Different groups are NSS NCC.I chose Btech cse with a specialization in AIDS because its sector has a huge scope in upcoming times and it provides info about every tech thing I am from ICSE I have command in coding from starting. 
The facility is good the ratio is 60:1. 
The facility is qualified and educated with better ideas for the education they make our learning process easy facility is always on time in class punctual and good in talking no harsh behavior. 
In each semester consists of two exams mid sem and ends sem each of 50 and 100 marks respectively each exam consists of practice before the theory exam and it's tough to pass because the question can be from anywhere all on logic.

Name: Sameer Swami
review: Our college celebrates many festivals and one of them is the biggest festival its name is D.Y Utsav. The library of our college is very big it contains about 50 thousand and above books. The college supports us with various sports one of them is table tennis. The coding club is famous in our college.From third year students can apply for placement the company that visits our college are Wipro, Infosys, sand wick. The average package is 3 to 4 lakhs per annum and the highest package is 10 lakhs. This year's highest package was 9.7 lakhs. I will look for a job after my degree.

Name: Ketan Jain
review: The course curriculum of VIT Pune is one of the best. While many colleges are focused majorly on Theoretical Knowledge, VIT focus on practical knowledge. We have projects, group discussions, and ppt presentations from 1st year itself. And they are given more importance than exams. There are two semesters each year. And there are not difficult to pass. You can get a really good cgpa without too much effort.As VIT is a private institute, fees are high. For the general category students' fees are around 1.9 lacs per year. And, if you come under EWS/EBC section it's around 1.1 lacks per year. I don't have much knowledge about any other financial assistance, if you have any doubts you can ask the student section of the college.

Name: Satyajeet Balaso Jadhav
review: The campus area of VIT Pune is quite small this is the only downside of this college. Other than that the campus life is awesome. There are many fests organizations in the college throughout the year. The library is quite big a lot of books are available.Placements in VIT are very good. Students can get placement from the 6th semester. There are many companies that come from placement. The highest package is 54 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. The percentage of students getting placed is quite high.

Name: Kaushal jadhav
review: There are 2 major events Vishwakarandak and Melange.In Vishwakarandak there are more then 150 games to participate for students and that time the lecture are held for only 2 hour the months in which these events are held is not Pacific it varies.In library there are more then 80 thousands books and any students can take it. If you are a volleyball or a cricket player then these college is best for you. Vel love is the famous club of are college and it is well known for cars development and making.In a competition recently held the club was  ranked 3rd in asia. For club membership you need to give 2 rounds of mcq test and a interviewFor general category students the fees is 1,80,000 and for reserved category it varies for SC/ST it is around 5-6 thousands for VJ/NT it is around 27-28 thousands.We can pay fees in one term or by step by step. For general category student their is a scholarship provided by maharashtra government.The students can apply for placement from 3rd year. The college make sure that their students us ready for outside competition.

Name: Akshat Shrimal
college: Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre
review: It is the newest branch at this college and seems to be attractive as it will help me to learn more in my field of technology. There is a 1:60 ratio between teacher and student. All the teachers are well qualified. Exams are not much tough but one has to do proper study for each subject.The placement of the college is outstanding. From 5th students are able to take part in college placements. Companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Infosys, TCS, Intel, byju's, Capgemini, etc visited here. Amazon gave the highest package of 40 lacs and the average is 6 to 7 lacs.

Name: Sarthak Madhamshettiwar
review: Fees hike is not so regular. It might be more costly than state colleges but it is certainly cheaper than other national-level colleges like IIT, NIT, and Public-Private IIITs. Various national and state scholarships are given to meritorious as well as needy students.I was interested in Computers, that's why choosing the IT course at IIITA. Every faculty is highly qualified and most of them have done PhDs in respective subjects from extremely reputed colleges in the country. Passing exams is certainly not a very tough task.

Name: P N UTTUNGA
review:
I chose ece thinking that this branch has various opportunities. Another reason is that as I am equally interested in ece/cse I thought ece in top colleges is better than cse un average college though branch is very hard to study. 
Almost all faculties did M. Tech from top universities across India including IITs. So many did PhDs too. Faculties are very well experienced and teaching method is very good and they are very strict which helps students to focus more on the class. 
Exams are very strict and tough too there are 5 internals which is conducted in cbt mode and sem end examination conducted in pen and paper mode but it does not include any choice! Yes, you read that right. There is no choice in any exam in PES and u must not miss any chance if u know concepts very well you can do well in exams basically u have to concentrate on your studies from day one itself as academics is tough.Campus life is not that good because the campus is very small and crowded but the infrastructure is very good. Classrooms are very well maintained. 
You can get any book which is related to your syllabus library facility is too good. 
Coming the annual fest the fest named "AATMATRISHA" is held each year in April month held mostly on weekends. But there are so many tech clubs that conduct so many hackathons. If u take average so you can participate in at least 3 events per week but classes will run as per the regular timetable.
Students are connected mainly through the discord server.

Name: Jeevanandam
review: The annual fest can be conducted once every year and there will be more events every student can participate in those events. classrooms are good and there will be good ventilation in every classroom and they provided with more number of fans and lights.I choose this course to place in an IT company with a good package. The student-teacher relationship is very good they are very friendly, and students can clear doubts easily with the faculty teaching methods are well and good.

Name: Sanjai
review: The annual fest can be conducted once a year. there will be more events per month. classrooms are good. good ventilation will be there. sports activities are very low. there will be more association clubs for the students to take participate.The fee structure is quite normal likes other colleges. the management fees are 200000 per year and the government quota fees are 100000. they also provide more scholarships to face financial problems. we also get a stipend.

Name: Narasimha Naidu
college: RVR and JC College of Engineering
review:
They are 2 categories in rvr and  JC college category A and category B.
Category A members are scholarship candidates who need not pay any tuition fees.
Scholarship students get a fees from the JVD scheme of approximately 66,000.
Category B  students need to pay 80,000.Rvr and JC college placements companies are hetero drugs, Tvs, Aliens group, coviam technologies,  L and T smart world, and communication, etc.
Best offers for all students in rvr and JC college. Maximum students are stratified with their placements.

Name: Maheerunnisa
review: Our college was conducted vibha 2022 which was much awaited fest and it was a grand successful event and they also conducted hackathon during night time which is to innovate and show their ideas and to create new things. Their are so many social clubs which are doing by our seniors of our college. Placements are offered from thrid year onwards in our college and before that they will give training to us and they will make us to face interview. Highest package is 6.5 lakhs oer annum and average package is 3 LPA and 85% of students get placements in our college.

Name: Botcha Ajay Chandra Mouli
review:
there will be atleast one fest per each month.
there is a very big library in which almost all the useful books and journals are available, there is a digital library in which we can access all the other books and journals through online.
there is digital lecture capturing devices, projectors are available in classrooms.
There is a special student activity center which deals with all the extracurricular activites of students, all the indoor and outdoor sport facilities are available.
clubs like ISTE,CSI,ACM,ACM women,SDA,SAE,etc., student bodies and clubs are present.from 5th semester the students will be eligible for campus placements.
companies like Infosys,Tech mahindra,Cognigent,Amazon,Byjus,etc., offered an approximate of 1000 job offers each year.
the highiest package of 34.5LPA is offered by Amazon and an average of 4LPA.
nearly 95%of students gets placed every year.
My plan is to get a good placement in a decent company.

Name: Vishal Pal
college: Raj Kumar Goel Institute of Technology - [RKGIT]
review:
I choose b.tech in electronic and communication engineering because there is high placement and the package I quite good.
The faculty member is too good they helped students in every situation and the semester exam, the faculty also take extra classes for good result for the students. One faculty manage 100 students approx.
Most of the faculty are graduated and many of them have experience of more than 11 years.
After 10 days there are internal exams which are hard enough to score good marks.The campus is too good there is a big ground for playing sports. The college also conducts a fest for the first year and there is also a tech fest which is happened twice or more a month. Most books are available in the library and the library is fully ac.
There is a ground for volleyball, football, cricket, and students also play indoor games like chess, badminton, and many more. I'm in my first year I don't know more about the social group and all.

Name: VELPULA GOPI PUJITH
college: Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering - [LBRCE]
review:
The campus is wonderful.
Annual fest, farewell, party's are amazing 
In the library all books, journals, authors, and famous books are available.in college sports conduct at the university level, extracurricular activities on campus are good.
Social groups like spoorthi, NSS, NCC etc.Internship opportunities are better available because they provide other companies with internships. the final goal for every student is to get a job. projects are conducted every semester with good quality products, it's good and safe for students in LBRCE college.

Name: Tarun Singh
review: Multiple events take place here like freshers party, farewell, sports event spardha and many more. The library is not that better but a good place to read your own books .classrooms are good. Sports are given importance here .all sports like football, badminton, chess, carrom, and all others. Clubs like a cultural clubs, social clubs, sports clubs, and many more are there all of these clubs are taken care of by students.I choose this college because it is one of the best colleges in greater Noida. Mentor to student ratio is 1:25 and teacher to student ratio is 1:60 . All the teachers own Ph.D. degree and their teaching skills are awesome. Exams were quite easy for a few subjects and difficult as well.

Name: Aayush Singh
review:
For this year the fee is 150k which increases 10% yearly i.e., 165k for the 2nd year and so on.
There are scholarships available, which students can avail of through the e-district portal of the state government. Where they provide scholarships from 25% - 100%. These are easy to avail, and the process is also normal, in case you find difficult to fill up the form you can watch any YouTube video, they all are explanatory.
Name of scholarship: Merit-cum financial assistance scholarship
There are many other scholarships the list of which you can find on DSEU's official site.
This year's average package was 11LPA (still counting) with the highest package of 18LPA in CSE.
One of the students from CSE got an off-campus placement in Amazon with 53 LPA.
Although these are the stats when this college was under IPU and not even a single big company visited the camp, now onwards it came under DSEU and its signing MoU with many companies which means that now onwards there will be a hike in the average package.There are many indoor games available like Carrom Ludo Chess Table Tennis etc., and for outdoor games, you can play Basketball and Badminton as they have separate courts for them.
And there is no ground available we use to play Volleyball in Basketball ball itself by hanging a net in between, and some students play cricket near the stage and beside the canteen.
The library is the place which plays an important role in any student's life here they are well acquainted with all the books, whether they are normal course books or the GATE preparation books they have a big stock.
2 activity days are held in college per semester, every activity day has a different theme, they also provide refreshments, which I attend them.
Many many clubs are available and many new ones are also in the process of being official, some of them are Team Zenith (Technical society), Buniyad(drama society), samadhi (social welfare), Youth, and Eco Society, IEEE, and many more.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Babu Banarasi Das Northern India Institute of Technology - [BBDNIIT]
review: The annual festival DVD is known as Utkarsh it comprises of the first and including techfest competitions DJ nights and other things availability of books is good we have on the library where you can find almost every book of your syllabus there are many clubs and have a good infrastructure for sports some of the clubs are technical club football club cricket club and tennis badminton drama dance music literature etc etcAll the syllabus of aktu follows and the whole syllabus is available on YouTube and other sites it's not very difficult to pass or good marks in exams the pattern is fixed and many times questions are also pretty predictable but you are checking is tough times on reasonable

Name: Dhruv
college: IIT Guwahati - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review:
Alcheringa (January)is our annual fest, last year 3 lakh people visited this. The technique (September) is our tech fest.
We have one central library which is very huge. Around 2.5 lakh books are there.
Classrooms are big and technically advanced. Equipped with mic, projector, and benches with steps in class.
In sports facilities, we have 1 swimming pool,11 basketball courts, 1 athletic ground and many more.
We have clubs for literally everything like finance club, fine arts club , robotics club, electronic club, coding club, etc.From the 4th semester, you will get a chance to sit in internship and from the 6th semester you will get a chance to sit in placement.
Nearly 300 companies visited last year for placement, like Microsoft, amazon, adobe, etc.
The average placement of the overall college is 16 lakhs, highest one was 2.04 crore.

The hostel and mess fees are around 25000 and the semester fee is around 80000. So the total fee for one semester is approximately 100,000. review: Honestly speaking this course that I chose was not by choice it's just what I got in the counselling process. The faculty students ratio is average in our college. Regarding the library, we have a fully air-conditioned multi-storey building dedicated to the library only, It has all the course books. There is also a book bank for SC/ST students. Also, the library has multiple newspapers and journals.
The classrooms are very well built. They are fully air-conditioned and spacious, and also have projectors for better teaching.
Our college has a very good sports complex having all kinds of sports amenities from a badminton court to a shot-put ground. Also, it has a very well equipped gym (one for boys and one for girls).
There are multiple clubs for students to participate in and grow from Leo club to EDC.All professors are PhD qualified and are knowledgable. The course curriculum is not relevant to today's world, but then the curriculum is the same for all engineering colleges (as AICTE gives the curriculum). Professors are friendly, but some are exceptions too. They provide extra time for doubt solving and can go the extra mile to help the students. We have three quizzes, one mid-sem and one end-sem in a semester. One needs to score 5 SGPA to pass a semester.

The normal cost to study will be around 7-7.5 lac in NIT Raipur, but for those students whose family annual income is between 1 to 5 lac, it will cost you around 4 lac only and for those having below 1 lac per annum, the fee will not be more than 2 lac for all 4 years. But if you want more relaxation in fees then you can apply for an education loan in banks. Banks provide scholar loan schemes for students admitted in IITs/NITs/IIITs/IIMs. Then, you don't have to pay any fees and if you have paid any you will get refunded. Since it is a loan so you have to repay it, the benefit is that your parents don't need to pay for it. You get a good placement and repay your loan.

After getting admission you will get to know about all scholarships on the college's website.Well, I got ECE in NIT Raipur not because I wanted to but because of my rank. But now I am happy because in our college we are given comparatively fewer assignments than the other NITs and some IITs. This is a very good practice because we get a lot of time to explore new things like coding, music, and dance. Our faculties are quite friendly, they don't pressurize us to do any kind of work. They teach us well and provide all the materials needed.

The faculty: student ratio is quite decent. We are not outnumbered.

All faculties are PhD. in their field, they are quite friendly. they don't pressurize us to do any kind of work. They teach us very well and provide all the materials required. 

Exams are not so frequent, except in this pandemic situation. In one semester we have the mid-term exam and an end-sem examination with viva-voce and practicals. Only at the time of end-sem, there is a situation of a little bit of stress which is common in all colleges.

Name: Abhinav tiwari
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review:

From the second year, the subjects will be according to your branch. The subjects of computer science-related branches are almost the same except for one or two.  Faculty members have well qualified many of the faculty members are PhD holders and some have done their masters. As like in every college some faculties are very good and some are not that good, The teaching style is quite good and understandable. Most of the faculty members are supportive except for some. Faculty to student ratio is good. Exams are held from time to time there are three exams 1.) SESSIONAL 1(ST1),  2.) ST2, 3.)PUT based upon the marks in these exams your internal marks are decided. The central library is located on the third floor of the main building. The library is air-conditioned and almost all the books are available here but it is not that spacious.

Although all the sports grounds and equipment are available in the campus (cricket, football, basketball, badminton, volleyball, etc) but there is a lack of awareness they focus more on academics.

The library is very good at NSIT. It has availability of all the needed and famous books. You also get free wifi in the library and now form this year nsit is introducing an online library for their students.
Classroom for 1st year students is world class. The first time I saw the classes, I was amazed by the infrastructure. But when I got to know about the other year's student classes that were normal.
The Sports campus is a very good college. You will get every sport available except the swimming pool. As I was a volleyball player, the college has 3 courts available. 
There are around 20-25 clubs/societies in college. It is very fun having any society. You get friends with the same interests. You do the workday and night and then do party, food and everything.All the faculties are highly qualified but don't expect them to teach like your coaching teachers or favourite school teachers. They just try to complete the syllabus. Only some of them are interested and energetic while teaching. And this thing happens in every college.
Term exams were not so hard to pass but the routine of college is very hectic. You can have class tests 4-5 days a week. A lot of classes to attend and maintain 75% attendance also. It becomes very hectic for students to try new things on their own and attend college together.

They are really inspiring and fun.The course is very much interesting as it is specialisation in automation. The student ratio is kind of fine from last year. The ratio is 7:1. Teachers' teaching method is good. But you must be focused. The exam is easy but the gap between the exams are less because of covid academic delay.

Name: Shashank Paliwal
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review:
Fee structure is very good it is divided in three categories in terms of your family annual income. If you belong to sc/st category or your annual family income is below 1 lakh than you only have to pay other college charges no tution fee is charged from you . And if your annual family income is in between 1lakh to 5 lakh than you only have to pay 1/3 of the tution fee and other charges . And if your annual family income is above 5 lakh than you will be charged complete fees i.e 164000 for day scholars. If you want to stay in hostels then you will be charged with few more amounts but as it is a government college so they do not charge much for hostels.
There are various scholarships that are given to students. Scholarships are given on the basis of your tuition fees.The course curriculum for first year is somewhat familiar and is common for all branches. Faculties are also good except for one or two you will get enough free time as well. All the faculties have done PhD from the top universities. There are a lot of exams and assignments you have to do so time management will play a key role in your college life. Exams are taken at a continuous interval end term exams are not so tough if you have studied well during your semester it is not necessary to study for 4-5 instead you should listen to your class lectures sincerely and keep on revising them after every class that will take you to score good marks in your exams.

Name: Ayush yadav
review:
College life is very hectic. Though there are many co-curricular activities yet the students do not get proper time to participate in them.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I chose Computer science and engineering, because of my passion for technology and innovations in the modern world. Our college has been an autnomous status in the year 2021 for a period of 10 years by UGC. So now my college is an independent body conducting its own exams and syllabus. The curriculum is diverse and students in our college are provided with the best knowledge. I am not aware of the student-faculty ratio but every class has two charges and for every 9 students we have a student mentor who looks after the student's well-being. We are being given assignments very often and exams are conducting for every 2- 3 months. Professors in our college are well educated and almost every professor carries a Ph.D. degree. Even a below-average student can pass the exam if he puts a minimum of his effort. Attendence of 75 percent is a must for every student for appering in semester end exam. In rare cases, 65 percent is also permitted. Every class has a projector, so teaching becomes easy.Nirvana is the annual fest conducted in our college. Every branch conducts its own technical fest. They are usually conducted in march. Our college has a very gaint library having more than 10,000 books and international journals. Every student having an ID card can enter the room for reference or for taking. Our classrooms are pretty good and they can accommodate upto 65 students. We have projectors in every classroom. Classrooms are spacious and very well ventilated. We have a cricket ground, football ground, basketball courts, volleyball courts and an indoor sports room having table tennis. There are many clubs in our college, music club - symphony, drama club- spotlight, literary club, idea incubator, NGO club-like streetcars - might. Last month a new club related to coding is also started. we also have a very good dancing club called beat cruisers.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review: The course curriculum is upto the mark  and the faculty is cooperative and techno friendly with a few exceptions at it. I chose chemical engineering since it was my passion . Name: Aman Mehta
college: Unitedworld School of Computational Intelligence, Karnavati University - [USCI]
review: B.Tech is a highly techno-professional course. The only thing that attracted me was the subject- Computer Science. It gives endless opportunities to each person around. Making it one of the most loved streams in the engineering field. People say one needs to become an engineer before studying engineering and our college succeeds in the same. There is a fair faculty-to-student ratio(1:15) because our college is relatively new. The faculty here has a PhD degree (minimum), making the knowledge level touch the extremes. The teaching method is simple and easy to understand through the use of smart boards, practical labs etc. We have a large campus and UID- the design college is also a part of our campus hence we get a chance to use and understand practical stuff at the workshops. Examinations here are conducted every 2.5-3 months wherein there are 2 examinations per semester- mid-semesters and end semesters which improves the efficiency of students. Overall you may bet on this college for sure.Our campus is one of the most underrated campuses in Gujarat. Beautiful infrastructure with greenery. This university is a paradise for social animals like me. The university campus consists of different colleges ranging from Liberal arts to Dentistry to law to computers to design etc. Nobody is restricted from entering a particular college for knowledge. There are events held almost every month to keep the students active and happy. These events are mostly on a moderate to large scale depending on the type of event. Students get an opportunity to interact with masters from a wide range of fields and the energy felt during events is just impeccable! Our college has hosted some of the biggest concerts, some of the biggest tech fests, and some of the biggest big things that one could ask for! You won't feel the stress of studying at our college instead you would learn by doing things! A practical approach is the ultimate USP of our university! I'm overwhelmed to be a part of the university.

Name: Velukuru punith
review:

Complete tuition fee waiver for B.Tech: Candidate must have secured rank between 1 to 2000 in EAMCET. 
Government of Andhra Pradesh scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement for eligible students. 
Stipend, tuition fee reimbursement & scholarships at PG level (M.Tech).

I choose ece because it is an evergreen field we can go to the IT sector side as well as the core side.

review:

Name: Ritika Raj
review:
We could just attend 8 months of offline college. 5 months before covid and 3 months after covid. 
We had our annual fest in the month of February. It was not that great. It's on the average side. Rest there are many other college society fests. Each society conducts there own fest/event in the month of Dec-March. There are many competitions that are held in these. It's based on which society is conducting the fest. 
To be a part of these societies you need to give an interview. (Placement Cell, Finance and Investment Cell, Entrepreneurship Cell, name it and you have a cell for that activity) 
You can get all the required books in the library. But since the course curriculum of commerce gets updated every now and then you won't find the latest versions
There are no such extra amenities in the classrooms. It's very basic. Just the conference hall had ACs. DRC has the biggest hall in the North campus where Miss DRC is held. 
There's an annual sports day in which anyone can take part.I was mainly interested in accounts and business-related subjects, therefore chose this course. 
The faculty at DRC is quite good. They will help you in all the ways they can. DRC has all the opportunities but only if you are willing to learn. You have to grab the opportunities and be active in order to have the best of experiences. 
At DRC we had phd scholars and professors who had done their masters in commerce. Other than this some of the professors were associated with rbi and other financial institutions.
We had a midterm which was 25 marks and end term exam (75 marks) in each semester. Since ours was a covid batch we gave only the 1st and the 6th semester offline exams. The rest were all online. But otherwise, obviously, the exams are held regularly. 
I would say it's easy to pass the exams, provided you refer to the 10 years and pay a bit of attention in the class as to what exactly to write in the exams. 
Also in the internals (25 marks) sometimes it's upon the teachers.

Cept library is one of the greatest collections as it houses all genres of books from all fields right from architecture, and planning, to technology. It is a huge resource. 
Cept fests and events are something that goes along with the ongoing semesters. It is a great way to get a break from the hectic schedule and socialise. Roots and Mazi are some of the events recently organised by the student council. 
Classrooms are well equipped with the basic requirements of lights and electricity, an area for projection, and air conditioners(not all in the classrooms). Cept classrooms are well-designed, and ventilated.My interest had always been inclined more towards understanding in depth about 'what is history'. In my bachelor's training, I was quite interested in history lectures and hence took up the research thesis to explore further. This all gave me clarity on what I really would like to pursue further.

The class strength is 12. We have our tutor as well as teaching associate with whom group discussions, as well as individual discussions, happen on at regular basis. 1:12

All the faculties allocated have a minimum of 5 years of teaching experience, with master's qualification.

End-semester reviews at cept are quite unique as there are no written exams. It is mostly graded on the level of our understanding, how in-depth we have got into research and our final outcome.

Name: KAIRAVI KETAN MANIAR
review:
Life at Cept is an excellent opportunity for students to explore areas of interest other than their mainstream work. The cept offers electives and summer-winter courses where one gets to gain more knowledge and expertise in other fields. 
Cept library is one of the greatest collections as it houses all genres of books from all fields right from architecture, and planning, to technology. It is a huge resource. 
Cept fests and events are something that goes along with the ongoing semesters. It is a great way to get a break from the hectic schedule and socialise. Roots and Mazi are some of the events recently organised by the student council. 
Classrooms are well equipped with the basic requirements of lights and electricity, an area for projection, and air conditioners(not all in the classrooms). Cept classrooms are well-designed, and ventilated.My interest had always been inclined more towards understanding in depth about 'what is history'. In my bachelor's training, I was quite interested in history lectures and hence took up the research thesis to explore further. This all gave me clarity on what I really would like to pursue further.

The class strength is 12. We have our tutor as well as teaching associate with whom group discussions, as well as individual discussions, happen on at regular basis. 1:12

All the faculties allocated have a minimum of 5 years of teaching experience, with master's qualification.

End-semester reviews at cept are quite unique as there are no written exams. It is mostly graded on the level of our understanding, how in-depth we have got into research and our final outcome.

review: If you're a sincere dedicated person towards studies, then this will be the best college for you. But when it comes to sports or extracurricular activities, then it's not worth it. Name: Sukriti Pathak
review: I have an interest in academics and want to be a professor so that I can spread knowledge, that's why I have chosen this course.  Faculty members are excellent in their fields. They are very helpful and supportive. They give advice apart from studies also and are very helpful and knowledgeable. They go with 1to 1 interact with the students and organise various seminars, career counselling programmes, and alumni meetings so as to acknowledge children about the several courses and college history. All the teaching faculty are PhD holders and stand excellent in their respective fields of knowledge. The teaching process is mainly done by the board system in this course and the classes are run by a systematic timetable which is provided by the faculty members themselves. Exam pattern is very easy if the student has studied.There are two sections of admission. Regular and Self-financed depending upon the marks obtained in the entrance exam. If the number hikes above the cut-off, the child can take admission by paying extra money asked by the college. The average fee for self-financed is 24,000/year and for a regular student is 13,000/year. For the regular student, the amount gets decreased. The scholarship has several rules and regulations and is limited.  The college provides several internship programs who are interested to get a job after this. No such financial assistance is provided apart from scholarships.
