This course makes the student's industry ready up to a certain mark, but beyond it, the complete efforts are of the students.According to the college Companies like Wipro, Cognizant, IBM, Microsoft, and Mindtree are major companies that visit the campus for hiring but very few companies visited our college for placement, and not a single student in our batch got placed in any company

Name: Shreya singh
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
The college provides u with very interesting opportunities to develop your skill via function or through extra curriculum activities. The college always tries to do something extra for the students to enjoy as well as learn well. The college has different groups clubs and also organizes trips. Educational and industrial visits with exploring the cities.The college fee structure start year is 133000, the second year it's 113000 at last year it's 101000.
The college provides two ways of payment,
self-mode payments.
BSCC (BIHAR STUDENT CREDIT CARD) where the Bihar state government provides you a maximum of 4 lahks of student loan.

Name: Abhishek Kumar
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review: The placement of this college is good. Many different companies come here like Wipro, TCS, ICC Bank, Utkarsh Bank and many more. They give many different offers but the height offer is approx 4 lakh and the average package is 3 lakh.Yes, there are many different clubs and social groups like a star club, dance club, coding club, environment club, sports club etc. There is a library where lots of books from different fields like IT field, Business management etc.

Name: Rajnandani kumari
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
I'll choose this because of my interest in programming and also because this field has a great future in the upcoming years. for 90 students 1 teacher is present. totally disciplined classes are conducted. teachers are very cooperative and helpful. they are ready to solve your problems 24/7. faculty are highly qualified. they have good experience in their subjects. Internal exams are conducted from time to time and in a very strict manner. Apart from this regular tests or unit tests are conducted in class to evaluate students' performance.Fees are quite high in comparison to other universities. but after submission of the course fee, u don't have to pay any other fee regarding anything related to academics.
Lots of scholarships are also introduced by teachers. and the best part is that the company is driven the campus placement.

Name: Anish mishra
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review: Here faculty members are good they are of helping nature. The syllabus of the course is very good here you also have to learn the add-on courses by which you will improve yourself for the upcoming future opportunities. Here you also get the feature of a bridge course in which we have to learn how we can improve our personality and how we can be good learners and speakers.The campus life is so cool here you can enjoy so many fests and tech fest geld by our college every year. There is only one problem we don't have a bigger campus at present time but in the upcoming years we have a bigger campus which is in construction now also it's not a big deal that we don't have a bigger campus but we enjoy it a lot here.

Name: Sakshi Kumari
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
My college always conducted events like workshops, English Communication fest, Skill development, Bihar development forum, etc.
My life on campus is full of joy.
My Director Sir is always helping in social workings like giving food to poor students.My course fee is 347000 and this amount is good for pursuing BCA. And in Bihar, my college is very popular and gives good results also.
Every year my college gives more than 250 placements.
The cost of the study is also affordable in my opinion.

Name: Saniya Sinha
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
The placements of Cimage are excellent. Students get placements in between completing the course. students get opportunities for internships also in the 5th and 6th semesters.
Many reputed companies visited our college for campus placements and made numerous offers in various places like Bangalore, Delhi, etc.I opted for BBA because I want to develop my skills in management. In Cimage faculty is knowledgeable. They are helpful and have supportive nature toward students.
The faculties are highly qualified and they also teach us with enthusiasm.
Terms exams are conducted timely before every semester.

Name: Roshni Bernard
review: It is a trimester system with 6 trimesters. It has a combination of subjects from all the domains in the first year after which depending on your specialization the subjects can be chosen. The faculty are really knowledgeable. And good teachers.The campus life is very engaging and great with events happening every trimester. From their in-house fests like pinnacle and Verve to fests from other colleges their cricket matches badminton and so on are a few of the events.

Name: saurav darshan
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
Faculties are well qualified and they teaches us very technically.
They always support interactive classroom, where student can ask for clearing the doubt not
Only during the classroom but as well as in the free time.
Cimage organises many events such as holi Mela Shubhaarambh , inspiro etc
And there are many clubs such as IT, Club excursion club, Digital Club , bloggers Club , Utsav Club , theatre club, helping hand Club,  etc

Name: Muskan
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
Here the fest is organized monthly whenever there is something special. We have got so much fun.
In cimage, You'll get a library where you find any type of books regarding BBA like auditing, finance, accounting, English, etc.
In classroom, you'll get a smart class board, a room air-conditioned with a big neat area.When I was in 12th. I thought about doing BBA because I'm interested in business.
Here in cimage, faculties are so humble and helpful. They help you whenever you're in need.
Here the faculties are so professional and highly qualified.
Exams are conducted every week like tests.

Name: AANAND GUPTA
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
Our college conducted so many fests, like subharambh, jasn a agaj, Bihar development forum, Holi Mela, and many more fest.
Our college conduct also has extracurricular activities like dancing, music, Saraswati puja, and many more.
Star club, music club, sports club, coding club, helping hand club, and many more clubs.I choose a Bachelor of computer science (BCA) because the modern era is fully dependent on Information technology, and the scope and jobs in information technology are very good. The ratio of our faculty members is 100 students per 1 faculty member. The teaching method of our faculty is awesome.

Name: Md Adil
college: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management - [ABVIIITM]
review:
I choose this course because my course is an integrated M-tech course. In this course, I directly get an M-tech degree also from such kind of prestigious college
Here faculty and students ratio is too much good
And every faculty of this college are doctorate. This is the only college in India with all the faculty members who are PhD Qualified from India's top colleges such as IIT and NIT. 
There are two exams every semester one is minor and the other is major. Exams are not so demanding and not so easy.After 6 semesters students are eligible for placement.
On this campus, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Atlassian, all big tech giants companies come—the highest package offered by Facebook of 2 CR. An average package is 25 lac per annum.
There 99% of students placed

Name: Chandra Shekar N
review:
There was no hike in fees for our batch it remained constant as the faculties said while the admission process.
We had an SSP scholarship of 5000 which we got for all the  3 years of our course year. They all meant to be nice while interacting with studentsWe organized many fest events, including inter-college fests, it was a great time and we had a great team, we learned teamwork from what we had participated in other college fest events, and we organized a mega job fair.
Had a good NSS classes

Name: Preet Raj
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
There are several fests organized in this college. Different types of functions are organized. And for such functions, we are trained enough we can organize all those functions very efficiently and effectively. We also get help from our seniors. Recently Holi Mela was organized in which we, students were allowed to do our one-day business by putting up different stalls of food and games. Through those stalls, we learned so much, about how to run a small business, and how to manage everything in real business life. 
Moreover, there are several workshops organized by our college by which we learn so many different as well as useful skills like app development, digital marketing, blockchain technology, and many more. These workshops are very helpful for us in gaining more and more skills.
Apart from this, we have several clubs in our college, like STAR Club, Dance Club, Music Club, Excursion Club, Theatre Club, and Sports Club for different purposes. Different club members organize this.I am so interested in the IT field and I want to make my career in this field as this is one of the most important fields in today's era. That's why I chose this course.
The teacher in my college is talented, they are well-skilled in their department. They are kind as well and always ready to help and support students.
The teaching methods are also very interesting and unique so that we can easily grab all those which are being taught to us.
There is an internal exam each semester before the university exams. Moreover, there are regular MARQ (Monthly Assessments) to record our performance.

Name: Asha Singh
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review:
I choose BBA because I am interested in business since childhood. Faculty were so supportive they guide us everywhere we needed. They teach us in a very understanding way no doubts are left. They even give us extra time for our doubt clearance. Class tests were conducted every month and for every subject. Exams were taken Properly. If the student is prepared then only they can pass.We enjoy different fest on our Campus. As related to the one-day startup and IT  fest we go to so many different workshops and learn a lot. All different kinds of books are available in the library either for management, IT, startup, financial, etc. 
The smart boards are there for our studies. 
We even enjoy so many sports as per our interest.

The library is open for books but one has to take a card worth five rupees. Too much drama on campus.

Name: Sushmita Singh
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review: I have chosen B.COM(P) course, as I am from a commerce background, and I'm interested in the banking sector so I chose this course. The faculty members of cimage are very cooperative and are always there to help us if we need it, all the members are highly knowledgeable and experienced teachers, they are ready to help us anytime, and even if it's 12 am at night they are always there for us. The term exams are conducted timely even though we have to go through monthly assessments, which is very good to check our knowledge. the teaching method of cimage is also highly appreciable.On the whole Bihar's cimage has been no 1 in giving placement there is no doubt of that. But you also need to be a deserving candidate in order to get the placement. From 2nd year students are eligible for campus placement. There are plenty of companies who visited cimage. Like Wipro, TCS, Reliance, ICICI, Utkarsh Bank, etc. After getting the degree I see myself working in a company enhancing my all the skills.

Name: Rajat Ranjan
college: Catalyst Institute of Management and Advance Global Excellence - [CIMAGE]
review: Placement! our college is known as a college of placements. There is a line for our college Cimage means placement so I don't think that I have to talk about our college placements.. because like every 2 months there's going to be a campus drive for the placements.The fee structure is quite good for this course. Because through these fees you are going to have a great 3 years for your career so I think that the fees structure is good for Graduation. You can study through DRCC yojna which was launched by CM Nitish Kumar.

Name: Shuvadip Nath
review: There are multiple fests performed at the college. There are a huge number of books available in the library. There is also a separate reading room where you can read books. The classrooms are quite big and airy. All types of sports are performed in the college. There are multiple clubs run by students for eg- Phoenix, GNX, and Lensified.I have an interest in Technology. Faculty members are very helpful. They are very cooperative. The 30 students are provided by a mentor. The teaching of the faculty is very good. Every topic is covered and they explain them very well. Exams are a bit frequent and it is easy to pass the exams.

Name: Nitesh kumar sahu
review:
The campus is big and is situated in Panposh. One of the best govt. College in Western Odisha. Campus conducts many events like fest, blood donation camps, study tours, etc. 
There is a big library where you can get all types of books. Free wifi also provided to the student in the library. Inter-college sports is organized every year. The Ncc group is there.I choose this course because I have to build my carrier in it sector only. The faculty is amazing, and the way of explaining the topics is mind-blowing. 6:70 ratio, including all sub-teachers. IIt, nit teachers. Every yr there is a 2-semester exam with, a time gap of 3-4 months. Easy to pass the exam.

Name: Kushagra Singh Baghel
review:
The fee structure for students admitted under all India quota(jee mains) is approx 1 lakh per semester and there are 8 semesters. 
The all-over cost of studying may add up to 12-13 lakhs for all 4 years. 
The Institute offers merit cum means scholarships to students. And earn while learn scheme is also there which offers approx. 2000 per monthAs for choosing the course I was allotted electrical engineering on the basis of my rank. 
Here the faculty: student ratio is 1:20
Most of the faculty have a PhD from top-ranking colleges across India like IITs. 
Three types of exams are conducted 1. Class test
2. Sessional 3. Sem end
Which are conducted very timely.

Name: Surya Pratap Yadav
college: KIPM College of Engineering and Technology - [KIPM]
review: As computer science student we get theory and practical both knowledge in college. Our college gives us balance in theory and practice. For doubts, there are extra tutorial classes and for practical, there is a lab assistant to help us. The teachers are really qualified and nice to us all the time.Fees are 71800 and if you take admission by counseling then the chances of a scholarship are 90% if you are eligible but if you take Direct admission your scholarship chances are approximately 50%. You can submit your fees in 4 installments.

Name: Nisarg
college: Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research - [DEPSTAR]
review:
Academic department has developed a very nice course curriculum. They have included only required courses and elective courses that students can select.
This course contains technical things which are related to computers. I always want to be a good engineer. So I have opted for this course.
There are both lectures and labs equally divided in the timetable in the week so that we can gain theoretical as well as practical knowledge. In lectures, 1 faculty teach around 60 students and in labs, 1 faculty teach 20 students so that proper focus on students can be given.
All faculties in charusat are young and filled with lots of new technology. They have completed their master's and pursuing their Ph.D. from charusat university.
Here, there is practical-based learning and method-wise teaching approach are taken.
There are basically two internal exams which contain 15 marks and assignments, attendance contains another 15 marks and at sem end there is an external exam and in my opinion almost every student score well.Annually a huge event is held that is spoural in charusat. It is conducted in January and takes around 20 days to complete. It includes sports, cultural events, indoor outdoor games, tech competitions, and many more.
There is a huge library in charusat where almost all the books are found.
Amenities like projectors, A. C. are common and are installed in every classroom.
There were a lot of sports and other activities like rangoli competitions, Dancing, singing, etc.
In charusat there is a group of students which is the google developer student club which conducts seminar and teach us various technical things and projects.

Name: UJJAWAL KUMAR
review:
The campus of our college is awesome and Quite big in terms of area. 
you must have a cycle or vehicle to roam around the full campus.
Greenery is everywhere on the campus. NO Pollution inside the campus. The infrastructure of our college is quite good but is it also improving day by day. Recently NAAC comes to our college for the College infra is quite improved a lot within some days and They accredited this time an A GRADE from a B grade in past.
Social Life is pretty awesome and you can roam around with your friends anywhere anytime. 
Our classes are fully Renovated and SMART. Lab facilities are quite good but improvement should be required especially in Electronics and Electrical Labs. We have Other Building called the R&D building for CSE AND IT branch labs. The Computer  LABS of the R&D building are best. 
Now coming to clubs yes there are plenty of clubs are there in our college depending on your interests you can join anyone. you can join more than 1 club with no restriction on the number.I choose the best branch of this college that is Computer Science and Engineering because it's none other than Placements. NO DOUBT you get what you deserve after graduating from this Premier Institute. The faculty here are highly qualified most of them are doing their Ph.D. from IITs and very good reputed collage . Student-faculty Ratio is also very good. The teaching method is ok-ok it depends Branch-wise, for CSE and IT branches most teachers are very good than other branches. 
Coming exams In every semester are two-semester exams Mid-semester followed by End -of the semester and many quizzes between them. Exams are scheduled and done at their scheduled time. To pass the exams you have to like start studying at least 1 week before the mid-semester and at least two-week before the End of the semester. For Quizzes and other stuff just before night study is enough.

Name: Krish Jain
review: Course cirriculum is really good and all the faculty has 100% international exposure and the srm ap university is really good for research. And the classes are interactive and from the 1st year itself they start preparing student for placement The tution fee  is 315000 for cse and it's quite high but it's very easy to get scholarship here, and they cost exam registration fee very semester and the hostel fee is also quite high to can find the fee structure on their website

Name: Gunda Mohana Krishna
review: College inside-college internships are also encouraged by the faculty of different branches to provide different internships as related to the departments and external or outside interceptors also eligible in the college for Minor major projects.Our college follows the JNTUA syllabus curriculum. Now the curriculum is s20 by the JNTUA in this total 4 year BTech course 6 months is a major project and in between the second and third year and 3rd and 4th year there are minor projects.

Name: Pakkurthi Aasrith Chandu
college: IIT Kharagpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITKGP]
review:
Students at IIT Kharagpur are eligible for internships from the third year of btech program and the fourth year of the dual degree program. 
The highest package at our college in the last year was 2.6 crore per annum. The average package is 26 LPA. I would like to get placed or startup after the degree.Students at IITs and NITs can avail of tuition fee waivers. To avail tuition fee waiver family income documents must be produced. If the family income is less than 5 lakh rupees, we get a two-thirds waiver and if the family income is less than one lakh we get a complete waiver.

Name: Darpan Varshney
review: The faculty members are quite good for the first year, as they are fully focused on I'm your studies and no other extracurricular activities are not permitted in the first year. So they can just focus on their studies. Felt like more school than college but it was good for the scoring in exams. And from the second year, all things are good except the attendance criteria, you have to do 75% attendance as it is mandatory to attend and sit in the examination.Yes, there are placement cells in our college which help us to get placement from 3 L/Y to 10 L/Y depending on our skill and capabilities. But mostly you have to depend on yourself for a better placement. In fields like CSE b.tech, there are a lot of job opportunities. The only thing we have to do is focus on leveling up our skills that can be required in the IT and tech industry.

Name: Anand Bera
review:
There are many extracurricular activities there so every week there's something outside of teaching makes college life really fun.I was in the music club so I enjoyed that time a lot.
Every possible book that we need including outside of teaching is available at the library with very minimal fees of 1000 per semester.
There's central AC in each of the classrooms as well as a high-tech big projector and very comfy seats there so I would like to say movie theatre type experience classroom.
Everything has its separate clubs there such as music, theatre, sports, art, and computer everything was conducted really well through each club as well as lots of exhibitions done every month.
There's every club that has its Instagram page you can find by username pdpe music,pdpe art, etc. that are completely run by students.First semester fees in university were 126500/- for studying only. And only 2-3 peoples got scholarship out of full batch of 100+ so it's really expensive to study here.
Peoples who got good marks in the GUJCET exam are eligible to pursue an entire course for free but there are lots of companies visiting there to provide campus placement there so I think its fees are worth it.
In petroleum engineering, the course placement ratio was 100% with a really attractive package but in other streams, I would say around 80% of campus placement was offered by companies.
I didn't apply for campus placement so I didn't get any jobs there because I wanted to pursue my career in the construction business.

Name: Aditya
college: Prof. Ram Meghe Institute of Technology and Research - [PRMITR]
review:
Aashayein is the annual fest and esperanza is the technical fest that occurs in the college.
Dance, singing, bridge construction, fashion show, treasure hunt, DJ night, flash mob, and traditional day-like events occur in this fest.
There is a big library which contains references according to the branch and subject although there is a departmental library for all the departments.
There is a cricket match arranged in the college which is played during the annual fest and there is no such social group in college.All the professors are Ph.D. holders and assistant professors are pursuing Ph.D. all the faculty are educated and have knowledge.
There is a semester Pattern for exams.
Each semester is of 4-6 months.
In the semester Pattern, there are practice exams and end-semester exams between these periods class tests are also conducted and exams are conducted by University as it's not an autonomous institute.

Name: Anu Verma
review:
There are various companies that offer internship and learning program and give performance certificates like TCS, TATA MOTORS, MAHINDRA, WIPRO, ORACLE, ACCENTURE, and many more.
we have to do certain projects to make it easy to get interns.There are many fests and annual functions for the students and faculty such an ongoing fest right now is Akanksha. It is one of the largest fests of the college which offers cash prizes for winning and there is a tech fest.

Name: Pavendra singh Rajput
review:
The campus was decent and disciplined. it was different from other colleges. you should have to wear college dress regularly and have to maintain attendance. there is a fine on bunking classes. you could not get time to enjoy your campus life
the college infrastructure is good have enough space.
it has a huge library with every kind of book.
there are many clubs such as gdsc, edc, dsac, etc.The college is affiliated with RGPV university and it follows the rgpv curriculum.  you should have to maintain 75%attendence and semester-wise exams are conducted. we could predict the faculty-student ratio but there are enough faculties for the students and well educated and completed their masters. and the faculties are supportive of students.

Name: Nisarg
college: Devang Patel Institute of Advance Technology and Research - [DEPSTAR]
review:

Here, there is practical-based learning and method-wise teaching approach are taken.

There is a huge library in charusat where almost all the books are found.
Amenities like projectors, A. C. are common and are installed in every classroom.
There were a lot of sports and other activities like rangoli competitions, Dancing, singing, etc.
In charusat there is a group of students which is the google developer student club which conducts seminar and teach us various technical things and projects.

Name: UJJAWAL KUMAR
review:

you must have a cycle or vehicle to roam around the full campus.

For Quizzes and other stuff just before night study is enough.

Name: Anand Bera
review:
There are many extracurricular activities there so every week there's something outside of teaching makes college life really fun.I was in the music club so I enjoyed that time a lot.

review: Annual fest we haven't seen but yeah recently we saw the tech-fest ie technova which took on a grand scale and even have wide participation from various colleges, our campus is equipped with the most renowned library which had a wide variety of books and journals, classes are also equipped with smart class, sports facilities are commendable ad in respect to various colleges in Haryana, many groups are their technical and non-technical which are funded by the institute.I chose this course according to my allotment in HSTSE, faculty of dcrust in the mechanical branch is quite good as in ratio is quite good, all the faculty members are PhD holders in their respective domains, and they teach according to the syllabus but not for other competitive exams, term exam are often held 2 sessionals or unit test and other than this one main exam after each term end and they are quite easy to pass as they teach accordingly.

Name: Jaya Sandhya
review: The fee structure is very feasible and not all expensive compared to all the other colleges. The college and alumni also offer a scholarship for merit and poor students. There will be no additional fees to secure a college seat. The additional fee is paid to the college at the joining of the first year for the purpose of the library and laboratory. In remaining all they not to ask any fee to pay to the college. In fact, they will provide a grace period of one month after joining college.The placements are very well provided in the college. The TNP cell takes care of the placement opportunities they will provide training and a platform for learning new skills. The average package will be around 5 lac for IT jobs and we can get other core companies also. Some of the companies are like Wipro, and Infosys and so many companies keep on visiting the campus for recruiting students.

Name: Harshanya Darathi
review: The placements are quite good. Eminent companies like NRL, Oil India, and Vedanta visit each year providing an annual package of about 12-16 lakhs. About 60-70 percent of students are placed each year. A student is eligible to sit in placement from the third year.Considering a state government college, the fee structure in our college is quite good. Students barely have to pay about 15K per annum as fees. Additionally, scholarships are provided by the college on a performance basis.

Name: Tannushree
review:

Name: Kovvuri Manoj Bhaskar Reddy
review: All of our professors are Ph.D. graduates and are acquainted with the latest technology. They always find paths to make us familiar with the latest technology. Name: Dipti
college: Jeevan Deep Institute of Management & Technology - [JDIMT]
review:
Programs offer a broad range of courses that cover topics such as finance, accounting, marketing, operations management, organizational behaviour, and strategy. I choose this to improve my skills for future job offers. The student-teacher ratio is good in a class two teachers teach in response to 50 students. Teaching methods need some improvement.  There is 4 semester each year exam difficulty is moderate.There are big and large companies visiting our colleges like Google, Tata and Amazon.
The highest package offered by the company is 40 lakh. The average package is 15 lakhs per annum. Approx 80 per cent of students get placement after completing the course. My plan is to become a finance assistant after completing my degree.

Name: Vaibhav Gupta
college: School of Open Learning, University of Delhi - [SOLDU]
review:
I took the course as I had to complete my graduation while I was doing a full-time job as well. There are others, especially from Commerce who take up courses from ICAI and simultaneously do graduation from SOL. So for students like myself, SOL provides great opportunities to learn and not lose valuable 3 years of life. 
All faculties are those who teach regular college students. You will be assigned a centre and will have weekly classes. Classes are not compulsory but highly recommended as you can get important information about exams. and how to score well in exams. 
Most importantly, the exams were held timely even during the pandemic. This was not so with other open universities, say IGNOU where owing to inefficient management syllabus was compiled and exams of multiple semesters were held in one go which led to the failure of numerous students and wastage of their significant years. You can visit the SOL office or contact them online to get your queries solved.Fees are quite nominal, 3800 per year. Also, they charge 600-800/- per semester as exam fees. For students belonging to reserved categories or PWD, relevant scholarships are available which you may search out on their website.

Name: Ashwini Shreedharan Pillai
college: Shree L. R. Tiwari Degree College of Arts, Commerce and Science - [SLRTDC]
review: The library is filled with books of a variety of genres. One does not have to rely on outside libraries. The classroom is not air-conditioned but is well-ventilated. The college encourages sports activities but does not have a lot of facilities, but encourages to utilise the facilities that are present. The event committee of BMS is very active and organises a lot of seminars and talks. The faculty encourages students to do internships and it is compulsory in 2nd year to complete at least one internship. The college conducts several seminars and invites several companies in the placement drives to provide its Student internship opportunities. The biggest strength of the college is its faculty. Their pedagogy is excellent and they are very supportive and friendly.

Football has its own MCL. But they don't have any playground. All the sports are held outside of the college. There is the cultural club Yuva. You may search on Instagram also they have the social clubs Rotaract and other clubs.I found my dream B.Tech in CSE that I choose in the counseling process. The student ratio is high but there are many teachers to teach us They teach us very sweetly and passionately. Some of them are my favorite teacher but yes one or two teachers are disgusting. Exams are quite easy if you take seriously your study it is. But I also don't study. but I manage it one day before the exam. Organizer helps me a lot.

Name: venky
review:
Due to covid, fests were not conducted correctly. In the month of December, our college conducted the national level technical fest in which many students from different colleges came to participate in the events we have organised.
All the types of books were available in our library. We have a big library, a digital library and many labs for the students to do their work.
Projectors, fans, ACs etc were provided. We have good facilities in the view of classrooms and labs.
Many clubs were organised by the students like the English club, dance club, etc.I have chosen computer science and engineering because I was interested in coding and I like to be a software engineer.
Our teacher-student relationship is good. They will explain each topic until the students understand the concept. The course curriculum is maintained as per industry learning and students will gain experience. Semester exams were conducted every four months along with the mid-exams.

Name: Deepankan Srivastav
college: SR Institute Of Management and Technology - [SRIMT]
review:
There are different types of fests provided here  srijan as freshers' party samyanvas farewell parties and engineer's day celebrations too
The library and books are available for the students 24/7 anyone can avail of this featureI choose the computer science and engineering branch because it gives you the knowledge of both software and hardware completely 
There is a 2:4 faculty-student ratio 
The teachers are well qualified here and educated

Name: Anjali Goswami
review: I choose biotechnology as an interdisciplinary course though we enter many sectors of life science, The teaching method of the faculty is really good they give students presentation which makes up their internal marks and helps the students in being more confident. The Faculty ratio of my college is 1:30. All teachers are Ph.D. holders.The fee structure is moderate as compared to other universities but after the university has got a grade A+++, they increased the fees of all the courses, students from outside India are given imprese benefits and the Bihar government also provides their students with DRCc scholarship.

Name: Ayushi Rawat
review:
I want to do any work within a time period so I want to learn more management skills that's why I choose MBA.
In our college, there are all faculties with Ph.D. which help to provide better skill and high-quality education and there are approx 180 students which divided into 3 sections with 60 students each.
Faculty teach through their PPTs on smart tv.
During the semester there were 3 exams held namely internal, a pre-University exam, and a final exam which help to enhance our skills.In our college there are every year fest will conduct as per the latest update our college invited King for the fest.
ITS library has all books related to your courses and also their dictionary and cultural book available for study and provide a better environment for study.
Every year our college conduct football, volleyball, table tennis, cricket, etc. games at the inter-college level and interdepartmental level.

Name: Pankhuri Gupta
college: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial College of Engineering and Management -  [SRMCM]
review:
Abhivyakti is the cultural fest that happened in Feb.
Gantavya is the technical fest that was Organized in sept.
Books are always available in the library. There is a huge library. 
The classrooms were well-organized and neat and clean. 
Sports activities also happen. Like cricket volleyball and so on. 
Students practice on a daily basis. 
Accessories are provided by the college itself. 
Literati is organized by students. 
Step cell is the dance club.
Dracula is the acting club and euphony is the singing club run by students. 
Overall my campus life was too excellent.I choose mechanical engineering because I want to learn more about machines and physical experiments which we use daily in our life. 
The faculty is too good, supportive, and knowledgeable. 
All faculty are well-qualified and knowledgeable. 
Their teaching method was too good and also there is lots of discipline in our college. 
Term exams happen every week. Surprise test organized. 
And their level was too great and surprising that you have to understand the concepts thoroughly.

Name: Navneet Vishwakarma
review: The placement record is good in my college as most students get placed and the average package is 4.5 lakh per month. The highest package was 36 Lpa for last month. Students who prepare for the gate and government exams don't sit on placement.I have chosen this course because I have been interested in CS since childhood and also I got a good rank in the UPTU exam and faculty is Ph.D. qualified and exams are held monthly of 50 marks and 100 marks exam before UT Exam.

Name: AYUSH ANAND
review:
The B.Tech CSE fees without scholarship are 120000 per semester. But I got a 38% scholarship and my fee is 74400 per semester. The placement is very good. The name of the Scholarship test is LPUNEST Exam. 
The cost of Studying with a Scholarship is not expensive as compared to another college.I Choose B.Tech CSE at LPU, Punjab. The curriculum is very good. All the faculty members are very supportive and caring and help students enhance their carrier. The faculties are Phdian. Exams are conducted in a regular manner. 
Test, mid-term, project, and term.

Name: Shivam Nagar
review: Algo is the biggest fest of the university. It basically occurs in March-August. For a library, Anyone can issue a book and even all study material is available in the library, you just need to have your Id for it. Classrooms are well furnished with AC and WIFI facilities. There are many groups for co-curricular activities and even for coding.There is no hike policy in the college. For the first semester, we need to pay 80000 then the rest is 70000 semester and the hostel including the mess is about 35000 per semester for 4 seater boys. There is no such scholarship but even it provides loans for students who want to have one.

Name: Akash kumar
review: I like mathematics most and also I've aimed to teach mathematics so I choose mathematics. Here approx 130 students are divided into two sections. Most of the teachers are PhD holding and some are about to complete them. Term exams are conducted according to schedule and it's easy to pass if you study regularly. Dr Pramod Arora sir is the hod of our department. Usha ma'am was the favourite teacher of almost all the students, she got retired and still come to the college and teach in a profitless business. There are approx 20+ teachers in our department. A few of them are:- Dr Pramod Arora, Chirag sir, Rahul Shukla sir, Tanvi ma'am, Sunil sir, Sushil sir, Bhupendra sir, Shipra ma'am, Rohit goel sir, Mukesh sir, Naveen Chandra sir etc. We have our society named kshitij. Its student union is very good and friendly they work hard to take the department to the top. Many students from batch 2019-22 cleared the IIT jam entrance exam and got admission to their dream colleges.The cost is not very expensive so middle-class students can afford it. College fees are very reasonable but you're going to costed for staying in Delhi according to your choice of staying and your suitable environment. There are many scholarships for different categories of students.

Name: Gopal kumar
review:
Teacher's day on 5 September children's day on 14 November, Independence Day, Republic Day and any other fest are celebrated in the University. Around 50000-60000, books are available in the university
Sports like kabaddi, cricket, Badminton and other sports are available at the University.
Many students group like ABVP are run by studentsBecause PATLIPUTRA University has a good environment for BSC (Mathematics) Students.
About 8000-10000 candidates are selected for BSC (Mathematics) at this University every year.
Those who have passed 12th with the science stream are eligible.
Once a year and the difficulty of the exam is moderate.

Name: Riya
review:
I chose this course because I want to. This is that course which overcomes the fear of shyness. It upgrades your communication skills. You can learn about cameras which I am very fond of. So I want to employ by a company on a big level in the field of PR that's why I choose this course. I have an interest in this course as well.
The faculty is top-notch. Everyone is so supportive, so kind, and so educated. Faculties are soo good at teaching us. They are so fun-loving and very serious about their student's careers. And the student ratio is good enough.
Faculty qualification is soo outstanding. Some are Radio jockeys, and news channels, some are directors and producers in high-level companies. So they are well educated and well employed. The teaching method is also good. Many of them reached us from PPTs in class. So many activities were to be done in class and assignments would be given to you which you enjoy for sure.
Once every 6 months. No difficulties at all if u are well prepared.Since I have been studying here for 3 years. No fest at all was conducted. In 2021, kalamanthan (Our college's curricular function name) is conducted online because of corona. Further, no fest was conducted. Recently, They conducted a small party which is not that enjoyable.
Yes, books and journals, newspapers, and magazines are available in the library.
Classrooms are made up so beautifully. They have smart boards, well air-conditioned, ventilated rooms.
No sports but yes theatre activity is there. Whenever is kalamantan occurred, students will go to a dance club, music, theatre, photography, short films, and clubs. And yes along with that, our college gave us a visit to ndtv news channel and many more agencies. Students make short films for college and short films are sent forward for competitions.
No websites etc run by students. College-owned themselves.

Name: harshit garg
college: MNNIT Allahabad - Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology - [MNNIT]
review: motilal nehru national institute of technology popularly known as mnnit Allahabad is quite famous for its placements. Students are eligible for internships from the fifth semester. and hundreds of companies visit this college and almost all students get a good placement depending on his/her skillalthough the fee is very high you can avail of a lot of scholarships here depending on your academics and family income as well. if your family income is less than 8LAKHS but greater than 5LAKHS you will get two third waiver on your fee and if it is less than 1LAKHS you will get a 100% fee waiver

Name: Tannushree
review:
The fee structure is quite nominal. However, no scholarship or financial assistance is provided. It might be provided to other category students. 
Regarding campus placements, the recruitment drive has already begun and they offer various stipends for internships and CTC for jobs depending on the companies. There are few job offers that provide excellent packages however most are just average.The infrastructure is average. The classrooms are of apt sizes, but there could be more facilities too. However sufficient is provided. Water coolers, GCR, BCR etc. are there too. 
Talking about extracurriculars, our college is renowned for that only. We have around 36 societies. Our annual Cultural fest Tatva is conducted on the Grand level. Also, there are many departmental fests too.

Name: Kovvuri Manoj Bhaskar Reddy
review: All of our professors are Ph.D. graduates and are acquainted with the latest technology. They always find paths to make us familiar with the latest technology. They encourage us in each step of ours. The curriculum is industrial-related and mostly focuses on the subjects that are required during the time of placements. The semester exams are quite good if we are well planned. They aim to test our basic understanding about the subject and test our understanding capability. The pass percentage is nearly 80 as far as I am concerned.We have well-sized classrooms with very high SEED Wi-Fi of min 200 Mbps and A good library with good number of books. Hostels looks so good with a well-maintained room of 4,5,3,2 shared rooms according to our budget and food is like okay but compared to other colleges it's better, we have a Hospital in hostel with a doctor and there 5 to 6 canteens, then coming to sports and games we have cricket, basketball, Football, badminton with some indoor games and we have a gym for both girls and boys separately.

Name: NABH GAUTAM
review:
Campus life is amazing! It's one of the most beautiful campuses of sibm. Faculty, as well as staff, is very supportive here. Faculty generally use smart classes to teach students. 
College has a huge playground for cricket, and football as well as a basketball court and a tennis court. The college also provides gym facilities to the student Hostels were inside the CampusI have done btech, so I want to gain business knowledge so that I can do good business in future. Being a technical guy it's easy how things work.
The faculty on the campus are superb! And well in knowledge. They also motivate students for extra curricular activities. We have a semester system here. And the difficulty depends on your study.

Name: prathmesh pandey
college: Vidyavardhini's College of Engineering and Technology - [VCET]
review: The fee structure is kind of high regards the course but it does seem worthwhile after being in college and scholarships are also very useful for students who can avail so. There are many scholarships for ebc, ews, tfws , sc, St etcThe curriculum is good. the faculties are very engaging they help a lot when needed many of the faculties personally help in problem-solving and relieving stress. Cons can be of some professors that they are shortly tempered

Name: Ujjwal Pandey
review:
After 3rd year we are eligible for the placement allocations provided by the university.
Companies like Tata, Cisco, Wipro, Oracle, Infosys, and many more.
From the entire CSE branch, last year's highest placement was around 13 lac and avg was around 7 lac.
Average package 6LPA.

The College is well provided with the library and digital library from IIT Kharagpur
many sports happen in college like MSL MCL MBL MVL etc.

Name: Bindusmita Das
college: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research - [IISER]
review:
For each new batch, there is a fee hike of 10% from the previous batch, which is fine as per national standards. But when we see it in numbers, It feels very high. When this continues, people will feel extreme difficulties affording the fees in the next 10 years. Being Lower middle class financially, It's difficult for us too.
There are scholarships and fee waivers but most people won't be able to avail of them. The tuition fee waiver is only for those belongings to SC/ST. KVPY provides a monthly stipend for its scholars which is around 5-7000 per month but I don't think there are any KVPY scholars in my class. There is another scholarship scheme by DST called INSPIRE that provides 5000 per month to very few students. The cutoff for INSPIRE goes around 96-97% for the CBSE board and similar for other boards. Also, you won't be eligible for INSPIRE if you are a dropper. Of the 200 students in my class, there are around 10-11 INSPIRE scholars. 
There is no Fee waiver for economically weak people.I chose this college without planning as I couldn't get a desired seat in IIT. But I think it was for good. The course is a wonderful primer on the path of becoming a scientist.
Compared to other colleges, IISER Berhampur has a quite good faculty: student ratio. But most of them are pretty good as people and as teachers. We manage to conduct all classes without fail. But I'd like to see an increase in the number so that the research area can be broadened.
The faculty here have all completed their Ph.D. and postdoc and all have some good prior experience in research and teaching. I like most of the instructors that have taught me except for a few one or two. 
The exam schedule is given right with the calendar release of each semester before the semester starts. Sometimes there might be changes in the schedule but we are informed around 2-3 weeks earlier in that case. Exams are not hard to pass if you attend classes and study sincerely. Questions are not asked beyond the concepts being taught.

Name: BISHAL SAHA
review:

Name: VARA PRASAD
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: The course curriculum is manageable and the faculty members are top of this country I chose this course because it has many advantages in the field of biology and science and also the packages are good the faculty-student ratio can be improved all the faculty have PhDs abroad institutes and they teach excellent and term exams are approximately one and half month each and they are in moderate to difficult level to writeThe annual fest is rendezvous and the tech fest is tryst these are one of the biggest college fests in India with an annual footfall of 50000 students and these are conducted in the month of march there are many books and one can avail of these books for free. Name: Monu Prajapat
college: Arya College of Engineering and IT - [ACEIT]
review:

Name: Maddukuri jetendra pavan sai
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: Firstly the college I am studying is one of the top colleges in India, so definitely the faculty are qualified and have good knowledge about the subject they teach, mostly because they do experiments(they have practical knowledge too).1 teacher teaches around 200 students but there are other teachers called T.As(Teaching Associates), to which we could confess our doubts. If you are good at any sport you can play and represent your hostel in a sports tournament called G.C. in which all hostels participate in the trophy. BSW is the social group that is run by students

Name: Kanchan Dixit
review:
College fees are 1,14,000rs for each year for consecutive 4 years.
If you choose the hostel then the hostel will charge only 12,000rs for one year
Our college provides scholarships for all sc st and OBC students under the scheme of the state government and for general category students there is Madhavi chhatra yojna for which you have at least 85% in 12th if you are cbse student and at least 75% if you are mp board students.This is humanitarian work.

Name: Nirmal
college: Vallurupalli Nageswara Rao Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [VNR VJIET]

Name: Debi Prasad Jena

review: I chose B.Com hons because I wanted to get the best placements by enrolling myself in a professional course and getting access to the best learning environment that is valid for the corporate world. review:

 Students can start looking for placement from 6th semester or third year.

Name: Navoneel Chatterjee
review:
MBBS is a very prestigious course,which provides you with a degree and license to practise anywhere in the county as a physician,and also opportunities to presure higher post graduate degrees.
Faculty student ratio is variable from dept. to dept. ranging from 1:12 to 1:20
Faculties are highly qualified,most of them having MBBS,MD/MS/DNB(in one or multiple subjects)and even PhD.
Teaching method is very good,student friendly,AC lecture theatre,Projectors,individual dept. and laboratories,library,examination hall everything is there.
Moreover most of the teachers are approachable and available for the students,they are very helpful.
Mostly offline classes are conducted.
There are 3 semesters and one final university exam in a year,total four exams,almost one in two to three months.
Qualifying marks is 50% in both theory and practical,and is a little difficult to pass to be honest,one has to study regularly to pass the exams.Life is a balance between huge syllabus and exam pressure in one hand and fun with friends and so much things on the other.
Fest is known as 'BEATS' and usually conducted in the month of October having a duration of 3 days and so many fun activities.
All sorts of books of Indian and International authors,journals,and a AC reading room is available in the library,book can also be borrowed for some time period.
Classrooms are quipped with AC,Projection screen,more than sufficient lights,fans,and high quality sound system,also Non AC lecture halls are very well ventilated.
Lots of extra carricular acitivities are there on various important days like 15th Aug,26th Jan,Holi,Pujas,X Mas,Eid etc.
There is a student union in the college.

Many students work outside of college because internships are not available.

Name: Rishika Ranjan
review: If you are in any college of Delhi University which is on the north campus, you are living, competing, and activities your college life at its best. The annual fest of Indraprastha College for Wo, Delhi University is named as SHRUTI. It is conducted in the month of March every year. The fest is on two days. Various quizzes and gas are held. The students from other colleges can also participate and earn good prizes and certificates. The infrastructure of my college is fully furnished with all the facilities whether it's the benches or the technologies. It is one of the most beautiful colleges. Many students also come through sports quota, if they are good players in any specific sports. You can participate in inter-college. There is NSS as well. But NCC is not there. There are around more than 20 societies like women development cell society, the Mridang society for Indian classical dance, Afroza for Western dance, the debating society, and a lot more. The library is big but you won't find all the books.The BA Program Department of Indraprastha College compared to other Delhi University colleges is relatively very good. I choose this course because I have two options to do a master's I am doing a bachelor's in Political science and Economics, and now I have two choices either to do a master's in economics or political science. If you are a UPSC aspirant. This course is the best. The placement cell of our college always comes up with good internships even for the BA Program students. The faculties are nice but not all of them. There is a need to bring even more good faculties. Faculties are postgraduates and obviously cleared Net Jrfs, some faculties are researchers, and some are even doing Ph.D. The class strength is 50-last year's qu60. There are six semesters. The course is for three years. So, every year two semesters are held at the interval of six months. It is not very difficult, I would say. The paper is moderate. Just take a review of the lestion papers.

Name: Rishabh
review: Chandigarh University provides a good amount of scholarships. But for maintaining a scholarship to have to maintain a 7.5 CGPA. For that, you have to study hard. Because CU's exams are of unexpected nature. For example, in the biology exam, they asked the question: define the term biology. I am just giving an example the whole biology exam has such types of questions from the units that have important topics such as meiosis, Mitosis, Mendel laws and many more.If I talk about campus life, it is nice. You will be having at least one event every month. They also have lots of clubs. Infrastructure is good but according to them they just have space to fill students but I don't think they can handle them.

Name: Venkata Jyothendra Tamarani
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: There are only two major fests conducted on campus one is the technical fest and the other is the cultural fest. The technical fest(AARUSH) is held in the odd semester of every year and the cultural fest (MILAN)is held in the even semester in which both are paid. There are plenty of books available in the library. All the first-year classrooms are great and from 2nd-year classrooms won't have an A/C facility. Sports are encouraged for those who have both interests and talent.In my point of view the fees are not at all relatable though the University has a good infrastructure the fees are not at all fair. Even the new batches may have more fees in upcoming years. University provides scholarships that require good marks/rank on the entrance test or a good score in academics.

review:
I choose BBA because I have an interest in knowing about business techniques.. knowing about the market what's the trend going on what customer demand and many more ..  Almost my faculty are PhD. They are well educated from well-reputed colleges and universities...and the strength of my class is 60

 For scoring good marks there is a well-mentioned library for students to study without any disturbance... And score high marks in exams.

review: VIT has a good social environment. Every month an event with regards to our carrier. Yearly once there will be a sports event and we will get cash prizes. Name: Rishika Ranjan
review: If you are in any college of Delhi University which is on the north campus, you are living, competing, and activities your college life at its best. The annual fest of Indraprastha College for Wo, Delhi University is named as SHRUTI. It is conducted in the month of March every year. The fest is on two days. Various quizzes and gas are held. The students from other colleges can also participate and earn good prizes and certificates. The infrastructure of my college is fully furnished with all the facilities whether it's the benches or the technologies. It is one of the most beautiful colleges. Many students also come through sports quota, if they are good players in any specific sports. You can participate in inter-college. There is NSS as well. But NCC is not there. There are around more than 20 societies like women development cell society, the Mridang society for Indian classical dance, Afroza for Western dance, the debating society, and a lot more. The library is big but you won't find all the books.The BA Program Department of Indraprastha College compared to other Delhi University colleges is relatively very good. I choose this course because I have two options to do a master's I am doing a bachelor's in Political science and Economics, and now I have two choices either to do a master's in economics or political science. If you are a UPSC aspirant. This course is the best. The placement cell of our college always comes up with good internships even for the BA Program students. The faculties are nice but not all of them. There is a need to bring even more good faculties. Faculties are postgraduates and obviously cleared Net Jrfs, some faculties are researchers, and some are even doing Ph.D. The class strength is 50-last year's qu60. There are six semesters. The course is for three years. So, every year two semesters are held at the interval of six months. It is not very difficult, I would say. The paper is moderate. Just take a review of the lestion papers.

Infrastructure is good but according to them they just have space to fill students but I don't think they can handle them.

Name: Venkata Jyothendra Tamarani
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: There are only two major fests conducted on campus one is the technical fest and the other is the cultural fest. college: Charotar University of Science and Technology - [CHARUSAT]

college: Charotar University of Science and Technology - [CHARUSAT]

Name: Mohit thakur

Name: Marreddy upender reddy
college: Gokaraju Rangaraju Institute of Engineering and Technology -  [GRIET]

Name: Dipsekhar Maity
review: Many students have been placed in various reputed companies. The university had a dedicated placement cell which helped students with job opportunities. The placement cell also prepares students for interviews. About 99% of students get placed in our courses. Name: Divyansh Gupta
review:
The college provides Various courses in the medical field.

Study cost estimation to 30 lacs but it is worth if one not interested to give the entrance exam again.

Name: Jenil Moradiya

Name: Student (Anonymous)

review: The course curriculum works in a such way that a student can grab quite an amount of knowledge from the scrap to an advanced level, it helps a person to take slow steps but in an incremental manner. Name: Pratap Singh
college: IIT BHU - Indian Institute of Technology
review: There is a cultural fest Kashiyatra, a tech fest TechNex and a sports fest Spardha every year. All these events are very big and happening. Name: Anuj lowanshi

Name: Chetan Yadav

Name: Bevara Sandhya Gayatri

 80% of the students were placed. my plan was to get into a Software company.Once every year in the month of January, we have Annual fest names uvatarang. Name: Sarthak Khaiwal
review: College life entirely depends on what you do with your life in college. LPU will give you all you want for a successful career and the skills thereof. But won't give you enough time to waste on non-productive and unnecessary things. You get tons of organizations to join, and a large number of events to participate in, organist, and enjoy. A large number of leisurely places, be it the central vista, Mall or playgrounds or gyms or swimming pools or indoor stadiums or skating rinks, or nets to practice. But it does not compromise in any case with your safety, your studies, your skill attainment, your employability, and finally your placements. Whatever the duration of your program, your campus life will depend on what YOU do with it. If you are sincere about your studies or any other activity, it will be great. The university charges a fee from your parents to enable a great career for you, and that's what LPU does best.Usually, the university collaborates with various reputed companies to offer internships to its students. Some of the companies that have offered internships in the past include Amazon, Google, Microsoft, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, etc. The roles offered under internships may vary depending on the company's requirements and project needs. During the internships, students get to work on real-life projects that help them gain practical experience and industry exposure. The projects assigned to the students are carefully designed to match their skill set and learning objectives. The internships usually come with a stipend, and the amount may vary depending on the company and the duration of the internship. The internship opportunities provided by Lovely Professional University help students to develop their skills and get hands-on experience that can boost their career prospects.

It's a good fest with fairly famous celebrities joining ( not as famous as guests in tier 1-2 colleges ). The library consists of mostly course-related books which can be issued with a library card.
The college offers a good space for sports and extracurricular activities on campus. review:
Life on the campus is pretty chill. You have ample freedom. 
The crowd here is nice, and everyone is grounded and friendly. You will have a memorable social life here. 
The classrooms and labs are decent. The infrastructure is beautiful.
Jaipur is an amazing city with lots and lots of things, activities, and food, but the campus is 20km away from the city. 2 buses go from the college to the city but are always overcrowded, so you must come much in advance to get a seat.

Being part of them is always fun and you learn things and manage things and make friends along the way.The course curriculum is bery similar to IITs. Faculty student ratio could be better. Every semester has mid sem and ends sem exams and several quizzes along the way and all are evaluated for grading. 
Getting a good CGPA is very tough here as teachers are strict in giving marks.

Students become eligible for campus placements from the seventh semester of their B.Tech program, and the placement cell provides ample training and guidance to prepare them for the recruitment process.

Name: Saurabh Kumar
review:
As I already discussed earlier, the school of engineering is too new( established in 2018 ).
Still, the placement of the first two batches is pretty good, with an average package of 8 LPA.
The highest package offered was 16LPA.

Name: Lokesh Rathi
review:

 Rs 1200 as exam fees per semester( in total there are 8 semesters)
Rs 5000 for uniform and bag.

Rs 2700 for registration (with respect to the first year)
There are many clubs, and for almost every club, you have to pay if you want to join. Yes, but they don't force you, the seniors just insist you join, and the college authorities have nothing to do with it.
 After covid, forget about good internships for now. Yes maybe our batch could get it, but seniors didn't get many internship opportunities on campus. Those who have got, it applied it off-campus. But those students are few in number.

About scholarships, you can apply for the swami Vivekananda scholarship, if your family income lies in their criteriaOur annual Tech fest is known as PARIDHI. There are many books, but that does not sufficiently get the point into a note about the increase in the number of intakes. There are many clubs run by students

Name: Ayush Kumar
review: Among various courses for UG, PG and Research Level, at UG there are two courses offered; B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) and B.B.A., LL.B. (Hons.). If you have a commerce background in the intermediate examination and want to make a career in Corporate Sector, you can opt for B.B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) course. And, if you are inclined towards the judiciary, UPSC or any other competitive examination, you can opt for B.A., LL.B. (Hons.) program. A semester is usually 4 months including holidays. Two exams are conducted, i.e., Mid Semester and End Semester Exams in a semester of 15 Marks and 60 Marks respectively. Rest marks are 5 Marks for Attendance, and 20 for Project+ Presentation.The fee includes tuition fees, electricity, mess fee, hostel fee, library charges, examination fees, etc. The annual fee is taken at once i.e., fees are collected annually and not semester-wise. Furthermore, every year, there is an increment in the same. However, there is no fixed rate at which it increases, but usually, it increases every year by 5K to 7K for all the batches.

review: The social life at the campus is pretty good there are some sports facilities and gardens canteens and multiple places to go and chill with friends the seniors here are very helpful and don't be afraid of being ragged I haven't seen much ragging since I am here Many sports are there like football, basketball, cricket, kho kho, table tennis, badminton courts etc.The course curriculum is good enough as after all what matters is this college is serious about its students getting placed, so it least matters that how is the course or what faculty members however if you still want a review, the course is good enough and most of the faculty members are also pretty good only some will always there for causing trouble.

Name: Utsav Jaiswal
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
MILAN is an annual fest that is conducted in a huge manner here in around Feb/March. Recently international DJs and actor Nani appeared on the show and it was a huge budget fest. Similarly, Aaruush is a national-level techno-management fest of SRMIST, Kattankulathur. It is one of a kind because it comprises of multi-faceted events ranging from technical to management and sports. Events generally consist of competitions, workshops, speeches by eminent people, etc. It is usually done in October. 
The UB building classrooms are well occupied with foam chairs and joint desks, ACs, and free Wifi but theres no AC case only in Techpark where most of the classes are done. Similarly getting elevators to get to the 11th and 12th floors where your classes are, won't be so easy. It's usually a climb. There are many sports and ECAs done here like hostel level, into college and intercollege teams. DSA is a club here at SRM which holds many domains like data science, web development, music. literature.I chose CSE because it was my subject of interest from the beginning. The student-to-faculty ratio at SRMIST is fairly good as there are a lot of faculties for every domain in the college. However, fitting 70+ students in a class isn't really effective when there's just a single teacher teaching. The class gets out of control quite a few times.
The faculties that teach here are mostly Ph.D. graduates if not just Masters' Degree holders. Their teaching methods are modern and they often use ppt and written notes in order to explain the subject matter the best they can. Although there's just a one-semester term exam, we have Cycle Tests for every subject after every 1-2 unit is completed. They're usually 50-mark tests that account for 7.5 out of the 60 marks of internal evaluation. Passing CTs is very easy but in order to score solid marks, one must push himself a bit forward and work a little hard. The teachers usually don't check the CT paper very strictly, at least in my case.

Name: Anubhav Rawat
college: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology - [DCRUST]
review:
Annual Cultural Fest 'Rhythm' is conducted and various other cultural fest are organized. However, due to Covid, the annual cultural fest has not been organized in the recent past but it will be organized in the year 2023. Annual Technical Fest Technova was organized in 2022. 
Saraswati Library provides all the required books that one may need during their course journey. There are various other novels, research papers, magazines, and newspapers available in the library.
The classrooms have all the basic facilities, including air conditioners. There are smart classrooms as well.
There are great sports facilities at the University. There is the University Team for every sport and there are fields for all the sports.
There are many cultural and technical societies, for instance, the Musical Society ' Goonj', the dramatics society ' Jzaa' and 'Skaa', Entrepreneurship Cell, the Robotics society 'Thinkbots', and Western and Traditional Folk Dance Groups.The fess is quite low, thus it is economical and feasible for a middle-class student to pursue higher education in the institute without much problem, Yeah there are several scholarships as well, various category scholarships as well 10 % topper scholarship in which the 10% topper of each semester are given scholarships.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
The main cultural fest is called Milan and is really impressive. The guests are very popular and the event itself is well-planned. Furthermore, students from other colleges may also attend it. This event is organized by the Directorate of Student Affairs
The tech fest is called Aarush, and while it isn't as glamorous, it is well worth attending. You'll have a lot of fun and gain a lot of experience from experts in the field. This event is held by the Directorate of Alumni Affairs
The library is huge. It will fulfil all your academic needs, and there's also an online database you can access. 
The classrooms are large and well equipped with everything professors need....projector screens, boards plug points etc. The ventilation is also top-notch.
The extracurricular amenities are also large in number and can accommodate a lot of people simultaneously.I opted for Computer Science and Engineering due to the opportunities the course gives you. Each class has around 72 students but this number is reduced to 60 in the consequent years. The faculty are all very knowledgeable and approachable, and you can approach your Faculty Advisor for any issue; be it attendance, misplaced ID cards, opportunities, guidance etc. Your FA will also keep you informed on upcoming events and competitions.
The exams are also conducted periodically, you have 3 cycle tests and one university theory examination per sem. The CTs and other lab experiments account for 60% of your overall grade while the UTE is worth 40% of your grade. If you study periodically, you should be able to perform well on all tests.

Name: Utsav Jaiswal
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review:
MILAN is an annual fest that is conducted in a huge manner here in around Feb/March. Recently international DJs and actor Nani appeared on the show and it was a huge budget fest. Similarly, Aaruush is a national-level techno-management fest of SRMIST, Kattankulathur. It is one of a kind because it comprises of multi-faceted events ranging from technical to management and sports. Events generally consist of competitions, workshops, speeches by eminent people, etc. It is usually done in October. 
The UB building classrooms are well occupied with foam chairs and joint desks, ACs, and free Wifi but theres no AC case only in Techpark where most of the classes are done. Similarly getting elevators to get to the 11th and 12th floors where your classes are, won't be so easy. It's usually a climb. There are many sports and ECAs done here like hostel level, into college and intercollege teams. DSA is a club here at SRM which holds many domains like data science, web development, music. literature.I chose CSE because it was my subject of interest from the beginning. The student-to-faculty ratio at SRMIST is fairly good as there are a lot of faculties for every domain in the college. However, fitting 70+ students in a class isn't really effective when there's just a single teacher teaching. The class gets out of control quite a few times.
The faculties that teach here are mostly Ph.D. graduates if not just Masters' Degree holders. Their teaching methods are modern and they often use ppt and written notes in order to explain the subject matter the best they can. Although there's just a one-semester term exam, we have Cycle Tests for every subject after every 1-2 unit is completed. They're usually 50-mark tests that account for 7.5 out of the 60 marks of internal evaluation. Passing CTs is very easy but in order to score solid marks, one must push himself a bit forward and work a little hard. The teachers usually don't check the CT paper very strictly, at least in my case.
