examinations were held timely, and there are 2 sessionals 1 pre-university and a final University Paper held in 1 semester.The cost for study at my college is not much, the cost per year is approx 110000. if you got any benefits from special reservations you will get the course free of cost you don't have to pay any academic fees for all four years.
scholarships are also given by the University and Govt. also.
jobs and internship opportunities are also good. more than 90% of students are got placed in campus recruitment.

Name: SRI RAKSHAGA S R
review: The fees were minimal compared to other colleges inside my city and Agni College guided me in every way possible to make my fees minimal and get me the placement and job. Many companies arrive in Placement and Technical Placement  Training given at Agni College of Technology is very disciplined.I experience very good campus life as my friends and teachers are very much supportive of me. We have many clubs for extracurricular activities, and many programs conducted by the college to encourage the talents of students.

Name: JAGRATI MEHRA
review: It depends on the company profile if any student from any semester year is eligible to sit in placement then the university has not had any issue. There has job fair recently, many jobs were offered to many students. There was vikalp foundation 2.14 LPA, Azim Premji Foundation 4LPA, TCS 7.5 LPA and many companies come. In the education department, most of the students get teaching jobs offered by the government.  For other departments, there are fewer placements but more placements in professional courses. They get a minimum of 6-7LPA. I am searching for Job, I am already selected by viklap foundation, and interviewed by azim premji foundation. If I am selected then I take it otherwise I have qualified for REET and CTET and planning to get govt or other jobs in education. In Present, I am preparing for MPSET, RJSET and NET so that I can be an assistant Professor.There are many activities and festivals going through the year. Each department will organize a fest which represents their department for Example recently (Feb 2023) "Entrepreneur in Action" was 3 days Festival.  3 march is always celebrated as the foundation day of CURaj. There is a central library in Curaj which is known as the biggest library in Rajasthan. There are 2-3 magazines printed named Astitva, Udaan and Nav Drishti (Hindi Magzine). there are Projectors in every classroom. 2 Smart high-tech Classes and a High tech Auditorium in each department. There are many social clubs for dance, drama, music, book, and environment. There is an official account of curaj on Instagram, twitter and Facebook. There is an unofficial account (run by students) on Instagram named Curaj_tak (shhh which will give you inside news)

Name: Aditya chaladan
review: There is lakshya the tech-fest which is conducted once in two years. Now a new tech fest is being conducted by all the clubs of the college named Endora. There is a common library and a branch library for mechanical engineering students. The classroom is well-equipped with projectors and a Samsung flip tv. There are lots of sports and a Gymnasium inside the campus.Students fom third year is eligible  for campus placement. But mainly the placement comes for the final year students. Mostly IT companies  are offering jobs. Cognizant, L&T, MOZILOR are some of the company in which students have been places. They offers a pay scale of 4 lakhs and 6lakhs per annum. In the batch, a total of 9 students have got placement.

Name: TARUN S
review: I have a wonderful life at agni college of technology. the placement in agni college of technology is very good for students who are studying here coz there will get confirmed placement in their core for a decent package. the placement cell is working hard to make the students placed in companies.There are more than 100 companies that are welcoming to take the students for the best packages and the internship is too good in this college. the students should get an internship on their own through many platforms and the staff will help students with their internship.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I choose this course to look forward in management and i am interested in finance   here college has huge campus and there are lot of faculty members  more than 100 above  and 3000+ students which is good  qualification of faculty member is atleast graduation and good in communication teaching method is very good  exams very helded in perfect date and it's easy to pass by their teaching methodThe fees structure for bba is 25000 and we may get scholarship depend upon caste percentage and other benefits  scholarship likes ssp,Sir C.V. Raman Scholarship ,Scholarship to Physically Handicapped students,Other Backward Class Scholarship

Name: Aniket kumar
college: Rashtrakavi Ramdhari Singh Dinkar College of Engineering - [RRSDCE]
review:
After the 6th-semester students become eligible for campus placement.
Campus placements are not that good right now.
Our university conducts pool campus placement at Patna in which students of every government college in Bihar come there. 
Around 20 percent of students get placed every year.
The training and placement cell is working very hard for bringing companies on board.I chose this course as I felt inclined towards computer science, I had a keen interest in coding as I had experience coding in school. As we know the IT industry is booming, it provides lots of jobs as well as to start something of yourself.
The faculty of our college is very much qualified, they are well experienced. Some of them lack the teaching methodology.

Name: Mahima Sree
review: From 2nd year we have training programs like programming languages, aptitude, etc. And from 3 rd year, we have placement training, students will be placed from 3 rd year. Students will attend drive form 6th sem. Many companies provide job opportunities and internships to our students.Many top companies like Tcs, hcl, Infosys, etc provide paid internships and job opportunities for students. Students are placed with high salary packs. Teachers will guide students in their projects and all other activities this will help students get placed without any difficulties.

Name: Tejas Patil
college: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering & Technology - [ADCET]
review:
It is very costly and not worth the fees Because of the teaching. But the facilities are great. They give uniforms, a bag, and study materials for the stationary fees.
By applying for a scholarship you can pay 75000 of 120000 by EBC and for the caste, it's lower.Campus Life is good in this college but it requires extra fees for the sports clubs and to enjoy the sports campus facilities. The events held in this college are good if not great. There are various clubs run by students that you can enjoy by applying.

Name: Abhishek Singh
review: Since the past two years, there has not been any hike in fees and it is the same as in 2020. The cost to study in Noida is a bit higher as all housing and lodging are expensive. The students having family incomes less than 2 lakhs avail of government scholarships.After 6th-semester students become eligible for package placements. This year the highest package is 34 lakhs and the average package is around 6 lakhs. TCS and Infosys are the major recruiters. Around 70-80 percent of students get placed here.

Name: Nikhil
review: The course is very limited and up to the mark. The faculty is very educated and humble. All are very cooperative and loving. They teach very well, their motive is to clear the concepts only. All are very educated and PhD holders.The fee structure is the same as of other colleges and they provide scholarships too. They have many programs for scholarships and the university also helps students with fee submissions if any student faces a financial problem.

Name: Lalkot Sumaiya Azeem
review: I chose this course as I was very interested in the software field. The faculty is also excellent at teaching and clearing our doubts about subjects.  We have exams semester-wise every 5 or 6 months. Exams pattern is moderate so that there is no difficulty in writing.Campus placements at this college are excellent.  Every student gets placed in the campus placements itself. The average package is 6LPA. Students get placed from 3rd year itself. The highest package is 44LPA. My plan is to get placed in a top MNC.

Name: Chaithra G P
review: Udbhav is the annual feast that happens in our college, and we also have our kannada rajyotsava fest at the end of the odd semester. Our college has a vast library facility, and most of the classrooms are well equipped with projectors and stuff. We have a deca office which looks after the cultural stuff. And for the sports and all, we have good playground facilities and also have annual sports. We have a lot of technical teams for race car building,  aircraft building and drones as well Names of them are quatlas,  velocita,  stire racing, Editha, and Volante. All these clubs are run by students and for the students.Mechanical is a well-known branch in Ramaiah and also it has good placement which is the reason I joined this branch. Ramaiah has good strength of faculty. All faculty are highly qualified but the teaching methodology is not good for all the faculty, most of them are good. Due to admission during covid we won't get enough time for our exam preparation and the difficulty level of the paper is medium it's not too easy nor too difficult.

Name: Shashikant Tripathi
college: Institute of Engineering and Rural Technology - [IERT]
review: Many fests are organized in this college such as technovation, Udbhav, and Aikyam. And Aktu also offer sports feast to each college which are affiliated with them. High-class libraries are also available in this college.From 6th sem companies are starting hiring the student for jobs. companies such as Adani, ACC, IBM, Infosys, etc took part in campus selection. The highest package of this session in 30 lahks and avg package is 6lpa.

Name: AAYUSH THAKKAR
college: Charotar University of Science and Technology - [CHARUSAT]
review: You get eligible for placements after they come into the 7th sem. Companies like TCS, MEDITAB, E-INFOCHIPS, CREST, WIPRO etc are the major recruiters. More than 100 companies visit the campus every year. Last academic year highest package was 18LPA and the average package was 5LPA. Above 90% of the students applying for placements get a good placement from the campus.The infrastructure is fantastic the whole campus is around 140 acres with various amenities, sports grounds, and indoor sports. Every class has projectors, ACs, and well-lighted classrooms. And libraries are like an ocean of books you can get books related to every field in the library.

Name: Raju Kumar Thakur
review:
You can assume that every course fees are same
Of Rs 2.20 lakh for the first year.
Yes, University provides scholarships for students who had a family income less than from benchmark mark of the rupee just they have to show valid documents that show their eligibility to grant scholarships.
On campus, you could have lots of opportunities to grab internships and also gets a chance to work with startupsYes, you will experience a very good life on the campus as talking about social life you will interact with International students and also the student from the master's background and from the design background there are lots of students to talk to elaborate your skills. 
 one of the most famous  annual fests is engifest and recently we had a literature and film fest we called it YUVAAN23

Name: Mohnish Dutt
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Fees per semester are nearly 1.2 lakhs for the general category whose family income is more than 5 lakhs. And for general category students with a family income between 1 to 5 lakhs and all OBC students get a remission of 2/3 of tuition fees which are 1 lakh per semester. And whose family income is less than 1 lakh will get full remission of tuition fees and a 100 per cent tuition fee waiver for sc /st / pwd students. 
And there are lots of scholarship here for students.Life on campus is fun but academics here at IITK are more difficult than at other IITs. Fests time is too much enjoyable there is a total of 3 fests but something keeps going on campus for a year. Lecture Hall has AC and a lot of places on campus to study. Sports and other facilities are great and there are too many clubs, societies, and teams run by the student body to discover and live their passion.

Name: Raj Vardhan
review:
I choose the course because I love mathematics, there are daily basis classes in the university 5 subjects are changeable every semester. The faculty is great they are well experienced most of the teachers had the PhDs in their respective fields. There are 2 types of exams seasonal and semester. There are 2 seasonal exams every 2-month gap and then semester if you study you can qualify for any exam. There is no toughness of the exam it depends upon the students.Life at the campus is pretty good. There is an annual fest called Utkarsh and tech Fiesta conducted in the whole University students showcase their talent. There 70 per cent of books available in the library are related to the course.
There will be no scope for sports in this university because seniors have made their own kingdom and don't allow anyone to let them play the juniors. 
There are socially active groups like AAINA.
BBD PARIVAR

Name: MANOJ NAGA SAI SANKA
college: Kakinada Institute of Engineering and Technology  -[KIET]
review: At present total course fee for the institution is covered under fee reimbursement by the Andhra Pradesh government and there will be a university fee of up to 5000rs per year. Apart from that there will be a fee for the college hostel and college transport that varies based on the distance and area. There will be no scholarships but we can earn while studying by teaching diplomas and lower standard students and we can also work as volunteers for college and can get paid. I got an offer letter from Inmovidu technologies and waiting for the onboarding.There will be no social and entertainment fests in the college, not even a single one, don't know about the future but in the last 4 years since I joined no fest has been conducted. Some technical events will be conducted on emerging technologies. We have a huge library that contains almost every book regarding the courses available In college. Sports are like falling stars in our college and the NCC and NSS are strictly followed, which can be a benefit to students.

college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]

Annual fest - Antaragni in October, Tech fest - techkriti in March. 
Almost all curriculum books are available in the library.
All classrooms have AC and projectors
One of the best sports infrastructures in our college. Almost all sports are played

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: The annual tech fest of KIIT is known as the KIIT FEST and is very popular. Every year big artists from all around the country visit our campus to perform. There are also many tech workshops held and extracurricular activities and cultural night programs during the fest. KIIT FEST is generally held from December to February. The KIIT Central Library has world-renowned collection of journals and books. It has more than 100000+ books and 40000+ journals. The classrooms are modern and equipped with all the required amenities to serve the students. Classrooms have screens, projectors, air conditioners, and whiteboards. KIIT is well known for its sports facilities and many renowned superstars are alumni of KIIT. KIIT spends a lot to improve the sports infrastructure. KIIT MUN is a famous club here at KIIT and very well-known all across the globe. Other clubs include Kaliope (Anchoring), Kreative Eye (Photography), and KFS (Film Society).The fees here at KIIT are divided into different parts. The institutional fee is 175000 per semester and the hostel fees vary from 28000 to 60000 per semester depending on the type of hostel opted. The mess fee is fixed at 22500 and there is some other cost like exam registration etc. KIIT also takes one-time money of 75000 for providing a laptop and blazer. The total cost to study at KIIT varies from 15 to 20 lakhs. There are many bank loans that can be availed to study here at KIIT and there are many scholarship awards. KIIT provides scholarships to the top 1000 rank holders in KIIT. They give 10000 rupees per month to the students. There are also stipends for securing top rank every year. I secured 3rd rank in the 3rd semester and received 5000 rupees per month for the next 6 months.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Playground is quite small so there's not enough area for you to choose where to sit.
Since I have came into this college, there's only one fest happened & other was the dandiya night.
Club members will help you in every way if you really want to know & learn. They will teach you in the field you want to go.They will provide you many internship opportunities but you need to be skillful to attempt and get into them. Your basic knowledge will take you to reach higher goals. Many companies approach them, but since I'm in 2nd year i haven't got the chance to meet and greet the companies.

Name: Akhilesh Singh Yadav
review: The faculty is really educated and professional. Though I would say they were a little cruel to us and didn't have much time for us. We were given a lot of exams projects and assignments and ppts. A lot for 1 sem but I guess that is what btech is.LPU is known for fests more than studies lol so u are going to have a great time here. There will be lots of fests with celebs coming. The infrastructure is great. Every facility is available like the library, courts, clubs, etc

Name: Divyanshu Singh
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review:
Placement season comes every year likely for last year's students. The company from various fields including cooperate and research-based companies are present. 
The average package is like 10 to 15 lakhs CTC and the highest fits cores.
Almost everybody gets placed though depending on the skill of the person also.Companies come to grant internship opportunities after every summer break.
Moreover, information about internships is also circulated via mail between semesters. 
Companies for both research and industrial sectors grant internship opportunities.

Name: Satwik Modi
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review: Two months internship is compulsory after the sixth semester. Companies do visit for two months of internships but the scenario is not that good companies don't prefer two months of interns. But the campus placements are good. All major tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon do visit our campus for the placement and they allow circuital branches to sit in their recruitment drive. Avg package is around 16 LPA with the highest package from the ECE branch in the IT company. Core placements are also improving. Around 90% of ECE students get placed every year.Two annual fests are organized here. TechNiti is the name of the Annual Technical Fest and Utkansh is the Annual Cultural fest of NIT Jalandhar. Every engineering branch has its own society and there are many clubs that cover vast activities like Kalakaar and Baware are the theatre clubs, Octaves is the music club, etc. The library is not that good but it has almost all the books needed for curriculum coverage. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have a blackboard, projector, and Samsung flip touch display board.

Name: Junaid Ahamd Teli
review:
Students here at the National Institute of Technology Srinagar start getting placed right from the 6th semester. The main recruiting 
 companies include wirpo, Tesla, Maruti, Hyundai, Tata, etc. Also, some government jobs offer by PSU companies. Our institution recorded a sky-high percentage of placements last year which was about 85% overall with students getting at an average of 15-20 LPA and the highest of 45 LPA.The fee structure here at the National Institute Of Technology Srinagar varies over ranges.
Suppose if your family income is less than 1LPA, you'll get a 100% fee concession. However if your family income is between 1-5LPA, you need to pay 1/3 of the tuition fee and if it's above 5LPA, you need to pay the full tuition fee which is about 75k per semester.

Name: Saina Gupta
college: IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITB]
review:
There is numerous fest which happens here, the biggest one is MOOD INDIGO, TECHFEST, E-SUMMIT, SOCIAL FEST, KALA DARSHAN, PAF, DHAROHAR, ANNPROD, STYLE UP, etc. all are conducted in there fix time mostly MOOD INDIGO and TECHFEST happen in December, others in march or Feb. rest happen in march. 
The classroom has all the facilities from benches to projector including ACs.
Coming to sports activities you'll have to choose between NS0 (sports), NCC, and NSS (social work) first to do one of them and it is compulsory in NSO you can choose your sports and can go forward and do whatever you want in that sports, other than that you'll get a coach in all game with Inter IIT competition and other inter hostel GCs.
there are numerous social groups, and clubs like Abhyuday, MoodIndigi, Techfest, E-Cell, cultural club and departmental club.You may feel that the FEE amount is higher than expected but you don't have to worry about it. You'll get assistant from your mentor and the orientation related to fees, where you'll get to know about the available loan facility through SBI & CANARA bank under VIDYALAKSHMI SCHEME, where you'll get a loan at lower interest rate, and you'll also get to know about the best part of it, i.e. Scholarships like NAMED SCHOLARSHIP, MERIT CUM MEAN SCHOLARSHIP, FEE REMISSION. most people got this scholarship if they have financial issues and have an annual income of less than 5 lac. Also, you can apply for a TA job after 1st year for 1st-year courses if will secure good marks in that subject. and you'll be paid for that, other than that you can participate in different competitions where you can win cash prizes up to 5 lac.

Name: Anshwardhan singh solanki
review: The fees in our college are very high if you come from a middle-class family and then this is difficult for you to pay the fees on time because, after the last date for fees, they can take charges for that like in my case. I pay extra 250 rupees extra because they take 50 rupees per day fine.The campus is overall good and there is greenery on our campus also there is stationary, canteen, gym, auditorium and many more things which I like so much also there is a library in our college in that almost 10000 plus books are present and that is a very unique feature in our college.

Name: Md adil karim
review:
As it is a government college so its fees are low and scholarship is also given to the needy people
Per year wise admission college fees are 6300 and exam fees are near about 9500
There're many organisations that also provides scholarship to needy people.
Likewise, FFE and NSP provides scholarship to the Needy peopleThe faculty members are quite good enough in all the departments.
As our batch has 150 students and then it is further divided into 5 groups so per teacher in every 30 students
Practical here are too good and the dissection part is also too good

Name: Kamlesh Patel
review:
You are in dtu, so your campus life will be excellent.
Cultural Council and LFC are the main cultural councils of dtu. And a lot of tech society's like IEEE, siam, Innova, e-cell etc present in college. 
Engifest, yuvaan, homecoming, aarambh, pehli mulakaat are some cultural fest of dtu.

Aahavan is the annual sports feat. 
So you can imagine your college life is going to be awesome.Yes, companies come to dtu for internships. 
But very less no. Of students get internship opportunities at the campus. If you are a tech student and you have mentioned well cgpa then you can get an internship at the campus. 
Sprinkler gives max 2,00,000 stipend for an internship. And the average stipend was approximately 55,000.

review: The course I selected was chosen as per my interest. The ratio between teachers to students is fine. Teachers' qualifications are up to the point and almost all teachers are professors and completed their degrees in well-reputed colleges. Exams are done semester wise and there are other exams in between each semester.The annual fest conducted in our college is named "malhar".It was nice, a lot of programs are there in 3 days. Occasionally college unions conduct different programs like onam celebration, Christmas, ethnic day ..etc. Sports in our college are not at all good but still improving.

BBD PARIVAR

Name: MANOJ NAGA SAI SANKA
college: Kakinada Institute of Engineering and Technology  -[KIET]
review: At present total course fee for the institution is covered under fee reimbursement by the Andhra Pradesh government and there will be a university fee of up to 5000rs per year. Apart from that there will be a fee for the college hostel and college transport that varies based on the distance and area. Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: The annual tech fest of KIIT is known as the KIIT FEST and is very popular. Every year big artists from all around the country visit our campus to perform. There are also many tech workshops held and extracurricular activities and cultural night programs during the fest. KIIT FEST is generally held from December to February. The KIIT Central Library has world-renowned collection of journals and books. It has more than 100000+ books and 40000+ journals. The classrooms are modern and equipped with all the required amenities to serve the students. Classrooms have screens, projectors, air conditioners, and whiteboards. KIIT is well known for its sports facilities and many renowned superstars are alumni of KIIT. KIIT spends a lot to improve the sports infrastructure. KIIT MUN is a famous club here at KIIT and very well-known all across the globe. Other clubs include Kaliope (Anchoring), Kreative Eye (Photography), and KFS (Film Society).The fees here at KIIT are divided into different parts. The institutional fee is 175000 per semester and the hostel fees vary from 28000 to 60000 per semester depending on the type of hostel opted. The mess fee is fixed at 22500 and there is some other cost like exam registration etc. KIIT also takes one-time money of 75000 for providing a laptop and blazer. The total cost to study at KIIT varies from 15 to 20 lakhs. There are many bank loans that can be availed to study here at KIIT and there are many scholarship awards. KIIT provides scholarships to the top 1000 rank holders in KIIT. They give 10000 rupees per month to the students. There are also stipends for securing top rank every year. I secured 3rd rank in the 3rd semester and received 5000 rupees per month for the next 6 months.

Name: Satwik Modi
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review: Two months internship is compulsory after the sixth semester. Companies do visit for two months of internships but the scenario is not that good companies don't prefer two months of interns. But the campus placements are good. All major tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon do visit our campus for the placement and they allow circuital branches to sit in their recruitment drive. Avg package is around 16 LPA with the highest package from the ECE branch in the IT company. Core placements are also improving. Around 90% of ECE students get placed every year.Two annual fests are organized here. TechNiti is the name of the Annual Technical Fest and Utkansh is the Annual Cultural fest of NIT Jalandhar. Every engineering branch has its own society and there are many clubs that cover vast activities like Kalakaar and Baware are the theatre clubs, Octaves is the music club, etc. The library is not that good but it has almost all the books needed for curriculum coverage. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have a blackboard, projector, and Samsung flip touch display board.

Name: Junaid Ahamd Teli
review:
Students here at the National Institute of Technology Srinagar start getting placed right from the 6th semester. The main recruiting 
 companies include wirpo, Tesla, Maruti, Hyundai, Tata, etc. Also, some government jobs offer by PSU companies. Our institution recorded a sky-high percentage of placements last year which was about 85% overall with students getting at an average of 15-20 LPA and the highest of 45 LPA.The fee structure here at the National Institute Of Technology Srinagar varies over ranges.
Suppose if your family income is less than 1LPA, you'll get a 100% fee concession. However if your family income is between 1-5LPA, you need to pay 1/3 of the tuition fee and if it's above 5LPA, you need to pay the full tuition fee which is about 75k per semester.

Name: Aditya Kumar singh
college: Madhav Institute of Technology and Science - [MITS]
review:
Collage has different cultural clubs that organise many events as well as parties on different occasions such as Holi etc.
Many tech competitions were organised within the campus.
Collage has a decent size Library with all the latest required books you need through your course.

All exams are conducted timely according to the academic calendar issue every year.

Name: ESHANT AGGARWAL
review: The course curriculum is slightly on the tougher side, with all the subjects properly aligned according to the requirements for industry ready candidates. The faculty is highly experienced, having industry experience as well. They keep telling us about the various innovations that can be done in the near future and what are the skills required in order to take up a job in the required domain. There are lectures in which there are around 65 students in one class, and in lab sessions there are around 20 students in one batch. The university focuses of hiring teachers which either have completed their PhD, or are currently enrolled with a PhD programme. The schedule of the exams is as follows: Within one month of commencement of the semester, we have the Class test which are then followed by Mid-Semester exams, roughly having a gap of around 1 month and then finally we have the Lab Practical Exam with Viva, and finally the semester ends with Semester End exam.The fest culture of Nirma is at another level. Every week there is one or other fest taking place in the various institutes of the university. There is an annual fest for each institute like Genesis of Management Institute, Cubix for the CSE department, Praveg for the Mechanical department, etc. There is a well-maintained library with full AC centralised.  The classrooms are equipped with smart boards along with projectors so that a proper understanding of a topic can be done by visualising things. The sports committee is also very much active in the university. Currently, matches of Basketball and Volleyball are going on for Inter-Department students. There are a number of clubs for one particular department there are 3 dedicated and active clubs in the CSE department alone. The clubs are related to both, cultural events as well as tech/core events. The authorities are actively involved with the funding of the clubs.

review: I opt for this course because it is the most demanding course nowadays, also this is the prior choice of most of the student's teachers advice is also inclined towards this. most of the teachers are not much-qualified but some of them are iitians and give future-oriented knowledge apart from being bookish, the exam is conducted twice in a semester. one is mid sem and the other is at the end of sem.Fees are not much and are affordable for everyone but the examination fees are very high and hostel fees are also much more than they should be. Post-matric and some other scholarships are there but only for those whose family income is less and there is no scholarship for general students, also there should be a scholarship test for genius students.

Name: Harsh Vardhan Singh
review: The annual fest zelicon is conducted in the month of April. A variety of books of all streams are available in the library and one is free to read and borrow them. Major sports like cricket, volleyball, football etc. are played in the college campus and you can play them according to your interestSince a new trend and vast scope in cse I opted for it. For every 50 students, there is at least one faculty. Most of the faculties are PhD holders and they have overall good teaching skills. Term exams were held after the completion of half the syllabus and yes it was a bit difficult to pass.

Name: Anusuya J S
review:
B.E/B. Tech fees are about Rs. 96000/year and  M.E/M. Tech is about Rs. 50000/year. 
There are many scholarships available for students based on their 12th marks and KPR Talent Test. KPRIET will give 100% placements for all the students.The course curriculum is excellent. Most of the faculty members have completed their PhD and their teaching method are good.
 The student-faculty ratio is about 3:45. Lab facilities are advanced and we can learn many things practically.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Lloyd Institute of Engineering and Technology - [LIET]
review:
College life is a bit boring.
The college does not conduct any sort of tests. They just conduct cultural activities or sports activities in a year.
The library is huge. One can easily get any type of book related to the subjects, stream or other books related to the field of engineering.
Classrooms are decent and some of the classrooms are under construction these classrooms are very high profile giving a feel of iits or nits.
There are clubs in the college which include a sports club, cultural club, drama club and no such emphasis are given to these clubs as only 2 events are organised up till date.I was interested in engineering want to get into it sector so I chose cse stream.
Faculty: student ratio is about 1:30.
All the teachers are qualified and some of them are highly qualified. Some of the faculty are really very good at teaching and can help you clear each and every concept related to the subject.
Term exams are easy to pass but time varies according to the university as the college is affiliated with AKTU.

review:
Annual fest=Abhivyakti.It was the best fest I had seen in my life It included singing+dance+drama comedy casting director was called as a special guest.

In sports, we play: Basketball table tennis badminton cricket Football

In scholarships too, there is a benefit given to lower castes.
Companies come on campus to take interviews and good and average students get selected!

Name: Rudra Narayan Swain
review: secured almost 87% in my all semesters. I was offered a salary of Rs. 15,000-25,000 per month. Our college arranges some campus placements for us like Zebil Plus, etc. The education system is very good, and they charge Rs. 60,000 per year. Most of the students are doing internships in IOCL, BSNL, etc. The students who secured above 60%. The highest salary they offered was 25000 and the lowest was 8000. The highest package is 2.5 and the lowest is 1.2. Per annum. Buildings designer and supervisor roles are offered in our courses. Above 60% of students got internships from our courses.The facilities and infrastructure available for the civil department are very good. The campus is completely Wi-Fi enabled. Labs are completely equipped with all the instruments. The classrooms are very good. In the library, there are all types of books. All facilities are provided in the hostel. The food served in the mess and canteen is very good, and other facilities are also very well equipped.

review:

Name: Anup Guria
review: I choose this course because there are lots of opportunities in doing Engineering. Now in our society especially in Bengal, for govt. jobs you need to give money to the political leaders. As I'm from a middle-class family, My father is unable to pay the huge money. In engineering, I get a job in a reputed company with a good salary. In our electrical department, there are 64 students, and in the case of civil, there are 120  so the student ratio is also much better for an engineering college. There are lots of skilled teachers present in the college the math name named Jharna Singha is just awesome. She taught us math like this is the easiest thing. They all are holding degrees like M.sc, B. Tech, and IITan. They are also well-behaved. The diploma is a 3-year course with 6 semesters mean, one semester at least for 6 months, the Internal exam is taken 2 times and the final external exam is taken one time. The exam pattern is quite simple and lots of MCQs are there, so it is so easy to pass all the exams.If we say about the fest, in Vishwakarma puja the annual fest is organized. Any tech fest isn't organized till now in my duration of studying. A library is present there in 1st year you can purchase 1 book, in 2nd year 2 books and for 3 years 3 books from there. There are many amenities present in the classroom, the teacher always gives support to all the students. Took an extra class in free time. Repeatedly says the difficult question. there is good infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor games like carrom, chess, table tennis, cricket, football, badminton, volleyball etc. An annual sports tournament is also held here. There are no social groups or websites run by students present, but the teacher always encourages us for social services like blood donation, tree plantation etc.

Name: RAJNISH KARAN
review:
Faculty behaviour is very good and they also do not take admission more than their capacity. Teachers are very well qualified and educated. The exam is of two types Mid sem & End sem. Mid sem held after 2 months of sem starting and end sem after 4-5 months of starting sem during this lab sessional, viva, quizzes going on for internal marking.The admission fee is 75 k Sem fees are 176k 
The exam registration fee is 1k  Mess admission fee is 15k
The mess fee is 22.5k Hostel fee depends according to the hostel
There are 3-4 types. of hostels
3 BED AC PREMIUM
2 BED AC PREMIUM
1 BED AC PREMIUM
3 BED AC common washroom
3 BED NON AC common washroom
2 BED NON AC common washroom

college: Swami Vivekanand Institute of Engineering & Technology - [SVIET]
review:
The cost of the product is not very high  but if you compare it with another govt college you find it a little bit expensive overall there are also many scholarships for different state students specially for Bihar and JharkhandAnully 5 to 6 feet are there but many guest lectures to motivate students and also there are a lot of libraries for different stream of student in their blocks 
There are dance, photography and another group available

college: Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College (Evening), V V Puram Campus - [SBMJC]
review:
B.COM is a great course for those who have more interest in the field of commerce or business.
I personally chose this as I like being in the field itself.
Teachers here are very supportive and helpful in every aspect.
As far as I know, most faculties are well-educated and speak fluently and their methodology is very different.
Semester exams are conducted in every 6 months but internal exams are conducted frequently.Social life is not as great as day colleges but events and fests are conducted.
There is a good library but I have no idea about the books as I have never been there to actually sit and read.
Classrooms are great no compromise
Sports are conducted for e.g cricket, football etc all sports are prioritised
Personally, I have no idea about clubs except one which is the Rotaract club

Name: VENKAT SAI
review:
KL University is an excellent campus for students to live and study. The campus is well-equipped with modern infrastructure and provides a range of amenities for students' personal and professional development. The university has a vibrant social life, with many clubs and organizations for students to join. The annual fest, Surabhi, and the tech fest, Samyak, are conducted every year in the month of March and October, respectively.
The university library is well-stocked, providing students with access to a vast collection of books and journals. The classrooms are spacious and equipped with modern audio-visual aids, which makes learning more interactive and engaging. The university provides a range of sports and extracurricular activities for students to participate in, including cricket, basketball, football, and many more. The university also has a social group, "KLites," which is run by students, providing a platform for students to connect and engage with each other.KL University has an impressive track record of providing 100% placement every year. The institute has concluded its placement drive for the batch 2022, and more than 150 companies have visited the campus for recruitment. Students become eligible for campus placements from the seventh semester of their course. The companies that visited the campus include Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, TCS, Wipro, and many more. A wide range of profiles was offered, including software engineer, data analyst, business analyst, and many more. The highest package offered was 60 LPA, while the average package was 6 LPA.
The percentage of students getting placements is high, with more than 95% of students receiving job offers. KL University offers great job opportunities for hardworking and determined students. However, for students who don't get placed, the university provides training and guidance to improve their employability. Overall, it provides excellent placement opportunities.

review:

Apart from fire and safety, mechanical, marine engineering, and ship technology departments, all other branches have a good boy-to-girl ratio. The library is well maintained with many national and foreign journals and you will get access to soe library and University library at the same time.

Name: Ashwini
college: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies - [DIEMS]
review: Annual fest named QUASARS was conducted in the month of January or February usually! It used to be conducted on the collage ground at a grand level! Sports and all other activities were also included. Prized were distributed as per academic and extracurricular performance! Tech fests were conducted in the month of September right before 2nd sem exams to brainstorm with students and give them recognition in the institute! I was not at all happy with my Library facility! We were provided with course books only and that too wasn't available in ample! I could barely get a book during my exam days because it never used to be available! Classrooms were quite spacious and had good ventilation, but we always had to switch classrooms if the lecture had to be conducted presentation because of the unavailability of network connectivity! Again I had a very bad experience with sports in my institute!I was interested in the CSE branch. But due to high cuts off, I was not able to get to the branch. But as all students from any branch can shift into the IT industry I was happy for an Electrical branch. Also, I can change the branch in the second year depending on the marks I will secure in the first year. The teaching faculty in this institute is excellent in teaching and all of them have completed their master's degrees. Some of the faculty have completed their Ph.D. and some are pursuing them. Their teacher's teaching method is good.

Name: Ashwini
college: SRM Institute of Science and Technology - [SRMIST]
review: Every year there will be an annual fest where we can exhibit our talents and this was a great platform for exploring our abilities. In the library, we can see national to international level magazines with new scientific research and invention. A lot of foreign authors' books are available in the college to gain knowledge. Every class had an inbuilt projector nearby to board and well-spacious classrooms.This course is my dream and love innovations. All faculties are well trained and accessed before joining the college. Plus we had a lot of counseling sessions to concentrate and peruse what we want. We had a weekly cycle test which will be very useful to understand the concept. We had a few IIT old students train us for our placement.

Name: Anish Raj
review:
From the 5th semester, students become eligible for placement. 
Various companies like Wipro,  Tata and many other visits our college.
The highest salary package is 15 lac and the minimum is 5 lac per annum.
About 80 per cent of students get placement. 
I want to pursue MSc after Bsc.I choose this course because it makes me interested in it and actually it was new for me
There are 16 boys and 30 girls in my class
Teachers are of PhD level and their teaching method is very efficient and effective.
Exs were taken at the end of every semester

review: I am interested in both computer languages as well as the electronics branch. These qualities are there in the electronics and communication engineering branch, so I joined it. The faculty: student ratio for our branch is about 1:45 and for our college now it is 1:30. Most of the faculty had their M.Tech from deemed colleges and some of them also did their Ph.D also. The quality of education is good. There will be semester after exams once every 6 months and the mid-term term will be for twice every six months. The mid-term exams are easy to pass, but the semester exams are quite tough to pass.Our Library is good with many of the famous and required books and journals are equipped here. Sports meet is being held once every year. There are only about 3-4 fests or annual days or freshers or another type of functions held in our college. The classrooms were good and also each department was equipped with one projector.

Name: Srivani Govindu
review: I am an architecture student. I chose this course for my interest in design and art. But there is no faculty in our college to teach us. We mostly study on our own. There are mid-1, mid 2 and sem exams in each sem. Each sem is for 6 months.There are fests conducted separately for each course group. Traditional days, fashion shows, rangoli competitions and many others are conducted each year. The library has many academic books to refer to. Sports are very rarely conducted.

Name: Priyanshi Bhowmik
review: Reverie is considered the most awaited annual fest that is conducted in the month of April or May. It is considered as one of the best fest of du. Then the library in our college is huge with a lot of number of books in. The classrooms are well ventilated . The college provides a number of Sports facilities to the students. There are few clubs and Society in the college which helps the students developer skills and networkings with other people and students from other collegesFrom the beginning of the third year the students are eligible for campus placements and for the internship opportunities students can apply from the first year itself. A few companies that have visited and have made offers to the students of our college include Deloitte, KPMG, Accenture etc. 80-85% of the students get placed. The average package of our college is 2 to 5 lakh per annum and the highest has gone up to 21 lakhs per annum

Name: Sameer Ahmad
review: Life on campus is exciting with plenty of social events and activities to keep students engaged. The annual cultural fest, "Spandan" takes place in March, while the tech fest, "Technotsav" is held in October. The library provides ample resources with access to books and journals. Classrooms are equipped with modern amenities for comfortable learning. Sports and extra-curricular activities are diverse, including clubs for music, drama, and debate. The student-run website "Campus Connect" keeps students informed about upcoming events and activities.The course curriculum and faculty members play a crucial role in shaping the academic experience of students. A well-designed curriculum can provide students with a comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of their field of study. Similarly, experienced and knowledgeable faculty members can bring depth and breadth to the classroom, imparting valuable insights and practical skills. The quality of the course curriculum and faculty members can greatly impact the success of a student's academic career.

review: From 7 the semester students are eligible for college placement. Various companies visited the school campus. They made almost 100 offers. I want to get a job.Because in the modern world, it sector is growing day by day and I want to make my career in that. The student ratio is 80%. The faculty are highly qualified and skilled and their teaching method is good. 3 times internally and one time externally

Name: Tahseen Naaz
review: There are many functions which happen here and students can take participate and enjoy them. No tech fest or annual fest happens but still, it is okay. The classrooms are pretty good. We have smart boards, a mic and all types of facilities available which a good college should have. The campus is also beautiful and also it provides hostel facilities.In my course B.COM Hons. the fee is 18000 per semester and there are 8 semesters as per Ranchi University. It is a 4-year course. In this college, we get short-term computer courses which help in getting internships. Placement is average here. Better than other colleges.

Name: Kshitij Kumar Gupta
review:
Our college has one of the best infrastructures among all DU campuses, All classrooms are fully air-conditioned. New Benches are there. Kalrav is the name of the annual fest although, in terms of the fest, I'm not satisfied. Our college is a top-class auditorium, events are regularly organised, Library is well equipped with books, and many sports like volleyball, basketball, badminton, kabaddi, cricket, baseball, fencing, archery, and table tennis games are there. The Ground is small. Various socities are there where one can take part in various activities. Student Wifi is there although speed is not goodI chose this course because, in my course, we are taught Botany, zoology and chemistry as main subjects and unlike honours in any one subject and then doing a master's in that subject. In life sciences, we can do masters in all three but in addition to this, we can also do a master's in bioinformatics, forensics, and biotechnology. biochemistry etc.
My class strength is 4o and each subject is taught by two professors, separate 2 lab assistants.
Teaching is 3/5 average, faculty members are top qualified 
Exams in six months and very easy to pass

Name: SHANTOSH SEELAM
review:
At kl university, talking about campus life is mostly forbidden and there are security guards in the vigilance department who monitor student activities like flirting, chatting with girls, making phone calls on campus grounds, and dress sense. Walk around campus during working hours. There are national level festivals such as Surabhi, SAMYAK, Hash-Include, Zrotiya, Fem-Flare Fest, 5-10 other fests are conducted in Feb and march
,there are technology clubs (Google Students Developers Club, Mega Club, Block Whiz Club, SODS Club, Garuda Club) about 20 technical and non-technical clubs such as Flim Club, Nartana Club, Swara Music Club, about 15 non-technical clubs, and also students interested in NSS and NCC can participate.
KL University has a 6 floor central library with a wide variety of books and periodicals available 15 hours a day. Gymnasium (additional charge), indoor stadium, large campus ground. The classrooms are fairly simple, clean, and boring.I heard from my seniors that the recruitments will start in the third year of the second semester, and I am currently finishing my second year. According to college records, visit kluniversity.in if possible. It says that those who choose education are guaranteed in 100% placement. Also, most students who go abroad for higher studies do have the option of not preparing for an internship or placement, they can choose to prepare as their wish. Many big MNC companies visit his KL university to recruit students in his 6th floor placement cell in C block. According to the university very few students have achieved a 50-Lac per annum packages are acheived by the students. Each student has 2-3 offer letters. The minimum package is 6 lacs per year. It's the hard truth that if you don't get a placement, you'll need to sign papers stating that you've declined the placement they're offering. My plan is to fulfill my wishes and to go to NASA.

Name: Parth Vadehra
review: The annual cultural fest of our college is the MOKSHA-INNOVISION which is held somewhere between march and April. Last year KK performed in our cultural fest and it was successfully completed with the footfall of 1lakh 50 thousand students. The tech fest of our college is RESONANZ and it is held in October every year. The course books are available in the library and you can take them whenever you want to. The classrooms are really big and spacious they're air conditioned and the washrooms are also really clean and hygienic. The college provides you with tons of opportunities and extracurricular activities to improve your overall development. There are many societies and clubs run by the students including the E-cell, enacts, venatus etc.The course curriculum is really good and they teach everything from the basic level. The student-to-faculty ratio is somewhere about 1:80 for my batch which is decent when compared to other colleges. Some of the faculty members are really qualified and have done their PHD'S from IIT while some of them just take classes for the sake of it. There are 4 exams in each semester, 2 class tests, mid-semester exams and end-semester exams. The difficulty level of the paper depends on the preparation of the student, some students score really well while some of them fail.

Name: Rithvik Kaliga
review: Life at the campus is really good. You will have lots of freedom to roam around; it's a very big campus. There are 2 gyms with good equipment and all kinds of sports grounds like badminton, football, basketball, volleyball, throwball and tennis, except cricket (only nets). Each sport has a coaching facility at a specific time. Coming to the part of the fest, our college has 1 annual tech fest, Aether and one sports fest, Airo, usually held in about 1 week around March-April every year. It's a really fun event where many colleges around the state take part. The classrooms are quite big, having capacities as small as 30 to as large as 240. All classrooms have a projector and screen as well as a chalkboard. AC is always switched on in all classes. There are also multiple clubs that are quite active in our college; a few eg. computer science, programming, math, literary, newspaper, movie, photography & media clubs, etc.I opted for a bachelor's in Electronics and Computer Engineering. I went for that branch of engineering because I had the leverage to select a career path in either electronics or computers, something which our college provides really well. The faculty: student ratio is not always the same, because it depends on the courses the student chooses. Until the 4th semester, the faculty: student ratio is roughly 1:120. Later, it depends on the courses the student selects. Most (99%) of the teaching faculty are PhD holders. Exams are held roughly every 3-4 weeks. There will be 2 midterm exams followed by one end-semester exam. If you sincerely attend all classes and study well, you can easily pass all the exams.

Name: Sarfaraz Abdulsattar Luharvadha
review:
Students get good job opportunities after mtech engineering. 
Earn more salary compared with many other courses. 
The student ratio is 1:15.
The facility of candidates with PhD degrees and candidates with strong academic and research credentials is supported.There is a loose 30 to 40 per cent of students of urban cities. 
Because of the fee hike policy and day-by-day constant study. 
Got a scholarship and provide tuition wavier and additional rs.1000 per month.
Got a project assistant job.

review:
Cultural fest, law fest, celebration fest..many functions take place there and every month one function is fixed to happen

Sports and other co-curricular activities are also praised

The faculty is good and the ratio is 6:60 every subject has its own faculty members and lecturer
Some are lawyers, engineers highly qualified faculties are here and have great experience and teaching skills
Every 2nd month there is a mid-term exam and papers are pretty moderate

Name: Sundar G
review: Our college management conducts the college fests once every 3years which are called mythri and medha tech fests and there mostly conduct the fest in March or April months. Our college has a big library and it provides every book that the student needs. And the classrooms are quite ok. Our college management encourages sports and other curricular activities. Some of the senior students maintain a social media platform to inform about college updates and issuesIn my college, every student must need to pay 35000/- per year for convener quota students and it is different from management quota if you are not qualified in Eamcet then you can join in management quota for that you have to pay 1-1.5 lakh donation and 1 lakh fees. And every eligible student will get a scholarship from the government and the college management provides campus interviews to get a job

Name: VS Krishnan
review: The course curriculum is current and the syllabus is continuously revised and made relevant according to the industrial skills needed. Some of the faculties are the best you can get and they motivate us to pursue and be deeply engrossed in the subject of their expertise. All faculties are PHD holders from reputed institutions. The exams are of moderate level and one could pass the exams with regular and sincere studies.The club's cultural and technical fest is spectacular and fun to be a part of. The opportunities one gets in pursuing extra activities and club work add to one's experience. The library is fully stocked with all the books. Classrooms are standard with a smart board and a projector. All kinds of sports facilities are available inside the campus. There are over 200 clubs and chapters run by students in VIT.

Name: Rakshanda Sharma
review:
AMU is a reputed university, and studying at it is what many students dream of.
B.Voc in fashion design is a very new course started 5 years back approx. It has a good curriculum and foundational subjects. The faculty is really qualified and also helps us whenever we have any issues with the syllabus.As it's a new course, there is no campus placements as of now. But they do provide a list of companies to which students can apply. 
Although regardless of not having campus placements all you need is a good portfolio that will help you, in getting your dream job.

Name: PAL JAIN
college: Institute of Professional Education and Research - [IPER]
review: The social life at my college is very good .. Different programs, activities, and fest is often held in which students perform and participate enthusiastically . Like spirits like a cultural fest which happens every march and competitions like singing dancing rangoli making are held. Then another program is a reflection in which other college students come and perform various activities. Then happens the traditional day in which students come in all traditional outfits. A fashion show also happens in which all students perform their best. Then another activity is roadies which is like a sports program in which volleyball, cricket, basketball, tennis , chess , kho kho, treasure hunt . Various activities happen with full courage . Overall the fest , programs are good and you will enjoy a lot. The college will never get you bored and encourages you to participate in activities and have fun at the same time. Studies and enjoyment both should go in a parallel way so it's good for colleges to include students.I choose this course because I wanted to do BBA from this college and then prepare for the cat exam to get a decent mba college . The student ratio in my college is 200 but for mba it's pretty high also the mba course is pretty reputed in my college. The faculty and staff in my college are experienced enough and they are very supportive in every aspect they motivate me to participate in various activities and also teach well in classrooms. After the new education policy comes into effect the semester system is abolished and exams are held in a yearly manner but the cce is held after every module completion in a quiz or assignment manner. Apart from this 2 internal exams also happen in which you have to perform well and the exam is of 50 marks total. 9 exams are held but in this, no gap is given to you to prepare it's like 2 exams happen in one day so you have to be prepared for it. The fact is that these internal exams are tougher than the actual university exam. The main exams are pretty easy.

Name: Joshva P
review:
I have a passion for Mechanical engineering so I chose this course.

Name: Chirag Hadiya
college: IIT Goa - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITG]
review: The annual fest is cultural and technical fest is Cepheus. The library at IIT Goa is well-stocked with books, journals, and other resources. The library has a collection of over 10,000 books and subscribes to several online databases, providing access to thousands of research papers and journals. The classrooms at IIT Goa are well-equipped with modern amenities such as projectors, whiteboards, and comfortable seating arrangements. The institute also provides high-speed internet connectivity throughout the campus, enabling students to access online resources from anywhere on the campus. The institute encourages students to participate in sports and extracurricular activities. The campus has facilities for various sports such as cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, and table tennis. There are also several clubs on campus, including music, dance, drama, literary, and photography clubs, providing students with opportunities to pursue their interests. there are also social clubs on campusIIT Goa offers campus placements to its students. Students become eligible for campus placements in their final year of study, i.e., in the 7th or 8th semester. Several reputed companies visit IIT Goa for campus placements, including Amazon, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, IBM, Tata Steel, Larsen & Toubro, Adani Power, etc.  Higher placements offer is of 1.2cr and average placement offers are16-25 lac per annum. The percentage of students getting placed during campus placements at IIT Goa is quite high, with around 90% of students getting placed every year. The remaining students generally opt for higher studies or pursue entrepreneurship. In case no campus placement is offered, students can explore other options for employability, such as applying for jobs through job portals, professional networking sites, or by directly contacting companies. They can also consider pursuing higher education or research in their field of interest or starting their own business.

review:

review:

Name: Deepandru Singh
review:
At IIITA, campus life is just fantastic. It seems chaotic at first, but you'll quickly adjust and grow to appreciate it. The campus features excellent facilities, including a pool, basketball, and badminton courts, a student activity cetre, and more.
The library also provides various books that will be helpful, especially in research activities.  Three fests are part of IIITA's annual celebrations:
Cultural Fest- Effervescence
Technical Fest- Aproksha
Sports Fest- Asmita
There are various societies that will help you immensely to grow your network and upskill yourself:

The curriculum is definetely hectic but wholesome, providing wide exposure to a student. 
I chose IIIT Allahabad because of its excellent placement record and strong research focus. Moreover, IIITA is well-known and respected in the industry.
The faculty: student ratio at IIIT A is commendable. The faculty members are highly qualified, with most of them holding Ph.D. degrees from reputed universities across the world, including IITs.
The term exams are conducted timely. IIITA follows continuous evaluation. Your final grades are a summation of various quizzes, lab assessments, and review tests that are conducted almost every two weeks.

Name: Sanidhya
review: Since I am a prodigy of the ICSE/ISC curriculum of the Indian study system, so, since class 9th I had JAVA programming language in my computer science syllabus which was continued till class 12th. I loved building logic and solving complex programming questions during the process of learning. So, I decided to take my knowledge and skills to an upgraded level which I could have done by getting admitted to B.tech. course in computer science branch only. Talking about the faculty-student ratio is approximately 6:1, which means 6 students per teacher which is, in my opinion, a great ratio without making the interaction between teachers and students messy and unfruitful. Almost all the teachers are P.hd. holders in their working fields. Coming from IITs, they hold a robust grip over the subject of their interest and teaching. The term exams were on time although the semester started late because of delayed JEE. They were somewhat onerous but not out of the vicinity of what the teacher taught in the class.The fee structure of the course is pretty affordable and reasonable. As anybody can afford to study in this glorious college if he/she has saved some bucks in his/her life. The college is actually supportive in terms of financial assistance as it provides scholarship opportunities to meritorious students, considering their intermediate results and on-campus performance in semester exams held during the course. The college has tied up with some of the recognized banks to provide students with education loans without facing any obstacles during the admission process and their study term. If u are scoring above 85% in your intermediate level, then you are awarded some amount of fee waiver, with an increase in your percentage accordingly. Then, in future, it depends on your semester CGPAs. The college offers some jobs to students with stipends. Jobs include handling the official pages of the college on different social media platforms, blogging for the college, becoming a college ambassador etc.

Name: Mukul Siloliya
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:

Name: Shyam sunder kanth
review: At sharda, as the tagline says, The world is here... its somewhat true. you will find student from all over the india as well as outside the india too specially from African continent. Campus infrastructure is very good and so is campus life. Coming to the annual fest, Chorus is orgainsed every year which is Sharda's annual fest. It's a three-day fest in which celebrities are invited, Dj night is organized any many fun things are being organized. Coming to the tech fest, the Technical society of Sharda also known as Technova is responsible for all the technical things including fests, hackathons and all done here. Techonva is a good initiative by Sharda run by a group of students under the guidance of the HOD and Dean itself for the students. Technova consists of 6 clubs, and I am also the head coordinator of one of the clubs named Game Drifters, which is responsible to organise gaming tournaments and game development seminars here. Every month each club has to do at least one event.I am doing Btech ( CSE ) here and from my three-year experience, I can tell that the faculties are very supportive here whether it is academic or nonacademic, they will help you in every means. Every faculty is well-educated and has great experience in the industry. Most of the faculty have their Ph.D. degree and the rest are pursuing their Ph.D. In my batch, there are total G sections and each section has 64 students which are further divided into 2 groups. Every classroom has a smart board and whiteboard too. The examination is held twice a semester, Mid-term examination and End term examination. 75% attendance is strictly compulsory. The only thing that I don't like here is they teach many additional subjects which are of no use at all like Environmental Studies, Biology, disaster management, etc. instead of these if they focus on teaching a subject that is placement oriented can be better than those useless subjects.

college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]

University exams are held after the completion of the semester and a semester is of 6 months. A total of 8 semesters are there in btech also pre-university or sessional exams are conducted by the college timely before the university exams. These exams are really helpful in university exams.kolahaal is orgainsed in campus . it is three days .celebrity is also invited on the last day of the fest. there are many societies and clubs or social groups are there in college. From time to time competition is done in these societies to encourage the students. also, they provide a platform for other skills. competitions are done in sports as well. teams are selected for higher platforms.

review: The classrooms have modern infrastructure and are air conditioned, the college has many societies (centralized and school-specific). the college provides book bank facility to each and every student, in which college provides book to students, free of cost and in return keeps 5000 as the safety amount and then return the amount after the course is complete. Name: Pragya Vatsa
review: English has been my interest so I pursued this course. There are a total of 8 colleges under BHU. All the faculties in my college are Ph.D. The teaching method in our college is a schooling type. Each and every student are paid heed. Attendance is mandatory. If you are a regular student, you can easily pass the exams without taking many loads.The college has got the best infrastructure. There are several clubs and cells in the college like placement cell, women's development, anti-ragging, social clubs, media clubs, and many more. Every week there are programs held where guests and speakers come not only from India but also worldwide. The library is rich with books. We have an e-library too for the facilitation of the students. Printout and xerox facility is available in the library free of cost.

Name: Tushar
review:
All the colleges at DU follow the same curriculum for the same courses.
I had commerce without maths, so I ended up getting admission to bcom course which is one of the most prominent courses at DU.
Since there was merit-based admission, loads of students applied for seats in this college. Currently, we have a strength of around 96 in my class. There are 4 sections For Bcom with an average strength of 350 students in bcom Program particularly.
All the faculty members have proficient skills and thorough knowledge of their subjects and hold a PhD degree. The teaching method is also up to the mark. It depends from teacher to teacher.
The syllabus is vast as per the new education policy but Can be covered with dedication within a month. Exams constitute subjective and lengthy questions so that there is no scope for cheating. Exams are conducted periodically after every 4 months for each semester along with preparatory leaves which is sufficient for a student to cover the syllabus.The college organised an Annual cultural Fest name Phoenix which features various cultural activities such as dance performances, music and artist performances.
There are various Societies and NGOs run by students of our college.
They also organise their respective fests which include various events and competitions, exhibitions, Presentations, speaker sessions, etc.
MLNC has the biggest Library in Entire DU having more than lakhs of books.
Students can issue books with their college ID cards. fine will be imposed on Default and late return of the book, 1 rs fine per day delay
The classroom is well furnished with proper electricity having fans, desks, blackboard.
Classes don't have ACs and Projectors.
The college has all sports but it requires prior permission from the Principal and teachers to hoist any match and introduce new games.
Currently, most prominent sports in our colleges are volleyball, basketball, football, cricket, kabaddi, etc.
