Name: Atirek
college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review: the fees of 1st year is comparetively higher as compared to 2nd,3rd,4th year. fees for 1st year is 1,18,000(approx.) and from 2nd year onwards it is 1,07,000(approx.), we have to fill out annual scholarship forms for the state and national levels respectively. generally, general-category students have fewer chances of a scholarship.Nearly all type of courses are available in our college including specialization in some elite branches. The amount of faculty to students are fair enough, not high nor low. The qualification faculties are between average to good. The exams are conducted on every fornight, and we have ample number of exams conductedin our college.

Name: Vishwajeet
review: College life is okayish.  Campus Is compact. Few of the classes are air-conditioned and the labs are clean. There is a decent-sized library. The sports ground is small with a football ground and basketball court. There are a handful of societies of different categoriesFor computer science and information technology, students there is 100 per cent placement. But for other branches opportunities are limited as very few non-IT companies visit campus for placement. But you can learn to program and get a package of 6 LPA

Name: Sayan gupta
college: Future Institute of Engineering and Management - [FIEM]
review: After 5th semester the students get campus placement and are eligible for placement. There are a lot of many companies that arrived like cognizant, infotech, etc. The highest package is 10 lacs above and the lower package is 4lacs.The annual fee is 32000 rs all 4 yrs, tech fest month is march and they conduct good fest. The availability of books is huge and good. the classroom is also good. There is a lot of sports section in our college.

Name: Srivatsa Prasad
review:
DTU has one of the best fests in India. It is called ENGIFEST. There are many small and medium-level fests organized are other societies.
Sports is one of the best things about dtu . There are 2 full basketball courts. 1 cricket field, 1 football field, and an indoor stadium also.Avg package last year was around Rs 15 l.p.a and the highest package was Rs . 1 . 8 cr.
200 + companies visit the campus and overall placements are good.
There are 100 % placements at dtu.
But there is a lot of competition due high number of students

Name: SHIVAM
review: Life of campus is quite cheerful as there are many events and workshops conducted time to time for refreshing+ there are many tech and nontech societies also Annual fest is ENGIFEST and Tech fest is INVICTUS. Books, Magazines and various kinds of journals are always available ranging on different topics in the CENTRAL LIBRARY. Our classroom as well maintained and fully air conditioned and they have many charging ports also. There are many sports facilities also both indoor and outdoor sports. Fresources is a website run by the students and for the studentsFees structure for the first year is around 2.2lac for academic year 2022-23. Fee hike is around 5-10% for every academic year. There are many scholarships Offered to the students some are merit based while others are category based there are many private scholarships also including Reliance Foundation Scholarship and Fast retailing scholarship. There are many on campus internship and job offers which goes upto 1cr per annum (for placements) and 2lac/month( For internship at Sprinkler)

Name: Hardik Saini
review: The students start getting placements in the 5th semester and the companies visited in the college are amazon, Flipkart, Infosys, Wipro, tcs. The highest salary package offered is Rs. 5 LPA and the average salary package offered is Rs. 2.5 LPA. Around 60% of students gets placement,The annual fests are held every year in 2023 the annual fest named Pratibimb lakermesee was held and the Punjabi singer Parmish Verma hosted that. There are all books available in the library. There are many clubs in the college which are run by teachers.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
The social life is very good in college it does organize superb fests like Engifest, YUVAAN FEST, E SUMMIT, and many more technical and other fests, and its a lot of fun, and most of the fests are conducted in February itself.
The library is a plus point for DTU because the books suggested for us in the course are available in the library but students generally issue the books at the beginning so you need to issue them at the beginning of the sem.
Different kinds of the classrooms are there (SPS    Pragya Bhawan and Departments classrooms) but all have AC and are properly ventilated with good lighting conditions and enough space for students to sit. 
The sports ground is too good it has an indoor badminton court tt court even pool tables and has a football ground cricket pitch basketball court lawn tennis court outdoor badminton court volleyball ground kabaddi dedicated ground and arenas are organized every year.The fees of DTU keep hiking every year but in my case, for the first year it was 2,06,000 and for the second year I paid 2,19,000 and I am availing a student education loan from the SBI bank which is inside the DTU campus only at a 7.65% interest rate and you have to start paying the loan amount only after 5 years no need to pay anything now.
This year the fees had a hike of around 10k for a year in first-year fees. 
apart from the fees I have rented a flat nearby dtu as my home is quite far and I dint get a hostel so my monthly expenses apart from studies are 15k including rent electricity water all time meals and some miscellaneous expenses which total around 1.8 lakhs a year. so my total expenses are approx. 4 lakhs per year.
it is quite high compared to many other courses and all but also low if compared to IIITD or BITS Pilani where per year fees are 4lakhs+.

Name: Aamir Sohail Ashraf
review: It is one of the best planning schools running architecture since 1973 and has Masters's in Planning since 2012. Most of the faculties have graduated from IITs/NITs. Almost all faculties (Full time) have Ph.D. degrees. The student-teacher ratio is good. Exams are conducted as timely notified through academic calendar. An absolute system of marking is followed as the strength does not fit for relative grading. Exams are comparatively easy. More focus is on academic projects and portfolios.All the basic amenities are available. Hostels may or may not be available depending on vacancy. Clubs are available. Central as well as department library facilities are available. Access to almost all prominent databases is available. Sports, technical as well cultural clubs run on the campus.

Name: Sahil
college: Janta Vidya Mandir Ganpat Rai Rasiwasia College - [JVMGRR]
review:
"Mhari reet- Mhare geet" is a cultural program held in this college in 2019 and every year a talent hunt program is also held in this college in around October or November.
Sports and other activities are also organized by this college such as badminton, running, boxing, volleyball, cricket, etc.
Activities like science exhibitions, quizzes and essay competitions, etc.A company named 'savlon' is coming here for offering placements with a yearly package of about 3 lahks.
Yes, there is an internship program also organized by this college in central university Palli.
An industrial tour like cloth factories in Faridabad is also organized by this college.

Name: Sandeep Rathore
college: Madhav Institute of Technology and Science - [MITS]
review:
If u talk about infrastructure that is excellent and the annual tech fest is good.
We can take 5 books at a time from the library without any fee and get any kind of book that we want to study for our exams.
Sports activities are good there are so many inter and intra college competitions like cricket, football, and badminton they provide full support to students and also provide various extracurricular activities like NSS where people do social work and many more things.
IETE, Aerospace, Mitsunion.There are 5 seats of FWD and 5 people will get the total fee back the fee according to me is quite normal compared to other institutions and after year and year when I get promoted I had to pay less fee because or the good policy structure.
I got an offer from Wipro limited with an annual package of 3.5lpa.

Name: Avanindra Srivastava
college: Gautam Buddha University, School of Information and Communication Technology
review:
The fees are quite high for specialization branches such as AI and other technical fields.
But other branches have affordable fees there comes a hostel price which is a great pro that is quite cheap.
There are many scholarship opportunities from UP Government for the backward class which can be availed to respective individuals.
I am not eligible for any scholarship so I won't be talking more about it anymore.It is generally a new course we are the 2nd batch in B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence there are faculty who are well qualified which are mostly the senior faculty.
Guest faculty are also there and generally, few are gems rest are just a teacher to guides them to follow some external platform to gain knowledge.

Name: ANKIT
college: Chitkara Institute of Engineering and Technology - [CIET]
review:
The annual fest's name is bivennue and it is as good the campus life is very excellent as compared to other universities. there is a small program happening every 2 -3 weeks and also the sports facility is also good there is an indoor badminton court and snooker table and table tennis court and one cricket ground and one football ground and one foothill ground 
there are many technical and non-technincal club 
the NSS is a social club 
the gdse is a technical clubI choose this course as I like to learn coding and also computer science has a bright future as compared to other streams.  Faculties are as good as they have PhD degrees and the faculty-student ratio is good and enough exams are once a month i.e st's

Name: Rajveer Singh Rathore
review: Generally, the annual function of the college is conducted in the month of February. The library is so huge and almost every book is available here. The classrooms are well maintained and every piece of furniture is well furnished. Various games like cricket volleyball, basketball etc. are played there. A website is run for students by the college.A choose this course because I wanted to complete my Masters in the field of commerce. The ratio of faculty and student is quite good. 100 students per teacher. Examinations are held yearly and it's very difficult to clear and pass the competitions.

Name: tushar Kumar Bhushan
review: Fests are the best part of DTU. You'll have Freshers, Engifest, Techfest, Yuvaan - literature fest, and many more. You'll witness the best concerts of your life here. The library is a bit off as you need to be fast as the books easily get out of stock. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. Sports are damn good, a huge sports complex is right there with cricket, football, badminton, TT, kabaddi, Volleyball, basketball, and in short every sport.The faculty here is good, the teachers are enthusiastic about their field of expertise. They want to teach and so goes for the student also. Coming to the ratio it's around 50:1. Quality is topmost, the best you can expect. You'll have two exams one Mid sem and one end sem. They are easy to pass, just study exponentially, and don't pile up to the end.

Name: Prashant Kumar Singh
review:
The annual fest of DTU- Engifest (North India's biggest fest). 
Techfest, Esummit, and more fests are conducted all year.
Library: The library of DTU is decent enough and contains major books of the syllabus of every course going on here.
Amenities in classrooms: Classrooms are fully furnished with AC installed, whiteboard, Projector, and screen. 
Dtu contains almost every sport like cricket, football, table tennis, pool, kabaddi ground, lawn tennis, volleyball, basketball, etc.
In DTU teachers are also supportive of extracurricular activities and allow students in their period to work on that if possible.
Here societies are uncountable, you name it and dtu have a society for that, and if not then you can start yours as well for the same.Yes, of course, there is a fee hike for the last few years, and In fact, this hike got all over the world and not just in DTU.
It is difficult for one to pay fees on their own, so there is loan availability and a sbi branch is opened as well on the college campus itself.
The university offers merit scholarships for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Minority category and a post metric scheme for Sc candidates.
For the Btech continuous education program: The students whose family annual income is less than 4.5lakhs per annum are eligible for fee concession for students belonging to lean financial condition.

Name: Deepak
review:
There are many scholarship opportunities for students in this college also from the alumni association and also the fee is less than other competitors around.
This year college transformed into University so fees doubled from last year.
But it's normal as highest as 73215 rs per year. For SFS seats whereas low as free for TFWS seats.
Alumni scholarship, NSP, SJE, FFE, etc.It's good but not the best we want, social life is normal.
Also, clubs are there in the university for different fields.
The infrastructure is old but, I say it's ok. University-level and intercollege sports are organized along with social groups and websites by students on the web by the name of the college.

Name: Subhiksha

Average package 3LPA

Name: Sumit Chaurasia
review: The teacher in our institution is very helpful well qualified and have good knowledge and some of them are qualified from iits, dtu is considered better than other collage as it provides a lot of opportunities when it comes to placement or other Personality development. Many students get on-campus placement.There are many fests conducted by the societies and the biggest fest in north India is engifest which is conducted in dtu, there is a very good library, a good ac classroom sports complex and a mic Mac. There are many socities like madhurima, yuvaan, wave society and many more, that conduct many activities.

Name: Shivam shah
review:

After getting my degree I will work in the same Companies in which I will get a job from my collageYes there is a sports club, dance club, singing club, and poetry club in the college and this is all run by students there is a lot of fun in the college and college students also run a campaign for poor people and give things to a needy person

Name: Alveera Nadaf
review:
IK was a PCm student with good marks so given the demand in the market and suggestions from my career counsellor I opted for this course. The faculty is good and reliable. The examination process is a little strict and tough to follow but nevertheless, you get used to it.Life at this campus is similar to any college life
. the college does have a number of clubs that you can join according to your interests. The infrastructure is simple and nice. The college does conduct cultural programs and festivals.

Name: Aashu Gupta
review: The fest conducted by DTU is ENGI Fest annually in the month of Feb. The availability of books in the library is nice. Every type of book is present in the library .you can issue it easily. The sports activities are conducted in a very nice way and competitions will be held between the universities There are many societies run by students like E-cell and many more.From the seventh semester comp[anies started to come. Many tech, NON-tech companies are coming to the campus for student hiring .maximum students got placed in the companies at the end of the final year. I think out of 100 95% of students got placed, the placement ratio is nice . My plan is to go to tech companies.

Name: Yagyesh Sharma
review:
Amity conducts Chroma Fest and Sangathan. Chroma is conducted in the month of Feb and sangathan in October.
They have multiple libraries and more than enough books available in the library for every stream.
Classrooms are air-conditioned with clean and comfortable amenities.
They have dedicated grounds for each game, one can simply go to the sports room and issue the kit.
There are various groups such as cultural, LIterary, etc.I chose this course because it was really diverse, and dealt with numerous interesting subjects such as Radio, Film and television, Editing, political science, etc.
5:1
The professors in the university were UGC approved, some were Ph.D.'s others persued Ph.D. They had good teaching skills and experience.
 Final exams would take half to one month to complete. The difficulty level of the exams was medium.

Name: Priyal Sharma
college: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology University - [JIIT]
review: I wanted to pursue some courses that had wide scope but that much core coding. So ECE was my good-to-go course. The faculty to students is such that 2 batches study in the same class throughout 1 and 2 years so it remains 40-50:1. Mostly they have faculty who have done MTech or PHD from IITs but not bachelor's, and some faculty are from international colleges also. The exams happen 3 times a semester. 1st after 1.5 months of start of semester, 2nd after 2.5 and 3rd after 3.5. the time after the start of the semester is the peaceful one other than its all hustle day and night. Too much academic pressure.Hardly 5-10 companies visited for internship opportunities and many or most students did not even get a chance to apply for the internship. Also, the college did not tell you that there is a specialization certificate in your own core field that you get after completing certain courses in a certain semester of your own domain.

Name: ashwin ghogale
college: Sinhgad Institute Of Management And Computer Application - [SIMCA] Narhe
review:
Sinhgad College has Huge Campus which is always crowded with young ethusiathics students, the main highlight of sinhgad college is its fest.
every year they arrange Huge events for all sinhgad students. during starting of the year, they arrange for CARNIVAL as well they celebrate all festivals in college and in the FEB month, They host Pune's huge college event which is called 'sinhgad karandak' and every year they invite some celebrities from Hollywood and Bollywood which is highlighted part of karandak in that they arrange so many Tech Fests as well intercollege Sports events.Actually, I completed my BCA at sinhgad college during that time some faculty came from SIMCA and they told us some benefits abut MCA after graduation I also want to do MCA that's why I choose MCA, In Simca there are 2 divisions for academics and there is 120 students strength in college in one semester there is 5 subjects and one faculty assigned for each subject almost 20 students: 1 faculty assigned for projects and almost all faculty did Ph.D. in a specific subject, and if you from computer background it is easy to clear all subjects in first attempt.

Name: Keshav Bajaj
college: Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Khalsa College - [SGTB]
review: The annual fest of Shri guru tegh bahadur khalsa college is lashkara which is held during the month of march where all college societies have their events and there is a grand performance by renowned artists and more than 10000 students join the fest and it's happening to be there. The university has vast libraries all around the campus where books and journals of different genres are there which is open to all university students. Each college has its own student-run societies.I choose bcom because of my keen interest in commerce also it allows me to follow my ultimate passion for theatre as the course curriculum is limited. All the teachers are professional in their respective subjects with a fair reel of experience. Every 6 months, there are semester exams and it is not that difficult to pass these exams.

Name: Palak Mrig
review:
Annual fest used to happen in the month of March. Tech fests for different departments used to take place throughout the year.
The library is one of the biggest that I have ever seen. A huge number of books with multiple copies are available in them. The accessibility is easy using the library card.
Fully A/C classrooms with projector services. Enough light and fans in the room for comfort. Blackboard/whiteboard with size bigger than usual.
Extracurricular activities were a little less due to the strictness in attendance. Sports was on high priority. There was an entire sports festival at the university for the same.
Math club, Chemistry club, AI club, Robotics club, cultural clubs, etc were all run by students with support from the faculty.Since I did my graduation in mathematical science, I wanted to pursue my higher education in the same field.
There were approximately 40 students in my course.
Each and every faculty was at least a PhD with a minimum of 5 years of experience.
The teaching method was according to all the student types considering that all might not be extraordinary.
Class tests are regular. For each subject, there was a monthly assignment or a class test. Then there were mid-semester exams and end-semester exams. Since the entire syllabus was already covered in the class, it was not much difficult to pass with good marks.

Name: Ramprakash kushwaha
review: The fees are good compared to other colleges. The fee of my course is 60000/ yr which can be more for a lower class students but the college also provides scholarship benefits to all the students who have less income. Also college provides the govt post matric scholarship for the students of SC ST and OBC. Although the fees must be less as compared to the current fee structure. The overall fee structure is good for another course also.The overall campus life is good for students and faculty.  Every year in the month of April a cultural fest is done where different types of dance, sports activities etc are done. The classroom is well-equipped with lights and fans. There is also a library where all course books are available and also some story books are available. There are also many clubs such as sports, cultural, tech club

Name: Priyanshu Charan
review: the campus was spacious and lush green though lacked many modern art infra facilities. as being part of DU colleges there were many fests organised by departments and the union. college library had most of the books required by the students and about the sports infra the college had its own sports club and various sports meets were organised by the dept, overall the campus social life  was pretty goodthere is a dedicated placement cell in the college that helps students in getting placed in various companies like Deloitte , KPMG and other finance-related companies, students avg placements ranges around 3-4lpa though the placements were strictly restriced for commerce students which was one of the biggest drawbacks of the college

Name: Aashish Gupta
review: In  NIMS there are three professional course like BBA BCA and BHM. NIMS faculty member are very supportive and cooperative they help each and every student to clear  their doubts. Every year 2 sem exams are conducted by makaut and every month mock test for students.NIMS provides the best campus life for students they can have fun with their friends and make good memories. The campus life of NIMS  has very positive vibes. In college, many annual fests are also organised for students and sports so that students can show their skills. Clubs are also available in this college for students.

Name: Shreyash Asati
review: DU colleges are famous for their social life and exposure for a student and that's true, one you visit the college campus there is a different vibe you get and there are many opportunities provided by different clubs and societies to showcase your skills and enhance them.The course curriculum was updated according to industrial needs, and most of the professors are PhD graduates and are suitable for the standard of DU. Exams are conducted on a timely basis while Datesheet is released 2-3 months before the exams.

Name: Harshit
college: Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Khalsa College - [SGTB]
review:

Name: Manish Gupta
review: There are many kinds of annual fests. they conduct in the month of march and April which is related to sports. The campus environment is so cool you won't regret it. A library is there for all the students and for this you should have an entry pass which is free of cost. classrooms are hygienic and so space is there to sit and the sheets are so comfortable. The sports faculty is out of college which is nearby college and there are many kinds of sports teachers and sports you like to play. No clubbing.I chose this course as per my interest in political science. further, it depends on you. The student ration is high there are too many students in this faculty both of genders male and female. The teaching method is good teachers come at the time. There was only one final exam when I was there. now semesters are there and it is not that difficult to pass.

Name: Uday Singhal
review:
DTU has a huge campus spread over 190 acres. The infrastructure is old but top-class. The labs and library are huge. All kinds of books are available in the library.  DTU has a chill life... there are fests every month conducted by different societies. 
* YUVAAN, The annual film and literature festival 
* INVICTUS, the tech fest
* ENGIFEST, the cultural fest
They are conducted over a span of 10 days in February.  In 2023, the fest was conducted from 10th Feb to 19th Feb.  Social life is good here. There are cafes in the nearby place.  There are a lot of groups and societies here in DTU.. the UGV team, AUV team, cultural council, and so many more
There is a huge sports complex with cricket, football, basketball, lawn tennis, and volleyball fields. There is one huge indoor complex with a badminton court, table tennis and pool table Classrooms are well-ventilated and lit up, and there are projectors in every class.At my college, DTU, the annual fee for btech is approx 2.3 lakhs
1st year- 2.19 lakh 2nd year- 2.26 lakh
3rd year - 2.37 lakh 4th year - 2.46 lakh
There has been a fee hike. A few years back..the cost of the study was barely 50k per annum but now it's almost 5× The on-campus internship season starts when you give the final exams of 2nd year(or of 4th semester). A lot of companies take interviews on the college campus and students get stipends as high as 2 lakhs per month. Most companies provide PPO. (pre-placement offer) to their high-performing interns. The student completed his btech degree and can directly work for the company at an earlier discussed package.

Name: Hrithik Raj
review:
The placements here are very good and its the key feature of this college. If with so many students intake the avg package of this college is at par with many iits.All the companies that visit IIT DELHI come to this college and the avg package of cs branch is 25lpa+. companies like google, microsoft, amazon, Atlassian, apple, come here for placements, the highest package of year 2021-2022 was 1.8 cr and avg package of the college was 15.6 and avg package of the cs branch was 25lpa+. the placement % is also good in top branches like 95% students get placed in this college also 5% left dont get becase they go for higher studies.The college life here in DTU is the most interesting part here people here are very genuine they are very friendly. The college is very beautiful to roam around and there is no strict rules or curfew timing for boys ( for girls its 11 pm) 
 The annual fest of DTU is ENGIFEST its 3rd best fest after IIT DELHI and IIT BOMBAY.
The library here is very great and clubs and societies here are also good you get a lot of free time here. you hardly have 3 classes a day.
You can follow your passion easily here if you have any.
sports and extracurricular activities are good but the gym here is a bit small for so many students.

Name: SHIVAM
review: Campus life is awesome there are many fests or we can say DTU is full of fests in the month of Feb our annual fest manifest happens every year and our tech fest Innova is in the same week wow the vibe was awesome for a whole week. Name: Vasudev
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review:
The fees are decent but they take all one-year fees at the time of admission. The college provides scholarships for brilliant students aktu which is Abdul kalam technical university. The college has many sports such cricket, hockey, basketball and many other indoor games also.
The tournament is also organized.

Name: Krish
review:
Students get full time placement opportunities in fourth year. However internship opportunities come in the second and third year. Every big mnc like google,amazon, microsoft ,flipkart,apple come here for recruitment. Over 400 companies come for recruitment.
In 2022 the average placement was about 16 lpa for entire college and 25 lpa in cse branch. Record placements were seen in  2022. Number of offers were close to 2400 approx and almost all the students(about 90percent) were placed who appeared for placements in 2022. 
Highest international package was about 1.15 crore which was offered to 15 students form amazon dublin. Highest domestic package was 65 lpa given by apple. 

My plan is to get a tech( full stack devloper) job with a decent package in any of these companies.

However placement opportunities are really great, i feel that due to huge competition in dtu beacuse of large student strength, it becomes really competitive to get that dream package of above 40 lpa.College life at dtu is the best.
Our annual cultural fest is engifest. It is the biggest fest in north india. It is conducted in month of February. It is one of the best experience in our college to attend engifest . This time around sunidhi chouhan, amit trivedi and kaleshi chori guys came in our engifest and they just made the atmosphere crazy.

Library of DTU includes every book and journal which student needs. Students can go to library at any time during day and study in a peace environment. The infrastructure of the Library is very good.

The classrooms for first year students in the pragya bhawan are very good. But apart from that classrooms are not that up to the marks. They are older and don't have ac.

Sports facilities in the college are decent. There is gym , sports complex as well as big grounds for playing sports. Various inter and intra college sports competition are organised.

There are a lot of student societies in dtu for every damn interest.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Students after 6th semester are eligible for the placements
there are 172 companies visiting in college every year.
There are every type of company visits in college like a mass recruiter -
Mass recruiter made offers - 20-30
Normal recruiter - 5-8
big tech companies like apple Microsoft - 1-3
The highest package for the tech profile - is 1.25 Cr or USD 207750 and avg package for the tech profile is 14-18 LPA

2nd year - 206000(tuition fee-64250 ; university fee-80250 ; remaining extra services and charges)
3rd year - 219000(tuition fee -69575; university fee - 86275 ; remaining extra services and charges)
4th year - 229000(tuition fee- 73000; university fee - 73000 ; remaining extra services and charges)

there is financial assistance to the students of the university pursuing higher education - chattra vittiya sahayata exam protsahan kosh (CVSPK)
College provides placement and internships also
I got job in E&Y

Name: Shanu Shamana
college: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University
review:
The fee structure is not too heavy. The semester fee is usually about 8000 including the hostel. Extra fees have to be paid for food. All the seats are entirely based on ICAR rank and the outer state students are granted National talent scholarship NTS. That's about 3000 per month for ug and 5000 per month for PG. And the Bihar students are awarded a scholarship of 2000 per month and an extra 6000 per year for the purchasing of books.
The placements include different NGOs like JEEVIKA, Pradan and so on. Most of the students have excelled in the ICAR JRF examination and last year the 1 and 3rd ranks were from our college... And 14 students are studying in the top fisheries institute of the country CIFE. And 2 of the have archived Erasmus Mundus international scholarship and are now pursuing their post-graduation in the UK.Most of the students passing out from here have chosen to for master's degree and those who haven't gone are well placed in some companies or in Govt jobs like FEO, AFO, FI and so on.
My plans after the degree are, of course, to gather master's degree in Fish processing technology (FPT) since it is very much interesting and includes food processing which has a great future.

Name: Shanu Shamana
college: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University
review:
The fee structure is not too heavy. The semester fee is usually about 8000 including the hostel. Extra fees have to be paid for food. All the seats are entirely based on ICAR rank and the outer state students are granted National talent scholarship NTS. That's about 3000 per month for ug and 5000 per month for PG. And the Bihar students are awarded a scholarship of 2000 per month and an extra 6000 per year for the purchasing of books.
The placements include different NGOs like JEEVIKA, Pradan and so on. Most of the students have excelled in the ICAR JRF examination and last year the 1 and 3rd ranks were from our college... And 14 students are studying in the top fisheries institute of the country CIFE. And 2 of the have archived Erasmus Mundus international scholarship and are now pursuing their post-graduation in the UK.Most of the students passing out from here have chosen to for master's degree and those who haven't gone are well placed in some companies or in Govt jobs like FEO, AFO, FI and so on.
My plans after the degree are, of course, to gather master's degree in Fish processing technology (FPT) since it is very much interesting and includes food processing which has a great future.

Name: Manoj shivagange
college: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management - [ABVIIITM]
review:
I chose Btech Mtech in IT because I am interested in a career in the computer science sector. The course curriculum is quite relaxed and to the point. In IIIT Gwalior, we don't have common subjects in the first year. They directly start with advantageous core subjects. DSA starts in the second semester itself. Faculty all have PhDs and are qualified. They teach using lecture slides and solving questions on the board. The quality of faculty and teaching method is on par with other colleges. The student ratio depends on batch, it's somewhere between 60-120.
Exams happen exactly as per the schedule and are fairly easy to pass. Studying one night before the exam is enough to pass, given that the student has attended some of the classes. There is a 75% attendance criteria that Some lectures strictly follow.Feb./march. There is a decent number of books available in the library. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and have one or two projectors. There is a sports complex with a swimming pool, 4 badminton courts, a few table tennis tables, 2 squash courts, 3 tennis courts, etc. There are many clubs run by the students such as the recreation/ journalism club(utthan), Rotaract, IEEEE student club, GDSC, AASF, etc. The only drawback is the limited student intake. This means everything here happens on a smaller scale.

I choose this course for gaining knowledge and also it will help me in networking with other people, the student is medium. The faculty members were very qualified.
The term exam was an easy way to pass the exam, but their teaching was very solid.The fee structure was different for all students, it was category-wise different SC, ST, OBC, and GEN. So, my fees were very high compared to other friends.
Government scholarship was available, but based on certain family income.

Name: Khyati Priya
review:
I have done my 12th in mathematics physics chemistry later I chose BA as from childhood Pol was one of my favorites Choosing it was great. 
As it helps me to be socio-political aware and helps me in a better experience to be world it feels great to be knowing the past and seeing improvement in the present.
All the teachers are MA and Ph.D. holders.The friend group totally depends upon you and Delhi University is well known for its fest and campus life it provides a lot of variety and makes you a dynamic human, The surrounding of the college is great as it is located in the Centre of South Delhi near Malviya nagar it has metro at walking distance which is 200 meter.

Name: Aadit
review:
The library of SBSC is really diverse, it includes books from many disciplines like literature, maths, politics, etc. And there are 2 floors of the library which provide a good environment for studying or any other important work.
We have 20+ societies in our college which you can join by clearing the audition rounds.The course curriculum is good there have been a lot of changes in the curriculum because of NEP and the faculty is too good they are all very well educated from IITs.     
I choose this course because I wanted to study maths in college, it is not difficult to pass exams if you study.

Name: Pratik
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review: I have chosen B.Tech because I want to become a software engineer. I have also applied for admission by counseling and I have taken the AIML branch which is an emerging branch. All faculties are very nice, few are strict but they have very nice teaching style and experience. Almost all of them have completed their Ph.D. And the ratio is about 20 students per teacher. Per month there are sessional exams and 1 month is completely for semester exams and half month goes for internal and external exams.I am right now in semester 4. So I have not made any projects and I have not taken any internships from any companies but we will get an internship form next semester and we have to make a project this year we have planned to make a handwriting recognition project which will work on ai.

Name: SIMRAN SINGH
review: Economics honors is a very rigorous course and involves a lot of math including calculus. The economics department of Ramjas has excellent faculty who have doctorates from prestigious colleges like the Delhi school of economics, ISI, and JNU. There are 20 marks for internals which can be conducted by the faculty at any time. Further, 75 marks are for externals that are conducted at the end of the semester. Lastly, there are 5 marks for attendance and anyone having more than 85% attendance is given full 5 marks. The internals conducted my the teachers of Ramjas were more difficult than the external exams conducted by the university at the end of the semester.Because Ramjas is located on the North campus, there are a lot of opportunities for students to socialize. Ramjas has societies like Enactus, placement cell, backbeat- the singing society, Melange- the art and craft society, woodcraft- the writing society, entrepreneurship cell, consulting society, and the MUN society. There are 3 types of fests- the college fest, the fest of different societies, and the fest of various societies. Most of these happen in the months of Jan-Feb. Ramjas also has a big ground and a gym for sports.

Name: Vamsi Vardhan
review:
There is one technical and one cultural fest every year and also a sports fest once every two years. The technical fest's name is SUDHEE and the Cultural fest's name is SHRUTHI. The sports fest's name is AURA.
College has a very big library that helps students to access several books for learning many things. 
The classrooms are good, they've got projectors for learning, not air-conditioned but fans are there.
Sports fests are there SHRUTHI not only a cultural but also inter-branch tournaments will be conducted among the departments.
Many clubs and social groups are there in CBIT  which not only deal with the development of skills and knowledge but also make everyone habituated to socializing and supporting social activities.Hardware growth has been increasing faster than in the previous 10 years. Now there's a great demand for hardware improvement technology in the Electronics department. Hence ECE is the best option to go with. Faculty is good, they help each student to excel in their life. Every faculty that comes to teach has had a good experience and they've done their doctorates in reputed universities. Exams were not that tough you can easily score if you keep up with your listening in class and understand the concepts taught.

Name: Harvinder
review:
55000 is an annual fee. The cost of the study is so much, college is so expensive but the facilities are very good. 
I apply for the UP scholarship but unfortunately due to the unavailability of funds, I could not find a scholarship. NSP Scholarships can be applied.The library is very big. All books and magazines are available. 
The classrooms are beautiful and the infrastructure is very good.
All sports are available and a big playground. 
Our classroom has a social group in which we discuss our daily class routine.

Name: Lakshika Sharma
review:
The annual fest of Kamala Nehru College is "Ullaas" it happens every year in Feb.-March.
This year it's happening on the 25th-26th of march.
There is a society called NSS for the sports in the college in which there are various sports like basketball football etc. and for extracurricular, there are various societies in the commerce department.Commerce subject has always been my field of interest. My 1st preference was economic honors but the cut-offs were too high to get into a good college so I choose my 2nd preference B.Com honors which is great too. Also, I am planning to go for an MBA post-graduation so I thought it was a feasible option and subject.

college: Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Khalsa College - [SGTB]

The faculty in the college is really good, all the professors are very helpful and they are extremely qualified. Exams in this university are a kind of mixed feelings like they are not hard to pass but are extremely hard to score good marks.Life on the campus is amazing, there are so many society fests, cultural fests, and all. Musical fests go on in the college like every few months. Studies are also good. And sports in this college are on a different level altogether. There's a cricket team, a basketball team, a volleyball team, and more.

review:

Moreover, we have a very good environment to study in.
The student-to-teacher ratio is very good.

Name: PREKSHA JAIN
review: I always wanted to pursue something creative and it felt like the right choice considering all my other options at that time. But I would recommend everyone to do their research properly before going for any course. The faculty is knowledgeable and well-qualified. For 36 students we have 4 faculty and the rest are visiting faculty. The term exams are fairly easy to pass and happen on a timely basis.Students in PG become eligible in the third sem. Major companies are Aravind mills, satva consulting, Myntra, target, Aditya Birla, etc. The average package is 4 lac and the highest is 10-12 lacs. Students can get into visual design, brand management, graphic design, UI UX design, trend forecaster, etc. I plan on getting a job and working as a UI UX designer.

Name: Abhisek Dash
review: I wanted to have a career related to nature and the environment so I choose this course. It's a 3 years course where the total number of students is nearly 100 and the total faculties are 12. Teachers are well qualified to have P. HD degrees and also honored with fellowships. There are 2 midterms and 1 final paper every semester and it's quite easy to pass the exam if u only study attentively and are punctual with your assignments provided.There are a lot of groups currently run by the aluminates of the department along with the current group of students. There is a club called M. Tech Students Society (MSS) where seniors and teachers help in grooming new students in every way as he is a future officer. The library is big and helps provide all the books.

Name: Sanskrati
review: I am doing my bachelor's in the field of life sciences, which includes zoology, botany, and chemistry why I chose this course because it is very vast, and as I was interested in the research field it provides all of this. The faculty is very good, all of them have done Ph.D. in their fields and the teaching method is based on a practical approach.Campus life is very interesting and fun. We have a lot of things going on our campus almost every day. The annual fest of Gargi, college reverie is one of the best fests in DU. We also have a departmental fest for each department.

Name: Rasleen Kaur
review: The average package provided by University is 5 lakh. The companies' names are TCS, Accenture, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, etc. The highest package offered to students is 15-20 lakh. Mostly every student who gets a good offer will leave the university. The placement department members are very nice.The library is well-maintained and neat and clean. Every type of book any course book is available in the library and placed in well maintained in the library. Sports grounds are well maintained and neat and clean with the best coach facility. Different fests take place throughout the year.

Name: Chandra kiran
review: My college is full of nature and the environment and we can sit and discuss in nature. Wherever we go on campus, we can observe nature everywhere. My college is better than compared to other colleges. We all participate in clubs that are conducted by college management.I came to this college with an Eamcet rank. So, I got a scholarship from the government. But I know how much amount for non-scholars and management students. For Non- scholarship students the fees will be around 60000 per year. And For management, it is up to college.

Name: Rajeev Ranjan Kumar
review:
There are so many tech fests held in our college just like tech fest, the annual fest they are conducted on time.
Our library has the best on our campus all types of books available in our college.
Our college has conducted sports and extracurriculars every year.
Yes, our college has its own social media group on Instagram and is run by our college students.We choose this course because best in college and academics.
Our faculty at this college is so good and very intelligent.
Qualifications of our faculty are Ph.D. holders and our faculty is very smart.
Yes, our college has conducted exams very timely.

Name: Abhigyan Rajanshul
review:
The only reason for taking CSE was just my love for computers and I want to be a game developer so I selected this one.
If I talk about faculty there are more than 30 faculty and if you talk about the faculty-student ratio then it will be nearly 1:50.
The faculty are appointed through the BPSE exam and everyone is gate qualified and well knowledged and in comparison to others, they have a very good teaching method.It's Bihar engineering college and there are not too many tech fests as our infrastructure is not developed.
And there is a central library where you will get books which are necessary for a semester and daily newspapers in Hindi and English.
If I talk about classes then it's fully organized. For sitting there are benches and the teacher taught us on the blackboard, every class has 4 fans.

Name: Mohit kumar
college: Indus Institute of Technology and Management - [IITM]
review:
The fee hike policy is somewhat good if you can't able to submit your fees you can write an application to the HOD or counselor to take time to submission of college fees.
The name of the scholarship is the UP scholarship and the scholarship given by the UP government to students. The financial assistance and job you got on campus and the stipend is depends on your performance.I choose this course because here the seat at CSE are available so the reason of choose it.
The faculty is good.
The qualification of faculty is Ph.D. and MTech and others according to their expertise.
The exam terms are first mid-term exams and after that PUT exams and final.

Name: Ishika Agarwal
review: An annual fest has been organized every year by the college known as flames. The college library contains every book related to the course. The library also has books containing knowledge of doctors.  The classrooms are too big, and the sports facilities of the college are fewer.The fees of this college is lower as compared to other colleges. Fees hike around 10 to 20% every year. The cost to study in the first year is around 24000. The scholarship is granted on the basis of the financial condition of the family or the basis of caste.

Name: Anshika Choudhary
review: The overall crowd is good and the students are friendly. We usually have our annual fest Kaalrav in the month of March or April. We have all the needed books in our library free of cost for all the students. Having big Fully furnished and well-maintained classrooms with AC. Having many social clubs as per the interest of students. But sports facilities are not up to the mark.I had a keen interest in chemistry but don't want to opt for honors courses so I go for BSc in physical science with chemistry. In our chemistry department, there are around 45-50 girls and an equal ratio of boys as well. Our faculty is well-educated and experienced as well. For term exams, one must go through the previous year's papers along with class notes.

Name: Kasam Saikiran
review: I have chosen this course in order to learn about artificial intelligence and data science. The faculty here would be keen enough to have a look their students. They are well-educated and experienced. Exams here sometimes seem difficult to pass but major times it's easy.The infrastructure is little poor. And talking about campus life, they merely arrange fests and cultural activities. As a stressed student you would be very anxious about the fests but it happens merely. Books can be taken from the library and returned at the given time.

Name: Aman Jain
review:
Campus life is not that good, the reason behind this is because the whole campus is not too big and it comprises of 4 colleges which make the crowd somewhat mixed. The annual tech fest is Gandharv which happens in February every year. 
The library is there for all kinds of books but they are outdated.
Classrooms are well-ventilated.
There are many cells in different domains which are very active and organize different activities.I chose CSE because I wanted to pursue my career in DevOps and Cloud.
For our Department, the ratio is 10:1 which is not that bad.
Most of the professors have done masters and some even PhDs.
There are CIE, SCE, ISE, ESE, and TW for overall semester-wise marks distribution. It's not that hard to pass the semester, one should be consistent. The difficulty is also medium and rests depends on the subject.

Name: Stuti Diwakar
review:
Lakshya is the annual Edu-Tech Festival of L.D. College of Engineering.
IRADA - FUN EVENTS, a college festival. Club of LDCE: Robocon, Vox populi, Innovator, IEEE, Coders club, Rotaract club, NSS, NCC, Prakalpa, SAE, FOSS Mind place and Adventure.LD College of Engineering is a government college that's the reason that fees are minimal and affordable.
You can get a mysy scholarship or a digital Gujarat scholarship. ( if eligible).
In LD college of engineering, placement is very good.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I am pursuing B.Tech (Computer science and engineering). For the general category, CSE closes at around 22-23k AIR in JEE Main. For me, the curriculum of this branch is slightly easier to understand and also, CSE has the highest placements with an average of about 12-14 LPA, and almost all students of CSE get placed. Overall, the average package ranges between 8-9 LPA. Faculties of every department are well qualified (almost all are Ph.D. holders) and they are experts in their fields, there are different teachers to teach different topics of the same sub. We have 2 mid-semester exams and 1 end-semester exam for each semester. Mid-semesters are held after every 3 months and the end semester is taken every 6 months. To pass the exams, you just need to focus on whatever is taught in the class, passing the exams is not a big deal but you have to maintain at least 75% attendance in the class to appear for the exams except that if you have a medical emergency, then min. 60% of attendance is required.Life at the campus is pretty decent. There is a central library on the main campus equipped with all the books that you will need for your program (there are no comics!). Classes are equipped with smart boards and fans, lecture halls are equipped with normal blackboards and air conditioners. Various sub-councils in HBTU take care of various clubs for your personality development. The sports sub-council frequently organizes various sports tournaments like cricket, badminton, volleyball, and many more in which anyone can participate after the screening. Then there is ASCPC (Alumni Student Connect Program Committee) which is dedicated to organizing different events like alumni meetings etc. in the college. The link for information regarding all the clubs is:-    https://hbtu.in/club
We have various events and fests like Aarambh, ChemCon, Adhyaay, etc. held every year, these fests are tech-oriented with some fun and cultural program.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I am pursuing B.Tech (Computer science and engineering). For the general category, CSE closes at around 22-23k AIR in JEE Main. For me, the curriculum of this branch is slightly easier to understand and also, CSE has the highest placements with an average of about 12-14 LPA, and almost all students of CSE get placed. Overall, the average package ranges between 8-9 LPA. Faculties of every department are well qualified (almost all are Ph.D. holders) and they are experts in their fields, there are different teachers to teach different topics of the same sub. We have 2 mid-semester exams and 1 end-semester exam for each semester. Mid-semesters are held after every 3 months and the end semester is taken every 6 months. To pass the exams, you just need to focus on whatever is taught in the class, passing the exams is not a big deal but you have to maintain at least 75% attendance in the class to appear for the exams except that if you have a medical emergency, then min. 60% of attendance is required.Life at the campus is pretty decent. There is a central library on the main campus equipped with all the books that you will need for your program (there are no comics!). Classes are equipped with smart boards and fans, lecture halls are equipped with normal blackboards and air conditioners. Various sub-councils in HBTU take care of various clubs for your personality development. The sports sub-council frequently organizes various sports tournaments like cricket, badminton, volleyball, and many more in which anyone can participate after the screening. Then there is ASCPC (Alumni Student Connect Program Committee) which is dedicated to organizing different events like alumni meetings etc. in the college. The link for information regarding all the clubs is:-    https://hbtu.in/club
We have various events and fests like Aarambh, ChemCon, Adhyaay, etc. held every year, these fests are tech-oriented with some fun and cultural program.

Name: Harshdeep Singh
review:
The fee structure of my college is 82,00,00 per semester. The fee includes tuition fees, examination fees, and other miscellaneous charges. The fee structure is designed to cover the cost of providing quality education to the students and maintaining the infrastructure of the college.
The fee is payable in two installments, one at the beginning of the semester and the other at the midpoint of the semester. The fee payment can be done online or offline mode. The college also provides various payment options such as payment in installments or payment through loans.
The fee structure is determined by the college administration, and it may vary for different courses and programs. The fee structure is revised annually to account for inflation and other factors that affect the cost of providing education.
The college provides various scholarship and financial aid programs to support deserving students who are unable to pay the full fee. The scholarship programs are based on merit.The campus and college environment of my college is excellent. The college is spread over a vast area, providing a spacious and green campus to the students. The campus is well-maintained and equipped with modern facilities such as air-conditioned classrooms, well-stocked libraries, and computer labs.
The college environment is conducive to learning and personal development. The college encourages diversity and inclusivity, and students from different backgrounds and cultures are welcomed with open arms. The college has a strict anti-ragging policy, ensuring a safe and healthy environment for the students.
The college also promotes co-curricular and extracurricular activities, providing ample opportunities for the students to explore their interests and hobbies. The college has various clubs and societies, such as literary clubs, music clubs, and sports clubs, where students can showcase their talent and skills.

review:

Name: Dwight S
review: I choose automation and robotics engineering in the mechanics department because this stream was new in Amritapuri, Kollam. review:

Name: Madhur
college: Dr. Akhilesh Das Gupta Institute of Technology & Management - [ADGITM]
review: Student to faculty ratio is around 1:60. I choose this branch because only cs and it was having guaranteed placements. Placements of other branches are usually low around 40-50 per cent. review: Companies for internships and placements start coming in the month of July. Overall placement is good. If one will study hard they will definitely get a good placement. review:

Name: Kanika wadhwa
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review: I choose this course as I believed there is high scope for this course in the near future as well as with changing times and technology one needs to be updated about events beforehand. In my college, the ratio is about 1:50 as there are many PhD students who also help you a lot in achieving your goals and setting a vision in life. Seniors guide you to the best of their knowledge. Qualification of the teachers is at such a level that one cannot believe that they have rejected a higher pay due to their busy work schedule and accepted the offer by my college. Mid Term and end term and the 2 exams that are conducted in a particular semester and the ease of the exam depends upon the students if attending each and every class then the examination is not a problem but if not attended classes the student can still cope up if she/he manages to study one week before the exam. For the mid-term 1 week beforehand and the end term 1 month beforehand preparation is more than sufficient.There are many companies that come to our college and offer placement and internship opportunities to many students few of the companies that come on-campus and recruit students include Google, Microsoft, Uber, Adobe, Amazon, Arista Networks, Palo Alto Networks they offer internships upto 1-1.15 lakhs and placement upto 40-50 lakh per annum. Apart from coding rounds, they take technical interviews and HR interviews for selection. Students are shortlisted on the basis of coding rounds and interviews and also resume selection is one of the most important criteria. Resumes should include the best projects example game development projects, app development projects, AI-ML projects, and Ar-Vr projects that boost our resume. An example website made can be added. One important aspect of LinkedIn and GitHub are major that one has to use in college in order to get better connections and a good social network.

Name: Ayyappachowdary Jasti
review: When we compared to other groups our group fees are low and the cost to study in this college is affordable to all students however the government is implementing some scholarships for college students. the scholarship name is Jagan anna vidhaya deevena and I'm in 3rd year still i didn't get a job with a stipendI choose this course because I want to be an Agriculture officer. overall the faculty is good but some improvement is needed. The qualification of the staff is Post Graduate and their teaching method is better than I expected. there are months between semester to semester and it what difficult to pass the exams

Name: Shruten Radadiya
review: I have a lot of interest in hardware and coding on both sides. So I chose Electronics and communication engineering. In our college faculty to student ratio is 1:20. Our all facilities are very talented and well-experienced. Many of them completed their PhD degree. There are two exams per sem, one is mid sem and the other is the GTU exam. These exams are moderate.Our college organizes many events like IRADA by the innovator club and LAKSHYA by the robocop club. They are so popular in our college. Our college has a big library too. There are also so many sports events too and there are so many cultural and innovative events so that students can develop their skills.

review: Fees are good for tuition fees, but for hostel fee, is equal to the tuition fee and the food will be not up to the mark to spend 85k for a hostel. review: The annual fest of the college and the university is conducted separately, the college annual fest is conducted after the end-term exams and the university fest is conducted in the month of March, this can be changed as well, classrooms are just normal, there opportunities of sports and extracurricular activities in the campus. Name: SNEHA MAURYA
review: Campus Life of IILM University is really good. Good thing is that IILM is not overcrowded. It have kept it's student intake limited and refined. This helps students develop a very friendly and cooperative environment. The crowd is very diverse with students coming from Jammu and Kashmir to Tamil Nadu. All kind of diversity is accepted and appreciated on campus. There is nothing like ragging here at all. Ignite is our annual fest and it is celebrated like a festival. It is conducted every year in March. There are 2 big libraries on campus filled with a lot of books. All the classrooms are very well equipped with excellent infrastructure. There is a lot of scopes for students to have sports spirit. There are 2 badminton courts, 1 football court, 1 basketball court, 1 volleyball court, 1 handball court, a big ground to play cricket, etc. Other than this a lot of social groups are available at University, like a debate club, coding club, mechatronics club, sports club, etc.The fee structure of IILM University is moderate I would say. BTech CSE have 1.5L fee per year structure and BTech IBM have 2L fee per year structure. This also includes the 30k program fee which is for certifications, books, events etc. Fee structure of hostel is also fine as compared to other colleges. IILM University offers both 3-sharing and non-sharing hostel facilities. Non-sharing hostel's fees per year are 85k while the 3-sharing hostel's fees per year are 60k. Other than this there is the monthly payment option for mees which is 4200/month. Every student is given a scholarship on tuition fees based on their 12th-class scores. Students scoring above 85% get 20% of scholarships and students scoring above 90% Get 60% of scholarships. A lot of stipend-based internships are also given to students which can help them develop financial independence. Faculty members of the admission team are always very helpful and ready to help you with all kind of issues.

review: Campus Life of IILM University is really good. Good thing is that IILM is not overcrowded. It have kept it's student intake limited and refined. There will be two mid-exams and final exams these will be easy if you study. It will average the exam.The percentage of students getting placed is growing as compared to the previous year and the student placed is around 80 per cent there will be many companies coming to the college for campus interviews. And many will join in campus placements. But few of them do ms in the USA after the BTech for better opportunities.

Name: Robin gautam
review:
We have mainly 4 actively functioning clubs in our college which are photografica, abhivyakti, avikrit and magma house. 
In terms of infrastructure wise, our college lacks behind as it has only 7 to 8 acres of campus. It's sufficient but if you compare it to any top private colleges then it's small.
Social life is very amazing in this college as we have activities twice in one semester where we have many activities.As our college is very new so no batch has been placed till now. We will see placement from next year when our seniors will be placed. But I can say that our college has one of the best placement cells and they prepare students according to the market requirements.
So if I have to guess the average package for next year I would around 4.5 LPA will be the average package.

Name: Usman
review:
The particular set of skills taught in this course will be in high demand in the coming future and that will help me to get my aspired job.
One teacher handles a class of 50 to 70 students.
The faculty members are well qualified.
The exams are also very easy if you are attentive in class.Ethnic day and kalajyoti are the big events happening every year in the college and many more fests regularly happen inside the campus.
There are more than 50000 books and more than 30000 e-books available for students in each library.

Name: PARTHIV MISHRA
review:
The campus is small, with not too much space to roam around but still campus life is good.
Annual fest is 8th mile but it won't happen annually, Esummit happens almost after every year which is also a good fest.
Fests are conducted after every 2-3 months, small or big doesn't matter.
Enough books are available in the library to make use of it.
The classroom contains a smart board and is good for a student kind of environment.
The sports culture is pretty good as uk Anil Kumble and lots of other sports personalities are from RVCE.
Ecell, RAAG, Rotaract, coding club, Alap etc. are some of the clubs.7th sem students are eligible for campus placement. Placements are better than lots of NITs and almost all the government colleges.
Average placement is >14 LPA this year for the ISC department and >8 LPA for IEM 
Deloitte, Capgemini, Mercedes Benz, Microsoft, Volvo etc. are some companies visit our college.
No. Of offers are maximum >250 for ECE department.
The highest Package is nearly 88 LPA this year
Almost all the students are placed in IEM.
I may prefer MBA as I'm already studying management at IEM.

Name: Sameeksha Ahlawat
review: I chose this course because of the high scope of computer science in the coming years. Good programmers are in demand. The first semester has a class size of around 120 students. The faculty and teachers are highly equipped with excellent methods to make our learning process convenient. Just appeared for midterms, and I have to say that the overall difficulty level was average. If a student is determined, he/she can score enough to get a good GPA.Students are eligible for Campus placements in 3rd year. But students can also get internships from 2nd year itself. Students of our university have been placed at some of the highest-paying companies like Google, Microsoft, and Infosys. The highest package was 32.16 LPA. Students should make sure to maintain an 8+ cgpa and should also learn a skill to be noticed by the companies

Name: Prateek Bhatt
review:
I found the law course curriculum to be quite comprehensive and well-structured. It covered a wide range of legal topics, from contract law to criminal law, and provided a good balance of theoretical and practical knowledge. The faculty members were also very knowledgeable and experienced, and they brought a lot of real-world expertise to the classroom.

Pros:

Comprehensive curriculum that covers a wide range of legal topics
Faculty members who are knowledgeable and experienced
Practical focus that emphasizes real-world legal issues

Cons:
Some of the readings and assignments could be quite dense and time-consuming
The workload can be quite heavy at times, which can be challenging for some students
I chose this course because I have always been interested in the law and the legal system. I wanted to gain a deeper understanding of how the law works, and how it can be used to protect people's rights and interests.
Life at the law campus was quite enjoyable, with a good balance of academic and social activities. There were plenty of opportunities to get involved in clubs and extracurricular activities, and the campus infrastructure was generally quite good.

Pros:

Vibrant social life with plenty of clubs and activities to get involved in
Well-equipped library with a wide range of books and journals
Modern classrooms with good amenities and technology
Diverse range of sports and extracurricular activities on campus
Social groups and clubs run by students
Cons:

The campus could be quite crowded at times, which could make it difficult to find quiet study spaces
Some of the facilities could be a bit outdated or in need of renovation
The law campus hosted several annual events, seminars and Moot courts

The library was well-stocked with a wide range books covering Philosophy, law and politics.

review: Life at our campus is extremely good, in the season of the Navratri campus team organises the Garba festival. In February we celebrate sports week and cultural events. There is a technical event which is very important in our career life as well. The college library is open during college time and you may find any books related to the course.Information technology IT is a very important field in this fast-growing world you can well set up your life in this field.in our college, there are 33 faculty members. The teaching method is good but there's always a lack of practical knowledge. Term exams will be held after every semester.

Name: Ayush
review: Anugoonj is a college fest that happens each year. There are also a lot of tech fests and sports fests that are organised by the management. The library is quite big it has all sorts of books both related to the curriculum and also others. Sports is also an integral part of the college it has a basketball and badminton court as well.Civil engineering companies like Jayprakash associates, JMC construction, and JSW came to the college. They offered roles like Field engineer trainee etc. Various projects are offered where you can parts of something big like hydraulic dams, bridges etc

Name: MD Arsalan
review:
The placement of my college is good, students are eligible after 3rd year and many companies like TCS, and IndiaMART come to campus for recruitment.
The placement wing of my campus is quite active and they do really hard work to bring the company to our campus.
On average 90 per cent of our students get placed.
The average package is 4.2 LPA and the highest is about 12 LPA.I have not got any stipend, or scholarship from this college yet the opportunity for an internship from college is quiet and it should be improved in the upcoming year. 
For UP students many scholarships are available and college also helps them to get a scholarship there is a lot of scholarship for girls students.

Name: Antas Jain
review:
Placements are good and after the 4th-trimester students will be eligible for sitting in the final placements and after the 1st-trimester students will be eligible for the summer internship. Name: Arpan
review:
