There is a big library in University where lakhs of books are present for students and faculty members. The environment is quite good and pleasant for students to focus on studies.The University also organise sports events, quiz competitions and seminars frequently.

Name: Gyan
college: Global Institute of Technology and Management - [GITM]
review: Fees structure for the B.Tech course is 85000 which you have to pay per semester wise and there is no fee hike policy as the fees will remain saturated over the whole duration and you can get a scholarship based on academic intelligence.You get eligible for a job and placement by the end of the 7th semester and you will get an average package of 4-5 lakhs per annum almost 80% of students get placement easily and I will join a good firm after completing my degree.

Name: Vishal Asodia
review: In our college, there are many fest & events that are organized by different-different clubs like adventure club, coders club, FOSS programming club, IEEE Idce, innovator club, mind palace, NSS, SAE Idce, Robocon Ldce, VOX Populi club, track club. these are the clubs that help many students to improve their skills by organizing events. In the month of February rang de event was organized by the NSS club, Sahitya Sarita by Lakshya, LD cricket championship by Rotaract club, etc are organized every year. In the library all kinds of reference books for generally every subject are available. We can issue a book and use it. In every department, some classrooms are having projectors and most of the classrooms is having a capacity of 200 students so everyone can sit comfortably. All the clubs mentioned above are generally run by students and social groups are also there. Various pages on social media are there for spreading the information.I always wanted to become an Engineer and I have an interest in understanding the structures like buildings, bridges, etc., so I have chosen this course as a career. There are 4 to 5 faculties per subject in our department. All the faculties are well qualified and have great knowledge in a particular field and are good at spreading it. All the faculties are very good at teaching and they usually teach us in the bilingual mode so that all the topics could be easy for us to understand. The Mid sem Exams are generally conducted in the 3rd month of the semester and the university exams are conducted at the end of the sem. Generally, one sem is consisting of 5-6 months. The exams are not very hard they are of moderate level and by studying regularly and solving the previous year's question papers one can pass the exams very easily.

Name: Sehaj
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review: See it's a one-time payment every year and the fees are nominal as compared to the rest of the colleges so that's a cool thing yes scholarships were also available and financial assistance might be available as I do not much know about that. My fee for the Course is around 115000 per annum.yes, life is good and there are so many clubs and societies in which we can take part and all those societies have a great impact on our personality development. Sports are also encouraged by them. There are personality development courses also in the college for the students.

Name: Youkti Anand
review: I had an interest in mathematics since childhood and so I opted for this course. The faculty is well-qualified and experienced and very helpful. My batch is of 62 students. The professors are mostly Ph.D. qualified. Some of them have an old-school type teaching style which is understandable whereas many new faculties are very practical in their teaching. The exams happen every 6 months and the exams are a bit on the tougher side. One needs to study the whole semester to pass exams.Manjari is the annual fest of Daulat Ram college which is conducted in march month. Stars are invited to the fest and it is a 2-day fest. Classrooms have all basic amenities such as fans, lights, smart boards, etc. The sports complex is below average. There aren't courts for sports like badminton, volleyball, basketball, etc. Various societies work in college such as NSS, NCC, department societies, DebSoc, etc.

Name: Surojit Bhunia
review:
All of the professors are good at this college. All of them are well qualified and they have done their PhD from well-known institutes. They teach very well in an interactive way. They are very friendly and they also give guidance about higher studies.
There are 2 exams per semester. One is internal and the other is the final semester exam. This college is not an autonomous one but it is under Calcutta university. Internal exams are easy but since it is under CU so final sem exam can be tough, it depends on the university of Calcutta.The cost to study here is fine not very high but opportunities are too low here. There is no scholarship or financial assistance for poor students. But all books are present in the libraries one can get them very easily. I am from the physics department and here no placements are given. I do not know about other departments.

Name: Bhoomika Bhalerao
review:
My motive was clear to gain knowledge and interest in the IT field. So I choose this course.
The faculty of this particular course is very concerned about the students it is quite strict about the attendance of the students.
The teaching method is best, as doubts are cleared on time.
As it is not so difficult to pass the Exam and it was of 2 - 3 hours.The college provides various placements in the companies like TCS, WIPRO, INFOSYS, CAPGEMINI, Etc.
There are internships also held.
Different types of Projects are assigned to the students in the 5th and 6th semesters to build knowledgable experience and be fully confidant.
Which helps them to clarify the queries in the project.

Name: Chirag
review:
I choose this course because of my speciality in computers and future affairs about it 
The faculty was awesome and very nice to teach they are all PhD holders and all are an amazing teacher 
There were 3-time exams in each semester 2 midterms and 1 end terms examsI am from ai branch of BCA that's cost 10000 rs higher than general BCA but it was amazing to choose Ai for future career opportunities helping in finding a good job earlier than any other student Good experience

Name: Shifa saifi
review: I chose this course because I want to get my career in this field only. But this course is not only available for commerce background students, all students from different backgrounds like science and arts can also apply for this course. The faculty of this college is really good and they are very helpful. They are well-educated with a big amount of degrees with them and they are well-experienced in their field of teaching. They have a really good method of teaching their students. The college has a good amount of faculty members for all the students so that no student faces any kind of problem. The exams were also pretty good they give us a good amount of time to finish the exam and they are very lenient with us, they give us logical questions which we can easily understand and pass the exams. The exams are not soo difficult and we can clear them easily.The life on our campus is really very amazing and it is beyond what I expected. Everyone is good, helpful, and friendly on our campus. There are a lot of activities, fest, parties, and competitions that are held in our college. There are a lot of clubs and groups in our college which are run by students and they give us a lot of opportunities.

Name: biswajitsandik
review: Kiit carnival was the recent fest conducted by them and there are many functions and fest undergo every week. the central library is very big you can come and study anytime it is open 24 hours a day. Everything for practical classes is provided by them. there are many sports to be played they provide every kind of extra curriculum activity it depends on you whether you want to participate or not.After 6 semesters students become eligible for campus placement and internship.no of companies visited like amazon, Wipro, Mahindra, TCS, Infosys, etc. highest package to date is 62 lahks per annum and the average CTC is 7.2 lakh.90% of students gets placed my plan after the degree is for higher studied from foreign universities.

Name: Kumar
college: St Ann's College of Engineering and Technology - [SACET]
review:
There will be one annual fest and one farewell in our college.
The annual fest is for freshers and seniors. All together will celebrate this.
But farewell is for seniors only.
Being a low-rated college, we don't celebrate many functions in our college.
Our college Management gives importance to sports also but studies are the main.
No social groups and clubs are being run by students.I chose the computer science and engineering course because it has good scope in the future in the software field.
There will be a 1:20 faculty ratio in our college.
Some of the faculty are Ph.D. holders and few are mtech degree holders.
The term exams are being conducted by the Andhra Pradesh government.
Term examinations will be hard.
You have to study well and pass.

Name: ritik rahul
review: I choose this course because I m interested in finance. And there are many students in this course. The teachers are very friendly and intelligent. They teach very well and the difficulty of exams is less. The faculty is really qualified and hopeful. They complete the syllabus before hand.The College conducts a talent show for new students. They give opportunities to new students to show their hidden talents. The availability of books is so good in Library we can borrow any book from the library. College conduct every year sports matches and social groups, and election.

Name: Abhishek Kumar Singh
review: From the sixth semester students are eligible for the placements. Many companies get into college like TCS, Wipro,pwc cognizant Accenture Infosys Capgemini, Oracle, and many more. The highest on-campus placement was 27 lakhs per annum and the average is about 4-5lakhs.I took this course B.Tech because, from the very beginning, it was clear that I have to do engineering and have to take the Computer science branch which I took also. As I took admitted in the year 2021 which was during covid me term exams were a bit early.

Name: Saniya Pokhriyal
review:
The infrastructure of the college is satisfactory and provides an auditorium, library, canteen, and sports room. 
The college organizes various events and days for students.
College is motivating students to participate in inter-college events. The overall college atmosphere is good.The placement in our college starts from the 6th semester onwards.
The college tie-up companies for BCA are Capgemini, Wipro, TCS, L&T, and Infosys.
The average package salary of BCA students is around 2 to 3 lakh rupees.
There is 100%placement assistance.

Name: Nishi Thakkar
review:
zesto and umang are the college fest which was held in January.
there are many books available in the library also college provides an online library with lots of books and journals.
many extracurricular activities like dance and sports like kho kho take place on campus and in fact, teachers also motivate you to participate in all activities.
social groups like NSS and NCC are there and the infomania club is there which is run by students.I chose this course because I wanted to go into the IT field. Also after this course, you get many varieties for further studies.
The faculty here is very helpful and down to earth.
they are always ready to solve your doubts and help in bringing out your brighter side.
Teachers here are highly qualified.
Exams are taken on time and all the questions are from what is taught.

Name: Siddharth Hiremath
review:
I want to learn cloud computing and cybersecurity so I came here to learn and I can finish this at a low fee.
Students are more all states students are studying here.
Good facilities are provided here for everyone.
Teachers are well qualified here smart classes every thing.
Every 6 months one sem each sem contains 2internals exams that are strictly and disciplined conduction.Every year they conduct sports fresher's parties and send off parties to the intercollege fest.
The classroom contains projectors and well bench facilities.
We have clubs according to subjects like Kannada English Technical Clubs.
Students are conducting TechOps named Club and they conducting technical events.

Name: Satvik Davar
review:
The annual fest will be conducted in the month of March.
There are a variety of book options by different authors readily available in the library.
There are few amenities in the classroom.
Sports and extracurricular activities are great almost every sport is there and a variety of tournaments are held on the college ground 
Enactus, Finmark, and Women Development cell are the clubs run by students.I chose this course as I had an interest In economics.
The faculty is good, Student ratio is 6:1 for boys: and girls
The teaching method is good, but sometimes they're in a hurry
The term exams were held timely, and in one subject it was difficult to pass.

Name: Prashant Yadav
review:
AIT Pune organises two major annual events namely "Rhapsody and the technical festival "Techlligent".
Rhapsody is a cultural extravaganza that showcases artistic and creative talents. Rhapsody is usually held in the month of February. 
Techlligent is a technical festival that provides a platform for students to showcase their innovations and technical skills. Techlligent is usually held in the month of March.

College has a well-equipped library that provides access to a vast collection of books and other academic resources. The library has a collection of over 1,20,000 books including textbooks, reference books and other academic publications.

There are numerous sports facilities in AIT like pool, squash, badminton, chess, table tennis, foosball, carrom, basketball, football, volleyball, and cricket.

Some of the social groups, clubs are AIT Robotics Club, Adventure Club, Literary Society, Photography Club, Music Club, Coding Club, Sports Club etcI chose the Electronics course because of the college's reputation for providing quality education in engineering. AIT Pune has a strong industry tie-up and collaboration which provides students with ample opportunities for internships, placements and industrial visits.
The faculty-student ratio of AIT Pune is approximately 1:20.
The faculty members are approachable and supportive. They are available to answer questions and provide guidance to students, both inside and outside the classroom.
Term exams are usually held twice a semester. Term exams are typically conducted on time and in accordance with the college's academic calender. While passing exams may require dedication and hard work. It requires consistent effort throughout the academic year. It is not difficult to pass the term exams.

Name: Yash Attal
review:
Fees are high in my personal opinion for the general category.
It would cost around 4,50,000 for a general-category Student to complete his graduation.
Scholarships are provided for other categories by the government and all category students who secure a rank below 10k in the TS-EAMCET entrance exam.
They are around 100-120 companies visited in 2022-2023 which many different placement offers. 
The average placement for CSE-IT students is around 9 LPA.
Highest offer off campus in our college - 1.2cr offered by Amazon(Dublin) to a student of the 2019-23 batch.
The average stipend is around 15k per month.
Placements are fairly good when compared to other colleges.There are 9 different clubs in our college and 3 fests are conducted in a year.
Many different hackathons and coding challenges are conducted.
The library is having a good collection of books.
Classrooms are well organized but require more enhancement.
Sports like basketball, volleyball, badminton, indoor - carrom, and chess are available.
Recurse is a Technical club for techie students which is run by college students itself.

Name: Asmita Arjun gadhire
review:
Firstly, I have chosen BCA because I wanted to know more about computer programming languages, coding, and many more.
Here are BCA department teachers who are very experienced you'll get to learn a lot.
We have been provided with many seminars and sessions on various topics side by side and there are a lot of different activities held for students.
Which is really good for many students.As I have mentioned this college is really convenient for students with financial issues because here scholarships are provided by the college for those who have financial issues.
And there are a lot of opportunities you get for placement and internships.

Name: Ankit kumar
review:
Annual fests are typically held once a year and may be organized by the university or by student organizations. Tech fests, on the other hand, are typically focused on showcasing the latest technology and innovations. These events may include presentations by industry experts, technology exhibitions, and workshops focused on emerging technologies. lot of books present in the library. Wipro
TCS (Tata Consultancy Services)
IBM
Cognizant
Accenture

Name: Nishant Khandelwal
review:
The campus life of Mnit is what makes it the best. You will get ample opportunities to participate in various activities. The campus has 19 clubs including dance, literary, quiz, etc. MNIT has an immense library with books on various topics by many known authors. In sports, the campus is well facilitated with almost all games including badminton, football, volleyball, etc.All major companies including Google, Adobe, Texas Instruments, DShaw, and JP Morgan come to the campus for hiring students every year.
The companies come to hire 3rd and 4th-year students for internships. For preparing students for the corporate sector various workshops are organised by the college.

Name: Aman rahuja
review: The annual fest of the college is SHOUTT and the tech fest is TALASH LEGACY which happens in the month of January. You can get all your course books and novels in the library with some unique courses also. All classrooms in the college are air-conditioned and have projectors. The college committee GYMKHANA organizes sports day every year with all sports. NSS and ENACTUS are some of the social clubs run by the students.The fee hike is very rare in this college but if u go for a donation then u have to pay 100 times more for your course. You can get a scholarship from the e-cell summit, they will provide you with better financial assistance and the average package for the job is 400000. The college assured you to get placement whether in the big 4 or any other company.

Name: Nidhi Jairam Nagap
review:
The college arranges many functions and competitions which make the students mentally and physically sharp. Utsav intercollegiate fest is also arranged in which students from other colleges also participate.
our college has a big library having all the books and also an app has been created for th e students' Elibrary in which books can be read online too.
The classroom got every important amenity that is required like benches. projectors.soft boards windows for ventilation.
Many extracurricular activities like sports, event management, and campaigns are arranged and marathons are arranged by students. The college participates in every sports event may It be interstate, intercollegiate, or national.
NSS is the social group in which students serve the needy or help people by arranging eye checkups, and health checkups for free.I chose this course because I am interested in the IT sector.
The faculty is good and there are many students in the BCA department.
The teaching quality is good, we got excellent teachers who are experienced and dedicated to their subjects.
There are exams taken every semester and exams are not so difficult but our college prepares the students for all the tough times.

Name: Rakholiya akash
review:

The University campus includes many more courses having separate buildings. Classrooms are having projectors and comfortable benches. There are many sports opportunities available with different sports programs.
 Students run different types of social groups.It is a Grant in aid college. 
The fee per semester is around 1200 Rs and there are six semesters in the whole course. There are no extra costs for teaching students. There are many scholarship opportunities available to students. 
Many campus placements are available.

Name: Radhika
review:
The course is of good reputation in the market 
the ratio is fair with 1:60 in each class 
Faculties are usually LLM, and PhD holders 
The teaching style is interactive style, with good infrastructure for better grasping of the concept 
exams were held as per the previously shared schedule 
exams were tough but good markingLife on the campus is hectic at first and then one gets used to it. 
Regular cultural evenings are held throughout the year every month and during fest time, every week 
Symfiesta is an annual fest held for 3 days.
Book bank is gifted every sem
good amenities 
aparajit is a sports fest

Name: Yash  Samvedi
review: Campus Placements in our college are pretty good. Though if we compare it with the top colleges of North campus like SRCC, Hindu, etc then it may seem not that good but the students of the placement society work really very hard to get good companies to the colleges so that students can get good CTC'S and work experience.I chose bcom hons because I had commerce in 11th and 12th and I really liked all the subjects so I wanted to pursue my career in this field only. The faculty of Rajdhani college is good but a few teachers are very careless, they do not take regular classes and didn't even complete the syllabus on time.

Name: Prerana Rao
review: The college infrastructure is satisfactory and provides a big auditorium, library, canteen, and sports room facilities. The college organizes various events, and days for students, They even motivate us to participate in intercollege events. Students can also go to the library and get hard copies of question papers for the exam.The students are able to get placements from the 6th semester. They enhance students for soft skills and personality development and provides various add-on course for future prospects, Students get job offer from TCS, ICICI, etc. Salary packages of around 2 to 3 lakhs are offered to students.

Name: Rahul Kumar
college: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology - [Vel Tech]
review: The campus curriculum is CBC where students can choose their own faculty and subjects except the first year where it is common for all. The Faculty here are so friendly except for a few who will be very serious only about their studies. Mostly all the faculties are Done with their Ph.D. There are Internal and External Exams. For the external exams which are Final Sem Exams Carryout 60 marks and for internal exams, you will have for 40marks. Adding both the marks you need 50 marks to pass and 27 for sure in external to get a pass which is pretty easy if you study with some concentration at the time of internal exams. The gap between exams is not soo long there will be exams Continuously in the last month of the sem.Coming to my college life and others is totally different someone wants studies and some want fest. This is the place you can find both things. The university conducts a project expo every year known as VISAI and we have our own incubator in collab with Ashok Leyland and Goreh and AVNL avadi. The Clubs were so good here you need to join at least one club to get your graduation which is very useful in getting explore to others. And the college students won many tournaments in cricket and kabaddi football and the sports amenities are super good.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I had taken up commerce with maths in class 11 and 12 and had an interest in that field. So I took up B.Com (hons) for my grad level degree.The course is good and the teachers are okay. We had fewer months to complete the semester and so everything was rushed. We are expecting to give our exams tomorrow (ie, 27th February)onwards.The social life is good. There are a lot of societies and clubs one can join according to their interests and hobbies. The infrastructure available is also commendable. Name: JASPREET KAUR KALRA
review:

Faculties are Ph.D. or masters in our college.Labs, lifts, airy classes, fully air-conditioned, white and blackboards, common rooms make iitm the best at social life. review:
I always wanted to be a teacher so this was the best option for me. And Thankfully I managed to get a seat here. Here the Ratio of Teacher- Student is quite good. It's 1:55  for 1st 2 years then it's 1:18 for the next 2 years. 
The Teachers here are really well qualified. Almost every one of them has done something great in their fields. Our Senior Professors like S K. Dash sir also have great contributions to NCERT books. Name: Paras Nath
college: Madhav Institute of Technology and Science - [MITS]
review: There is no annual fest or tech fest associated with the college. Some cultural events and Technical events are conducted by the clubs present in the college. Name: Ankit
college: Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya - [RVSKVV]
review: There is an annual inter-college cultural program and sports meet held every year, books and journals are available in the college library and easy to access, smart classes are there through experienced faculty, and internship programs are there national and international too.Because I belong to rural background nd wants to pursue my career in agriculture, 25: a 1 ratio of student and teachers, good and phd qualified teachers, there are sem wise exams 2 sems in 1 year nd each sem has 8 to 9 subjects which is really a tough task to pass.

Name: Aditya Upadhyay
review: The course curriculum is a bit outdated. I have opted for CSE(core), and in the first year, we were taught Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical, and Electrical, which are irrelevant for a computer science student. Instead of these subjects, other technical subjects could have been added such as Digital Design, Web Development, etc. I chose CSE because I love programming. Some of the faculty members are good while others are mediocre. There's not a studious environment in college. Out of 70 students, only 2-3 students are willing to study, others are for timepass. Teachers also are not concerned about students. The teaching style seems archaic. The biggest drawback is the attendance criteria of 75%, if you fail to fulfil this criterion, you get detained in internal exams. For each semester, there are two internal tests with a gap of around 1.5 months between them, and at the end of the semester, there are external semester exams. Too easy to do although no matter how well you are prepared, you will get avg marks.Life is dull and boring here. If you are a studious student, you will hate this college. If you come here for a time to pass, then you are most welcome. The annual fest usually happens around the month of April which is known as Zealicon. There are a variety of clubs such as NCS, GDSC, etc. related to computer science, electronics, quizzes, etc. The library collection is limited. Newer editions of books are not available, older editions are there. And some of the books popular in the programming field such as Code: The Hidden Language of Computer Hardware and Software, are not available. Some of the classrooms are equipped with ACs, while the rest are simple. It gets too suffocating during hot summers. There is one big playground, you can call it a multi-purpose playground. Cricket, football, and volleyball, are played on this ground. No separate fields for different sports.

Name: Gyan Prakash
review:
In the mid-winter, you will get a freshers' party.
There is a very big Tagore library. where you can avail a number of books
The classroom is well equipped..seating arrangement is comfortable and airy.
Those who have an interest in sports and extracurricular activities will get many chances to be a part of it during this entire course 
Abvp, nsuiPrimarily psir was my optional subject for upsc..so for strengthening more of it I selected this subject for pg.
Faculty: student::10:100
All facilities have very excellent in their pedagogy and all are well-qualified. Have friendly nature with students.
Mid-semesters after ever six months. and semesters paper were good in difficulty level

The facility is nice The teaching method is good you can ask any doubt you want and very supportive but you have to study on your know own also as nobody will drag you to study. There are 2 internal exams and 1 external semester exam so if you study you can easily pass the exam.

Name: Vaibhav Saini
review: Many annual fests and tech fests keep going on on campus for the students. The campus life is very good because of the well-maintained infrastructure and facilities. The college also pays a lot of attention to the sports and extracurricular activities of the students. The highest package here is 3 crore and the average package offered is 6.5 lakhs. the percentage of students getting placements is about 70 to 80 per cent. My plan after getting my degree is to do a job.

Name: Sudipta Majumder
review: Life at Bundelkhand University, Jhansi campus is enjoyable with a mix of social life, clubs, and good infrastructure. The annual fest is called 'Jhankar' conducted in February, and the tech fest is called 'Techno Vision' and is conducted in March. The library has a vast collection of books & journals. Classrooms have modern amenities. The campus provides sports & extracurricular activities with good facilities. There are many social groups, clubs, and a website run by students 'BUZZ' to keep students engaged.The fees for a Bachelor of Science in Biology at Bundelkhand University, Jhansi ranges from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 30,000 per year. The university offers various scholarships and financial assistance programs such as the Post Matric Scholarship, Merit Scholarship, and Free Education for Economically Weaker Section students. The university also provides on-campus job opportunities to students with a stipend of around Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 per month. The university has a fee hike policy of up to 10% every year.

Name: Anuj Gargya
college: IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITK]
review: IIT Kanpur has a large campus of 1055 acres. However, you'll usually wander around only 300 acres. Life on the campus is nice. The campus is very beautiful and the sports facilities are well-maintained. We have here one hockey ground, one football ground, one PE ground, and several other grounds. The campus is full of greenery. One thing I especially like about IIT Kanpur is its culture. It has hall culture, wing culture, baapu culture, and many other cultures. The annual cultural fest is ANTARAGINI and the tech fest is TECHKRITI. Both of them are going to be conducted this year in March and I haven't attended them yet, so I cannot review them. Regarding the availability of books, the PK Kelkar Library has around 4 to 5 lac books and you'll find most of the books you need there. There are 20 lecture halls of different sizes and the new ones are very good. IIT Kanpur has the best OAT among all the IITs and is the main hub for cultural activities.Well, I choose this course because this is the best which I can get at my rank, but after joining the institute, this course sounds interesting to me. The faculty: student ratio here is around 1:9. The faculty is highly qualified here and have great knowledge of their respective fields, however, I would say that they somewhat lack in teaching. Most of the students have to study by themselves to get good grades in exams. Plus the academics at IIT Kanpur are hard. Within a few weeks of the beginning of our semester, quizzes were organized and after a few weeks, our mindsets started. Just after the midterms were finished, we got the dates for the end seems, which took place one and a half months later. In short, you will have to give exams very frequently. If you want to pass, you'll have to study one week before the exams, but if you want to excel, you'll have to study hard and regularly.

Name: Sumit Datta
review:
Since KIIT was my backup plan for JEE MAINS and BITS, I thought I am not going to be a good engineer as I am not able to clear those exams.
This college changed my thought process as well as boosted my confidence with its teaching methodology. I talked about the opportunities and how to get the best out of myself from Dibakar Behra Sir(My mentor in the first year). I followed his advice and I am literally feeling that this is the place I wanted or more accurately needed. Though not as big a name as IIT or BITS still they provide us with every tool and tip to be a good engineer. KIIT is a very good platform that boosts your dreams in every possible manner. Faculty members are well-qualified and equipped with excellent skills in teaching. Faculty to student ratio is here about 1:12 . Exams here are challenging but our pre-exam preparation is so good that we find it easy. There are no skipping exams. Every exam is taken as per schedule.As I just completed my first year, here is my experience. It is going to be one of the best years of college life, making new friends, and adjusting to the new environment, classes, and all. During the first few days, you will be able to sort out the people with whom you will stay friends for the rest of your college life maybe even more. One thing that most people do is they will attend classes during the first year which will subsequently decrease in the succeeding years :P. One thing that you will hate is that in the first year, you will be caged inside the hostel as the timings are strict for first-year students. Boys will get involved in sports be it football cricket or tennis and some will start their journey towards Esports like Counter-Strike, Dota, or AOE. In short, your first year will be a smooth run with mid-sems and end-sems taking a bit of fun from the joy-ride.

Overall, KIIT College in Bhubaneswar is an affordable option for students looking to pursue a nursing degree. The college offers a range of scholarships, financial assistance, and campus jobs to help students cover their fees and further their education.

review: Computer science is the most demanding course in India currently and computer science has good scope too. In computer science, there are 180 students divided into 3 divisions and there is a total of 15 faculty available for them. Every sir and teacher has completed their degree in a reputed college. Some teachers are very nice they are always there to help u but some aren't that great. 1 year is divided into 2 terms per term is of 4.5 months and exams are a bit tough and not that easy to pass without studying.There aren't many events happens in here some are technoid and sports day and they hostel rivals competition. Name: Siddharth
review: I choose this course because the number of students is less in it compare to the CS branch. Students are in higher numbers but colleges have a sufficient amount of teachers and mentors to guide you. Teachers are always helpful if you need any help just go ask them you also have a mentor who plays a major role in your journey. Exams are in the semester and in mid-semester, you can study 4-5 days before the exam and score well if you listen and stay attentive in class.A lot of festivities are there. just be part of different communities. a huge library is there so do not worry about it. New buildings are there so all the classes have smart boards for freshers but not for seniors you have to be in old buildings after that. The cricket team is where you can play any sport you want in college. You be part of any club all are good and just explore the university.

Name: Shubham Kumar
review: The campus is really awesome to explore yourself, used provides a platform for everyone. Annual fest used to happen once in the first week of march. There's a big library equipped with all the modern available resources like an E-resource center, OPAQ, etc. The classroom well designed and furnished having properly equipped with smart projectors. Various sports facilities are also available for instance football, kabaddi, basketball, etc. And they're a multiple numbers of societies created for a different purposes which have been providing a significant platforms for the desired student.I have chosen this course because of my own passion to explore deeply in this program which will be beneficial for my learning growth as well as for my future carrier. The faculty of the university is up to the mark, there's always proper coordination between students and the faculty member having an average ratio is 1:30.The faculty members are well qualified to have teaching experience of several years, and they all have expertise in their respective fields. Conduction of exams used to happen very smoothly in a periodic way.

Name: Dheeraj
review:
To be honest my all university life was done online. I would give 5/5 to the library at the university. You'll get everything you need in the library. Our classrooms will be perfect for a student who will reach their expectations. I would give 2.5/5 for sports there won't be many facilities for the sports ground is too small. We'll have a group on WhatsApp for all our faculties and my fellow classmatesData science was in huge demand in the IT field earlier even new computer engineering was said to be the course including data science in our university so I opted for computer engineering (data science) and now there is a separate course for data science which is name as csd.
Teaching varies from person to person but most of them were good. Passing an exam was easy..it's easy to pass

Name: Shanmukh teja
college: Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences - [ANITS]
review: By the end of the 6th semester, the student is considered eligible for placements. Name: Shreya Patel
review:
I had to study something in the commerce field. My first choice was Economics Hons. Failing to get admission for the course in any college of my liking, i made the choice of going for this course.
The present ratio is somewhere around 1:60
Most of the students usually don't attend the classes so, it's really not that big of an issue.
Most of the teachers are decently qualified with masters in various domains and some possess Ph.D. too. However, I do no really find their teaching to be inspiring. They seem more like monotonous renditions. I hope that they taught with more interest and evoked curiosity with their speech. Most of our classes are often canceled. It leads to a lack of interest and seriousness in education.
The exams were fairly easy to navigate as the pattern remains the same and students can easily gauge the repetitions through various sources easily available. A week of serious preparation before the commencement of exams can easily guarantee a student a decent CGPA.Campus Life is pretty decent. I considered it to be great but after I witnessed the same in the other Private Colleges of India, I realized ours doesn't offer us an atmosphere that remotely compares with theirs. 
Our annual fest-Tide is organized in the month of February/March. Then we have other cultural fests that too are sprinkled throughout the year. The major ones take place in Feb/March though.
The library is fairly endowed with a decent number of books.
Classrooms are pretty basic. A blackboard, projector, fans, ventilation, lights- that's pretty much about it.
Sports are actively promoted. Students go up to the nationals while practicing here.
Societies are there too- quite a few. All of them are student-run with a convenor who is a part of the faculty. Enactus, Finance and Investment Cell, Entrepreneurship Cell, Debating Society, Dance Society, and Music Society are among the tons we have here.

Name: Naushin Fatima
review:
The fee structure of IILM University is decent. For B.Tech in CSE, the tuition fee is 1.5L per year and for B.Tech in CSE with IBM, it is 2L per year. Other than this there are two types of hostel facilities available on campus, non-sharing and three-sharing rooms. The non-sharing rooms hostel costs 85k/year and the three sharing rooms hostel costs 60k/ year. Both hostels are decent and well maintained. Scholarship opportunities are also very good at IILM. Based on your academic performance you are given different scholarships. If you score above 85% in the 12th then you can avail 20% scholarship on your tuition fees, if you score above 90% in your 12th then you can avail of around 60% scholarship on your tuition fees. Also as per your every year performance in college exams, you are given different scholarships. There is a lot of financial assistance on campus. The faculty and admission department are always ready to help you. Campus placements are also very good. A lot of companies visit the campus.Campus Life at IILM is just amazing. The students are really good here. Things like gender or caste discrimination are nowhere around. Ragging is also not a thing here. Everyone is always very cooperative and supportive of each other. Every year an annual fest called Ignite is organized on campus. Students from all over India visit the campus at that time. It is conducted in March during the last week. The fest involves all types of activities like dancing, singing, sports, innovation ideas presentation, etc. Other than this a lot of activities happen on campus every week which is very informative and engaging.
IILM consists of 2 big libraries. Both libraries are occupied with several books and journals. Classrooms are also very large and equipped with excellent infrastructure. There are 2 badminton courts, 2 volleyball courts, 1 handball court, a basketball court and a big ground for cricket, etc. is given. A very good gym is also there. A lot of social groups are there.

Name: ARNAB CHOWDHURY
review:
The 2nd year students are eligible for the final placements.2021-2023 had a batch strength of 186 students with a good amount of diversity in terms of gender, educational background and work experience ranging from zero to 36 months. The highest Package for our batch was 25 LPA offered by DE Shaw and the top companies which visited the campus are Hero moto corp, Aditya Birla retail, reliance retail, DHL express, EY, Accenture, and countless others. All the students were placed as college brings a sufficient number of Companies onto the campus. The top roles offered were Area Sales manager, Territory manager, Associate Consultant, Strategic Consultant, etc. All the students were placed and the average stood around 13 LPA.
My plan after my degree is to get corporate experience for the rest of the year.Coming from a background in hospitality, I felt it was time to enter a B-school and learn the fundamentals of a business environment. The ratio of faculty: students is 1:6.
The curriculum is just like what is taught in other B-schools, and it is updated every year keeping in mind the trends going on in the industry. Certain key trends which were adopted in terms of the curriculum were subjects like sustainability and machine learning. Teachers are really helpful as they are having relevant educational experience along with industry connections. Semesters are not difficult and one can pass with diligent efforts. The pass percentage stands around 98 percent. Exams are held every trimester.

Our campus life is good I would say as our annual fest moksha is one of the best in north India and our tech fest conducts many activities for interested students. They were both conducted in the month of Feb and march.
Our library is also good it has many books related to every course and different magazines and journals for interested students.
Our classrooms also have facilities that are needed like smart boards, ac, and better sitting.
Sports facilities are also awesome we have every sport in our college and our college host sports fest and inter university tournaments also our sports faculty send us on different tours to play and show our skills.
Our college has almost clubs for every extra curriculum activity including drama, dance, singing, standup, social service,gaming,photography,literature,quiz, coding, etc.. I mean I can't even remember the no.of societies and clubs. Also, we have our official website and student sections for important information and instructions.I choose this course to get a mouth-watery package of course and another reason is my interest in the software field, especially in cyber security and ethical hacking.
The faculty is quiet good I would say a mix some are very good and chill but few are not friendly and helpful to the students and the student ratio is now improving as our college gives a 20 percent female quota.
All the faculty members are highly qualified and their teaching method is good needs to improve they need to connect the subject to students not just start teaching.
We have a back-to-back examinations from class tests to practicals to mid sem to another CT and finally end sem exam and it is not easy to pass the exam the students need to give a certain amount of time to each and every subject.

Name: Shriya Beura
review:
Since I am a BBA graduate my next best step is to pursue MBA to gain expertise in marketing. The faculties in this course were very talented and detailed explanations were given in the class. the faculty-student ratio was perfectly balanced.
teaching methods of the processors were impactful and helpful for the long run in the future.The job offered by the campus was fabulous. Summer internship programs are also provided to the first years.
fee structure of the course is 18 Lakhs for including food and hostel.
my Sip and placement drive process was a great source of my knowledge and experience.

Name: Raman Patel
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: The campus offers good placement opportunities for students enrolled in BE program. Companies visiting the campus hire for Tech, non-tech, and core roles as well. However, tech opportunities are more relative to other domains. The highest offer made was around 40 lahks pa with an avg of 10 lakh pa. 70-80 percent of the batch gets hired easily during the campus placements.During my session in the college, the fee for pursuing BE was around 4 lakh annually which includes the academic fee, the hostel, and the mess fee(2019-2023). But recently the management has introduced a hike in the fee structure. There is a system of financial support and scholarship in the college which is department-wise and rank-based.

Name: Saimansa
review: Fests are conducted every 2 or 3 months. Every book is available for every course in detail. Classrooms are very good with central AC, digital boards, and labs. Sports and extracurricular activities are provided for the free time after campus. We can go through Malla Reddy University's official website for student runs.I have interest in this course so I've joined it. 1:3 is the faculty: student ratio of the university. All the faculty are well qualified like MS, PhD. and their teaching methods are too impressive that they perform every bit, it's too good time to get exams and pass.

Name: Gokul
college: Adhi College of Engineering and Technology - [ACET]

The teaching method is fully practical and based on a PPT presentation.Every year conducting cultural day and national-level technical symposiums in our colleges. Department library for every department and central library which have 50000 books in our college. A lot of extra curricular activities are conducted in our college.

Name: Chirag
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review: I chose this course because I was interested in mathematics and wanted to build a career in the same. A rough faculty: student ratio is 1:6. Faculties are easily approachable and helpful. Exams are held timely and you have to study consistently to score good marks.From the 7th semester onwards you become eligible for placements. Companies like Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Optiver, Uber, Quadeye, Google, Microsoft, and tower visit for placements. Placement rate is above 90%. I plan to opt for higher studies after my b.tech.

Name: Bhanvi Joon
review: The course Curriculum will involve 1 year of mandatory courses and the second year is directed toward specialization. In the second year, students can choose the electives they want to study. Faculty members are helpful and knowledgeable; they incorporate class discussions and Harvard case studies to teach concepts.The college provides internship opportunities. The students can apply for the internship listings from the college portal and if the students are not able to get the internship from a college application or from a self-generated option then the college assigns them an internship.

Name: Verain
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: I was always very passionate about computers, I was introduced to computers when I was a very young kid and this lead me to choose a career in CSE. Initially, I did a diploma in CSE and then a bachelor's course in the same discipline. The faculty we got at the institute was great. It was hard transitioning to the offline setting after the pandemic but they motivated us to do our best. Most of the faculty was well educated.The college works really hard to provide students with the best opportunities to boost their careers. As it was established a long time ago, the alumni support is really good. After my degree, I want to work for a well-established firm and gain as much experience as I can.

Name: Nisha Gautam
college: Inter National Institute of Fashion Design - [INIFD]
review:
I had the interest of Design and creativity.
20 to 30 students were in one section and there were 3 to 4 sections.
Teaching method was friendly,
there was one semester every year.
I tried to do some extra classes with a few complicated subjects and tried to score better.There were some events and Fashion shows, I had been a part of it.
there was a mini library and access to campus books.
the classroom was fully furnished with all the needed equipment.
I have attended some extra activities.

Name: Phani teja
review: This College collects a fair amount of fees from students for the quality education that they provide. They collect it on a yearly basis which is around 1,40,000 and another fee which includes the library and infrastructure which costs around 10,000. In this generation i would this is a fair few structures. People who have merit scores, i.e. having EAMCET rank below 10,000 have an exemption from fees by the state government, they only need to pay other fees of 10,000 per year. People with BC reservations get a fee reimbursement of 35,000 whose rank is above 10,000. One can also avail of Student loans or education loans to pay the fee. After all 4 years of my study, I could place myself in a job with a 9 LPA package. Considering this I would say it's a fair course vs affordability.Computer science and engineering is a booming course throughout the world because everyone is into technological advancements, so I chose this course. The course curriculum is well designed from basics to advanced topics for different semesters. The faculty is always available to students whenever they need them, by supporting, motivating, and encouraging new ideas of students. Faculty are very experienced people who have their Ph.D. from reputed organizations like NIT, and JNTU. Term exams are a piece of cake if one can attend classes regularly and just listen to the faculty classes.

Name: Samantha Pillay
review:
The faculty members are well-educated and great at teaching. However, a little more personal attention can be beneficial for the college. Having 30-50 students in one class makes it fun yet time-consuming for effective use of time and knowledge gained. 
The review teaching method was missing during my bachelor's as it was a very individualistic way of working on assignments and performance.There are multiple fests and events being conducted every month. 
The library is well acquainted with all the books to lend and return within a given period of time.
Amenities in classrooms include a whiteboard, presenter, etc.
Sports are very popular and the university has won many awards related to Hockey, Cricket, and Football.

Name: Arijit Mitra
review: I love Physics and Math so I took Physics at graduation. The total number of students reading was almost 15 in my class and the no. of teachers was approx 05 in my department. All the faculties were M.sc pass with Ph.D. holders and one of them was doing research in Quantum Mechanics in Japan. The exams taken were standard and on time, twice in a year and sometimes small class tests were going on for us. The difficulty level was moderate as the question paper was made by Burdwan University.We have got one annual fest after taking admission in the college in the month of August-September. The library was very good and the stock of books was also very sound. Sometimes we borrowed some books from the library. The classrooms were quite well though it requires improvement. There was a Gym room for the students and a carrom room. A WhatsApp and Facebook group is presently active and run by some Ex-professors and students of the college.

Name: Harijith V S
review:
The campus beholds various fest based on the faculties. The current ongoing fest for the faculty of science is 'Akansha'. 
The library is so huge that it holds almost every kind of book that one requires.
The classroom is equipped with smart classes. 
The campus also ensures a beautiful and lovely nightlife with wonderful experiences.As the course is a special multi disciplinary course the fee is about 40000 per semester. There are many scholarships like available for those who are eligible for it. Placements are not promised in the university, but instead, open up a wide range of opportunities.

Name: Rehan
review: The hike policy and the cost of the study are too costly for the students.  On our campus there are two types of scholarships first is a national scholarship and the second is a government scholarship. The job we get from the university is professor teacher and assistant and many more with good stipend.From the 7th semester, students become eligible for campus placement there are many companies that visited our campus and many offers are made the highest package is 21 lakh per annum and the average package is 6 lakh per annum 80 cents of students get placement after I get the degree I go for a job.

We have monthly based sports competitions in our college.

Name: Avinash
review: There is one professor for every five students at this college, which I believe is a good faculty-to-student ratio. Information technology is the best area of study at this institution, and I am interested in computers, coding, and software development. We have two midterm exams and a final exam; if you attend all of the classes, the exam will be simple for you; if not, it will be challenging, in my opinion. If you start studying a month before the exam, you will be able to pass the final exam with ease and earn good grades.There is one initiative taken by our respected senior is that we can teach nearby children on our campus who can't afford the coaching fees we can teach them free of cost and all the faculty members and director sir will help us to do so. In this institute, we face sports, coding, literature, and cultural hobby councils where students can explore themselves

review:

The difficulty level of Exams was Moderate.The Fee Structure depends on what Quota you were getting into a college. Through KCET it's around 85k/yr and through Comed-k it will be 300000/yr through the Management the fee will be 350000 to 400000 per year for CSE/IS and its allied courses. It depends on the branch to which you were taking admission. SSP and NSP scholarships will be provided for the Students.
Many Premiere Companies like Google, MS, Wipro, SAP, etc. visit the college every year to recruit students. And almost 90% of them are placed on Campus this year.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
The fee Structure of the College Total fees for the full course is 50,000.
First-year fees - 20,000 including all the other components like tuition fees, masa fees and other misclenious cost. 
The college has semester-based fees structureOur college Celebrities The Annual day at the End of the Year. 
Our college has a large Library and it has around 10,000 Books. 
Our college also Celebrates all the other days like Republic day, and Independence day.

Name: Sarvesh  Biwalkar
college: Smt Kashibai Navale College of Engineering - [SKNCOE] Vadgaon
review:
The faculties available here are well educated mostly ME or PhD holders from renowned institutions and colleges. Bonding between faculties and students is good so students get their help of them at any time during college hours. As the college is affiliated to sppu(Pune university) exams are conducted by them.Colleges provide internships also but the percentage of internships is less. For internships, various companies visit here like jio, TCS, Accenture, etc. 
But we get internships from our campus also this year one girl from TE is having paid internship of nearly 1lakh per month.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Anil Neerukonda Institute of Technology & Sciences - [ANITS]
review:
I want to Pursue Higher education first, and also I have an interest in both the Fields of Computer Science and electronics as well. 
The major in electronics will help me in studying the Latest advancements like IoT, 5g networks and embedded systems etc.
I will opt for a CS minor later.
The faculty-student ratio is quite good 1:5.
The faculty strength is very good in our college.
A good number of professors are available in each and every department. In ECE we have nearly 40 professors. The Faculty-student ratio is nearly 1:8.
The faculty are all well qualified and the majority of them are PhD holders from premium institutes. The remaining faculty are also actively working as PhD scholars to get their PhD. The  Teaching process is excellent and is good enough to get Knowledge. Each semester Has two mid-exams and a semester-end exam. They will be held timely and also within the scheduled time.The infrastructure of the Campus is good. A technical fest Will be conducted in March of every year. Also, separate fests are conducted by each department separately. The college is good and known for its library facilities. 
It has a good number of volumes of books and international journals from IEEE, CSI etc.
The library has three sections namely the central library, digital library and reference section.
The classrooms are well-equipped with projectors for better teaching practices.
Lots of clubs are run actively by students as well as faculty.
You can refer to the website anits.edu.in for further reference.

Name: Ilma Ali
review: I choose journalism because I have a keen interest in reading, writing and public speaking and becoming the voice of the voiceless. the faculty was well-educated and highly professional. There used to be regular and disciplined classes. there were around 45 students in my class it was all girls' college. One of my teachers pursue his Degree in journalism from BHU which is well university rest of the others were also highly skilled and professional we used to have media house visits as well we even visited India T.V And watched live App ki adalat and the guess was Kartik Aryan that was one of the best visits we had and then we were also taken to DD news and watched live Interviews and the entire studio the newsroom it was such a good experience. we used to have semester exams after every 5 - 6 months. semester exams conducted by the university were not very tough one can easily pass if one studies well the night before. Questions used to repeat from previous years' semester question papers too.There is a number of vests that take place in my college every department has its own fest. As I belonged to the journalism department we used to have a fest named "journutsav" which used to happen in the month of February every year. Different colleges used to participate there used to be so many fun activities along with panel discussions, street plays, RJ hunts etc. There used to be other festa as well like Phagun, Enthusia etc. library of my college was well furnished and filled with a variety of books one can easily have access to the books without any problem. Classrooms were huge and well furnished there used be good quality chairs and desks along with a smart class in the same there used to be proper ventilation and proper cleaning of classrooms on daily basis a few of classes even had beautiful huge windows which make them very artistic and eye-catching. We even had a gym in college which was free for all sports students. the college has its page.

Name: Vineeth a
review: Yeah our seniors had said that so many popular companies visit dsce to recruit students and they also provide some internship work in there company itself there and approximately 95 per cent of students get placement every yearThe campus is very wast it has nearly 50 acres of campus in addition to that it has 3 campuses of which one is a university and a green campus it's a student-friendly campus over the life of dsce is nice.

Name: Achal Kumar Anand
review:
As we know very well in this day and technology is on our boom and I have also interest in the side of the computer field that's why I choose this course and we know that in the computer science field student have more opportunity to made up their carrier that's why to choose this. I am very sad and disappointed to see that at the faculty level of the whole tit group college, not all faculty are underrated but some faculty are also too good. Some doctorate faculty and some normal faculty are there if we talk in terms of ratio 8:1 is the ratio of non-doctorate or doctorate faculty. They provide scholarship facilities to students, student can get scholarship money easily from the government after that they created some unexpected unlogical issues for students about their fees. They put the fine on the student portal without any reason

Name: Sunil
review:
BCA is close as possible to Btech. With a similar curriculum. And also with less money. BCA cost 3.5 lacs for 3 years while btech is 12 lacs for 4 years. 
Faculty of computer application here is meh! Not soo good not soo bad. There are 2-3 teachers who are loved! Whatever they'll teach you in the class you can't forget that. 
Exams are hectic here first practicals then theory. Mid-terms and just after midterms end terms. Assignments, seminars, mini/major projects. It really gets hectic during exam days.You get summer fest. There are many quiz events going on every other day. If you're a social you can easily get friends to create your group and have fun. Participate in different programs, sports etc. The campus is not huge but it's pretty with its lush greenery. Classes are totally digital. Lecture theatres are HUGE! And quiet with any to every amenity. 
There are several groups SPE, DBC, and dance clubs. Variety is there. You just have to be active.

Name: Madhu
review:
Campus Life is a memorable one. It is fun and interesting out there in Miranda House. The red bricks hold up various beautiful stories about the memories of the students there. There are various clubs and societies on campus. The campus also has groups like NSS and NCC which come in collaboration with various other societies and then cause various social drives on the campus for the students to join in. We have Women Development Cell, Placement Cell, Drama Society, Classical and Western Dance society and Music Society which all functions beautifully. 
The library of Miranda House is the dream of all bookworms. There are all the books available most of the time and these books are easily accessible. There are sports clubs on campus as well.
Many society fests, department fest and the one and only annual fest happens throughout the year. These are all colourful and well-planned. They are also executed properly and it is all fun during the fest season in our college.Life Sciences is the study of life which helps one to explore and touch upon various aspects of biological science and understand one's area of interest. Somebody who is interested in the field of research in biology should definitely pursue this course to understand deeply their area of interest.
Miranda House has a beautiful campus and amazing teachers. The biology labs are well-equipped and the teachers are really knowledgeable and kind.
There are 2 teachers per 50 students. The teachers are well qualified and mostly PhD holders in their subjects. The semester-end exams happen every 6 months and these can be easily passed if one is regular in classes and listen to their respective teachers.

Name: SIMRAN JHA
college: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University For Women -[IGDTUW]
review:
So my plans after completing my degree are to just get a decent placement and after saving a good amount I want to start up 
Also, the highest package for the year 21-22 was 55 lakh per annum and the average package is 15 lakh per annumThe fest is amazing. Especially the TAARANGANA, jhilmil they are the love of igdtuwians it's a 3 days event also there are many societies like for dance singing Marshellate, sports, tech  many more you will get almost everything

Name: Abhishek verma
college: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology - [SVNIT]
review: College life is awesome. The annual cultural and technical fests are Sparsh and mind bend and after that celeb, the night is also there. The library is actually very good all the books are there and the e-library is also available. the department buildings are newly made that's why it is very good. In svnit we have a big ground where we have two basketball courts, two volleyball courts, two lawn tennis, two badminton court, and a big ground for cricket, football, and other games. It also has a gym and table tennis. Svnit has many clubs such as Raag for music, Akriti for arts, dancing club, economical club, and many more.Fees are a little bit high if you do not get any scholarship or fee remission it will charge around 1.5 lakhs per annum but if your family income is between 1 to 5 lakhs per annum you receive 2/3rd fee remission in tuition fees which are 62500 and if it is below 1lakh per annum then your full tuition fees will waive. If you have SC/ST or PWD benefits then also your full fees were waived.

Name: Saurabh Singh
review:
Every year college includes some extra fees.
And also colleges follow all the government rules related to scholarships and financial assistance and also provides good campus jobs. The college follows mp scholarship and also follow Bihar scholarshipIn the 7th semester, students are eligible for campus placement.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I'm a fresher in the Btech CSE branch. Technology being on the cutting edge made me take Computer science and engineering. At my college our class size holds approx 120 students, teaching is done in smart classes, teachers are highly qualified, exams are taken regularly and if a person pays attention in class he/she can easily pass the examBeing a fresher I'm not very much exposed to placement ideas and offers but would like to explore them. Name: Abhinav Tiwari
college: IIT Delhi - Indian Institute of Technology [IITD]
review:
Rendezvous four-day cultural fest - has celebrities like Sunidhi Chauhan, and Benny Dayal.
 Tryst is an annual tech fest.
Literati, BeCon, and Kaizen are some other fests
Also different clubs also regularly organize events and competitions. For eg. the Debating society of iitd conduct stalwarts where basically students showcase their debating skills and compete with others.
Thus, every club regularly organizes such activities.
Also, sports are given great importance and are considered a central part of campus life, particularly through the General Championship (GC) which is an inter-hostel sports competition. Additionally, there is the Inter-IIT Sports Meet where all the IITs compete against each other in various sports.As a first-year student, I have not had any personal experience with internships, but from what I have observed and heard, many students have been able to secure valuable internship opportunities with a wide range of companies. These opportunities have varied greatly in terms of compensation, with some companies offering staggering packages of up to 40 lakhs, while others offer more modest salaries. Name: Mayank Gautam
review:
Many fests are organized around the year at NSUT. The main fest is "MOKSHA" which is organized roughly around the end of March. There are other cultural and technical fests like TeckWeek (Organized by IEEE), Resonanz, etc.
In the central library, one can find any book one's needs.

I believe that there are slightly fewer faculties relative to the requirement.
Faculty here at NSUT are well experienced and highly qualified and their teaching method suits all students.
Exams are held regularly. From class tests, mid-semester, and practical to end-semesters all are planned perfectly to enhance learning. The exams are easy to pass if one has a basic grip on the topics.

NiT Hamirpur's annual college fest Hillfair is organised in the month of November and December every year.
And technical fest Nimbus one of the greatest technical fests of North India is organised In hereby NIT Hamirpur in the month of March and April.

Name: Dheeraj Singh Yadav
review: Our college is very good.  There is no problem here.  Faces etc. keep on happening here.  Good fests happen only after exams so there is no problem. Name: Taniya
review:

Name: YASH SHARMA

review: Course curriculum is not that for t much difficult. You can easy pass your semester exams if you study from the starting. Teachers are also helpful, qualified and knowledgeable. Name: Ankur Kshitij Sahai
review: College life at NSUT is very exciting, we get to meet a ton of amazing people with brilliant minds. And for every interest, there's a society from tech, sports, robotics, off-road racing, philosophy, photography etc. anyone can take part and excel in this society. The annual fest MOKSHA is among the best college fest in Delhi, students from different colleges come to attend it, and there are various tech fests held in college like HackNSUT, and TechWeek and many hackathons are held regularly. There are well-maintained grounds for Football, Cricket, Volleyball, Basketball, and Badminton and students participate in various events held in different colleges. The library is well equipped with every book and journal and has air-conditioned rooms. There is an app made by a society of college to check the student profile like attendance, marks, the notification from college etc in it.The academic fees of college for our batch i.e the batch of 2026, for the first year is Rs.219000 and it increases to Rs.10000 after every year the hostel fees for non-AC rooms for single seater are Rs. 51000 and for non-AC double seater is Rs. 49000 per semester (including the 19000 mess fees per semester) for AC rooms the hostel fees is almost Rs.60000(+ $750 mess fees) per semester. The college helps to provide the scholarship schemes from the government like the National Scholarship Program, E district scholarship, merit cum means scholarship etc. For a student loans, there is a branch of SBI inside the college campus.

Name: Tanisha Sethi
