review: I chose psychology as my major, and yes the curriculum and course layout is effective and knowledgeable, the qualification of the faculty is very efficient though there were a lot of faculty changes happening, which did delay the course, there is also a foreign language being taught, and that's the hard part, to pass those exams. all the midterms and finals were on the scheduled timings only.the placements are good for the engineering department and other departments get good exposure to the placement drives. students start getting emails regarding the placements from 4 semesters onwards. I have heard that the highest package has been 3 crores. yes, there is a large percentage of students who get placements. I have planned for pursuing masters in clinical psychology.

Name: Anubhav mishra
review:
From the 6th semester, all the students became eligible for placements on campus and also other placements.
TCS, Infosys, and Wipro visit regularly and around 600 offers were made.
The highest placement is 25 lacs and the average is 3.5 lacs around 82% of students are placed in UCER.There are two annual fests happening in our college one is founder's day and the other annual programs happen in the month of April and November respectively.
Free Library is provided by the college for students and also it focuses on extra co-curricular activities.

Name: Priya
review: Infrastructure is extremely peaceful and neat daily they'll clean. About books all kinds of subjects and general books are available in both department's library as well as the office library, they have the facilities for xerox and printouts. There will be freshers day at starting and also there will be farewell. Regarding sports interested people can play in the evening at also they'll take you to tournaments.It depends on the quota for the government quota they'll charge around 70k for the first year alone book fees are included and for the management quota, it's double like around 1lakh 45k something, the hostel charge is separate. Regarding scholarship, it is a government post-metric scholarship that will be given based on community.

Name: Prabhat Kotangale
review:
So many different events/fest is organized on campus where the interested student comes to take part in the competition, Library has all the study material required by the students, with take away facility also. Projectors, speakers, and Smartboards are also provided. 
Twice a year sports teams are very focused and they have fun fighting to make their team the best as always.
SPE Society of Petroleum Engineers is a social club for students and petroleum engineers across the globe.If you are shortlisted from the college campus, you can get a perfect package that is better and more than any other engineering stream. Faculties are well experienced which helps students in every aspect of the course and carrier. In-depth teaching is provided to one that requires attention. Each semester i.e 2 in a year has 2 phases one online and one written, which is difficult to pass if you are not focused on your studies.

Name: SOHAN RAUL
review:
Unlike other colleges, there are not any hidden charges. Fees hike is rare unless there is any inflation. Study cost is worth. Because what you get in your fees is completely worth it. 
You will find many scholarships like state and central government all scholarship is applicable to you. Including this, Industries like SAIL and some other releases their scholarship. You will get notified by the faculty members who are specially appointed to aware students about scholarship information. College claims that they will help you to get study loans but I recommend you to manage yourself for study loans if you need them.
Come to jobs, colleges provide campus joining where companies like TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, etc. recruit students. But my suggestion is, you always look for off-campus opportunities and don't worry about how to get to know about opportunities. You will automatically get to know if you have a strong friend zone.Today's era is the era of machines. I had a strong determination to take computer science as my engineering course. It gives you a larger scope for your further carrier. Also, get a sound salary and lock in a bright future.
The faculty-student ratio is good. Unlike other institutes, it has spacious classrooms with fewer students. So that teachers can guide them properly.
Faculties are well-qualified, skilled, and trained. Notes given by them are easy, understandable, and enough for exam preparation. The teaching method is also to the point and elaborates according to difficulty. Exam occurs twice a year i.e. one exam per semester. Also, there are class tests, internals, and assignments. To pass the exam, you have to complete all these sections like practicals, assignments, internal, and of the course semester. The exam is not that difficult if you prepare from the study notes.

Name: Anagha R
review: Having a successful social life will make your college career easier for many reasons. a social life, a person does not feel lonely because you have friends to talk to and listen to. then you can get help from your friends. we have a wide range of book collections in our library. so I am blessed with that. NSS is the main social club in the college.I love this course to study and the strength of my class is 50. The qualification of my faculty is postgraduate. we were having exams in the semester, we have 6-semester exams and the difficulty to pass the exam is medium. I am really enjoying my graduation journey.

Name: Parul
review:
Life at CT University's Campus is very fantastic as there are ample events of events conducted by them on monthly basis. They celebrated each and every festival of all states full of enthusiasm and in a wonderful manner. Every month, there is a minimum of 1 mega event and other small events being organized on campus. Even there are many webinars and seminars conducted by the department to provide industry-driven knowledge to the students. 
There are so many facilities provided to the students like a well-equipped library, Food courts, Playgrounds, etc. Sports facilities are very good at the campus as there are basketball ground, football ground, badminton ground and well-equipped indoor games on the campus.I have opted for B.tech CSE(Hons.) at CT University. Overall, the study at CT University is excellent as the faculty taught you each concept in depth and practical exposure is also provided to the student in every subject. Mostly, the faculty here is Ph.D. and the teaching method used by them is awesome as the main motive is to make the concept clear to the students. The term exams were held thrice in one semester and if the student studies well then he/she can score good marks as it totally depends on the student's efforts in studies. Overall, the teaching curriculum is excellent at CT University.

Name: vishal
review: faculty are assigned to teach required courses, based on experience preferences and seniority. they also may propose a course that is put through the curriculum approval process younger faculty might teach more of the less favored required courses.when I was admitted to this university 2017it was 60000 per semester and now it is  85000 per semester. fees are a little bit high as compared to the infrastructure provided. ct university provides scholarships on the basis of an entrance exam.

Name: Shruti lodha
review: I choose fashion design and it was one of the best courses offered. The faculties are so helpful, as well as talented. The exams were taken on a time basis and there was more emphasis on enriching the roots of the student.I got direct admission. The fee for every year is 1Lakh. I got no scholarship as there is no scope for a scholarship in fashion design. The campus offers very good recruitment and ensures everyone gets something out of it.

college: Sreenidhi Institute of Science and Technology - [SNIST]

Coming to the course curriculum the subjects will be according to our current year. Exams will be held according to our fixed curriculum.I don't know much about the internship provided by the college. But with the help of college, we can get internships. The college will help us to get the opportunities to avail of them. Our faculty will help through the process of getting an internship and completing of it.

Name: Jagriti Tiwari
review:
I opted for the BBA course and it was a great journey of mine I have learned a lot from that I have improved my communication skills & personality also.
there were 54 students in one section, there were 30-35 faculty in our university.
the faculty qualifications are they have done Ph.D. + 10 Years of Experience.Life at the campus was very good I learned a lot and had a lamhe fest I participated in this fest as a social member club.
All books were available in the library.
in every February month, there was a week of sports day.

Name: PRAGYA MITTAL
review:
I chose this course because I was passionate about literature and I wanted to pursue my career as an editor or a content creator. Literature is a diverse field and it gives a world exposure to cultures and manners. 
The faculty is really nice and over qualified. They take our issues every time we ask.The campus is beautiful and safe. it also has multiple eateries and gives a pleasant atmosphere. access to the library is limited till six in the evening which acts as a disadvantage for the ones who live in the hostel.

Name: Abhishek Mishra
college: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies - [UPES]
review: The fee structure of this college is also good and the fees are worth it as with these fees u will be getting the best study material which no college provides in this course. The cost of the study is also nice. There are various scholarship which is given to the students.In the 7th semester, students are eligible for the placements. Placements are also good in this course. About 80% of students get placed in bpharma courses. My plans after getting the course are to build a pharmacy shop.

Name: Arjun Gandhi
review: I chose this course because it was in line with the commerce stream I opted for in my 11th-12th class. So there were around 10 teachers for the Bcom stream consisting of around 120 students. The Faculty was well-qualified and was good at communicating the whole concept. So there were house tests once and the final exams at the end of the semester. If gone through the syllabus thoroughly, the exams were easy to pass.Life at the campus was good. There was a youth festival every year in November where different activities were conducted. There was a big centralized library for the whole campus with a huge variety of books.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: I choose Bcom because I'm intersted in studying finance and marketing. 80 - 90 students are in your class/course. Your teachers are highly qualified professionals and they teach us very well. There are 2 exams 1st mid sem and 2nd semester ending exams. It's not that difficult to pass.In Panjab University there are alot of fest we can say every month we have fest in our university. We have huge library every type of book are available there. Sports and extra curricular activities in the campus are highly supported.

Name: Pushparaj salpala
review: Campus infrastructure is good but the college is very strict in rules and regulation library hours is provided in college hours sports hours are every Saturday for juniors for seniors alternate days campus is lush greenery and not bad.Cse is better in smec than all other branches which eco-friendly faculty but the college is strict that faculty are qualified for their post-graduation and PhDs who are teaching in smec opting smec is the right way to placement.

Name: Debjyoti Barman
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review:
BE in Computer Engineering from Thapar shows a good placement ratio.
faculty is qualified enough to clear all your doubts.
Good interaction is built in the class. The one-to-one session is also available.
Exams were moderate to tough. Your basic related of the subjects should be clear.Tuition fees remain more or less constant, but development fees vary.
The scholarship is based upon your percentage and further in 2 criteria
boards should be above 80.
and you should be above 10 percent of your registered stream.

Name: Sumanth burla
review:
No internship, only internship we got from the job that the company wish. Few companies will have few companies will not have. The online learning platform learnings are considered as internship which is not benefited to student only theortical.
Jobs avg 4 lpa lot restriction over the placements...Average 4 LPA. Lot of restrictions over placements.

No matter what package, no of placements, etc

Name: Abhijeet
review: It was different from other courses as it offered MBA in Information Technology Business Management. I chose Information security as my specialization. The student ratio is very good. Almost all the faculties have a Ph.D. or are pursuing it. Exams are not that difficult to pass.5 to 10% fee hike every year. No scholarship was provided. Financial Assistance in terms of education loans at lower interest rates is available. 100% placements. 12LPA average CTC. BIG 4 visits every year for final placements. All students get summer internships.

Name: AVEEK CHAKRABORTY
review:
THE ANNUAL FEST WAS NAMED AMIPHORIA, WHICH USUALLY HAPPENS BETWEEN 15TH-25TH FEB.
LIBRARY WAS HUGE, LITERALLY HUGE, BOOKS FROM ALL KINDS AROUND THE GLOBE ARE AVAILABLE 
THE CLASSROOM IS TOP CLASS, MODERN AC HALL, PROJECTOR CLASSROOM, STEP SITTING, EVERYTHING YOU CAN IMAGINE OF, WAS PRESENT. 
MOSTLY FOOTBALL, BASKETBALL, AND BADMINTON.
THERE WERE MORE THAN 20 GRPS AVAILABLE FROM SINGING TO DRAMA TO DEBATE AND LOTS OF OTHERS.THE TOTAL COST FOR THE ENTIRE 4-YEAR DEGREE PROGRAM WAS ALMOST AROUND 7.5L in academic fees. 
I got placed with Amazon India at a package of 3.4LPA, OTHER THEN THAT THEY DO THAT DEDUCTIONS IN FEES RELATED TO HAVING A GOOD PERCENTAGE IN 12TH BOARD EXAMS, ARMY, AND DEFENCE QUOTA.

Name: Jayaprakash
college: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering and Technology - [SVCET]
review: Fees are depending on the course that has been selected and the hostel things and the tuition fee so for that it is relevant the education and knowledge provided by them are outstanding so campus placements are also good. The fee for my course is 75000 which is reasonable as compare to other colleges.We will have an annual test in which there will beTech test included and DJ nights and other events conducted every year there is a library of books that help us to gain more info related to the subject and things apart from classrooms there are play area and the courts where we can sp in our time.

Name: Yogita Katara
review: They have a well-maintained library. Each and every book is available there with a good area for sitting. The classroom has decent amenities. There is a field of extra curricular activities and there are various clubs run by the students.The courses are up to the mark. Classes are conducted on a regular basis. There is a girls' hostel as well. The classes are conducted in such a great way that it doesn't hamper the co-curriculum activities. The exams are taken timely.

Name: Dharmendra
review: I opted for Btech in biotechnology because of the bright future scope. The faculty-student ratio was 1:40 which is good. The faculty was highly qualified professionals. The exams and materials were of top quality. Exams were mediated to crack.many top-class companies like Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Infosys, and many PSUs visit college campuses each year and hire students for many roles like executives, HR, counselors, etc. The stipend provides by companies is also good.

Name: Ankur Agrawal
review: The fees of the college in total are 125000 and there is a bus facility also for which you have to pay 18000 all semester book is issued from the library and you can return that after a semester there is no scholarship system in the collegeThere are many fests happen in the college all important books are present in the central library classroom is well developed and all classroom have a projector and all the important things that are needed for the study

Name: Sunil Kumar
review: Fest is not good in college. Only one fest was conducted in the months of November and December. Sports events are also held in December and January. Class condition is good and labs are good and well equipped and the library is good.You can get fees reduced by requesting faculties and fees not hiked yearly and remain the same as the whole course. You can get a scholarship from the government and you can get a loan but you need it and you can get a chance to work.

Name: SHIVANSH SHARMA
review:
The annual fest is held every year in the months of March and April. And many other events are organised like engineering day etc. 
The best thing about campus is the library. Our college has a central library have most of the books 
And colleges have many clubs like environment clubs, sports clubs etc.I choose btech cse due to its scope in the technology sector. The faculty of the college is well educated and knowledgeable and has good skills of teaching.
Teaching is done with presentation as well as traditional methods. And the exam is conducted semester wise and it's easy to pass.

Name: Vishnu Sai Namala
review:
I choose Cse because the college is basically excellent for both cse and mechanical batches.
The faculty student ratio is about 1 per 30 
And a good rappo is maintained.
The basic qualification here for faculty is Mtech and most of had phd's in various streams .The fee hike policy may be once a decade.
Cost to study is nearly 150000 rupee per annum.around 100000 rupee for college and 5000 for library usage so on.
Every one will be given a job placement.
I got a job on campus with 20000rupee as stipend.

Name: SAISH RAO balguri
review: There are two fests that are held every year, one is sumshodini i.e the technical fest as a part of it various technical events based on new trends will be conducted. The other one is the cultural fest i.e samskrithi in which music dance and DJ will be held. There are various books and a vast library and also a digital library is present. There are overall 8 clubs that include games club, literary, technical, NSS, ncc, humanity, disciplinary, and finally music dance club. These clubs help a student to excel in their own field. Overall campus life is one of the most beautiful things.There will be various placements offered and there is also a training and placement cell in our college that looks after various placement and internship opportunities for the students. The companies that have visited our college are Tcs, Wipro, Cisco, Oracle, PWC, Accenture, jsw Steels, and many various MNCs like Amazon which has offered a high package of 31 lakhs. the average package is 6 lakhs. At a maximum of 85 percent, students will be placed every year and the other 15 percent will be pursuing their higher studies.

Name: Sandeep
college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review: In the 1st year, Rs118013 is charged and from 2nd year onwards Rs107013 is charged. And every year an exam fee is also charged by the university i.e. Rs7865. The total fee is Rs470512 and Rs5000 is refundable at the end of the course as the security deposit, so the net fee is Rs465512 if you are eligible for the UP SCHOLARSHIP, then every year you will get Rs56600 as a scholarship amount.Many internship opportunities are available from 2nd year onwards on the basis of your knowledge. At least 2 months internship is given which are paid of about Rs3500 and it is Online and you have to submit 2 projects one is minor and the other is a major project. Free internships are provided outside the college in online or offline methods.

Name: Deepak Sharma
review:
Life on campus can be quite exciting and lively, with plenty of opportunities for socializing and making new friends. There are usually various events and activities organized by the college or university, such as cultural festivals, sports competitions, and guest lectures. Many students also form their own social groups, based on shared interests or backgrounds.In my first year of Bachelor of computer application (BCA), Fees was 51000 rupees for a year and now in 2nd year, it will increase upto 52000 rupees so fees do not hike as hell.
Now college does not provide any scholarships or internships.

Name: Vaibhav Kawade
college: Tulsiramji GaikwadPatil College of Engineering and Technology - [TGPCET]
review: the college generally offers a well-structured and updated curriculum that covers theoretical concepts and practical applications, with a focus on industry-relevant skills and knowledge. They use various teaching methods such as lectures, case studies, discussions, and project work to enhance student learning and engagement. Additionally, some faculty members may also have industry experience and connections, which can help students to gain insights into the latest trends and practices in the field. At the end college conduct exam for the year.Some of the companies that have visited the college include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, etc. The highest package offered in recent years has been around 10-12 lakhs per annum, while the average package offered ranges from 3-4 lakhs per annum. Our college has a good track record of placement, with a significant percentage of students getting placed in reputed companies each year.

Name: Vansh
college: K. C. College of Engineering And Management Studies And Research
review: The course curriculum is as per Mumbai University, and the faculty has a mix of people old and experienced and as well as new members but the supporting attitude is the same including the principal and the HODs. Overall it is like a student-friendly environment. The internal assessments are held twice a semester and can be cleaned easily if you do the basics right.From the 7th semester onwards the students are eligible for the placement and the TPO is constantly active with the students right from the 6th semester. Multiple pieces of training for soft skills, technical skills and other aspects are organised. The placement support is available throughout with decent packages of around 5LPA.

review:
The faculty is very nice

Best from any other college

which there are 6 semester 
10500 per semester fees 
Examination fees included

Name: Ravish Ratan
review:
According to me, the fees are a bit high for middle-class families.
Every year the fees increase by 10000 because of the NAAC grading also there is a hike in fee policy.
Jayantian scholarship and other government scholarships.Students become eligible for placement from the 5th semester but the training for the placement starts from the 4th semester itself.
Big four and many other big companies come to offer the jobs.
50% of students get placed.

Name: Ankur Chauhan
review: For example, ABESIT College used to host a freshmen party, an annual festival, and a sports festival for new students. The college library has a wide selection of books, and the building's interior is nice as well. Additionally, the classrooms are in excellent shape and offer their students amenities like air conditioning, CCTV, a projector, a blackboard, and well-furnished benches. On our campus, there are several fields for playing specific sports, and students use those fields for a variety of sports. Clubs like AAYAM CLUB used regularly hosted a variety of cultural activities.Students become eligible for campus placement after the fifth semester. Numerous businesses, like TVS, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, etc., have visited our campus in the past to place students. The average package at our college is $5 lakh, and the biggest package is somewhere above 28 lahks. The majority of students—nearly 95%—get placed after the fifth semester. I'm going to pursue a master's degree after my btech.

review:
From 10 th board I had a dream of software engineer. To fulfill the dream I take this course interestedly.

Name: Darshan A
review:

Acharya Habba is the fest that happens annually, it happens in the month of march. The fest happens for three days. The small events happen for the whole month of February and march.

Most of the faculty completed their master's in their respective fields and many of them completed their Ph.D. program. Faculty use projectors to teach the students, so there is no issue with the teaching. 
The term exam comes once in six months it is conducted by the respective university, and we can pass easily if we study the subject thoroughly.

review:
Your MBA campus life is a mix of enriched social and culture environments. Every month you will be experiencing events organized by clubs and committees. there will be a Sports section war 'Kurukshetra'. 1st year vs 2nd year, you will get the opportunity to make your own team and play. Each festival will be celebrated with great enthusiasm. There will be dance night, movie night, and prom night. 
Dhruva is the annual fest of IIM Trichy. If you are a sports enthusiast you can get a chance to play in Sangram, which is like the Olympics for South Indian IIMs (IIM-B, IIM-K, IIM-T, IIM-V).
IIM Trichy's library or LRC has one of the largest collections of books and online journals. As a student, you will get subscriptions and direct access to many expensive journals.
Your classroom experience will be the best of its kind, full of discussions on every topic and you will be always promoted to actively participate.
Classes are smart classrooms with centralised AC facilities.IIMs offer PGPM courses for MBA, earlier it was PGDM but after 2017 every IIM started offering PGPM and you will be awarded an MBA General Management degree after 2years of successful completion.
For entire PG courses Faculty,: student ratio is around 1:13, which is good. And Faculties are permanently offering Ph.D. courses in their domain. Apart from this, you will be exposed to a rich Guest faculty list from foreign universities and old IIMs.
Every faculty is a Ph.D. holder in their domain from top colleges and India and also some are from foreign universities, They have also industry experience in their domain and are also associated with various consulting projects. Some faculties are editorial writers in National financial newspapers.
There will be a total of 6 terms duration varying from 2.5 to 3 months. Almost every week you will be writing an examination. Your evaluation will not be based on a single exam, during the entire term, you will be evaluated.

Name: Swapnil Pandey
review: Students can sit here for placements from the sixth semester onwards, many companies come here which take 80 to 90 percent of the students from our college. Name: Mithlesh mourya
review:
Starting from the first year at the time of admission you have to deposit an amount of 55000 or 60000 according to the course as the first installment. The second installment of 23 to 24000 at the end of the first semester in a total of 78000 or 80000 for 1 year then for the next 3 years there is 55 to 57000 per year.
Here you get two types of scholarships first MMVY mukhyamantri medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana and the scholarship given by the central government.
In MMVY you get a total refund of your college fees as well as if you reside in a college hostel that also.
In the central scholarship, you get a refund approximately equal to the college fee but that is only to SC/ST,  the OBC gets less refund.
The third thing is the TFW seat which is a tuition fee waiver in this you don't have to pay anything to the college your whole study is free of cost and this is given to only the 5% of students of any branch with their highest score in Jee.
Since I am in my first year I didn't get any stipend from college.The course curriculum is aligned the same as with RGPV and there are few variations in the subjects provided as SATI is an autonomous body.
Seeing the boom of CS and IT I availed this course.
The faculty-student ratio is approximately 1: 30. As this college is old and well establish so facilities are well qualified but this does not mean that their teaching method is also very good. In any branch of SATI you will get only 2 or 3 teachers with very good teaching others are not good. Some teachers use the digital way or you can say advance for your analysis while others do nothing. This means the main thing is that if you get the right teacher for a good subject like digital electronics and computer science you are at a good level, otherwise you have to do it all by yourself.
In 4 months of the semester, you have two mid sem examinations and one end sem examination in between there are assessment tests according to the respected teachers. The best of two medicine is taken for the final result.

review: Life in college is cool with friends. Yeah, there are a few events that happen every year like fest, freshers, and a few branches conducting some tournaments. review:

Name: ARKOPRAVO DE
review: Recently here KIIT carnival took place and believe me it was just amazing. Veteran singer Sunidhi Chauhan came here and had a star night in kiit cricket stadium and that was really a spectacular show. The central library of KIIT has 5 floors and it is full of good books, foreign journals, research papers, etc. In fact, it is a world-class library on each floor you can find department-wise books and other things. The classroom is very well decorated here each classroom has a smart board, ac, lots of fans, a projector, etc. Sports facilities are one of the most well-known facilities here. Almost all types of sports grounds and equipment are available here and with the kehlo india campaign, you can take your sports career to another level by using the sports facilities.  And there are various types of social clubs and groups which you can join if you are interested.I have chosen the cse branch of my interest in coding. Here the student-teacher ratio is 80:1 as it is private here the student number is a little bit high. Now Coming to the faculty members are very good at teaching and friendly in nature, and some of them are highly qualified in their respective fields. Almost every assistant professor is a Ph.D. holder in their respective subject. Here all the semester exams are divided into two parts mid-semester exams and end-semester exams. Mid sem exams are held normally after 2 months after the start of the classes and end-semester exams are held at the end of the semester. The exam is not that tough to pass if you are regular in class you can easily score a very good CGPA. Reminder, 75% attendance is mandatory for classes.

Name: Amlesh mandal
review: To study in this college you will have to pay 350000 to 400000 total in 3 years and after that, if you want a hostel than the hostel fee is 40000 to 45000 per semma there are loans for this all the banks can give you an education loan and also Bihar government give loan to this college.In the third year the placement starts the companies start to come to the college for placement 90 to 95 percent of students get placed the biggest package is 4 to 5 lakh and the average is 250000 hotels like kemon tree and zuri and many others come here for placement.

My main interest of mine was in agriculture because I belong to a farming family and I want to help to grow farming with a combination of old and new techniques. But due to some reasons, I did not get this course. after that, I decided to choose that course.
The faculty and student ratio is almost fine .it is 1:20
all faculty members are Ph.D. holder and the teaching method is different for all teachers .it depend on them but the teachers really nice.the vibes of my college are totally different as compared to other colleges. there is so much greenery on campus.
the annual fest is named tempest and it is conducted in the month of march.
there is a large library with lots of books and also have wifi facility.
and about other activities, I want to say that, they are equally important as studies .and the important thing is that all run by students.

Name: Shivansh Singh
review:
The course curriculum is around 6 months. The students teacher ratio is about 1 is to 60. Which is pretty good.
You will find one of the best professor of India here. Which are very helpful and kind. Terms exams are easy over here.The campus life is pretty good. You will gonna love campus life. KIIT is the house of sports especially Olympics sports like hockey, and rugby. The social life is also pretty good. You will love the location of the college.

Name: Rahul pal
review: The class environment here is very good, we get to learn extra things here and our college campus is huge. Different types of sports also take place in our college. The library here is very good in which there are many books which are there to make our life very good and successful.The college itself conducts internships here and many companies also transfer the students. Most of the internships are conducted here during the holiday season, due to which we keep getting new information. Our college makes everyone do internships according to their branch.

Name: Naman Verma
review: My branch in this institute is mechanical engineering so the mechanical course curriculum is very good it covers many topics for gate exams and ies and our college many students work in many PSUs and many students in ies and is also. The faculty is good and all are PhD holders and helpful. The student and faculty ratio is not better but good. Every faculty are intelligent in her own field. Two semesters exam mid and end but in nowadays 2 mid sem and one end some exam will conduct in our college in this year. Exams are very difficult if ur not studying then u will not pass the examMany fests are conducted in our college like adhyay. A technical event like technika and many more but every year a minimum of 4 fests are conducted in our college. Books are available in our Tagore library and every student excess e book of hbtu. The classrooms are big and include ac. Sports activities are good but not better. Every year HPL conducted harcourtiam premium league.

Name: Shomit Bhattacharya
review: From the past records, we can say that KIIT offers genuine placement offers. It generally offers 100% placement for almost every branch. The average placement for the CSE branch ranges from 6-8 LPA and the highest placement this year went upto 62LPAAfter the KIITEE entrance exam, if you score a rank under 1000, you will get a scholarship of 10000 per month. The fees structure is 175000 per semester and hostel fees are 60000 per semester and mess fees are around 22000 per semester

Name: Md faiz Jamal
review:
from the 5th semester, the students are eligible for the placements but if the student is talented then they may be placed before  
there are 150 to 200 companies came to campus but some of them are ionex, TCS, nucleus, dell, hp etc.
the highest package is 1700000 and the lowest is 400000.
80% of students get placed every year.
after getting a degree I may find a good salaryits fees are excellent according to its infrastructure and its quality. national scholarship and Uttar Pradesh scholarship are the main scholarships provided here. mainly all the students got placed every year in almost all courses

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review: Our college will conduct an annual fest department wisely but for our department, it is namely Pragnya and for CSE it is a quest and for mech, it is sparks, etc.. it is conducted in the month of April. In our college, we have two libraries with huge collections of books and a digital library with ordinary computers. we have a big ground in our college and an indoor stadium for sports. our college gives primary priorities on extracurricular activities and clubs. We have a huge number of clubs in our college namely IEEE and wattguild, etc.Placements are started from 3-2 sem for regular students, and for  IDP it is 5-1 sem..in our college TCS, Microsoft, IBM Wipro Google and so on companies visit for placements it is approximately 30 to 40 companies. For the last academic year, the highest package is 46.5 LPA for ECE IDP students and the average package is 8+ lpa. For last year 55% of secured placement as per the principal voice in the auditorium hall.

Name: Soumyamoy Dhara
review:
In the 55th Semester, students become eligible for campus placement.
TCS and WIPRO are visited on our College campus.
The average package as per the company is 20000 rupees.
60% marks are mandatory to get placement.
A good and secure job placement after getting the degree.The annual fest is conducted in the month of December.
the library is very good, all books are available.
The classroom is very nice and clean.
All types of sports and extracurricular activities on our campus.
we have a college WhatsApp group for inform information.

Name: Satwat
review: Excellent. Everything is fine here. The curriculum and faculty members are excellent. All the faculty are very good and provide Full support to their students they also provide extra support whatever then needed hear the mentor is also supportive of the students and helps them to increase their knowledge and skills.The fee structure is like 175000 per semester and they take rs 1000 as the exam booking and semester booking charges and Mess fees are 22500. The opportunity for the scholarship is very high because the KIIT merit scholarship is for those who are under 1000 rank.

Name: Aryan Mehta
review: There are huge numbers of internship opportunities are there in Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology and the college provides every facility to avail of them at any given point in time. Companies like high-radius Amazon gives internship opportunities to students.I chose this course because I love computer science. The facilities here are good in their field and their qualifications are also very good. The exam conducted was very smooth and on time and it was a little difficult to pass but not impossible.

Name: Kavish Jain
review:
The annual fest of college is named aarohan and the tech-fest is named texter.
They are conducted in the months of May and November respectively.
The availability of books and generals in the library is a good amount.
Amenities in the classroom are not comfortable for a longer period but good for a short period of time.
The college has an enormous amount of sports and extracurricular activities on campus which includes the MIT-WPU summit of sports includes many types of sports college is also highly active in conducting seminars and motivational speeches.
There are many social groups clubs or websites for students runway students but some of them are hack x Mit WPU, innovators hub, and many others.That's fee structure is mentioned on the MIT website but for the particular engineering course the fee structure is 310000 per annum which is divided in two installments by the college for every year and there is a 10% hike every year for new admission.
Scholarship is also available if you are more than 99% in JEE mains and more than 95% in board exams.
Campus placement is not up to the mark but it is good for starting.
Overall I will consider it a little expensive in comparison with other colleges.

Name: Prathamesh Bhuyan
review: Life on the campus is very Amazing. The campus is very well organized and everything is very systemic in manner. Fests are usually conducted in the month of December. All the classrooms are smart classrooms with projector setup and CCTV monitoring.I chose this course because of my interest in this stream. The faculty-student ratio is perfectly balanced, that won't be an issue ever. The review of the faculties is great. Whenever you want to approach any faculty it won't be an issue.

Name: Muskan
review:
One year's fee for each course varies as I am pursuing B.Sc. in life sciences, my course fees are around 19k per year which is affordable. 
Many scholarships come during college which you will know during the session. 
In the last year of college, you will get placement from college on a good salary package. 
Also, you have so many chances to do internships with big companies like google, amazon, Internshala, etc. with a good stipend per month.I choose B.Sc. life sciences because I want to study zoology botany and chemistry all in one course that's why I choose it. 
The atmosphere of the college is very nice teachers are Ph.D. holders.
Their teaching method is so nice they make a friendly environment for students.
There is a semester system at DU but before the final exam, we have soo many tests taken by our teachers to evaluate us for an internal exam.

Name: Chandni Singh
review: The campus is good and the ambiance of the blocks is very nice and the C block is the best. Classes are provided with projectors and labs are provided with good computers and air conditioners. Many clubs in the college provide extra co-curricular activities along with sports.As I m from B.Tech so after the 6th semester we all are eligible for campus placements. Companies like Wipro, Infosys, and many more provide opportunities with an average package of 4 lakhs and more. My plan after getting a degree is to prepare for MTech.

Name: Pratap Kumar Dey
review:
The fee structure of this college is very low among all the colleges in India. For a general student, he has an admission fee of only 15000 in a year. If the student is a girl she has to pay only 7000 in a year and for SC and ST, they have to pay only 3000 in a year. And this fee is constant for 6 years.
The scholarship pattern of this college is also good. If any student has an annual income of less than 2 lakhs, then he/she gets a scholarship of a minimum of 20000 and a maximum of 60000. And in regards to the job, in the year 2021, the placement record is 80% and in 2022 it is more than 95 %. The highest package of this college is 44 lakh. And if any student place in any company he can get at least 4 lakh minimum.I choose this course because in Electrical the placement is good. Electrical students are placed in core companies as well as coding companies.
The faculty-student ratio is also good. The ratio is approx. 30: 120. The teachers who teach in B.I.T Sindri are minimum MTech from good colleges. And the HODs are Ph.D. from well-reputed NITs and IITs. The method of teaching is also good. There are smart blackboards. After every 1.5 months, there is a mid-sem exam and after 2 mid-sem exams, there is an End exam. There is a regular test that takes place. The difficulty level of this college is the same as others. One who is an average student can get a good CGPA in his/her exams.

Name: Rhema Tumati
college: Prasad V. Potluri Siddhartha Institute of Technology - [PVPSIT]
review: From 3rd year 2nd semester, students become eligible for campus placements. The highest package in civil engineering is 12LPA, 64% of students get the placements. My plan after getting the degree was to take coaching for the GATE exam and write the govt exams.Life at the campus is good. We also have annual fest tech fests. And we are very friendly with each other we have many clubs and also there are sports, and extra-curricular activities we have a fest last December, and our infrastructure is also good.

Name: Aditya Singh
review:
B.Tech students, they are eligible from the 7th sem for campus placement. In my time only 2-3 companies have visited and taken around 70-80 students.
I got placed in Nucleus Software with a package of 4.25LPA and you have to sharpen your skills then only you can pass the exam in off-campus mode. The highest package was 9LPA by company TIAA and the average package was 4.5LPA. 
75% of students got placed in respective companies from all courses.
My plans are so simple, I have no time for higher students and currently, I am working in MNC at a good package.Freshers were organized for the fresher batch in October and in February they call a singer and organize a fest including dinner. They also conduct a technical fest in mid of April and in your last year of college they organize Farewell.
The availability of books in the Library is good but some books are too old and out of the syllabus.
There are only fans in classes, and the bench is average.
Sports and extracurricular activities also organize in college every 6 months.
There are also clubs like cyber Srishti for CSE students and many more.

Name: Shivansh Sadana
college: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies - [UPES]
review:
Fees is the area which I will take as a con because for students coming out of Uttarakhand for them, the fees are quite high for BBA 3 lakhs per year is the fees also hostel fees are around 2 lakhs per annum so now you can imagine that after 3 years you will be spending a sum of at least 20 lakhs so that should be considered.
Talking about the scholarships the University offers quite good scholarships like you can appear for an entrance test before admission and that scholarship can be continued till the end if you perform well. Also, people from low-income groups receive certain benefits.
Loans and financial assistance are provided with much ease University has partnered with such firms who finance your whole course.I had a good interest in business and finance so I decided to go for this course. The faculty-student ratio is quite good. The faculty is always ready to help you and the class size does not exceed 65 in most cases. The teaching faculty is well educated almost every one of them has Ph.D. degrees in their respective fields and are very polite and helpful. The university follows the basic 2-semester rule system in which we have one mid-semester exam and then an end-semester exam. Mid-sem has a weightage of 20% and end-sem has a weightage of 70% rest weightage is for internal assessment.

Name: Aaradhya Dharmadhikari
college: Sagar Institute of Research and Technology - [SIRT]
review:
There are many types of Clubs in which we can get ourselves involved to get interactive in Public. Like, if there is a specific team or we can say a specific group that looks over that Activity. 
The annual fest is also a good happening, in which all must participate so that they can get Exposure to how everyone performs there, Public talks, Professionalism, etc. There are multiple types of Sports facility been provided like, Badminton court, Table Tennis, Cricket ground, Volleyball courts, etc. There are some teams, who are part of some Start-up or company, which means Campus Ambassador.I chose Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) branch as I wanted to know new things related to Hardware and Software,  I was interested in computer types gadgets and learning the newest technologies.
The faculty is also really helpful, and they are always ready to help us. Most of the faculty members here are Ph.D. holders and have completed PG in their respective fields, some are researchers also. Mid-sem exams get conducted after nearly 1.5 Months from the start of the  Semester and they are not so tough to pass but of good Level.

Name: Abhinav Sahay
review: I took btech CSE because I have an interest in designing and want to learn more about computers. The faculty here is excellent and supportive all the faculties are here well qualified and even the young professors are from IITs and NIITs so they make our work easier with the way they teach. Exams here are with no holidays either mid sem or end sem no holiday will be given to you and in each classroom, 2 teachers will be allotted and the level of questions is moderateFrom the 5th sem, you will get opportunities, and after the 6th internship will start coming and after a month or two your placement will start. More than 100 companies or even 200 companies come every year top recruiters like bosch microsoft deloitte oracle pwc and many more highest package by Microsoft 40 lacs more the 80% get placements after getting the degree to learn new things and when the offer letter comes for joining just work hard and fulfill my dreams

college: Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology, Management and Gramothan - [SKIT]

Name: Tanishka
review:
I choose this course because I am interested in the healthcare industry.
On average in this course, there are 15  - 30 students and for each subject different faculties are allocated. 
Faculty members are quite knowledgeable with Ph.D. qualifications. Teachers are cooperative and understanding. 
A semester is of 4 - 5 months. With 3 internals and 1 external exam.
The curriculum itself is easy, Study a bit harder, and it's easy to gain a high CGPA.I am personally doing an internship at Apollo Spectra Hospital, Greater Noida. It is paid internship.
my students have joined different hospitals,  blood banks, and labs for their dissertation work.
The students who were unable to do their internship outside the campus were offered to do it under their mentor's assigned.

Name: Rishabh Kumar
review:
No annual fests are conducted here since this college has more than 60000 students. I enjoyed only one fest which was 2 weeks long and held in the month of February 2023. This was held with the inauguration of the college's silver jubilee.
A student will get the books every semester for free from the college itself. 
Sports and extra-curricular activities are held every month in the college. You can participate in any of the sports or activities hassle-free. 
There are many student groups which are known as Student Society. I was in two societies named Kamakshi-HeforShe and Microsoft Students Community.Students become eligible for campus placements from the 5th semester. 
Many companies visit the college such as Amazon, Cognizant, High Radius, Capgemini, Adobe, CSG, JP Morgan, Delloite, etc. 
The average package is around 8.5 Lakhs. This year (2022) highest package offered was 58 Lakhs. 
Almost 95% of students get placed every year. 
My plan after getting a degree is to get placed with a salary of around 20 LPA.

review:

There are 70000 books in one library and we have such 3 libraries.
There are comfortable benches to sit with a blackboard and a smart board with fans lights and many more.Fees have been increased because the naac grade has increased to 3.74 out of 4 so the fee is now 90000 before it was 80000. Which I feel is a bit high according to the classes happening.

Name: Sudipan Podder
review:
KIIT University offers a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses across various fields, including engineering, law, management, medicine, fashion, and others. The course curriculum at KIIT University is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the subject matter, as well as practical skills necessary for their future careers. The curriculum is regularly updated to reflect changes in the industry, ensuring that students are well-prepared for the demands of their respective fields.
The faculty-student ratio at KIIT University is reportedly good, with a relatively high number of experienced faculty members compared to the number of students. The university has a team of well-qualified and experienced faculty members who are passionate about teaching and helping students achieve their academic goals. They are known for their dedication, professionalism, and expertise in their respective fields.The computer science department at KIIT University has a high placement rate, with a majority of the students being placed in top companies. The average salary package offered to the students in the computer science department is around 5-6 lakhs per annum, with some students receiving higher packages based on their skills and performance.
Some of the prominent recruiters include Amazon, IBM, Microsoft, Dell, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Capgemini, among others. The university has also seen a surge in the number of startups visiting the campus in recent years, offering students with exciting opportunities to work in innovative and emerging areas.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Sports facilities Multiple sports grounds & coaching present
College events Moderately busy calendar with 1-3 monthly events. Mess and Cooking arrangements are Hygienic, Quality and taste of food are acceptable
Attendance policy Incomplete attendance invites a penalty
Additional expenses The requirement to eat out despite mess fees, Books
Outside movement of girl students Allowed within restricted timingsSoftware companies like TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Cognizant, etc, and many more core companies hire students from our college. Good placements are available, best companies are ready to take the students, but mainly CSE, ECE, and EEE got more opportunities compared to the remaining branches

Name: Rohan khomane
review:
The campus is one of the best campuses in India. Kiitfest is the annual fest conducted.
All the necessary books are available in the library. There is a separate infrastructure for each kind of sport ( cricket, football, hockey, basketball, rugby, tennis, and many more).  Some of the clubs are IOT, KSACI choose this course as I was interested to do so. The faculty ratio is around 15:1. The faculties are mostly PhD or M.tech ones. Teaching is good enough. Some are best and some are worse which is almost the same case in every other college. Exams are moderate and can be passed easily

Name: Kunal Shaw
review:
I am not sure about other branches but for computer science and IT, we had special training programs organised during our holidays. They did charge some nominal amount, which seems to be a lot when you are in college, but later on, you realised its importance. Today, if I can write in my resume that I am OCJP JE6, certified then the credits solely go to those training provided to us.
Apart from that in our 3rd year of engineering Microsoft did come to recruit people for internships and even provided PPOs to some deserving students. I am sure such programs must be organised for other branches as well. If not maybe you could start an initiative and bring in companies for internship. You just need to think big.I have chosen Btech(Computer science Engineering) as my curriculum, my rank was 320 so I got the opportunity to select any of the courses provided by the college in a stipulated time frame.
In KIIT student ratio is 1:1, it's a healthy environment you will feel here.
All the professors have PHD degrees and many professors are from IIT, and IIIT and some are even from Harvard. Teaching is good they help us a lot.
Toral of 8 semesters are there with every semester there you have to give two exams, mid sem and end sem.

Name: T SUNDUPALLI BALAJI
college: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology - [Vel Tech]
review: I have interest in electronics and communication engineering since my school stage and there is the plenty amount of faculty to teach each subject there are many facilities for digital teaching and labs in the easier way many faculties are professors. Internals will conduct every month and sem exam every 6 months.The placements start in the 6th semester and many companies will come but most are for it for core jobs the companies will come but many students will go for it. The highest package is during my batch its 43 lpa for amazon the average will get 4 to 7lpa.

Name: Sahil S Sarvade
review: I choose BCA analytics as I was interested to move into the data analytics field. Amenities in the classroom are not much just a blackboard and a projector with a white screen for it. But the classrooms are well equipped with furniture for the students. review: The course curriculum feels pretty much hectic at times to complete core course papers within 6 months, however, the practicals keep me glued to the subject. Name: Arshiyan khan
college: Dr. Vithalrao Vikhe Patil College of Engineering
review: After completing the 3rd year you are eligible to go for an interview conducted in the campus drive. The college arranges in campus placement drive every year many companies visit there for an interview and mostly go to selected packages offered like min. 2LPA to 7 LPA. Remaining about my plans after getting the degree I am going to seek better opportunities in Pune or Bangalore and for now, I am doing different types of certification courses which can help me to grow in future.Basically, there is a total fee of 98000 approx. But if you are in any type of category then you are a reserved candidate based on different categories for the EWS category there is a 50% concession in tuition fees and the same for obc and for others like my friend is in vjnt or something I don't remember but he has only 13000 annually fees. You have to apply on the Mahadbt portal to take benefit of the scholarship and you need to pay only the remaining fees except for the fees which are pending to pay by the government.

Name: Abhishek
review:
I have chosen this course due to my interest in the food and nutrition sector. Student: faculty ratio is healthy. Professors here are highly qualified with PhDs, post-doctoral research, research papers, etc in their respective fields. 
This 4-year course has 3 years of Theories and Practical semesters with exams of both at the end and 2-semester internships which are an Experiential learning programme and a Rural awareness work experience program as per the curriculum prescribed by ICAR.Fee increment is there but it is completely dependent on the notification from the government's side. 
The fee is around 28,000 for the first semester and around 10,000 for the rest of the semesters. 
Mess dues are around 2000 per month
There are a lot of scholarships to cover up your expenses like the merit Scholarship, the ISHAAN UDAY scholarship for NE students and NTS as well.

Name: Faizan Ahmed
review:

The curriculum is designed to provide students with a holistic education and develop their skills and knowledge.

The teaching is Best for the student because the teacher knows where the student get lacking because in the past they are a student only, therefore, they focus on the important topics and explained them in deep and full coverage with very simple methods so that students can get easily understand. Every month on any Saturday of that month must have the events like singing dancing coding competitions etc. The sports is very good. Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I have chosen this course because I had a good command of Biology related concepts and I did my schooling(10th, 12th) in biology as the main subject. Also, bioengineering has many future scopes.
Faculty: student ratio is good. Every student has an opportunity to ask their study-related doubts even after the class hour in the respective faculty's cabin. Apart from this, each student is assigned one faculty whom he/she can contact if they have any queries.
All faculties are Ph.D. holders so they have a very good understanding and knowledge of their respective subjects. The teaching method is excellent which includes group activities, presentations, real-time projects, faculty-student interaction, coordination, cooperation, and teaching every concept in such a manner that everyone can understand it.Life at the Campus is awesome. VIT Bhopal University held AdVITya every year as their annual fest and tech fest. It is conducted mostly during new year months like January or February. 
All learning materials and subject-related books are available in the library. There is a good collection of course-related books and journals. 
Classrooms are well structured with projectors, tables, chairs, etc.
There are so many activities conducted by different clubs on campus including sports, dance, debates, dramas, competitions, workshops, seminars, and so on.
Each extracurricular club has its social group and website for students which is run by the student coordinator of that respective club, for example, Dance club, Sports club, Tech club, etc.

Name: Pratham patel
review:
I chose this course because it is future-proof and I had an interest in computers. 
We have many great facilities for core subjects from IIT NIT and for programming subjects we have facilities from bytexl learning company from Bangalore industry experts', terms exams are conducted on time and can achieve great marks with good preparations.The placements start from the 7th semester and yes the university does provide placements, the companies that came here are Infosys, TCS, lnt, reliance, azure, and oracle. The highest package offered is 20 LPA and the  average is 5 LPA, I am going to apply for placements if good offers then stay else abroad for further opportunities .

Name: Devesh pandey
review:
The fee of my college is very moderate and affordable to get admission and I want to say that this is a good college for graduation and for getting technical education.
The students who are eligible for scholarships get their scholarships and the campus placement is about 6 to 7 lakhs on average.A fest organized in my college named Parampara is held every year in April month.

There are many social sites and social networking IDs that can control by the students.

Name: NAMAN SHUKLA
college: Jaypee University of Engineering and Technology - [JUET]
review:
The campus is very huge around 120-125 acres. And the infrastructure is also pretty well. The library is open till 11:30 pm. The collections of books present in the Library are quite good. You can find any book there which is well-known. Classrooms are not too much big but are enough to manage 35 students at a time and the lecture theatres have a capacity of around 120-130 students.
If we talk about sports then I can say it's pretty good in that field, you can usually get one or two tournaments of each sport in a semester.I always wanted to choose CSE because I have a great interest in programming. Some of the faculties are highly qualified, some are from IIT's and some teachers studied in foreign. 
If we talk about exams, I can say that exams are not that tough if you manage to study the tutorial questions provided by faculty members.

Name: Anyasha Das
college: MNNIT Allahabad - Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology - [MNNIT]
review: I choose this course because I was inclined towards the software field and our college has an excellent history of placements for the Computer science branch. The teaching of the faculty is nice too. The teaching methods are quite advanced too. The college has many professors with numerous degrees and they have been working in the software field for 20-plus years. The term exams have been regular and have been timely too. Name: Shivam Dhingra
college: School of Open Learning, University of Delhi - [SOLDU]
review:
There are many Sections for Job oriented Training that happen in March every Year.
 There are Plenty Of books available in the campus library.
Amenities in the Classroom are White Boards, Well Developed Wooden Benches, and Ventilated Windows.
Sports and Extra Curricular Activities- There are many activities on an Arts Topic.

Name: Harshal jadhav
review:
I chose this college because of it's good teaching with good faculties and it's only the reason why placements ratio is so good of this college.

Name: Shashank kumar
review:

The profile offered by the companies are audit department and HR and marketing 
After my degree I'll be taking up HR

Name: Arpita Saha
review:
The college campus is very big. The college is near the Teesta river so you will get great views of nature. The annual tech and cultural fest are Esperanza, which is conducted in the month of March-April. There are so many different clubs for both tech and cultural events. There are Peptalks, tech-o-nicks for the technical event, and Rongmosal, Ramdhanu, dance club, drama club, music club, etc for the cultural event. Also, we have a "Google Developer Student Club" in our college. In the month of April/May, there is held sports tournaments (Cricket, Volleyball, Football). The library is also big and filled with lots of books however the no of books is not enough for all students.I choose computer science and engineering because I have an interest in coding and software development.
There is 6 faculty member and 72 students so there is a 1:12 faculty-student ratio.
Most of the teachers are highly qualified. Some have done their PhD. The teaching is also very good, the teachers are very humble and friendly.
There are 4 CA exams in 1 semester and they are easy to pass if study a lit bit.

review:
There are three courses in our college LLB 3 years, bllb 5 years, and LLM 2 years and all course fees are different.
The fee for LLB is 44000 per year and BA LLB is 55000 per year and the fee for LLM is 60000 per year.

Recently Mahendra company come to our college and ICICI Bank comes to our college for placement.
I think 50% of students will get placement every year.
When I complete my course I become a lawyer at Patna High court.

The companies like Capgemini, Accenture, London stock exchange etc. For placement, The students should have minimum 6 cgpa. 40% of students get placement.

review:
I selected this course personally because of the family pressure plus societal pressure. There are so many claims from this course that mostly all students try to get this course no matter what. And there are so many jobs in it so I selected it.
There is decent faculty present on the campus but very strict in every manner so not too good thing but some faculty members are good too.
These are very qualified faculty members depending on what they do maybe best in their department of liking. Some have a very easy way of teaching and a fun way and some have a very careless way of teaching just like typical teachers.

Getting placed in the public sector unit like ONGC or oil India etc.
This is my target of mine to achieve in campus placement only. And get high-payout jobs in these companies. And to apply the knowledge which I have gained in my college studies in a practical wayExams are moderate. They are easy to pass if you study properly in the class. Self-study is essential. And exams are taken on a regular basis. Class tests, internal exams, and surprise tests all are there along with the whole sem.

Name: Gourab Samajdar
review:
PESCO is Conducted every year and serves as the refresher for the whole year around. On an addition we have The Kalotsava and many other events which will keep you engaged and charmed throughout your course period. 

Library is well equipped with a humungous collection of books and by books it means good authors for almost all topics and subjects that are requisite for competitive as well the college semester exams. 

Classrooms are well ventilated will projector and a digital system available in almost all of them. 

When it comes to sports it's of a high value in this college. Almost every month witnesses some or the other state level competition in the college and there is absolutely no sport which the college doesn't provide facility for. So if you're a sports freak ... You'll definitely have a good time here are PESCE Mandya. 

Clubs are run by student groups based on activities that are energized by the students themselves. Course Curriculum Is Based On The Latest NEP Scheme. That Is National Education Policy Scheme. This Scheme Offers The Students Not Only To Attain Theoretical Knowledge But Also Priorities The Development Of A Student's Skills As Well. Hence I Found This College A Booster For Powering Up And Installing New Skills In Me. 

Faculty Members Are All Highly Qualified As Well As Knowledgeable. Special Care Is Taken For Students Who Have Difficultly In Specific Topics For A Particular Subject. The Syllabus Coverage By The Faculties Are Very Proper And Done On Time.

Name: Deepak
review: They always conduct fest-like technology and co-curricular events. The library is excellent every book is available and they have a library for students. Sports activities are also conducted by the college and it gives a platform to pursue your sports skill. There is a YouTube channel run by students.The fees are not much it is a government college and fees are less and you will get scholarships and financial assistance is also there. Students getting placement also. Overall it is an affordable college for every student as course fee is ok of 30000 for my course.

Name: myank
review: Students who are average or above average always get placed, while other students who are placed also get placements but do not get a high package. our campus is routinely visited by new startups as well as some major businesses like Infosys, TCS. the maximum package for this is 33 LPA, and possibly around 4LpaFee for the underprivileged the cost of attending Poornima college of engineering is reasonable. this college offers scholarships based on grades from the 12th grade, which enables parents to pay lower tuition for their kids. additionally, the annual costs are split into four payment

Name: Shashank Singh
college: Army Institute of Management and Technology - [AIMT]
review: The placement here in AIMT is very good , some of the very famous companies like PUMA , HDFC, HAVELLS, EY, PAYTM, MAKEMYTRIP etc visit here. Almost everyone gets placement here , some of the get placed in more than 2 companies. After degree we all are going for startup.The fees for MBA are 165000 per semester and there are many scholarships for the wards of serving and retired personnel. Job opportunity here in AIMT is very good, many good companies like HDFC, PUMA, HAVELLS etc visit here with handsome package.

Name: Mohammad Kaif Khan
review:
I choose MSc botany because the staff of botany is quite good in comparison to others.
The total no. Of teachers are 7 and the students in each class 25.
Every single teacher is a Doctorate
The teaching methods of every teacher are different and three teachers are the best in every fields of knowledge
The college is affiliated with DDU university Gorakhpur and they decide the exam schedule basically we have to give semester exams in every 5 to 6 months and mid-semester exams after 3 months after the class start date.
The exam pattern is mcq type 80% and 20% descriptive and the difficulty level is from mid to high.The annual fest sports meet and everything is conducted from NOV-DEC and they're quite okay.
The availability of books is average in the library.
Amenity in the classroom is good.
You can play basketball, cricket, and football in the college.
You can join the NCC camp also.
There are no such websites that are run by students.

Name: Shivam Rai
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review: The fee structure of the college is as tuition fee is 1 lac 50 thousand per annum while you have to pay for the hostel separately which is around 1 lac per annum. Scholarships are available to students of sc st caste and obc students and also to ews students.The placements of college are decent and really good as compared to other colleges in this area. The highest package offered last year was around 58 lac per annum to one of our seniors and the average package was around 650000 per annum.

Name: KARANAM VENGAL NAIDU
review:
There is a big fest named CHIGURU, which will be celebrated in the month of June /July.
Intra and inter college competitions will be conducted and will be awarded.
And tech fests like hackathons, ideation and etc will be conducted at the college level.
A lot of varieties of books and journals and even magazines are available in the library. And even an e-library will be provided to the students to make it convenient. 
Sports like volleyball, cricket, kabaddi, and basketball will be encouraged.
An indoor stadium is available and even ground is available.
Yeah, some groups are there which are maintained by some authority but the information provided will be genuine. 
www.cambridge.edu.in is the college website for any query please contact us.I have chosen ECE which is electronic and communication engineering.
Because I am very interested in the core jobs related to this course.
The faculty will be teaching each and every module and even beyond the syllabus.
As per my knowledge faculties are well educated and will educate the students in the same way.
There will be 3 internal assessments periodically between 45 to 60 days.
That will be a little bit tough compared to the university.
To ensure that the students should clear the subject on the first attempt itself.

Name: Aryan Harsh srivastav
review: College provides Many activities on the college campus like tech venz, freshers party for juniors, farewell and many more. Every department of the college has there a personal library in which so many generals and books are present. College also provides extracurricular activities like sports in which students of different departments compete among us.I pursuing my graduation in b pharma. And the faculties are very helpful and familiar to the students. I think there is a 1:15 ratio of faculty and students. most of the faculties have master's and PhD qualifications. so the term exams are held in particular periods of time and it is quite tough to pass

Name: Kartavya
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review: The course curriculum is pretty simple and easy to understand. The faculty-to-student ratio here is around 1 teacher per 50 students and class strength is also near to 65 students. Faculties are qualified decently and some are PhD holders as well. Exams are conducted twice per semester before the end sem exam.The fee Structure of the college is simple and is around 1 lakh 50 thousand per year. this is the tuition fee only as you have to pay separately for hostel charges which are around 1 lac per year including four-time meals. Apart from this, you've to pay 8000 per semester to AKTU for the semester's exam fee.

Name: SUMEET KANT
review:
I selected this course personally because of the family pressure plus societal pressure. There are so many claims from this course that mostly all students try to get this course no matter what. And there are so many jobs in it so I selected it.
There is decent faculty present on the campus but very strict in every manner so not too good thing but some faculty members are good too.
These are very qualified faculty members depending on what they do maybe best in their department of liking. Some have a very easy way of teaching and a fun way and some have a very careless way of teaching just like typical teachers.
Term exams are moderate and sometimes a little hard depending on how the teacher was who was teaching and did he was teaching properly or not. Passing is mostly easy every teacher passes the student but again mostly depends on the teacher as I said faculty is strict.There are two main fests one tech fest is known as Moksha and another is a cultural fest known as Resonance. There are plenty of books and journals available for students in the library and are quite easy to avail.
There is so much exposure to other things than studying like all sports are present plus are being taught by the coaches and there are many societies which also help in extracurricular activities.
There is an app present named Nsutx made by students for the student profile and mainly attendance and there are a few pages after college on Instagram handled by the students.

Name: Md Yazdan Rizwan
review: I choose this course at this university because of its attractive and low course fees. Also, the infrastructure of this university is damn good. The teachers are helpful and well-qualified. The labs are also good here. And this university is located in a prime location of Hyderabad surrounded by a lot of MNCs like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Qualcomm, Deloitte, etc.The fess is damn good for a course like B.Tech in Computer Science i.e 5500/semester. Also, the hostel fees are too good i.e 6400/year + around 2200/month for the mess. Though getting a hostel in this university is a challenging task you have to be a good student with high marks to get a hostel.

Name: Sudipta Adhikary
review: The course curriculum of our university is made in our university as it is a autonomous University not registered under MAKAUT. The faculty is good very much cooperative. It's a 1:50 faculty student ratio. The faculty is well qualified in their respective fields. If we talk about exams till now as of February I have given one exam and the next one is starting from 24th.Placements as far as I heard, it's great we can't expect to get placements like IITs or LPU but it's good. Many companies visit our college like Microsoft, cognizant, Wipro, TCS, CAPGEMINI, IBM, and many more. The highest package of TIU is 25 lakhs per annum.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Social Life- It is crazy. The friends, bond, and connections one make are parallel to none. Party culture and peer learning are there. 
The library is really good with almost all journals required for projects, assignments and case studies available. 
We participate in various sports tournaments across different B-Schools throughout the year and there is a section war plus senior vs juniors in sports. We have all kinds of sports facilities available which one plays on a day-to-day basis. 
There are various committees, clubs, and SIGs which one can be a part of once you are on campusWe have our summer internship process in September and once you are placed, you'll be required to do your internship in April-May-June of the next year. The avg SIP this year was 2,82,000 for 2 months which is basically 1,40,000 per month. 
The highest stipend stood at 2,00,000 per month and the lowest at 75,000 per month.
All the students get placed. So if you are worried that you are not good enough, no need to worry, you'll also be placed at a very good stipend.

review:

Name: Moksha jain
college: HR College of Commerce and Economics
review: This course specialises in Accounting and Finance and my aim is MBA in finance so it can be the foundation of it. The faculty in HR is very good. Teachers are very humble and Helpful. I would rate the course 8/10 other than that the only con is many times the teacher gets lazy and doesn't teach that properly.Mystique is the name of our official fest and it was a blast. We've AC, a water cooler, and a projector to present the material. Every year there is an Annual Sports meet where students can showcase their athletic talent plus there are other small Sports events happening once in a while.

Name: NIKHIL LALASAHEB ELAJALE

review: Campus Life is very much enriched by the care and efforts taken by the college. All the faculty members are at least post-graduated and some have done their PhD teaching is done in such a way that even a novice can easily understand.
