Fees are nominal as compared to private colleges. It is affordable and a loan facility is also available from the Institute Bank. 
Fee hike occurs frequently but overall fees are affordable till now. As a general candidate, there are no such scholarship opportunities. My course fee is Rs.220000.The course curriculum is good, the Faculties are okay, and Classes are just for formalities in some cases. But some professors have great knowledge as some of them are in the top 2% of scientists in the world. Exams are conducted thrice including two mid seems and one end sems.

Name: Aman Shukla
college: Sagar Institute of Research and Technology - [SIRT]
review: There are many types of Clubs in which we can get ourselves involved to get interactive in Public. Like, if there is a specific team or we can say a specific group that looks over that Activity. The annual fest is also a good happening, in which all must participate so that they can get introduced to new members from all over the category and to know how everyone performs there, Public talks, Professionalism, etc. There are multiple types of Sports facility been provided like, Badminton court, Table Tennis, Cricket ground, Volleyball courts, etc. There are some teams, who are part of some Start-up or company, which means Campus Ambassador.I chose Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) branch as I wanted to know new things related to Hardware and Software, I was interested in the computer field and learning the newest technologies. The faculty is also so nice to us, and they are always ready to help us. Most of the faculty members here are PhD holders in their respective fields, some are researchers also. Mid-sem exams get conducted after nearly 1.5 Months from the start of the Semester and at the end of the Exam, all the students get to know, how we should write an examination.

Name: Narendra Singh
review: College fees are definitely affordable or I will prefer to say value for money. College fees are 12,000/- per annum. Fees are very low compared to a similar level of colleges. I have worked in an internship provided by my chemistry department under the DBT College star scheme.Annual fests are conducted at department and college levels also every 1 St Feb kirorimal College celebrates its foundation day. Freshers are also called conducted in college in Jan and Feb. All the sports facilities are available like Indoor and outdoor gaming.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
Every year there is college week and other events. Events are more during the summer. The college week event is more like a college month where every day before or after classes we have events of different themes. The college is also well known for its various sports activities. Every year within the college, sports activities are held before or during the college week. College athletes get to represent and compete in various competitions outside or within the state. There are also other various activities and clubs in the college for students with other different interests such as social activities or music clubs etc. The college also takes us for excursions within the state and outside the state during the winter holidays.
The classroom is big and well-ventilated. The library is also provided with almost every book and journal needed for the students and within it, there is a computer lab for students' purposes only.The course fees are around 20-25000 for a year. Each fee is paid when a semester begins or is finished, which makes it affordable for every student to come and study in the college. Financial assistance is also provided in case of students with financial problems. And Scholarship is also given every year.

Name: Moksha jain
college: HR College of Commerce and Economics
review: This course specialises in Accounting and Finance and my aim is MBA in finance so it can be the foundation of it. The faculty in HR is very good. Teachers are very humble and Helpful. There are like two teachers for one subject with the strength of 150 students in a class. Every teacher has an experience of at least 5 years and has done phd in their respective fields. The exams were taken on time and the paper was really easy. Teachers helped us by giving us important questions and the most likely topics to come in the exam. I would rate the course 8/10 other than that the only con is many times the teacher gets lazy and doesn't teach that properly.Mystique is the name of our official fest and it was a blast. There are more than 50 clubs like the Student Council, Investment Club, TEDXHRCOLLEGE, Research Cell, Rotaract Club, Placement Cell, NSS etc. in the college of which you can be a part and it is fun. Every club organizes events like business pitches, mysterious events, moot courts, dancing, literary arts etc. where you get the opportunity to explore more paths. We've AC, a water cooler, and a projector to present the material. Every year there is an Annual Sports meet where students can showcase their athletic talent plus there are other small Sports events happening once in a while.

Name: Yash patidar
review: IIIT Nagpur is a very good college and I choose this college because of the computer science engineering course. The faculty is quite good. all faculties are Phd qualified and have good knowledge of their respective subjects. Every month there is one or two sessional examination and also one end semester Examination. The exam was quite easy and moderate level and we can pass easily by just taking notes from classes and also we can attend online YouTube etc for help.Every year 2 to 3 feet,  Tech Fest, Abhivyakti are conducted in our college. All subject curricula, books and journals are available in the library and open up to 10:00 PM. The classrooms are very good and air-conditioned. Many sports and other extracurricular activities are also there. Orator Club and estoria(drama) Club are also in our college.

Name: NIKHIL LALASAHEB ELAJALE
college: Smt Kashibai Navale College of Engineering - [SKNCOE] Vadgaon
review: Campus Life is very much enriched by the care and efforts taken by the college. The campus, the infrastructure, and the various buildings for each department provide a completely different atmosphere. Karandak is the annual fest hosted each year around March and it is a major attraction amongst all. Internet along with research paper access and computers, newly published books and journals are available. All the necessary amenities are present for student and teacher comfort. There is more than 1 large-scale ground for sports life. Many inter-departmental and inter-college matches are held to boost sportsmanship. There are many clubs managed by students such as robotics club, motorsport club, Ecell, ACR, NSS etcThe course curriculum is implemented by SPPU for over 90 colleges and it is very in touch with the new updates and basic requirements for stepping into the job phase. Computer Engineering (engineering in general) course is very realistic and practical in execution aspect so I opted for this course. A basic batch compromises 23 students at Max which are managed by 1 teacher for practicals so that students' and teachers' communication gap is less and can coordinate well. 2 teacher guardians are also appointed for a while division comprising of 60-70 students. All the faculty members are at least post-graduated and some have done their PhD teaching is done in such a way that even a novice can easily understand.

review: We have approximately stayed in our college for a total of one year and 8-9 months and it is because we got admission during covid and we have been given three semesters online to date. but yes the amount of time we have stayed here felt nice to me ..respective clubs organise different cultural activities from time to time on specific occasions also. we have different clubs as usual but a club dedicated to poor children residing near to the campus and our students help them in any way they can like providing old books copies dresses any sort of thing which in my view is great to work.We have 8 semesters and 5-6 subjects per semester at the present time I'm in the 6th semester and the subjects which are relevant for practical purposes in our core branch are just three to four in total. this shows how much our course curriculum is relevant or not but yes the faculties are well educated some are easy to understand and some are not also okay ...

Name: Yogesh Kumar
college: Government Sivagangai Medical College and Hospital - [GSMCH]
review:
I chose this course as it was my dream and it was efficient in earning money in this situation too
Actually, the ratio is 4 faculty per 100 students
Facilities are highly qualified and they possess great knowledge about the subjectThe annual fest here in govt sivagangai medical college is called mephobia
It was conducted in August
Books are available always in college stores anytime
Sports have been given more importance here equal to the course

Name: Tarun chauhan
college: G L Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
review: The fee structure is also simple. Per year College fees are 150000 and besides this, you have to pay 8000 to aktu for semester exams (once per year payment). The cost of studying is a bit high in this area, scholarships are available to sc st and OBC students and also to ews students as well.Placements of College are pretty awesome. If concentrating solely on placements it is one of the best colleges for placements in this area and aktu. The highest package last year was 57 lac per annum to one of our seniors in Palo Alto and the average package was around 6.5 lacs.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Kakatiya University College of Engineering and Technology -[KUCE&T]
review: computer science or information technology is the developing course with which we can place fast compared to other courses. our faculty are supportive and better with teaching, passing semester exams is a medium level not so hard and not so easyannual fests are once a year but tech fests are rare. availability of books in the library is good but limited books we have to take, the classroom is good, and sports and extracurricular activities are few ncc and nss are available.

Name: MOHD ASAD ALI
review: The fee structure of MBA is like decent one can't be called perfect as MBA is an expensive course here in India but still the fee is a little bit high here in the university and the scholarship here is something which you get when you give the cat and 75 percentile you get 25 per cent scholarship and on 85 percentile you get 40 and on 90 and above percentile you get 100 per cent scholarship in the first sem itselfThe life on campus mostly what amity is famous for like a well built green campus good security at the gates and a big canteen with mostly everything which a student needs or wants to eat during lunch is available there and a big sports section at the ground you can call and there are many events happenings every now and then depending on the person who wants to participate

Name: SUKUMAR KRISHNAN
review:
The course curriculum is updated regularly. We have subjects such as Platform Business Models, Business Analytics with R, and courses on IoT. This ensures that whatever is being taught is in line with what's going on in the industry. I chose XIMB, because of its reputation as a premier institution in spite of not being in a metro city. This speaks volumes about the quality of the institution. 
The faculty-student ratio is 1:12, ensuring that everyone is able to grasp the concepts taught and clear their doubts. We have highly qualified faculty, with some who are stalwarts in their respective fields. Teaching methods vary according to faculty, but there is a central emphasis on case-based learning, which makes difficult concepts easier to relate to.  There is a lot of academic rigour at XIMB, and while actually failing a course is pretty rare - the academic load can get stressful at times.We have a lot of student committees. One can be part of core committees ( Eg- CAS - The placement committee, Alcom - Alumni Committee), Functional Committees (Eg - MAXIM - Marketing Committee, XFIN - Finance Committee), or Interest Committees.
The library is well-equipped and sufficiently stocked, with very helpful staff. We have fully air-conditioned classrooms with sufficient space. There is a football ground, jogging track, indoor badminton court, volleyball court, basketball court, and cricket practice nets.
Xpressions is the annual management and cultural fest of XIMB, which is a 3-day extravaganza full of fun and frolic.

Name: Sri Ram
review:
The skills thought in this course have a very high demand in coming future.
It makes the students completely ready for the corporate world.
A single teacher handles a class of 50 to 70 students.
Exams are basically easy if you are attentive in class you can score well.From the 5th semester students become eligible for the interview. By the 4th semester, the placement training for the students is started so that they can learn something and be ready for the interview.
Big four and many more companies come to offer the jobs.

Name: Anshika Malhotra
college: K J Somaiya Institute of Management
review: Life at the campus is great, it is a lush green campus with a lot of amenities, committees, clubs, and sports activities for the students. there are events happening every now and then and the annual fest Melange is something to wait for, the library on the other hand gives access to numerous books and journals both online and offline.The campus placements are available for both Summer Internships and Final placements, the process for the summer internships starts from the first Trim/Semester itself. The college assists you with the placements well. the average final placements were 12,45,000.

Name: MD TAUSEEF
review:
There is an eco-friendly campus where every student will feel good and enjoy the campus. Every year fresher parties and yuva fest and many more are done within the campus. The library is very neat and clean and thousands of books are available.
There was a common room for both boys and girls which is the best part of the campus. There were student union groups are in universities like NSUI, ABVP, AJSU etc.Companies like TATA MARUTI SUZUKI INFOSYS WIPRO etc. came with various types of jobs role like accountant, sale executive, data entry operator, data analyst, and IT sector with good stipends under internship in various fields. Anyone who wants to study in BBMK University their heart-warming welcomes a great personality name binod bihari mahto once said "padho aur lado

Name: Anjani Kumar
college: MNNIT Allahabad - Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology - [MNNIT]
review: I took computer science and engineering because it was of interest to me and the field is very vast and offers a lot of opportunities. The faculty-to-student ratio is decent in this institute. All the faculties are highly qualified and their teaching methods are easy to understand and effective. There is a mid-semester exam and an end-semester exam which are held midway between the semester and at the end of the semester respectively. If you attend classes regularly and study on your own a bit before the exams it's fairly easy to pass them.The cultural fest is called Culrav and it is held in April. The tech fest is called Avishkar and it is held in December. The library is huge and has a lot of hard copies and soft copies of various books and journals available. The classrooms are decent but not too good but it has all the amenities. There is a sports fest which is held in January. The websites for Culrav and Avishkar are maintained by students.

Name: Mohan
college: PSV College of Engineering and Technology - [PVSCET]
review:
I have some knowledge of coding and software side so I prefer this course.
There are 11 faculties in our department and 60 students in our class.
Facilities are well qualified and teaching is also good.
Exams are conducted often and it's hard to get pass.Annual fests are conducted once a year and tech fest is also once a year. Annual day is conducted in march month and tech fest in November month.
We have a large library on our campus. Equal importance is given to sports and studies.

Name: Koushik
college: Kakatiya University College of Engineering and Technology -[KUCE&T]
review: Coming to the course curriculum and faculty members, the course was a little bit old and it should be improved to the latest technology. The faculty was good. There were a sem,2 mids, and lab externals in a sem. A class consists of 70 members.Coming to the fee structure, the fee structure was based on the type of course. There are 2 types of courses. For the regular course, the fee was 18000 and for the self-financed course 35000. The fee hike policy was done in 2021.

Name: Mohammed Taher Abbas
college: BMS Institute of Technology and Management - [BMSIT]
review: The fee structure was a bit costly for the management seat, it was around 3 lakhs per year, and there was no fee hike, many scholarships are provided by our college, and the job I got on campus was cognizant with a stipend of 15000.The student becomes eligible for campus placements in the final year of engineering the highest package was 25 LPA and the lowest package was 4lpa with the average being 6 LPA, almost 80% of the sty get placed on the campus.

Name: Aashuraj
college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review:
I chose this course because, in the coming time, it plays a very important role in electrical vehicles.
Qualifications of all faculty are Ph.D. and master's degrees.
After every 21 days, a sessional exam will be held in the college.107000 is the one-year fee of the college.
Fee waivers, UP scholarships, and management scholarships are available in the college and these are given based on students' performance and many other criteria in college.

Name: Sparsh Majumdar
review: For my course students from the third semester start with their internship. The course I have opted for has the guidance of people who have an experience in the field we want to be a part of. Many companies such as Wipro, Ericsson, Bosch, and Siemens have visited the campus.The fee for my course which is B.Tech (CSE) is 2 lakhs per year, in total 8 lakh for 4 years. The fees for 1 year is split into two parts for even and odd semester including transport cost and other facilities such as a security deposit.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: K.K. Wagh Institute of Engineering Education & Research - [KKWIEER]
review: Maffick is the annual fest that takes place in the institute.  Moreover, each department has its own techfest which is generally conducted in the month of march every year. Name: Sajal somankar
review:

There are many books and a big library is present at our university.

NSS and NCC are some social groups in college.There has been no fee hike policy since I got admission so I'm unable to give proper information about that.
Currently, I'm not seeking any financial benefits or scholarships from the college. But government scholarships are applicable.

Name: Hardik soham kakde
review:

For companies like VNR seeds and many more the highest package was 500000. 
75% gets placed in different companies. 
After a degree get a nice job.Fees hike is very high repeatedly fees are increasing and the cost to study is approximately 60000 including bus fees mess and other requirements.
The scholarship is available for minorities and backward classes, parents who have income below 100000 their children also get scholarships.

Name: Shaikh yusuf
review:

We have a Library and almost all the books are easily available.

Sports grounds and sports tournaments are regularly organized like cricket leagues and other sports.The fee hike is not so much most of the time it remains the same like mine was 22000 a year. 
There are various scholarships provided by the government of Odisha so you can avail of them. 
Financial assistance is provided to students from the reserved category.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: K.K. Wagh Institute of Engineering Education & Research - [KKWIEER]
review: The fee structure is pretty much good which means they provide so many facilities like a gym, libraries, and different playground facilities such as basketball tennis volleyball, etc. The scholarship is based on caste and divided into OBC, SC, ST, NT, and EBC.College fest MAFFIK is organized every year and every branch has its technical event i.e. equinox for computers. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. Classrooms have projectors for tech-based teaching. Many sports competitions are held.

Name: Aman Singh
review:
There are two cultural fests Adhyaay and aarambh, sports fest Aagaz, technical fests Technica, and e summits, that are conducted here. Last year celebrities Yasser Desai, Rahul Jain, Rahul dua, ojha sir, Asim Azhar, and dz bands have performed here. The library is one of the oldest in India. You will all the necessary books here. For sports, there is great scope in cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, kabaddi, chess, etc.
There are clubs like aeroclub as CPC (which connects alumni) psmsc auto rob gruv(dancing) and octave (singing). There is also a good coding community.From the 7th semester, students are eligible for placements. Companies like Reliance, Samsung, cognizant, Paytm, Airtel, lnt, Asian paints, aarti industries, and also some multinational companies visit here. Last year's highest package of 55/pa and the lowest was 3.5lpa. was given. The highest was from CSE. In CSE and IT all eligible students get placed. For chemical technology from 70 to 90 percent of students gets placed. In electrical most students opt for higher studies. In mechanical 95 percentage students got placed.
I am planning to give a gate as well as a cat.

Name: Sanya
college: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology - [DCRUST]
review: I chose this course because architects are the people who design such spaces in which a person spends most of the time of their day. Be it an institution, be it an office, or even a home. We must make those spaces as user-friendly and comfortable as we can. Three permanent faculty is about 15-20 and students intake 80 (so 40 students per section). The teachers are well qualified but still, the teaching methods lack somewhere. The term exams are often on time.Life at the campus is great. There is an annual fest called rhythm. Also, many other fests like Technova take place annually. Except for this, small events take place every month or 2 months. The library and reading room is the best building on campus. Mostly all required books are available. There is a basketball court which is well maintained. Also, there are many societies and groups for music dance art and many more.

Name: Niki Dhameja
college: K J Somaiya Institute of Management
review:
Fees for the 1st year are around 9  lakhs and the 2nd year is about 12 lakhs.
Hostel fees excluding security are 1.5 lakhs for 10 months since the course is for 10 months. Rest 2 months are for the internship.
An additional mess fee of 50 thousand for 10 months has to be deposited.
There are scholarships but only limited scholarships are available.The stipend range is from unpaid to 1 lakh. 
The unpaid companies however bring with them the advantage of brand names like JIO Creative labs an unpaid internship. The highest-paying companies were Arcesium, Cisco, Goldman Sacs, Gartner, etc.
Other companies include JP Morgan, EY,  Nerolac, ICICI, TCS, etc.

Name: Raju
review:
the college fees may vary depending on the college policies and with govt permissions and also provide the best quality of education to the students.
EMCET qualifies students to get scholarships based on their category and many companies are very frequent to visit college so simply get campus recruitment.Every year college fests are conducted annually day and different kinds of workshops are held every month.
TKR college has multiple libraries on campus.
best class amenities provided by the college some of the toilets not much very well.
best sports area cricket ground, basketball court, etc.

Name: Rahul kumar
college: J.C. Bose University Of Science And Technology, YMCA
review:
The campus is good and the infrastructure is building day by day and social life was also good and the college club was amazing and the fest was very less but other than that all is good and there are lots of things where they have work. All the course-related books are available in the library.Fees for the first semester are 62k per semester and for the rest semester, it will be around 50-52k per semester.
And for SC scholarship is provided if they apply for it and for OBC students scholarship is very less.

Name: Shreyash Zombade
review:
The students are eligible for campus placement only after completing the last semester of their respective courses.
Some companies that visited the campus are Mahindra, TCS, Wipro, HCL, Apollo, etc.
The highest package was about 16.7 lakhs and the lowest was near about 2.89 lakhs.
The average number of students who got placement is about 40%.
After the completion of the degree, I'll be running my family business which is related to my course.The annual function is organized every year on campus.
The library is full of various books and journals with a big sitting capacity.

Annual Sports fest is currently going on at the University in which many sports programs are organized.
Social groups in the college are NCC and NSS.

Name: Hitesh
review: Campus life is chill with a focus on studying, and well being of students. The annual fest Engifest always happens in the 2nd or 3rd week of Feb with over 50,000 students attending the fest last year. There are various books available in the library and University also organizes various Sports (Interdepartmental - Arina) and Technical fest (Innova).The placement is excellent at the University for the B.Tech course. Students can participate in Internship opportunities from the third year and Placement opportunities from the fourth year. The average package is also about 15-20 LPA for CS students. Various companies like Google, Microsoft, and Atlassian visit the college.

On campus, placements are also available in all courses

review:
Life at my college campus is truly a unique and enriching experience. The college provides students with ample opportunities to participate in various events and activities. One of such event is the tech-fest called Lakshya, which is conducted in the month of November and is one of the most popular events in the college calendar. The annual day of the college is another event that is conducted in the month of February, which provides students with a platform to showcase their talent in various cultural activities.
one of the best aspects of the college is its library. The library is well-stocked with all the books related to studies and journals, providing students to expand their knowledge.
Another impressive aspect of the college is its state-of-the-art infrastructure. Each classroom is equipped with a dedicated projector and desktop.

This is a great opportunity for students who are financially challenged to pursue their studies without having to bear the entire burden of fees. One of the benefits of studying at this college is that the fees are hiked only once in 4 to 5 years and sometimes it depends on certain conditions also.
The college also offers scholarships to students who excel academically or face financial difficulties. The campus placements are quite good, with many students securing good packages through the college placement drive. I got a good job with a decent package.
Lastly on an average,it would take apporoximately 10 to 12 lakhs to complete the B tech degree with all expenses included.Overall, I feel that college provides a good platform for students to further their education and secure good jobs in the future.

Life at my college campus is truly a unique and enriching experience. The college provides students with ample opportunities to participate in various events and activities. One of such event is the tech-fest called Lakshya, which is conducted in the month of November and is one of the most popular events in the college calendar. The annual day of the college is another event that is conducted in the month of February, which provides students with a platform to showcase their talent in various cultural activities.
one of the best aspects of the college is its library. The library is well-stocked with all the books related to studies and journals, providing students to expand their knowledge.
Another impressive aspect of the college is its state-of-the-art infrastructure. Each classroom is equipped with a dedicated projector and desktop.
The college also conducts various events and saheli ,spoorty and kruthi are the clubs run by students which provide a platform to pursue their hobbies.The fee structure is not too expensive, costing around 69700. The college also offers scholarships to students who excel academically or face financial difficulties. The campus placements are quite good, with many students securing good packages through the college placement drive. I got a good job with a decent package.
Lastly on an average,it would take apporoximately 10 to 12 lakhs to complete the B tech degree with all expenses included.Overall, I feel that college provides a good platform for students to further their education and secure good jobs in the future.

Name: Anand
review:
After graduation, I was looking for an interesting master's course. When I learned about TISS from my school friend, the course curriculum sounded very interesting. Here is my course, there are currently 23 students and per semester there are 4-5 teachers and 1-2 guest lecturers. On average, the faculty-student ratio is 1:25

There is a student scholarship from the institute for the poor and needy students where 50% of the tuition fees is relaxed. I got it one semester. The name is Student Financial Aid. The course offers 100% campus placement. The average is 6-6.5lpa

Name: Sachin Singh

Name: PRATEEK GONDWAL
review: MBA at IIMC comprises compulsory courses in the first year wherein you are given exposure to a diverse set of fields in management. However, the 2nd-year structure is different wherein an Electives approach is followed. Courses are auctioned and students bid for the courses they wish to enroll in. A fixed schedule is shared at the beginning of the term and exams are conducted every 5 weeks to keep the learnings afloat. There are quizzes, class participation marks, and several projects which are a part of the evaluation criteria.There are over 30+ clubs in the institute catering to all the diverse interests of students coming from across different places in the country. Despite a heavy focus on academics, the campus is a highly fun place to be at. There are 4 hostels. A 7 lakes fest is conducted annually imbibing its name from the 7 lakes on the campus. Coming to sports, Sangharsh is conducted between IIMA, B, C, and L in addition to the popular C vs XLRI rivalry. The sports infrastructure isn't fantastic but it still is above par when compared to other major Indian institutes.

Name: Yash Agarwal
review:
HBTU has a thriving student life, with a variety of social, cultural, and sporting events taking place throughout the year. Some of the major annual fests and tech fests hosted by the university include "Adhyaay" (cultural fest), "Aagaz" (sports fest), and "Technika" (technical fest). These events provide students with the opportunity to showcase their talents, network with peers, and have fun.

The university has a well-equipped library that provides students with access to a wide range of books, journals, and other resources. The library also has modern facilities, including internet access and study spaces, to support students in their academic pursuits.

The highest package offered to students at HBTU is INR 60 lakhs per annum, while the average package is around INR 10-12 lakhs per annum, depending on the profile offered. 
Typically, a significant percentage of students get placed through campus recruitment, with the exact percentage varying each year. However, on average, more than 90% of students can secure employment through campus placements.

Name: vyom kashyap
review:
Every year around? 500 to? 1000 are increased in the fee structure every year. Currently, The Fee is around 130000 per year.  Although for some it may seem to be quite a high price if we compare it with all the facilities  And opportunities provided by the institute it gives value for the money.

  As for infrastructure the institute has a vast ground 2 auditoriums and a variety of indoor and outdoor games.

review:

Name: Avadhut Kulkarni
college: Nutan Maharashtra Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NMIET] Talegaon
review: The college has an annual function name Vihangam. Generally, college functions are held from February to march after the end of the first semester. The college has a Library with all the college books and references books written by the popular author available. The college has also sports days as well college also takes part in inter University matches.NMIET college comes under the PCET education society. They provide very good campus placements for college students. The highest package offer in the previous year was 14 LPA and the average package of college is 8. lpa. All the students from our college got placed in top MNCs like TCS, Infosys, etc.

Name: Rathod mehul
review: We have placement in the 6th semester but in the pandemic (COVID-19) so that's why we have a general placement, not related to field placement provided by University. But after completing my graduation civil staff and placement officer of the University provided in a WhatsApp group new vacancies related to our field and it's great. the highest package in University is not sure but it's eight to ten lakhs. General placement is provided by University so mostly students are not interested. Plan  after getting a degree is some great job in my fieldI really like this course and I handle this. And I was good and this college is good for me.  Student's relationship with the teacher is very friendly and beautiful. The university has good teachers. qualification of teachers is great. All teachers are qualified masters or p.hd. so have a great knowledge of the subject. The exam is hard and is required for a good student. and it's great for good student

Name: Abhishek N J
review: Students get a good amount of opportunities in this college from the placement department. The students who are in the pre-final year will start getting a notification from the placement department about the list of opportunities and the students can start their preparation. There are 100+ companies visiting the college for recruitment and a large number of offers with different roles are provided for the students. Last year one of the students got a package of 27lpa at Juspay. And most of the students get places in the college and need not worry about off-campus placement opportunities. In the CS field, the opportunities are more.Campus Life is good in this college. We have an annual fest every year called Vismay. And it's a cultural event followed by DJ night. About Vismay, it's a fest where students enjoy their fest and have fun and participate in events like singing, dancing, etc. There are celebs who are invited to the fest to make it memorable. And through the year there are different events happening in college like department fests, freshers' day, and each branch would conduct events to make students learn people skills. This college also supports sports and they participate in inter-college competitions with the college team.

Name: Jagmeet Singh
college: Fairfield Institute of Management and Technology - [FIMT]
review: The cost of study here is quite high compared to a few other colleges. The college has good infrastructure so they charge high fees. I do not know about the fee hike policy because there was no fee hike during my three years of college time. There is no scholarship offered by the college but you can apply for a scholarship offered by the government and college management help student in that process. The college has tied up with a few banks which helps with financial assistance.I choose to study BCA because computer science is one of my favourite subjects in school. I love to do programming also. The faculty and student ratio is 1:10. Most faculty members are postgraduate and few faculty members are also pursing the P.hd. Faculty members provide us with notes and PPTs for learning. They always explain topics with examples and easy language. Term exams are conducted every 6 months. The semester exam is not difficult to pass.

Name: Suyash singh
review:
There is an electric bike and e-rickshaw made by our seniors especially those working in the mountain and hilly areas.
Many other projects like drones are made by the Electronics department.
We have participated National technical event at IIT Hyderabad.
The coding culture is nice.
Companies are providing internships for from7 semesters, and students are working very nicely. Nice internship available at our collegeThe faculty is awesome and supportive in nature.
But some faculty are too young and have such experience.
Like computer programming mam.
My course is very nice, have better scope in future. providing me large opportunity regarding my career. My exams are of moderate level.

Name: Shivam chauha
review: I have a general category so I don't get any scholarship. but because of national importance, the fee structure of nits is very affordable and the level of education is very excellent and provides all the facilities which are given by the college.I got a CSE branch in nit Uttarakhand. I have a lot of interest in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and web development so I want to become a good coder and want to get specialization in these courses which are in the CSE branch.

Name: Jatin Kumar
review:
I have chosen this course because I am a finance enthusiast. It provides practical knowledge for real-world challenges over and above the regular B.com programme.
But if you are getting a college with good placement history with so many companies coming for placement frequently, you should opt for B.com(p) in that college.
All faculties are doctorates. Most of the faculties have good knowledge as well as impart their knowledge in the best manner.
But some of the faculties suck the blood in all the ways, such as by not having good knowledge-sharing capabilities as well as do not cooperate with internal assessments and attendance.
There are around 3000 students, and 40 faculties with each faculty having a good knowledge to teach multiple subjects.
Exams are conducted two times a year,i.e. on time in one semester.
Exams are easy to pass, you just have a basic knowledge of the concept asked and must have good handwriting.The yearly fees of the college are around 7000 to 10,000.
The exam fees are different which are 1000 per semester.
This is so many reasonable fees in return for the value student gets.
You can get as many scholarships by becoming a part of societies from 1st year itself.
A student should continue to indulge in internships during their whole college life to substantially raise their chances to get selected for on-campus/off-campus placements.
There is a proper placement cell with a gamut of placement of various startups and companies coming there at regular intervals.

Name: Rajveer Singh
review: Annual fest is organized with very various activities in April. All necessary books and journal easily available in library which is open from 10 am to 8 pm. Facility for Sport also available for interested student Inter college tournament are also organised. Various groups are made by the interested student like drama club cricket club eco clubActually the college is very new first batch is in final year so not much data is available for placement but hope soon placement companies comes to the campus. Off campus placement are also available from various companies like tcs

Name: Tanmay Maheshwari
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review:
Campus life is good and events happen every semester in form of fests, hackathons, competitions etc.
Some of the famous ones are Saturnalia, Thapar food festival, izhaar etc
The library is the 7th most stunning in the world with a wide range of books and journals.
Amenities in classroom halls are great.
There is a lot of space for extracurricular activities for cricket, football, basketball, badminton etc.
Many societies and clubs are there in the college  including tech, non tech, dance, music drama and everythingCollege campus placements have shown great results and have kept on increasing year by year.
The average package for CSE packages is around 12 lakhs. With the highest on-campus placement being around 50 lakhs. 
Lots of companies visit our campus including Amazon, Microsoft, Accenture, samsung, Deloitte, jp morgan etc 
More the 95 per cent of students got placed in CSE branches.
My plans are to get a successful high-earning package after the degree

Name: Rachit
review:
Fees hike per year is around 5-10%
The scholarship depends upon marks in 12 class .for computer science the placement are good with an average of 5 lakhs and for other bachelor's degree it's 3.5 lakhs and the course affordable I would say that's it's a private university so comparing that's it's ok feesI am pcm student so I chose engineering and the placement was also good my relative also studied in this college so I chose this college
The teachers are good and easy to communicate with in terms of term exams and it's easy to pass exams if you attend classes regularly

Name: Varis Sharma
review: The faculty is highly professional and proficient in their areas of expertise. The lectures are insightful and interactive and are aimed at not becoming monotonous. An appropriate amount of industrial exposure is also provided to the students to make them ready for the corporate world. The term exams are taken every 2-3 months.The social life at FORE School of Management is highly dynamic as students are always taking part in either industrial seminars, cultural events, sporting events, etc. The institute also has more than 23 student committees that help in building strong leadership skills.

review:
campus life is just amazing as it facilitates all the requirements that a student requires.

I have chosen this course because I am a finance enthusiast. It provides practical knowledge for real-world challenges over and above the regular B.com programme.
But if you are getting a college with good placement history with so many companies coming for placement frequently, you should opt for B.com(p) in that college.
All faculties are doctorates. Most of the faculties have good knowledge as well as impart their knowledge in the best manner.
But some of the faculties suck the blood in all the ways, such as by not having good knowledge-sharing capabilities as well as do not cooperate with internal assessments and attendance.
There are around 3000 students, and 40 faculties with each faculty having a good knowledge to teach multiple subjects.
Exams are conducted two times a year,i.e. on time in one semester.
Exams are easy to pass, you just have a basic knowledge of the concept asked and must have good handwriting.The yearly fees of the college are around 7000 to 10,000.
The exam fees are different which are 1000 per semester.
This is so many reasonable fees in return for the value student gets.
You can get as many scholarships by becoming a part of societies from 1st year itself.
A student should continue to indulge in internships during their whole college life to substantially raise their chances to get selected for on-campus/off-campus placements.
There is a proper placement cell with a gamut of placement of various startups and companies coming there at regular intervals.

My plans are to get a successful high-earning package after the degree

Name: Bangalore Naga Suvidhya
review:
For my school days  I am interested to learn to code and interested to know how software is designed that's why i opted for this course, we have the best facilities in our college that won't teach only for the purpose of the curriculum they concentrate on basic topics which I most important for students for their career.
About exams VTU exam papers are really tough I have to do hard work to gain good marks we can easily pass we regularly attend classes and concentrate on important topics and I am glad our college facilities helped me to gain good marks in sem exams. coming to teaching methods our college provides both digital teaching and board and chalk teaching, we have labs where we can learn few topics practically which is most important.After 6th semester students are eligible for internship jobs along with project work given by the college or we can do our project work, till now infosys,Wipro ,few electrical , CSE related companies visited our college, and now we have the highest package of 10L. I am planning to pursue higher studies after completing this degree.

Name: Vinay Shah
review:
One of the key highlights of the whole DU campus for which it is known is its fests and functions. Several fests are organized in the college to mention one of them is DIWALI MELA of Hansraj is very famous. The college library has an excellent collection of books and journals with ample space to sit and read wifi connectivity and a central cooling system. The college has several societies such as enactus for drama pixel for photography and several other.After having some research and going through several reviews of students that have already studied and also of that who are currently pursuing their degree at Hansraj College I came to the conclusion that the college has a renowned pool of teachers and the college provides a healthy environment for one's overall development.

review:

I have chosen to pursue Data Science and Engineering as my B.Tech major because it is a rapidly growing field in the IT industry and plays a significant role in the development of various industries. This field is relatively new and offers a wide range of job opportunities globally. After completing this course, one can choose to further their education with a Master's or Ph.D. degree. IIT Mandi has the best faculty-to-student ratio among all the IITs, which is 1:8. Additionally, there are teaching assistants available to help students with their problems. The faculty members are highly qualified and many of them hold positions as Associate Professors or higher at various IITs and NITs. They possess extensive knowledge in their respective fields. At IIT Mandi, the course structure typically includes two quizzes and one end-semester exam, although the exact number of assessments depends on the instructor. With consistent learning, students can score good marks in exams.IIT Mandi holds three major festivals annually: Xpecto, the technical festival, held in March; Exodia, the cultural festival, held in May; and Ran-neeti, the sports festival, held in October. The institute has well-equipped libraries on both its North and South campuses, with a vast collection of books, both in hard copy and electronic format, as well as research papers and theses from students and faculty. Classrooms are designed to provide a comfortable and productive learning environment, equipped with blackboards and smartboards and suitable for accommodating up to 300 students at a time.

There are numerous clubs at IIT Mandi, including photography, writing, dance, robotics, programming, and clubs dedicated to specific branches of engineering, sports, and more. The Student Gymkhana is the governing body responsible for overseeing the activities of these clubs. Further information can be found on the official Student Gymkhana website at IIT Mandi.

Name: Lakshita
review:
The campus life is as amazing as students expect before coming here. Campus life is very fascinating because here you can grow socially as well by making friends chilling with them in the campus area and exploring Delhi.
Different colleges organize annual fest which is mesmerizing to our eyes, the celebrities, and their show.
The fest is the real campus life because of which students want to be here.

Name: Bhadekar Kalyani Kaustubh
college: Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT Bombay - [SJMSOM]
review: My primary motivation for choosing this course was its integration with the IITB ecosystem and its legacy of alumni in diverse fields. The faculty is highly experienced and the course content is relevant to today's day and age. They follow a case-based teaching pedagogy. There are 8 terms spanning over 2 years, two each semester. Exams are conducted at the end of every semester along with other continuous evaluation techniques.The annual fest for IIT Bombay which is conducted at the end of December called 'Mood Indigo' and the Techfest is also conducted in December. The classrooms are well equipped with projectors and speakers and seating is facilitated for discussions.

Name: Piyush Mishra
college: IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITBBS]
review:
As per my rank, I'm getting only the metallurgy branches in IIT BBS. So I decided to go to IIT instead of getting admission to NIT colleges.
Here the ratio of faculty: to students is too good like 1:20.
Faculty are highly educated even some of them collaborate with high-standard scientists from foreign countries.
Everyone has tonnes of papers published in one of the famous publishers. Literally, they are highly educated people that you will go to meet in your life.
Exams will always come after 1 and 1/2 months. Moreover, it is easy to tackle as exams contain the question from the assignment and notes that the professor has given you.On my campus 3 Fest is there a cultural fest Alma Fiesta, a Tech fest Wisseneire, and an Entrepreneur cell called E - summit. All of these are organised in January. Other than that there is a sports fest named Ashmedha that is organised in October.
The library is too good if you love books.
Here you have to choose a course from NSO, NSS, or NCC in your first semester which is Extra academic activity. College life is too amazing. You are going to enjoy 900 acres of campus with new hostels and other things

review: Life at Auro University Gujrat is exciting. The college campus is well-equipped with modern facilities and an array of activities to engage in. Name: Epil Gagrai
review:
Like every PCB student in class 12th, I also wanted to opt for MBBS, but I couldn't clear the AIPMT exam (now known as NEET-UG) on my first try. My scores weren't great so I thought to look for other options and BSc Food Technology was something that I was fascinated with. 
There were only 17 students in my class and there were 4 faculties in our department. Some of the subjects were also taught by the faculties of other life science departments. 
Most of our faculties were usually master's and Ph.D. holders. And they were too good with their teachings.

Overall the campus is great.

Name: rickdev hazra
review:
Environmental Geo technology is a combined course of Environmental Engineering and Geotechnical engineering. Mostly Geotech-based course.
In 2022 MTech. Batch there are 26 students and faculties are about 12 to 15.
Well-qualified teachers with highly experienced. Most teachers are actively publishing theses, articles, and projects. They are very helpful in terms of teaching as well as guidance. The teaching method is satisfactory. Mostly they do blackboard work and presentations. They bind this 2 years course full of projects, presentations, and seminars. The laboratory is also very good. And students can go and do their experiments any time. No issue with that. There will be p.hd students who will help in doing laboratory experiments.
Here one mid-term paper of 30 marks, assignments of 20 marks, and end semester of 50 marks are there. A cgpa-based system where getting passing marks is easy. The minimum required CGPA is 6.5. Below this cgpa MTech students will not get their stipend of 12,400 Rs.Here in Nit Calicut, MTech fees structure is comparatively higher than in other Nits. At the time of admission, students need to pay 1.2 lakhs. This is for one semester. And in the second-semester payable amount is nearly 80000 rs. so to sum up total course fees are about 3.6 lakhs. 
Here the hostel fee is about 9000 Rs for sharing a room and 10000 rs for a single room. The mess bill is around 34 thousand. This is flooding expenses. Academic fees are about 37 thousand rs.
  Apart from a stipend, a scholarship is also there. But if you apply for a scholarship then your stipend will be cut-off. Carrying study expenses is not that hard but students can get loans easily.
Here campus placement is very good. Btech placement is very good. Mtech placement is above 50% in our department.
The internship is also provided by the college through the gen skill portal. Here also job conversion rate is above 80%. After 1st sem internship offers to start coming.

Name: CHETNA CHUPHAL
review:
First things first, the look, feel, and vibe of the campus are surreal. In a single day itself, you can witness the different seasons, from bright warm sunny mornings to heavy downpours during the evenings, to chilly winters, the hilltop has a myriad of colors waiting for you to discover.

SIBM Pune offers a variety of clubs and special interest groups that one can be a part of. I myself am a current member of the Alumni Team, and words are not enough to express my happiness and gratitude for being so. The entire student council, their day-to-day activities, and even the events are completely student-led, with minimum or no interference from the administration.

The library is huge and is at the heart of the academic block and the ground floor of the library is accessible 24*7.The placements at SIBM Pune have plenty of opportunities for students across specializations. The companies that come on campus are from multiple various domains and sectors, so the students have the pick of the best.

Name: ASIF KHAN
review:
Maharaja Ganga Singh University (MGSU) has a modern and well-maintained campus that provides students with a supportive and inclusive environment. Name: Rohan Paresh Balsara
review: Recently the annual fest had gone in the college and the fest was awesome it was of 10 days and every student enjoyed it very much. The college also has its own library and it is also very big where students can go and study or also take from the library and read. The college also has sports which are also very nice. Name: Satvik Rastogi
review: The campus is small in size but contains all the required amenities that a student can require. The annual fest is known as Genesis. The library has all the books and journals one can ask for. Sports and Extracurriculars can be better, they are restricted due to college size. The college has very active student-run committees.Summer internships and placements are a big part of college. A Plethora of Top companies visits the campus every year for placements. The alumni base is very good and alumni are working in different parts of the world, at top locations. The college has a record of 100% placements each year.

Name: Satwik Sayan Ghosh
college: ISM Dhanbad - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITISM]
review: The course structure is very well planned. The micro schedule and the number of lecture hours for each topic are included in the lecture plan. The faculty members-to-student ratio is good enough. The professors are well-qualified, learned and helpful to students. However, Some professor cannot deliver their knowledge properly to students. Teaching is done in hybrid mode using both a smart classroom and a blackboard. Quizzes are conducted regularly throughout the semester and they carry marks to the end semester. Exams are conducted timely and strict discipline is maintained during the exam so that no one can do cheating. Even bio breaks are not allowed during the exam.The fee structure is similar to other IITs.Even the fee of IIT ISM Dhanbad is lower than most of the IITs.The course fee per semester is around 1 lakh. The mess fee is 23 thousand and another fee is 8 thousand. So, per semester total fee is 1 lakh 33 thousand. A total Fee waiver is given to those students whose family income is less than 1 lakh per annum. Those students whose family income is upto 4 lahks, have to pay only mess fee and other charges that totals to 33 thousand only. The scholarship amount of 6 thousand was given to tuition fee waiver students. Other scholarships are also given by the institute to the SC and St students.

review: The dual degree course in chemical engineering is designed very well and is ranked among top institutions for pursuing btech and mtech in chemical engineering. Most of the faculties here have done PhD from foreign top universities and then pursues there career as a researcher here at IIT Delhi.IIT delhi topped in the employability rankings from India, it provides placement to almost all the students who sits for the placement seriously in the UG programs, however in the PG programs the placement stats are a bit lesser relatively. UG placement percentage is around 85 %.

Name: Nazakat Bushra
review: The campus is very beautiful and it's wide open, it has two play grounds and it's actually large enough to play two cricket at a time. This college is very good for the annual fest and tech fest,it holds 2 types of an annual fest Rivera and prayukti, and there are many tech fests like coding, robotics, drone making, and many more, there are projectors in classroom, and desk and bench single seater, annual sports occur every year it consists football, cricket, high jump, long jump,race, and many more, many social groups are there like hit times, hitman inside, samarpanI opted for some other branch but due to limited information I was not able to do the counseling properly, the faculty and student ratio is like 1:6, and all the main faculties are highly educated like p.hd, masters, normally sem exams are taken in 6 month but due to COVID it was reduced to 4 month, in online it was easy but in offline it is a little bit hard

Name: Rishi Raj Khanna
college: Shri Govindram Seksaria Institute of Technology and Science- [SGSITS]
review:
Every year the Institute organizes cultural events for the students in both the semesters. 

The academic session starts with a fresher’s day “Aavahan”. This program is exclusively designed for the fresh students joining the Institute. 

the Institute hosts a Techno-Cultural event “Aayaam”. This program hosts large number of events. Nearly 1500-2000 students take part in this event.

Currently college library of SGSITS is fully flagged with good quality of high cost standard reference and text - books, world reputed International and National research journals, theses, project reportsand electronic learning resources in all disciplines of technical education. 

Amenities provided in the classroom are podium benches, stage for the faculty, a. c. , fans, tubelights and tables. 

Games like Football, Cricket, Badminton, Volleyball, Throw ball, Basketball, Netball, Chess, Table Tennis are being played. 

Clubs in the college: Ojasva, Pratibimb, Kshitij, E-Cell. I was really fascinated towards electronic devices and it's functioning . Along with that I was very curious to know how different process and operations took place inside the electronic machinery, therefore I took this course and luckily with the tank which I got in Jee mains exam helped me to enter in this course. 

The faculty -student ratio is very good in our college. For every 10 students there is 1 faculty is being allotted. 

Mast of the faculties have competed there PhD's from their respective branches. Along with that the Junior faculties have completed their mtech from it's. Talking about the teaching method opted by the teachers is very much advanced. Most of the conceptual topics are being taught on using videos and 3d views. 

Every months mid semester examinations are being taken and along with that at every 5 months end semester examinations are being conducted.

Name: SHASHANK THAKUR
review:
There is something going on at any given time on campus. There are several clubs and committees organizing various events. The annual fest is called Passion which generally happens in December. Chakrvyuh, organized by the sports committee, is an event to which the entire B-school fraternity looks forward every year. It is known as the "Olympics of B-school."  
Research & Consultancy Enterprise (RACE), the official consulting club of IMT Ghaziabad, organizes Koncentrix, which is a National level consulting symposium, comprises of multiple events. They also organize events like IMFC, Fireside Chat, etc.
Then there are clubs like Markup, Finesse, E-cell, and many more, all run by students.I was selected for PGDM core which is the flagship course offered at IMT Ghaziabad. I believe IMT was the best call that I had at the time, other converts were from baby IIMs and other institutes. 
Faculties are extremely helpful and highly qualified. 
Coming to exams, if one pays attention in class, it's easy to pass most of the subjects.

Name: Deepanshu Varshney
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review: The course curriculum is very good. The subject taught to us in our college is very well. And had subjects that help us to get industry-level knowledge. The faculty: student ratio is 1: 60. The qualification of our faculty is very good as they had completed their graduations from top colleges or institutes like IITs, NITs, etc. Also, they had an amazing way of teaching and had a lot of years of experience. The exams were average or somewhat more difficult than that and they happened every month.The college life at NIET is not very good, as there is no fest happening in our college. Also, the schedule for studies is very tight. The availability of books and journals in our college library is good. Almost all the necessary books are presented here. There are a lot of sports facilities to play in but we almost had no time to play. And there are a lot of clubs, websites, social media pages, and youtube channels run by the students.

Name: Anand Raj
review:

Name: Satwik Sayan Ghosh

review: The course structure is very well planned. The micro schedule and the number of lecture hours for each topic are included in the lecture plan. Name: Rajat tiwari
review:
I choose this course because of my interest in software development. 
The faculty and students ratio is very good so there is no disturbance in the studies. 
 All the faculty members are well qualified, and the teaching method is very good they are friendly.There is no hike in the fees during your graduation. 
There is no particular name for the scholarship you can avail of it by reaching a certain criterion which is a 60% score in the 12th class. 
The college also provides in-campus paid internships.

Name: Tushar Bhardwaj
review:
After 4 years the thing you will miss the most will be your campus life (playing at 12 in the night, roaming the campus all night, Maggi at mic mac).
After that are the fests of DTU, Engi Fest(North India's largest cultural fest), Invictus (Tech Fest),Yuvaan (Literature and film Fest) and apart from these. There are many societies, they invite many guests for student interactions.
The infrastructure of DTU is decent you have a sports complex (huge). The best thing is the wifi all over the campus for students. Classrooms are spacious enough and projectors are also installed.
All the societies are run by the student council. There are also some tech teams for tech enthusiasts which make cars, drones, mass rovers and underwater vehicles, etc.Fees if different for every semester, every next semester is slightly more expensive than the last one. It starts from 1.2 lacs. But the difference is not very big, so the fees remain around 1.5 lacs per semester.
And it does not include the hostel and mess fee(which is around 55k -60k per year.
There are various government scholarship schemes applicable but they are on the basis of your family income. So for that, you can contact the admin department of DTU.
There is a special department of placement and training which helps you to get a job out of what you have studied.

Name: Karan Yadav
review:
Our college's fest is very famous all across the university. It is called Nexus. Various singers are invited. Ankit Tiwari etc many singers have been invited to this fest. Our library is hidden and very big. I personally enjoy the serenity that is present in the library.
Classrooms are equipped with high-tech features and can certainly be called modern classrooms.
Sports present in our college- Basketball,  Volleyball, Tennis, Cricket, Table Tennis and a few more. And we have a ground for all these.
We have 36 societies in our college. You can name it, and we have a society for it. They are all funded by the college.
Due to some glitch, I am not able to write the list of societies.I wanted to pursue archaeology so I chose this course.
Faculty to student ratio is very good approximately 1 teacher for every 10 students in the history department.
All the professors are PHD holders and very qualified and intelligent. They teach with passion and help us understand the subject with ease.

Name: Animesh Yadav
review: KR Mangalam University offers a lot of exposure for the students by letting many companies her for Placements as well as Internships. Almost 90% of my batch got placements from the University's placement cell itself. Companies like RBI, Microsoft and many other top companies come here.The classrooms are having fully centralised AC. The college has a variety of sports in it, starting from outdoor sports like cricket, basketball, and Volleyball to indoor sports like chess, carrom Table tennis, etc. All books recommended by teachers are available in the library.

Name: Hiten
review: More than 80% of students are placed with good salary packages. Top recruiting companies are IBM, Samatrix, Semiens, TCS and others. Most of the students get placed in a better role. The placement cell of our university is unmatchable.The campus is very lush green. We have 9 clubs at university. The infrastructure is very impressive. The college has a fully arranged and well-developed library. Nice campus and good facilities. the hostel is also well-planned rooms

Name: Shibalik Saha
review: My course was very hard. I did mathematics honours if you compare it with class 12 math and graduation math it's totally different. I choosed it just because I really love mathematics so that's why. 1st to 3rd-year student was around 15. we gave a test before our final examination.The fee structure was a little bit high for me because I'm from a lower-middle-class family. so it was very difficult to give me fees. it's around average-5000/7000 per year. No, I'm not a job lover.. my mentality is doing great business

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology - [NIT]
review:
There are different fees for students coming from different family background. Like full tution fees concession for the student coming from family whose family income is less than 1 lakhs similarly 2/3 of tution fee concession for 1-5 lakh family income and above 5 lakhs income you have to give full fee. 

You can also get scholarships according to your eligibility and merit.
Techniti is technical fest conducted in second half of year and utkansh is cultural fest held in first half of year. Most of department have great infrastructure. 
There is physical as well as digital Library. And the construction of new study room is going on. there are various technical , cultural, arts, creativity, sports clubs to improve skills.

Name: Akshat Gupta
college: KCC Institute of Technology and Management - [KCCITM]
review:
Many companies offer internships like Wipro, Infosys, HCL, TCS, and many others. 
Most of the students getting their job. 
Internships are good enough if the student is quite good in study then he will get their internship.The main scholarship are gotten from college is a state scholarship (UP SCHOLARSHIP), The financial assistance is too good. They make sure the student understands or not. 
The college also allows for other scholarships.

Name: BHABANI SHANKAR NANDA
review: The cultural or annual fest is called VISTAAR conducted in September or October also college conduct tech fests, and there is a central library where books are available in a decent amount of sports and extracurricular activities are also there.I wanted to opt for computer science but because of little low rank I couldn't go through that then I learned about electronics and telecommunication and found that the faculty was good and the teaching method was also very good.

Name: Kumar Raj
college: KCC Institute of Technology and Management - [KCCITM]
review:
1. I was interested in computer engineering thats why I choose this course.

review:

The different types of clubs are being organized.

Name: Shreyashi Srivastava
college: Meerut Institute of Engineering and Technology - [MIET]
review:
As the Electrical department is the core branch and it will never be out of date, so I chose this course because it is beneficial.

Badminton, football, and kho-kho are the sports of the college.
Ahimsa and parivartan are the social groups of student clubs and this is run by students of the college.

Name: Manish Chamoli
college: Greater Noida Institute of Technology (Engineering Institute)
review: We get an internship from allogenic with about 5000 stipends, the company came at colleges like TCS, Wipro, and Accenture, and we get different roles like software developer, quality assurance, and testing roles and get good opportunities at frontend and backend.The course curriculum is good, teachers are well-supported and ready to solve doubts. The qualification of the faculty is good, most of the faculty graduate from NIT, and the teaching method is good it is both theoretical and practical.

Name: SANKARRAM G
review: In our college, the annual day and annual sports day are conducted in May and march month respectively. We can issue all the books from the department library or college library which are very well stocked. The classrooms are also good. Our college is a major cricket venue for all inter-college matches organized in Madurai and sivangai districts.I chose ECE since I was interested in this course. I had an interest in the communication side like 5g technology and satellites. In my department the student-to-faculty ratio is 15:1. All faculties are well-experienced. There are three internal exams conducted in a semester and it was quite hard.

Name: Karthickpandi
review: The placements are good and every year conducted by IT companies and other companies. The college has a placement cell, especially for placements. The average package is 2.5 lakhs per year. But, every year place a few students only.The fee structure was good and reasonable, worth for money. Government scholarships and institute scholarships are available in our college. Also, our college provides campus jobs, your work helps in the library, office, and labs.

Name: M T Ram
review: Actually, the course curriculum in our college is quite good. And my branch is instrumentation and control engineering which is a circuital branch. And hence it is the best possible branch that I could get here .so I chose it. And joining here I can say it is one of the top 4 branches in nit Trichy followed by cse,ece, eee. our faculty are very good and experienced and we have lots of work to learn ourselves. Because the faculty won't say everything in class just they want to make us learn ourselves. There will be 2 term exams will be conducted for every semester within a month gap between them. And it is not that difficult to pass but the scoring top is quite difficult here.The fee structure of nit Trichy is high when compared to other nits as it is a top nit and it is to develop in its research projects. it costs around 1,20000 to 1,50000 per semester. with including tuition fees the reservation candidate can be free from tuition fees. everyone in college is to avail to apply for scholarships like nsp and ffe. The sc and st students are better to apply nsp for scholarships they can get around 40000 per year. And other category students are better to apply ffe as it is a private one it depends on the capability of their interview process which is conducted by them online. Campus placement is very good here the avg package is 15 lakhs here.

Name: Deepanshu
review: The college is very good and various types of companies are coming and the role of the offers is also good with a good stipend and then they are also given various types of projects and work and the outcome is that you got a good job.In the BHU there is no such fee there is required only pg and hostel fees cost and the basic fee is very low there is only 2000 rupees is the fee for all the courses so can be managed and various types of facilities also available.

Name: Deepshikha kain
college: Jagannath Institute Of Management Sciences - [JIMS] Vasant Kunj 2
review: the college takes fees that are very affordable for the students and pocket friendly too, and according to the course content and the programs the college conducts from time to time is very nominal, and yes after the 5th semester students get placements in reputable companies.College provides placements to each and every student, after the 5th semester students got their placements, and in a good reputation company that is provided by the college. companies like: asain paints, liv space, home lane, and much more.

Name: PIYUSH SHARMA
review: Campus life is good, we have a lot of seminars, functions, and competitions. We have an annual fest called GENESIS (held in November). One good thing about FORE school of management is it is a very much student-driven college where events are organized by students which helps a lot to understand working and managing people.I choose an International business because it is the way forward, where the boundaries between nations are reduced. Here, our course provides dual specialization where we can do specialization in two fields. The faculty-student ratio is good, with an estimate of 1:10. Teaching methods differ from teacher to teacher. But one thing common is their case-based approach.

Name: Chirag Gill
review: Our Campus size is decent and many events are being conducted from time to time at our university. Our annual fest 'MOKSHA' is going to take place next month and I am very excited about the same. There are many books available in our university libraryOur college placements are very good as it is a well-established college and almost 85% of students grab their on-campus packages every year which is an interesting fact to note. After doing btech I am planning to go for IIM Ahmedabad MBA

Name: Saksham Jain
review:
fests are something we students look forward to and are waiting for 
The library is huge and the collection of books present is more than enough for all the needs and requirements
classrooms are excellent and well maintainingfaculty is friendly and helpful and I'm sure will guide us to a good future
good scope in btech 
faculty-student ratio is also decent 
term exams are timely and done regularly to check the progress of students

Name: Bishal Sarkar
review: College life is pretty decent in NSUT if we put aside the 75% attendance policy and some strictness like there are lots of societies to join for a student as per their interest. NSUT conducts the annual fest Moksha which was so famous for the greatness and fun in Delhi and societies also conduct their annual events like Tech week, ethnic day, and all. The library of NSUT is pretty big and well ordinated, you will find all kinds of books and journals related to your interest and related to your course/branch. The amenities in the classroom for a first-year student are fabulous, for first-year students, their classes are held at APJ Halls and they are really huge and well advanced but after the completion of the first year, they shift to their department buildings that are a regular class like wooden desks and a blackboard / green board. There are lots of opportunities for sports and extracurricular activities on campus if you're interested and willing to do. There are lots of societies to join.I chose the course of CSE specialization in mathematics and computing because I want a CSE-related branch because all companies allow CSE-related branches to sit in their interview during placements session and I filled out the choice filling sheet according to the cut-off of the university and according to the rank of mine in JEE Mains I got the CSE'MAC branch. There is 1 faculty (professor) for the 89 student strength in each subject in my branch. The qualifications of the faculty are high, they are highly educated and trained, their teaching method is also very helpful and nice but there are always some exceptions are there. The term exams happen timely, the class tests happen regularly in the NSUT and the difficulty level of the term exams is moderate not to hard not to easy if you studied for it.

Name: Somay
review:
The curriculum is very structured covering all basic aspects. The faculty is very experienced and helpful. The teaching method is very effective and easy to understand. The exams are conducted for a duration of 2 to 3 months and have a good standardMany companies provide internship opportunities to students. Students can apply for internships in 2nd year itself. Students can gain experience and a stipend from the internship.
Companies like Microsoft and adobe come for internships.

Name: Archit Gupta
college: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology - [Thapar University]
review: I choose this course because of my interest in this field. The faculty is very good. student ratio is less that's why the opportunity is more .teaching is good. classrooms are huge and clean with proper teaching facilities.Exams are done monthly and they are easy to crack if you study regularlyThe fees are a bit more for this college. scholarship won't be provided unless or until you get 100% in boards or jee .there is no specific exam for the scholarship like other colleges have. The average cost to study in this college is 1500000 (without a hostel) for engineering

Name: Shivam pal
college: Noida Institute of Engineering and Technology - [NIET]
review:
My plans are my plans after my degree.
Around 90-95% of students get placed in my branch at the average package of 5-6 lac by companies like VMware, Microsoft, Amazon, Capgemini, voltas, TCS, and many more.

review: I have chosen Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering course.
