Name: Gaurav Singh Patel
review:
There are many courses available at the university of Allahabad.
I have chosen a BSc course at Allahabad University. There are approx 1000 students who take admission every year. There are so many excellent professors teaching at our University.
Exams are held yearly and you have to be serious about your study because the passing ratio of BSc  
is only 32% meaning out of 100 students only 32 pass.The university charges a yearly fee of about 4100 rupees ( including all facilities).
There are many national and State scholarships for students.
Like the UP scholarship and National Scholarship.
There are many best courses available with good campus placement.

Name: Rupesh More
college:
MGV's Samajshree Prashantdada Hiray
College of Hotel Management & Catering Technology Panchavati
review: I choose this course as I wanted to do something different than usual. The total faculty for this course was 12 and the total students per year were 60. All the well-known 5-star are offered for internships and you have to crack the interview rounds to get a secure place for an internship in any brand you wanna work for

Name: Baani
review: The curriculum is pretty decent, you do not have to waste huge amounts of time and energy trying to cover your syllabus for the exams in fact the spread-out schedule of our tests is good enough to help us cover everything so that we do not have to ramble around in the last moments. The professors and teaching staff is amazing and very helpful and the infrastructure is beyond compare.I really like my college life here, to be honest, the idea of the ideal college life is what helped me through high school and once I got to nsut it felt like it was everything I ever wanted. the people the societies the vibe the culture is just so immaculate.

Name: Pratik
college: IIT Indore - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITI]
review:
Life on our campus is very good. We have an evergreen campus with an incredible infrastructure of labs, a Library, and a classroom. Sports on our campus are pretty good, we can choose various sports in our college like cricket, football, basketball, badminton, etc. We also have various clubs which are run by students like photography club, debate club, etcI choose this btech course because it enables me to explore various expectations of life. The faculty in our college is very good.
We have around 1 teaching faculty for around every 10 students. They teach us very well. We have mainly 2 exams mid sem and end sem exams and they are pretty easy to pass

Name: Prajwal Negi
review: Campus placements generally take place in the last year. There are over 200 companies that come to the college for placements, such as Amazon, Flipkart, Google, etc. The highest package was Rs. 1.25 Cr which was recorded in the year 2021-2022. However, the average package is Rs.10-15 lakhs. The percentage of students getting placements in the core branch is 85%, while in the tech branch, it is 100%. I have always wanted to be an entrepreneur, so, after getting the degree, I am thinking of creating my own company related to automation.The fests are one of the best parts of one's college life. The annual fest Moksha, which is held in March every year, is quite huge. Over 50,000 people attend this. There is a vast variety of books available in the library. The classrooms are also very spacious with comfortable benches and good lighting. There are a lot of extracurricular activities such as dance, football, basketball, and so on. There are many societies such as Ashwamedh, Crescendo, and Junoon for acting, music, and photography respectively.

Name: Krishan
review: There Is Great Employment With High paid Jobs in IT SECTOR SO I CHOOSE CSAI BRANCH in NSUT, NEW DELHI. Faculty Student Ratio is 1:90. Faculty are well Qualified and all have done Ph.D. OR MSC OR DONE BTECH IN IITS with huge Experience. It is very easy to pass the Term Exam If You study Daily and Effectively Hour a Day.Many Companies offer Internships with high paid amounts. Sprinkler Offers an 80,000 stipend per month. If you are in the CSE branch Then you have an 80% chance you will get an internship. College is branch specific. Coding is Must

Name: Jatin Chauhan
review: Life is amazing on campus. Moksha the annual fest is one of the biggest college fests in Delhi and it is generally conducted in the month of March. Most academic books are available in the library and you may find several journals as well. All the necessary amenities like charger sockets, wifi, air conditioner, and comfortable seating benches are available in classrooms, at least in the first year. A huge sports campus is available at the campus which contains areas for many sports to play like football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, cricket, table tennis, lawn tennis, kabaddi, etc. Many societies such as the coding society(IEEE), robotics Society (ARES), and entrepreneurship soc(E-Cell) are very much active in the college.I am interested in tech placements and despite it being a core branch, I chose ICE as I have heard about students from ICE  in the past, cracking handsome tech placements in terms of salary and perks. The faculty-student ratio is decent. Faculties are very much qualified and knowledgeable and adopt great teaching methods to explain concepts to students. In each semester, two exams are held - mid-sem exams and end-sem exams. Exams are quite easy to crack and one can achieve very good marks just by studying 2 weeks before the exams.

Name: SMIKSHA KHANNA
review:
Seminars are conducted on regular basis, Genesis is the main fest of Fore which is conducted in November with lots of Competitions and amazing Prize Money.
Books from various authors are available.
The classrooms are big and air-conditioned.
The college has a lot of committees like Marketing, HR, IP, CONNECT, Cultural etcI wanted to do a Master and it's one of the reputed colleges in Delhi.
The faculty is great with a lot of experience and knowledge 
Faculties are well qualified with PHD from IIT AND IIM'S.
Three Semester System, Schedule is very tight and strict.

Name: Lovish Garg
review: Our course is superb. It is one of the easiest in the whole college where we can secure the highest CGPA in the college which in turn helps us to secure a good placement season. The faculty here is nice and helpful. THEY help us in some instances but are strict in case of paper checking. It is quite nice.The fee structure here is quite good. It increases by 10% every year. The scholarship here is not up to fine if you are in the top 5% in the first sem then you get your whole fees to return. But they take a lot of rounds for doing it and sometimes they just ignore us.

Name: Somay Singh
review: The fee for the whole 4-year course is nearly 10 lacs. The yearly fees would be around 2.25-2.50 lacs. Students can avail of scholarships through their merit and eligibility criteria. The students are eligible for placements after the 6th semester. Almost 90% of students get placed.Moksha is the largest fest that is the key highlight of the college. The college is well equipped with sports facilities including indoor as well as outdoor sports. The college also has a gym facility, and a library with almost all kinds of required books available.

Name: NITHISH KUMAR SG
review: Moksha-innovation is the annual fest and along with that we also have Resonanz. Moksha - innovation is held around march and resonant is held around October. The library is very well maintained and is stocked with books that are relevant. Classrooms are top-notch. There are many sports events that take place like winter sports and annual sports meets.I have always been interested in design and that made me want to apply for design here. The faculty-student ratio is good. Roughly one teacher per 30 students. The faculties are well qualified and experienced. Terms exams and internals are held on time

Name: Bala
college: Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering and Technology - [SIET]
review:
•Fees structure is only good for students who avail of anna university quota and who avail of scholarships - sports, first graduate quota... and it is not too good for students who are selected by management quota( where fees are higher than normal ).

My college takes an effort to keep campus Greenery since it's appreciable. Infrastructure needs to be improved some more - water for drinking is slightly lower than normal which needs to be encountered, cameras installed inside the campus are appreciated

Name: Dipbyendu Debnath
review:
The reason why I chose political science over other subjects is very simple.

The faculty are well educated and they're student-friendly also.
Around every 6 months semester exam held.Annual sports and other cultural programs are held there.
There is a library with an abundance of books.

Dance, music, reunion, and other programs were held in the college.
Yes there is a student union

Name: Snehamai parsha
review: Students from 5,6 semesters have access to internships and placement drives. Various companies Wipro, Amazon, etc. offer placements to students with good salary packages ranging from 8-20 lakh per annum on average .more than 90% of students get placed during the placement drives. The high package offered in our college was 60 lakh and the lowest is 4-5 lakhs. I would like to get my job after my 6 semesters in our college placement drive aiming for the highest salary package.I am currently pursuing a B.Tech undergraduate course in computer science and engineering at my college. Our college offers various other courses like artificial intelligence, data science, cyber security, internet of things, mechanical, civil, etc. The faculty is great for all branches and sections. Most of the faculty graduated and completed their pg and Ph.D. courses. Examinations are held twice a semester along with internals and they get the best out of the students.

Name: SOUPTIK  PAL
review: Fees were divided among the six semesters and they varied. I got no scholarship from the institute as such and I didn't opt for any internship in the college. College does provide internships and one has the choice to opt for them.The faculties were fantastic and well-qualified. I had a very good experience with the faculty members and they provided me with enough guidance. Most of the faculties were CA qualified and their way of teaching is good too.

Name: Mihir jha

Our college has societies for every activity like a dancing society music society dramatic society and I am giving auditions for all I like the society named Ashwamedh very much which is the name of the Dramatic Society.

Name: Anshul
review: I chose this course because of my keen interest in cinematography and editing space faculty and student ratio is like there is one teacher available for the batch of 20 to 25 students faculty is well qualified and has been there in the industry's popular movies and projects in vfx , editing, directing teams, etc for diploma students there is only one exam at the end of the course and for the degree ones there are semester wise exams to clear both kind of exam you need to be prepared both in practical and theoretical terms with utmost practice as the question framed in the exam are quite trickyLife at the campus is good they do organize different fest and competitions regularly for keeping students engaged and to give them a chance to show their creativity and talent this kind of fest and celebrations they do throughout the year talking about the amenities all classrooms are air-conditioned and have well-sitting arrangement large displays to help students in studying high configuration desktops to practice whatever they have been taught in class.

NSUT also gives Scholarships and financial assistance to those students who need it. There are also intensive like if the child lost the earning member of the family then the study fee is not taken from the student.

Name: Mayur Chauhan
review:
The annual fest is really enjoying and we loved it 
You will get any kind of books you want to read and learn the library is pretty much bigger
Classrooms have ACs and Projector to learn
The college has social groups like Rotaract NSS act and interact and many more for dance singing and etc 
The college also has a gym khana which organizes many sports Indore and outdoor gamesI always wanted to do this Course actually I loved this field 
The faculty is really Good and Co-ordinating
The professor is Good and Are authors of the books PhD in The teaching subject
The exams are difficult but uh just need to be Prepared like Just Attend the lectures and do what the teachers teach you it becomes easy

Name: Ankit
review:
MOKSHA is our annual cultural fest, whereas INOVISION is our tech fest, MOKSHA is conducted in the month of March.
Usually, students prefer soft copies i.e pdf forms of books and youtube videos although the college has its own central library, which has enough space and well-maintained books covering vast topics and fields. The college has its own cricket ground, football ground, athletics track, kabbadi ground, volley ball court, badminton court, TT rooms,  Gym, and other essential facilities for various other sports.In 7 semesters every student is eligible to appear for the placement drive. Companies start visiting NSUT for giving placements in various profiles from the month of August. Depending upon companies' requirements students of different branches are allowed, to keep a certain filtration of overall CGPA till the 6th semester. At the end of the placement drive, 70-80% of students get placement, where the average package is approximately 15 LPA for the Software Developer profile.

Name: SMRITI KUMAR
review: Moksha-Innovision is the annual fest and along with that we also have Resonanz. Moksha - innovision is held around march and resonanz is held around october. The library is very well maintained and is stocked with books that are relevant. Classrooms are top notch. There are many sports events that take place like winter sports and annual sports meet. There are numerous societies, and club groups that are run by students.I chose this course because the design is my passion. The faculty-to-student ratio is fairly nice. Most faculty members are highly qualified and doing great in their own professional lives. There are two semesters with mid-sems and end-sems. Class tests are held before each sem. Term exams and internals are held on time

Name: Bharat Kumar
review:
There are two annual fest and many small events that happen every month. But there is no such great exposure.
And a very less amount of books are available in the library, which also gets out of stock as soon as possible.
There is some time Inter college level sports happen, which is quite impressive. Our college is at a good level in sports because of the students.The qualification of faculty is a PhD. Degree. And their teaching quality is not that much level of an extremely experienced faculty, But if you want to study, then you can easily get a lot of help. Tests occur every month. A total of four tests for theory papers and two tests for practicals happen in the semester.

Name: Sahil Arora
review: I was interested in the science and technology stuff, it always fascinated me how small things like the calculator to mobile phone work or how the application and games are built/coded so I decided that I want to do a course where I could learn all that. so I opted for BCA i.e. Bachelor in Computer Applications as the course eligibility was simple and easy. When I first attended the class, I felt that the staff was a bit short as there were 60-70 students in a class and the no. of teachers were fewer but they did cover that up within a month by dividing the class. The teacher was highly qualified in their respective fields and their teaching method was also quite flexible. The staff is polite and kind and the classrooms are spacious with screen projectors for the visual presentation of topics. Soon, the term exams for 1st semester came and the syllabus was quite easy to understand if paid attention in classes. So, passing exams was never an issue due to good teaching.There are placements available but the salary package that is provided by them is not good enough. I mean you could a job at a much higher pay rate if searched properly. The students become eligible for campus placements after the end of 4th semester. I am still in 2nd semester so I am not so sure about all the details. But I have heard from the seniors and staff that there are quite a few companies that give a good offer to students. Personally, I don't think I would choose campus placements as I am currently working and gaining experience and after my course completion, I would apply/ search for jobs in my respected field and there are quite a few vacancies in companies out there for data analyst or for animation editor and I think I would do well in both the fields. So, for now, I am focussing on completing my degree and then searching for a job in a good company where I could utilize my knowledge and experience properly.

Name: Pranjal Dagar
review:
Life at the campus is amazing, there are places to explore where you want to be in life. The social culture of NSUT helps everyone grow into a better person. The library is full of books with helpful staff but the timings of the library are restricted which I believe can be changed. The sports culture is active enough to get engaged in it.The fee structure of the university is not that good. It is quite expensive but the government administrative process is good that helps students who're facing a financial crisis. 
There are various scholarships in our university for such students as CVSPK.

Name: Sayan Mandal
review:
I choose this course because a different type of subject includes this course which is a combination of science and arts. 
The student ratio is an average of 40 out of 100 students. 
2 semesters are in a year, and exams are also held 3 times in a semester. 2 internal and 1 main exam.Studying fees is normal to this level I mean graduation level. Fees structure is admission fees for every semester (6 semesters in 3 years), University fees before every exam. And hostel fees for those who live in a hostel.

Name: Abhishek Agrawal
review: Campus Life is good. The campus is really big and green and the infrastructure is modern. The annual fest is moksha which is held in March. Diverse books are present in the library. Modern sports facilities are present and there is a number of societies to pursue your Passion.This college course was allocated to me at this rank. The faculty-student ratio is good. Faculties are qualified from prestigious colleges and are PhD holders so they have good knowledge in their field. Term exams are difficult they are on time.

Name: Siddhartha Jaiswal
review: Fees is quite high. Being a state funded college but it's fees is quite high. 219000 in first year with 10% increase in each year. Schlorships are provided by delhi government through edistrict. Cost of study and living is quite high but placemenys are too good.I choose the course with my interest. All Faculties are experienced and well educated. In a year two exams are their mid sem and end sems. Also, a class test takes place. The academics are good and the teachers are friendly and the labs are also quite good.

Name: Shivam
review: I have chosen this course because in childhood I have an interest in a mechanical department that's why I choose btech. The qualifications of faculty are high as you expect. Name: Bharat Bhusan Ojha
review: The fee should be low as many scholars can't afford it. Name: K THAHER KHAN
college: Rao Bahadur Y Mahabaleshwarappa Engineering College - [RYMEC]
review: Mechanical engineering is my passion, it like a can discuss a whole day it that's why choose this course. college: Government Jamuna Prasad Verma Post Graduate Arts and Commerce College

review: The course curriculum is industry based and ready. Many programs are conducting in every month for the development of students

Name: Mishi Gupta
review:

Sports staff is not good they don't have much more  games
We have club like Rotaract club, marketing club and many more

Name: Vishal sharma
college: Arya College of Engineering and IT - [ACEIT]
review: in our college there is a lot of annul function like our main and big program is shradhanjli ,  in which there is a lot of state participatent in games, dance, singing and ramp and there is also a price upto 1 lakh and more. and our self APL (arya premium league)cricket tournament and inter college sports also happendedin our college, they provide industrial training from the conching and center you do not have to go to their study center but the faculty is come to our college and provides training according to the time and placement cell provides a company for the internship but first you have to crack the exam.

Name: Jatin singh
review:

Name: shubham kumar
review: Life at a college campus was actually very very great, I joined the cricket tournament and everything was very very good and sports activities were a lot there and we went to the final of the cricket tournament also, got prizes and momentofees structure for my course was around 25k per year for three years and there was e- Kalyan scholarship for OBC and SC/ST students so that they can reimburse their course fees everything was very advanced and professional

Name: ASLAM ALTHAF
review:
I chose this course to develop business acumen and the better job offers that come with the IIM brand 
Being in a classroom of 80, so far I've had 20+ professors take classes in the span of one year. So, decent ratio.
Teaching is case-based a lot of the time. Otherwise, it is lecture-based, sometimes with graded class participation

Term exams are easy to pass with minimal effortStipend offered averages around 1.75L on day 1, 1.5L on day 2, 80k on day 3

Name: Deepak Verma
review: I am studying Computer Engineering at NSUT. The faculty in this department are pretty great and have vast knowledge in the field. They are great mentors doing research and projects. Exams in NSUT may sometime become a headache in the initial semesters as you may face tests and assignments every 2 weeks.The college library provides a wide range of books for academic purposes. NSUT proudly hosts 2 fests in an annual year. First is the inter-college fest - Resonanz and second is the intracultural college fest - Moksha which attracts more than 15,000 people every day and features many well know artists.

Name: Yash
review: The campus Life is awesome. A big and beautiful campus with lush greenery and sports infrastructure. The campus is so big that you cannot see it all on foot. Some parts of the college have ac classrooms with projectors but the others don't. The are various societies handled by students themselves.The fees have now become a bit high if we consider the government college aspect but overall still less than private colleges. The fees add up if you avail hostel. The college provides financial assistance for those who have low family income.

Name: Sarthak Kaushal
review:
Life at MDI is a blend of social, academic, and extracurricular activities. The campus has a vibrant tight-knit- community, which provides students with opportunities to make new friends, develop new skills, and engage in a variety of activities.
It has a lively social scene with a range of clubs and committees which bring students together, these are student-run clubs that anyone can join based on their interest, to develop their passion, and to be a better leader. 
The infrastructure comprises of state of art facilities with equipped resources, ventilated classrooms, lecture halls, a library, etc.The fee structure at MDI varies from 24-30 lakhs, based on the choice of courses.
It offers different scholarships based on students' needs like merit-based scholarships, and need-based scholarships for students with financial needs.
It has a strong network of industry experts and alumni which helps the students to secure better jobs for further financial assistance. Also, students can opt for internships, live projects, etc. for further assistance.
Banks easily give education loans, as MDI is a tier 1 college with high ROI for students.

Name: Yash Das
review:
Yes, many annual fests & activities are done here like annual functions, annual dance competitions, annual singing competitions, annual skills, etc.
The sports section is well managed by the department to get the best physical fitness in ownself.I have chosen this course for the best practice of my knowledge & get skilled full future.
The faculty is good enough for the students to learn things in a good manner.
No, there is not any kind of issue in the exams that happened over there.

Name: ARJUN SUD
review:
I chose this course since I wanted to develop my managerial skills. The course helps through the core areas of management including Marketing, Sales, Strategy management, etc.
The faculties are very much experienced and knowledgeable. The faculties not only teach the bookish langauge, but they also help in taking future decisions according to the understanding of the students. The exam difficulty is moderate and every 4 months we had our semester exams. Almost all the books which the teachers refer to us for notes are available in the library and in good quantity too. I was a part of the Cultural Club, we used to organise events related to Music, Dance, Cooking activities and a lot of other stuff. 
Other than this the campus has all the sports facilities for Football, tennis, volleyball, basketball, snooker, carrom, table tennis, etc.

Name: PALA LAKSHMAN SAI
review:
I choose ECE because of its versatility, it has greater opportunities going forward.
The faculty-student ratio will be around 1:15.
Many faculties are from its and nits and some top universities around the globe and they are quite friendly and teach well.
Exams will be there every 2 months and they're a bit difficult compared to other colleges.From 3rd year 2nd sem, students are eligible for campus placements, and around 150 companies visit every year. Last year the highest package is been 52 LPA and the average package is around 5.8 LPA.
Almost 90 to 95 percent of students will for placed every year. 
I wanted to get into a  good ece core company after my BTech.

review:
This was the best course available at my JEE rank, so I chose this college over my choice of branch.
The faculty-student ratio is about 1:20.
Most of the professors are pretty much well-qualified and experienced. But there is a chunk of young training assistants that are new to the job.
Exam time is the most hectic time of the year, the entire process is very tiresome and very strict.
The evaluation is too strict too.Moksha and INNOVISION are the cultural and technical fest of NSUT.
Conducted in March.
One of the best college experiences is through the fest.
The sports authority in college keeps on hosting regular sports weeks throughout the year.

Name: Hemanth kunar
review: Placements are very excellent almost everyone who clears all the subjects will get the job. Nearly 129 companies visit our university. The highest package is around 42 lpa the average package is 5 LPA almost 95% of students get placed.The fees are asked to be paid at a time. Scholarships are available only for merit students. For financial assistance, students can apply for education loans. Internships are offered in which they will train the students.

Name: Jash Mehta
review:

I chose this course because I wanted to be a good marketer and wanted to learn various extracurricular activities which college provides us and wanted to improve my communication skills.
The qualification of the faculty is very good as they are enough qualified and with great wisdom the interaction in the lecture is interesting.
The exams are an important aspect of any program the difficulty I would say is nominal and subjective for students depending on their preparation.Life at the campus is magnificent the lively and enthusiastic crowd keeps college life way interesting.
The fests like Mirage symphony and many more fests allow students to bring out their best and the involvement of students is the crazy classroom is well equipped with a projector and everything necessary to make students understand the concepts.
Every sport is there in college.
There are various clubs in college such as incubator, club courier development, and rotary club for engagement of students in various activities.

Name: Avinash
review: The college life at SRKR is very memorable and one can collect their bag of memories at the end of the course. Here we are provided with the special programming classes for our course of study which helps the student to score well and get placed in the top company. We are provided with a central library which is big enough to gain a lot of knowledge. And also each department is provided with a departmental library. The annual fest is one of the big events of our college and our college management will celebrate that at the maximum level of their status which will be very grand. We also conduct many of the sports events on the time of the annual day and also for the general events. Here we have special Executive body member groups for each department who are responsible for all the events of the department and also they may conduct many events for the students. Overall we can enjoy ourselves a lot at this college.As I am interested in computers and hacking I choose computer science and engineering to get a good position in my life and nowadays Computer Science has a lot of demand. So, I choose these courses. The college faculty is very talented and highly graduated. Their teaching way is very interesting and the average student also can understand clearly. Exams are based on semesters each semester has 2 mids and each year has 2 semesters and the total course has 8 semesters and 16 mids, Easy to pass exams if we work hard and listen to what the teachers say and listen to the class.

Name: Ayush Anand
review: This course is highly productive. You will never be seating like an unemployed person. I choose this course because it increases your attitude it gives you some extra knowledge about tourism and the hotel industry. If you are interested in travelling and want to job out of India then this course is very good. The qualification of staff is they do M.sc after their completing of a bachelor degree. The teaching style of the teacher is very unique and quite good. Two exams will take place in a year one is an internal exam or mid-semester exam and the other is an End semester exam. It's very easy to pass the exam you just have to give some time on your study daily.The course is only for 3 years. The fee structure is not so high you will just have to give 40 to 50 thousand rupees every semester. The campus selection is 100 per cent. The college also sends you for your industrial training and in your training, you will also get a stipend for your job. How much stipend you get is depend upon the hotel in which you are going to complete your training

Name: Vinay Verma
college: IIT Roorkee - Indian Institute of Technology - [IITR]
review:
Annual Cultural Fest- Thomso ( conducted in October)
Annual Technical Fest- Cognizance (conducted in march)

The campus of IIFT Delhi is located in the heart of South Delhi in Qutab Institutional Area with many B-schools, IIT Delhi, JNU, DU, NCERT, etc. nearby. Hauz Khaas is very near the college premises and students go there during weekends for parties and get-togethers. The campus and nearby area are full of greenery with Sanjay Van located beside the institute. 
Although the infrastructure is a bit old but very beautifully made with all the necessary amenities like High-Speed Wifi, Projector, and Smart Classrooms, ACs, etc. The library is one of the biggest among B-Schools with the presence of the WTO Study Center and Bloomberg Terminals. 
Quo Vadis is the annual Cultural and management tech fest organized in February with many management and cultural competitions in which students from various B-Schools take part. Aside from that many other Fests and Initiatives happen regularly such as Trade Winds Annual Summits, Adrenaline (Sports Fest), TEDx, etc. that keep the students engaged.First-year students sit for a summer internship from September onwards and the summer placements are usually 2-3 weeks long while the Final Placements occur in the month of November & December lasting for 2-3 weeks as well.
Many of the big names in Finance, Marketing, Operations, Trade & Consulting such as JPMC, Goldman Sachs, Mckinsey, BCG, Accenture Strategy, HUL, Dabur, Marico, Mars, ETG, Cargill, etc. come regularly for Summer and Final Placements and are regarded as Legacy Recruiter.
Placements have consistently been 100% with statistics for 21-23 batch final placements as 29.1 Lacs Average CTC and 85.4 Lacs Highest CTC. The placement Report can be accessed at the institute's website and Linkedin Handle. Placements are comparable to some of the best Tier-1 B-Schools in the country

Name: SOMYA SINGH
review: I chose this course because of the pedagogy of the college. The faculty: student ratio of BIMTECH is 1:60 approximately. The faculty here are very qualified, most of them are experts from different business domains and are Ph.D. holders in different fields. A practical approach to teaching is used by the faculties of BIMTECH. They are very cooperative and provide students with proper guidance. Students are given many field projects to give them an experience in the market and business. In total, the curriculum is divided into 6 trimesters and after every trimester an end term is held, apart from that, the internal assessment also takes place within the trimester itself. Apart from the faculty, there are many guest lectures arranged where experts from the corporate world come to guide students in different business domains. subjects like data analytics and digital business are also a part of BIMTECH's curriculum. in all, students have a lot to grasp through the opportunities providededThe college campus is pretty decent, all the basic amenities like a gym and a beauty parlor are available within the campus, and there is a cafeteria on the campus, along with a general store where all essential need items are available. the college library is quite good, it has books of all genres available. The classrooms have centralized AC, and the college also organizes the annual cultural fest, apart from that there are various clubs and conduits which make students develop interpersonal skills and they are all student-driven. College also provides different sports. The campus has a badminton court, Volleyball, and basketball court. The hostels are also situated inside the campus.

Name: Shaurya Srivastava
college: Prin. L. N. Welingkar Institute of Management Development & Research - [WeSchool]
review:
There has not been a fest so far. Although events corresponding with different batches are conducted now and then. All in all, life is good, there is a lot more to explore outside college than inside due to the limited space. There is a game room and a gym which facilitates fun. 
The library to my knowledge is well equipped with books and there is an E-library login access that is given to students, in addition to this teachers provide PDFs of whatever they teach so in that sense I would say reading resources are plenty.
Classrooms have air conditioning and lighting, plus a master board and whiteboards. there is a small stage that the faculty uses along with the podium.
There are not many clubs here but I have heard that if you can justify the need of having one, you can apply for the formation of a club. Sports events news is circulated by students in all the groups and interested people can join in. There is a TT table, carrom and billiards in the game room.I applied for 4 courses, out of which I was shortlisted for 2 (BD & RM). Out of the 2, I picked RM because I am interested in marketing, and when I went through the course curriculum (available on the website) it interested me enough to apply. the subjects listed were very interesting. There have been about 12 subjects each trim so far and they have been taught by permanent as well as visiting faculties. I would say that the faculty-to-student ratio is fair and doubts get cleared even if the class is a bit much with 62 students. Almost all faculties are either people who are or were working in the corporate world. And all of them are Ph.D. with industry knowledge. The term exams were conducted after just 2.5 months and just after the inter assessments, therefore it was a little hectic. Passing the exams was of moderate difficulty, if one studies it was not very tough to crack.

Name: Shomyo Jyoti Roy
review: The course is the best that any B-school can offer, with systems from all domains in the first two terms to give a strong foundation for budding managers; the first month of the course is Foundation term, where the basics of each subject are brushed upon to bring all students to the same level. The faculty-to-student ratio is reasonable at about 1:60. Since IMT is AACSB accredited, the curriculum and subjects are rigorously updated to keep up with industry requirements. This enables the students to be good performers in whatever company they join. The faculty is highly qualified and is a mix of industry experts who have been working for many years in different industries and professors who have been teaching since their PHDs. The exams are timed accurately with no gap to have any relaxation; the whole academic routine is designed to keep the students busy with different activities throughout the two years and the exams are moderate owing to students if they study enough, they are sure.The annual fest is Passion; it is conducted in December. There is also a significant event by the sports committee, the Chakravyuh, a sports event inviting all the alums from past years and other colleges too. It is the biggest sports event across the country at the B-School level. The library is exhaustive and has several latest journals and books. Also, there is an e-library to scourge through books and take help from online resources that the library has tied up with like The Ken, Statista, and the CRISIl. The classrooms are equipped with good quality desks and revolving chairs with sockets under for laptop connectivity; the wifi is decent and has campus-wide connectivity. There is a whiteboard and blackboard for the teachers and a projector with a dedicated classroom desktop system for easy access to teaching resources. The teacher also has a hospitality staff on each floor for light snacks and hot beverages. There are in total 21 clubs and committees with different roles to play.

There is an inter-college sports competition, which greatly enhances physical activity among students. No clubs other than sports club is present here.I choose this course because English is the need of the hour nowadays, and I want to excel in it. The faculty-to-student ratio stands at 1:50. Most of the faculties are having the highest degree of post-graduation. But the ground reality is that there is a need to improve their teaching methods as some of the teachers are not capable of delivering concepts smoothly. Exams are not all time, but they are on an easy to a moderate level which you can easily pass.

Name: Ankit Raj
review: Campus Life at NIT Jsr is one of the best. The campus size is 350 acres occupied with an academic building, hostels, library, playground, etc. The academic building includes classrooms fully furnished with smartboards and LAN facilities. In the first year, students start exploring things in different domains like core, noncore, analytics, sports activities, etc. Sports fest URJA is conducted between Aug-Nov and includes all types of sports and then a cultural fest CULFEST is organized between Nov-Feb. A variety of books are available in the library and also some researches by professors are available. There are clubs available for every talent you have, rather it is singing, dancing, making cars, writing poems, etc. There are many clubs run by students like Drift for electric vehicles, LDS for literature, etc.The fee structure is slightly on the higher side if you compare other NITs. Here for one semester, you have to pay 108000 including all things. There is a hike of 5000 in fees this year. The fee includes 62500 as tuition fee and the rest includes the hostel fee, bus, library, water, electricity, etc. There is a provision for financially weak students. Students having income between 1 and 5 lakhs per annum have to pay 1/3 of the tuition fee and those who have less than 1 lakh per annum enjoy full tuition fee remission. Scholarships are also guaranteed under different government schemes like E-Kalyan. On campus, there are many jobs available like an assistant professor, lab assistant, machine operator, researcher, etc.

review: The infrastructure is excellent and the campus is eco-friendly, there are clubs on our campus to enrich the knowledge and give some webinars about the current trending courses and there are many sports activities.The fee structure is completely fair and there is a scholarship for the marks obtained in JEE main exam and other sports activities. The campus jobs are excellent in our college the average annual pack is 600000.

Name: SOUMYA JHA
review:
I was a commerce student in school and I decided to opt for BBA because this field interests me. My course commenced in December 2020. As my college used to run online mode due to the pandemic, I had a little bit of difficulty adjusting to the mode. But while being in online mode, all important notes and study material were provided to us by our teachers. They also used to try to make the classes more interesting through presentations and activities. 3 initial semesters out of the 6 were spent via online mode. Then, the Government permitted universities to reopen colleges which was a very happy moment because the offline mode of education teaches much more than just academics. On 14th February 2022, we attended college for the first time in our 4th semester. The faculty was helpful and lenient as students were trying to adjust to the offline mode yet again. The teaching method used by the faculty was perfectly paced and explanatory. Regular class tests were taken. Exams were regular.Life at campus at Maharaja Surajmal Institute is very good. Every week there is some or the other event conducted in the auditorium. Many of them are educational while others are just fun activities. Our college also hosted a Diwali fest for our college students only. It was one of the best memories i have made till now. 
There are many societies in our college. Enactus, Ecell, Sifar, Octave are to name a few. The societies cover all fields like fashion, music, dance, theatre, business, social work, self defense, etc.
The libraries have perfect reading spots and have decent variety of curriculum books. Book bank facility is also there in my college.

A very 21-day sessional exam will be held in college.

Name: Sai Sambit Dash
review:
XIMB spends heavily on its library and resources. Many research and other information websites are made available to students through the college portal. 
Annual fest ie Xpressions is conducted in the month of February. There is a Business Excellence Summit as well in the month of October. These are 3 day long events with many business and cultural activities on campus.
The classrooms are well maintained and are well equipped with modern facilities. 
Sports and extracurriculars are also a major part of campus life. Ample opportunities to participate in sports events are present. There are courts for badminton, lawn tennis, volleyball, and basketball.
There are 13 committees that are managed and run by students. One can choose committees based on their interest and actively participate in events organized by the same throughout the year. 
Life is very happening on campus and sometimes sleep becomes the cost for it.I chose the course because of the curriculum. I discussed it with some alums who are friends with my relatives. The program demands a lot but also helps you to develop in many aspects. The rigor helps you develop a sense of discipline and responsibility. The alum base of XIMB is very extensive. 
There are many permanent as well as guest faculties. Faculties are appointed to students as advisors.6-7 students have one faculty as their academic advisor.
Most faculties have Ph.D. from old iims (mostly A B C), and some faculties are seasoned industry experts. They help to get a real-life perspective of the classroom concepts.
The term exams are scheduled every 3 months. The term exams are always done on time and are very rigorous. It is not hard but I won't say it is easy to pass the papers either.

Name: Sai Sambit Dash
review:

Name: Student (Anonymous)
college: Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT Bombay - [SJMSOM]
review:
I had work experience in supply chain and wanted to pursue my career in the operations domain. SJMSOM is known best for its operations. For operations, they have highly experienced faculty. For other subjects as well faculty are highly qualified with master's, and Ph.D. from foreign universities. The student-to-faculty ratio is approximately 10:2, Teaching methodology varies from prof to prof but mostly all faculty follow case-based teaching, putting us into the shoes of managers and making us learn to think like a manager through different cases and examples.
In one semester there are two terms, each term has one midterm and one end sem examination. Apart from this regular presentations and assignments. But still, the curriculum is not very hectic, we can manage to have spare time left after classes and assignments and it's not very difficult to pass the examinations.Campus life is the main plus point of SJMSOM, We get the leverage of the IITB ecosystem, a beautiful, serene  545 acres of campus with a lake and hills inside the campus.
All IITB infrastructure, Libraries are accessible to us. We can enjoy IITB Tech fests, and Cultural fests (MOOD-Indigo).SJMSOM has its own festival Avenues, Diksha series, and Continuums -Where distinguished industry experts from different domains of industries are invited as speakers to share their learnings and experience with students. Alumni meet is conducted every year. Sports facilities are also there, SOM has its own sports club and festival, Prithvi.
Students run different clubs and committees  related to domains- OPERA, Finesse, Consig, Prodigy, Systematics, Matrix, etc

Name: Ritik Jain
college: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology University - [JIIT]
review:
Placements start from the 7th semester and go till the 8th semester. Many companies visit the campus for placements, some of the key recruiters include Reliance Jio, Optum, Oracle, Morgan Stanley, Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Tower Research Capital, GreyB Research, Procol, Futurefirst, Inframarket, Biz2Credit, etc. 
220+ companies visited the campus in the year 2022 and more than 1400 offers were made.
The highest package was 1.15Cr by Amazon EMEA and the average package was 11.01LPA. Generally these companies come for Software profiles or Data analysts. But there are other companies as well which come for the ECE and Business An, analyst domains. Above 99% of placements were recorded in the year 2022.
My plan as of now is to work in the corporate sector and if it goes well then will look for other options as well.There are separate fests held at both campuses of JIIT. Converge being the biggest fest of Sector-128 is organized around the month of November. At sector 62 Impressions is organized which is again a big party held annually. The college has a huge library on two floors containing books in every section. Classrooms are well equipped with AC and smart class. Sports at Sector 62 are not up to the mark but yes there are good opportunities at Sector 128.
There are a lot of clubs and societies at the college which are really helpful for personal development. For eg. Knuth (Programming Hub), Nrityang (Dance), Surkhaab (Bhangra), Crescendo (Music), MuCR (Electronics), etc.

Name: Amandeep Singh
review: Campus life is as enjoyable as it can be. We have an annual event called Passion, which this year ended on December 12th. We also have Chakravyuh, which will be held between February 10 and 12 and is kind of like the Olympics for business schools. We also have about 20 to 21 clubs and committees, including the student council, The Eye, the admissions committee, the academic committee, and the student government. The BGS committee, Mark-up, alumni relations committee, and many others organize a variety of festivals and events on our campus, including open mic nights, the marketing world cup, and too many others to list. We also have the IMT G library, where you can choose from thousands of books on a wide range of topics. This library also receives new arrivals of books on newly updated topics in a wide range of fields. Our classroom can accommodate between 60 and 65 students at once so that teachers can interact with each and every student.Since IMT G is regarded as the mecca of marketing, I had an interest in it and decided to pursue it even before I enrolled in this college. We have world-class faculty and a faculty-to-student ratio of 1:15, so it makes sense that we would have a good mix of faculty and students to allay our concerns, both academic and otherwise. Most of the faculty have advanced degrees in business, such as an MBA from a prestigious IIM or a Ph.D. in a business-related field, so they are all knowledgeable in whatever subject they teach. and in addition to that, they have rich professional experience that enables them to give us accurate insights on any given subject.

review: The curriculum contains tough and very unique. During 1st year all the subjects will be common for all the technology students and chemical engineering. Most of the paint technology and surface coating subjects are covered during the final year (4th) of B.Tech. The learning methodology is purely based on practical experiments in chemical engineering and paint technology. During 4 years of my journey of B. Tech Surface coating technology, we have learned all of the subjects of chemical engineering in detail (except Transport Phenomenon and Mass Transfer - II). Along with chemical engineering 8 more subjects are compulsory for every technology. All 8 subjects will teach you practical and theoretical about paint technology right from pigment, resin, solvents and additives to the final paint preparation application, properties, testing, etc. The course contains one full-time internship of 2 months.The paint manufacturers such as Asian paints, Berger paints, Nerolac paints, and Axalta coatings offer roles in research & development and manufacturing. Also, vehicle manufacturers such as Tata motors, Mahindra vehicles manufacturers, FIAT, etc in paint shops and given a project on improvement online. The internship will teach more practical & industrial knowledge to the candidate. Manufacturing trainees will learn the manufacturing process of the paint, departmental works for all the departments and basic knowledge about the factory. Paint shop trainees will learn the different paint application methods in the paint shops, application processes, detailed knowledge of paint-shop processes, etc. Trainees will actually see the robotic & manual paintings. Whereas R&D trainees will be given training over paint formulation concepts such as PHR ratio, P: B ratio, shade matching, knowledge of colour values, grinding, pilot batches, etc. Most of the trainees do not get a stipend here.

college: Prestige Institute of Management and Research - [PIMR]

Name: Sai Nihal
review: I chose a computer science and engineering course(CSE) and more particularly a specialization in it i.e, artificial intelligence and machine learning(AIML). As Artificial intelligence is becoming the future now, I thought it will give me a good scope for the future and a good standard of living, so I opted for that course. We have 6 to 7 subjects for each semester. And each subject has a faculty. If the subject is about programming languages, then we have lab faculties too to guide each subject. More precisely, we have 3:66 faculty: student ratio mostly even though it depends on the subjects they are teaching. Faculty are well qualified to teach that subject, some have done PhDs, and masters in those particular fields that they are teaching. They explain theory topics in the class and explain programming topics in the lab. They make us practice programming languages in the lab. For every 5 months, there will be a semester exam and it's not that difficult to pass if we study well the topicsThe fee for 1 year is 1,07,00rs. But if you joined the college through an entrance exam conducted by the state government and if you are eligible for reimbursement, then you can get 35,000rs reimbursement which will be added directly to your college fee. College provides some scholarship opportunities and brings some companies to college to assist us in financial, job and scholarship ways.

Name: Student (Anonymous)
review:
I was getting only this course at my rank 
The student-faculty ratio is about 1:8, you can find so many phD Holders taking tutorials classes formally but they don't even come to class not even for attendance.
All the faculties here are PhD holders and one of the best in their field and most of them have done PhD from REC Kurukshetra (NIT KKR) Itself, especially the old ones. Their teaching method is not so modern but very classy, they just stick to the syllabus and not to the industrial exposure also they didn't give any attention whether you are studying or playing Games in class they just need your attendance otherwise they will detain you.
Term exams are held on a uniform basis every month we can say. As there is a semester of 4-5 months, you have to give 2 Mid-semester exams and One end sem exam and the overall CGPA depends on both of these scores. You can easily pass the exam but for scoring well you have to study really hard coz they didn't give you marks but will pass easily.There are two major fests of college are TEchspradha and Confluence in this both an average celebrity is called and he will perform according to their interest like last time aman dhattarwal and Ash King was called and also there is some cultural fest in the college itself so it's not so bad but relatively less fest happens in this college.
Almost all the books for your course will be available in the college.
All the classrooms are AC and in the electrical block, you also have a projector also in LHC as well.
Sports facilities are not so gut like tennis and Football facilities are very bad Also the swimming pool is closed for the last 3 years.

Name: Ankit Ranjan
review: Campus life is very Engaging. The cultural committee of the college conducts an annual fest Dhruva in the month of January. The college also conducts an annual business conclave and a leadership conclave namely Nishtha and Daksha in the months of December and September respectively. IIM Trichy has one of the best libraries in the country. The library is equipped with all the modern amenities, journals, research articles and books. The classrooms are designed based on the Harvard classroom designs and have all the necessary amenities. The college caters to all the sports needs of the students by providing them with all the necessary courts and grounds for all sports. The campus even has a swimming pool with a jacuzzi.The placements in the college are pretty decent and they are improving year after year. The placements are handled by the placement team and they make sure that the placements process goes on smoothly. More than 120 companies visit the campus for placements and the roles offered are very diverse. The name of the companies and the no of offers they made cannot be disclosed due to the policies of the placement team. The average package was around 17 lakhs CTC, but this year it has increased to around 19 lakhs ctc. For the summer placements, the students become eligible from term 1 itself and for the final placement students are eligible from term 4. 100% of the batch gets placed during the placement process.

Name: Sai varshith
review: The college provides placements and quite a no of companies to reach out to the college for the recruitment process. Here campus life is worth having it.  A few events also happen which include the annual fest.  Fests events were handled by students only and are quite enjoyable

Name: Kunal
review: Life here at SIBM Bangalore is full of rigour. We have 10 committees and 10 clubs here on campus. The infrastructure of the college is good with all the basic amenities like Gym, Basketball Court, Badminton, and other indoor games. Also, the Library here is huge with books available across all domains.Companies like JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, Dell, MTR, ITC, Adobe, Dalmia Group and Decathlon visited our campus for the Summer Internship Program. Name: navneet kumar singh
review: I choose this course because I have done diploma in plastic engineering from cipet Aurangabad so I have to do be but not in plastic because it's not a very big thing to keep on studying so I decided to go for chemical engineering but it feels like I have taken a wrong decision because I am unable to correlate with the subjects.Many companies came for internships in our college mostly when the students got placed in some company so the company only offer them internships it's not a very big issue to get the internship. But still, if any company didn't give internships so college provides internships for everyone.

Name: Ayush Maikhuri
review:
Because it is better than most of the baby and new iims + it offers a general MBA in business management which helps you give a holistic and not specific industry knowledge at the same time giving choices to do majors and minors or even double majors. is a residential program and the rigour is the most real
Faculty to students ratio is 60:1 during classes and students have been assigned teachers as mentors in a ratio of 15:1
All the teachers are PhDs, have good industry work experience, (some lecturers are important to the state finance suggestions and decisions), and many of them publish research papers regularly and also books on the subjects
The term exams are fairly moderate but the checking is very tough the toppers score around 8 points, and there are quizzes midterms and end-term examinations throughout, having a trimester systemThe college has many events like Xpressions which is very big and happens in January also there are many legacy events that happen as well as cultural and festive events. There are many competitive events that happen throughout from section rivalry to block and batch rivalry, we have a tennis court, indoor badminton, gym, cricket nets, pool etc

Name: Kuldeep kori
college: University Institute of Technology, Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya - [UIT- RGPV]
review: Rgpv Bhopal has one of the best campus life. There are minimal restrictions. Students and seniors are very friendly, no ragging in the college. Many clubs are present in the college like E-Cell, GDSC, etc. Our college has a well-stocked library with every thing available, free wifi is available in the library. Classrooms have projectors installed. Sports facilities are available for everyone. The college has a sports complex.College does not have good placement opportunities. The highest package is 18 lpa and the average package is 4.5 lpa. From the 5th semester students are eligible for placements. The placement percentage is not good. Students after completing their graduation opt for off-campus placements or for higher studies.

Name: DEBSRUTI DASGUPTA
review: Life at the campus is very lively, The annual fest is named Xpressions, and this year, the campus celebrated the 25th year of the fest. Xpressions were conducted in mid-January. The library is very well stocked with various business books as well as research articles from various faculties. There is a Bloomberg lab in the library as well. There is a dedicated committee for Sports as well as all interest areas like cultural events, photography, etc. conduct regular events for engaging the students.XIMB 's MBA program is among the top 20 in the country and there is a very strong alumni network in the college. Faculty to studio ratio is about 1:12. The faculty are highly qualified with most of them having Ph.D. degrees along with several years of corporate experience. Term exams are very timely and efficiently conducted.

Name: Sanjana
college: HI-Tech Institute of Engineering and Technology - [HIET]
review: I choose this course because I am interested in learning new technology and this course is provided the relationship between me and technology computers I am always willing to learn and setup up new things so this is the best way for the path, faculty is good in my college and also supportive and taking about the student so there are the 150 students in this course and very competitive students, the qualifications of faculty are excellent and also a method of teaching is good. Name: Sahilhusain Zakirhusain Shaikh
review: IMT is known for its tagline "IMT never sleeps". It is a very lively environment at IMT at late night as well we can see people playing sports, indoors and outdoors and people studying in the library or doing projects and assignments in groups. There are a lot of clubs and committees which are solely driven by students and they organize a lot of events that are very engaging and maintain a festive environment throughout the year. There is a gym facility and all sporting facilities and equipment are present and working.Fees are comparatively lesser than other institutes and there is a scholarship and fee assistance for eligible people, details of which are available on the website. The cost to study is very affordable and there are no separate hostel fees it is included in the total fees only.
